CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Wow, you've got it worse than me, and I'm an idol. Here I thought my schedule was rough... Alright, cross this out, and this out... Don't thank me, you've gotta rest hard to work hard!

Back in my debut days, I had to print my own posters, alter my own outfits, do everything myself to save money. But I mean, that taught me a bunch of practical skills, so... Hehe, look here, I embroidered a little finbeast into my own work sleeve. Isn't it super cute?

This pudding looks so good... My agency never used to let me eat pudding, but no one can stop me now—no, think healthy, Haruka, you've had enough sugar already—Doc, that's not an invite to eat it for me!

When I was growing up, adults loved to feed me ghost stories, so that stuff has always terrified me. And now ever since my debut, horror movies keep casting me 'cause they like how real my screams are... Mattaku-mou, that's the one thing I don't need validation for!

Rhodes Island is really good at coverups. It's been days and the gossip rags still haven't hunted me down... Wait. I haven't faded away, have I? There's no way I'm old news already! Oh, this is bad, I'm gonna head back tomorrow!

This photo's from after we wrapped my first movie, I'm posing here with all the locals. Yeah, in Kajimachi... Maybe once I've hit up enough cities, held enough performances, then I'll catch sight of them again one day, somewhere in my sea of cheering fans. That's what I believe.

Finbeasts are so cute, seriously. I love the gold glittering ornamental ones. Putting them in those little bags of water, holding them up to the sun, watching them blow out bubbles. Like this, *pop*, *pop*—blah, I can't talk and pout at the same time!

Last night, I dreamt I was on a cushion of bubbles lifting me into the sky, and I could see home fall further away with every gust. And it was like, I know I'm gonna fall eventually, but it's so pretty up here in the sky, so I had to keep on flying and flying, as hard as I could, even if at some point I was just blowing the bubbles myself... 'cause I wanna keep flying.

My memory's never been that good, but the nerves I get from being in front of my bosses make my head go white. But technically, you're my boss too, right? So I wonder why you don't make me... um! I mean, what I mean to say is, don't start intimidating me or anything, 'cause I'll... I'll, uh—I might, um... sorry, what I was gonna, uh... *groan*...
C'mon, fall asleep already... I won't feel hungry while I'm asleep... This is so unfair, how come the Doc conks out so easily?!

Wait, okay, so a friend recommended me here, but before I sign anything, just let me read these contracts—okay, no crazy long-terms, no outrageous penalty fees... Doesn't look like a black company to me. Great, I'm ready to sign!
Maybe we could mix a few of my concert tapes into this... Hey, wait, at least think about it!

I can't believe how fast the promotion track here is! I took forever to go from training to debut, and I had to pay the agency for my classes the whole time… Ugh... When can Rhodes Island get into the idol biz?
Now I can finally work alongside Hoshiguma! She helped me out so much back in Mitsukue, and I'm gonna make sure I don't drag her down anymore!
Huh?! But idols need years of training just to go onstage! I don't have nearly enough combat hours to... A—Are you really sending me in?
I dunno about commanding people, I think I'm more of a morale booster...
Doctor, what do I do if my legs are shaking...?
Doctor, there's, there's enemies!
Last step of battlefield prep—deep breaths, in, in, in!
Do we have time to go over combat techniques again...?
I—I'll try and keep my eyes open!
If I make it back in one piece, I win...
Iai-giri! Wait, that's not a sword—aw, whatever, take this!
If I'm dead anyway, I'm taking you with me!
My idol image? Who gives a crap about that right now!
I've been in plenty of events, but this is the most chaotic venue ever!
Doctor, gimme a copy of the combat log for this, I'm gonna clip it for my personal promo! Heheh, Battle Diva Momoka, isn't that so cool!
Look, I know this was our hard-earned collective victory and everything, but, um, Doctor, did I take out any enemies by myself? Just show me which ones!
I guess I can't just shut my eyes and flail my weapon around... I didn't hit anyone I wasn't supposed to, right?
Ngh... screw it, I'm going for broke! D—Doctor, I'm gonna—hold the rear!!!
This room is spacious! Look how high my bubbles go!
Wah! Don't sneak up on me like that!
Is the bow on my back straight?
Arknights.

New Year's is usually my busiest period, but I figured this year I'd break the mold to come see you and Hoshiguma. Feels weird to wish blessings on people and stuff when you're not face to face—hey, I'm kidding, I turned down a lot of good work opportunities to visit Rhodes Island! Couldn't you act a little happier?!
Hi, Doctor! I just had the cuuuuuutest encounter, you wanna hear?

Here's some accessories I made myself, and omiyage from my tour stops, and then there's a letter at the bottom... Why do I know your birthday? Well, I—I only just found out yesterday, that's why all of this is so on-the-fly... You know I have a bad memory.

On this day of Rhodes Island celebration, I bring some news from Higashi—everything's fine in Mitsukue, and other cities have been sending me offers to perform lately, including you. Doctor, do you think we'll be sharing the good times like this at next year's party?

handbook.profile: Haruka, born Haruka Shino, is a well-known entertainer in the Southern Court of Higashi, performing under the stage name Momoka Hanyuu. She was recommended to Rhodes Island by Operator Hoshiguma and acts as liaison between Rhodes Island and Higashi. She is being assigned to a number of field missions at her own request.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Haruka shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.11u/L
Operator Haruka rarely comes into contact with Originium, thanks to a combination of coincidence and acts of kindness.

Additionally, we have noted that Haruka's dietary habits are not particularly healthy, even when not judged by Operator Hibiscus's standards. To put it simply, her calorie intake is insufficient and mostly comes from processed foods.

She gladly accepted our advice, though she was briefly dejected to learn that she would have to limit her sugar intake. Nevertheless, she has adhered to our dietary recommendations, even developing the hobby of watching others eat desserts.
You're stronger. That's much better. Besides, your clothes still fit fine!
—Gavial
handbook.promotionRecord:
It's the economy, you fool, e-co-no-my. Everything is in the name of the economy. That's what modern Higashi is all about, no exceptions. Nothing's a problem as long as the numbers keep going up. Don't believe me? Then name an exception, I dare you.
The yakuza? Where do you even find real yakuza these days? All they do is stroll through their factories watching workers put conductive paint on components.
Kaidan? Kami? You've got to be kidding me. How much time do you think has passed since the Kinsekikai Incident? Who's stepped forward to speak the truth, other than that dumb idol? The public loves kaidan. It makes them feel something, which means it makes money.
The Eight Clans? What do you think they are, some invincible monsters bound by intricate blood ties? Maybe Mitsumoto and Kougon, but other than those two... Hmph. Let me give you an example. So many kugyou, even the Sumeragimi himself, wrote songs and poems to praise the impressive appearance of the head of Kurogo, all about his impressive frame and plumes. But look at the current head. A short, balding old man with flat ear feathers, whose only talent is that every coin that leaves his hand comes back five-fold. Who cares if he was a retainer, an adopted son-in-law, or just a merchant who assumed the name? As long as the money keeps coming in, the clan will find a way to put him where he works best.
Pollution? Compensation? Are you a child? Have you never thought about how much room there is to manipulate the compensation amount? Who are the true victims, and who are just greedy opportunists trying to profit off a tragedy by pretending to be sick? Give public opinion a little nudge, and they'll instantly decide who are the latter, and paint them in an even worse light than those who actually caused the pollution in the first place. All that matters is that the chemical factories must never stop running! The Originium appliances we're so proud of need their casings, after all. Besides, how are those people supposed to make a living? Move away, change their names? Maybe to nearby Isazaki, maybe to Mitsukue, changing their name from Tsukushino to Shino to hide their Gokawa origins... Like I said, they don't need us worrying about them. It's when the factories stop running that they starve.
—A Higashinese dignitary who came to Rhodes Island to seek treatment, berating his secretary

When Haruka overheard this conversation, she angrily charged into the room, but could not find the words to rebut him.

'I know that what he said was... The more I saw, the more I learned. I'm in no position to go against that man, or even the man he was yelling at. But...
'I promised my fans I'd dedicate the bubbles of my next performance to the saddest person that day, so that they could carry that person into the air to see the bustling cities, the distant sky, the barren land... I have to go back, even if only for that promise.'
That afternoon, Haruka set off for Higashi. The above is what she told us when an operator asked her to stay.
archives:
Many operators have a hard time deciding on a code name, but Haruka's experience was particularly unusual. She originally came at the recommendation of Hoshiguma under the name Momoka, and asked to be called by that name at first. However, after reading Rhodes Island's contract and listening to the explanations of HR, Medical and Utage, who was just passing by and suddenly felt like checking on the newbies (and Kirara, whom Utage had dragged along), she bacame not so sure about using her stage name. Eventually, she settled on Haruka, the name she was given at birth. Nevertheless, she instinctively signed her contract with her well-designed 'Momoka Hanyuu' signature before being reminded by a Higashinese-speaking HR operator, at which point she gave a bashful smile and wrote down the name 'Haruka', slowly and carefully.
She told us that, if Rhodes Island was indeed the kind of place she perceived it to be, she wanted to try living here as Haruka Shino, and not as Momoka Hanyuu.
Still, she has no intention of cutting herself off from her Momoka persona. She gladly gives autographs to anyone who recognizes her, hums her own songs, instinctively gets into character when comforting children receiving treatment, and is still easily scared by stories of the paranormal, just like the Momoka Hanyuu known throughout Higashi.

I'm sorry, I won't do it again.
—Annie, apologizing to Haruka after giving her a fright.

I'm sorry, I won't do it again.
—Bena, apologizing to Haruka after giving her a fright, at Annie's insistence.

I-I'm fine, Kirara told me you're all r-really good kids...
—Haruka, pale as a sheet, trying to collect herself after the fright.

Haruka demonstrated an affinity for water-related Arts during her onboarding test. She carries bubble water with her and enjoys blowing bubbles, especially when she is in a particularly good mood, or a particularly bad mood. The bubble water itself is entirely ordinary, but the bubbles she makes are remarkably colorful and long-lasting, and her Arts are also only maximally effective when expressed in the form of bubbles. Her talents in this regard are not exceptional, but impressively flexible and able to play a unique role in combat. She has given some of her Arts the names of her past songs and albums.
Under extreme emotional conditions, she occasionally demonstrates remarkable performance in melee, but this is entirely unpredictable. She has been seen using the Higashinese Form of Kasumi, Leithanian zweihander swordplay, and even Yanese sword-dance, but all without any subtlety. Once, as she cleaves through a poor dummy target with a picture of some ninja stuck to it with a wooden sword, all the instructors have the same question...

How did she learn that hodgepodge of styles?
—Dobermann

After the emotions pass, however, she can no longer recreate the same forms, or swing with the same speed and sureness. In her own words, she has always been prone to forgetting things when anxious, and she remembers little about the moves she learned as an actress. She had only performed the techniques subconsciously because of the memories that photo brought back.
The examiners lament that any talent Haruka may have had was buried so deeply by life that there was no way to excavate it, even in mortal danger. She only shows a sliver of it in fits of rage.
With her role defined as a supporter using Arts, Haruka enthusiastically went through Originium Arts training without complaining even once, leaving a deep impression on everyone. Her mic has been installed with an Arts unit for easier use. For her, however, the best part is that she no longer has to rely on bubble water to make colorful bubbles.

When she first joined Rhodes Island, Haruka frequently visited pet-owning operators. They all fascinated her, from common pets like fowlbeasts and cloudbeasts to more unusual ones like metal crabs and sandbeasts, even the plants in the Convalescent Garden. She could spend a whole afternoon staring at them, but would always recoil and shake her head when invited to pet the fluffy (and less fluffy) little ones, or at the suggestion that she try raising one herself.
Perfumer managed to coax the reason out of her with a cup of floral tea, a few cookies, and some aroma oil. Even though she was no longer under the oppressive management of her former agency, she dared not be responsible for any living thing, not after her last pet died—an electronic one. Not to mention the difficulty of raising a pet while traveling back and forth between Higashi and Rhodes Island.
After listening to Haruka's concerns, Perfumer picked a plant from the garden that was the same species as Hasuke, made her take it, and spent an afternoon teaching her how to take care of it properly, all while Haruka kept careful notes even as she voiced her reluctance. She eventually agreed to take the plant back to Higashi with her.
The Convalescent Garden started receiving regular updates from Haruka about the plant, complete with photos. It took a little while for it to adjust to Higashi, but it survived, and is now thriving.
Today, Haruka still spends a lot of time with other operators' pets, but she no longer keeps her distance. She makes bubbles out of thin air, and Beanstalk takes photos from the side while her metal crabs try to poke them with their pincers...

Hey, can I get a copy of those photos?
—Closure

Excellent, master, these photos will sell for a good price... Castle-3 entering forced sleep mode.
—Castle-3

Much like the plants she used to keep, Momoka Hanyuu's career struggled in the period after she left the Kinseki Talent Agency.
The public that had expected her to bring back even bigger news was disappointed. Her comeback concert went without a hitch, but there was no kaidan, no dark secrets exposed, not even the sudden appearance of a tall Oni woman. She had been honing her singing and performance skills, and remained as sweet and cute as ever, but she had shed the image of being associated with kaidan.
Her confession on that summer night is widely known, but her antis saw it as abandoning the sinking ship that was the Kinsekikai, while many of those who claimed to be her fans simply treated her as a toy that squeaked whenever she was squeezed by a kaidan. Add her true fans to the fray, and a war of words quickly broke out on the intercity net.
Momoka was inevitably asked about kaidan whenever she appeared on a show or did an interview. Though as timid as ever, she now believes that there is an explanation behind every kaidan, be it the presence of a kami, sheer coincidence, or the intentional work of man. For example, although she was trembling when she accepted an offer by a TV station to investigate the truth behind 'Sawara the Silentious' in Shin-Aki City, she spent a week with the crew in the Saeki district, wandering on the midnight streets. Luckily, nothing out of the ordinary happened, other than running into a thirsty young man who drank all the water they were carrying. This led to another controversy on the intercity net, this time expanding to include Mifune and the Kinseki Group, only for the topic to suddenly go silent when the ownership of Kinseki Group was touched upon. Even Momoka went off the grid for an entire month before she reappeared in public.
Even harder for some people to accept was how she began to draw attention to usually-ignored issues and people, such as the strange illness that plagued her homeland, gamblers who'd lost everything but gambling itself, teenagers who fell into the dark side of society after dropping out of school, victims of land sale scams, etc. She is powerless to change anything at the root of these issues, a fact that she herself knows full well. As such, she never judges. All she hopes is that Higashi, amidst its roaring progress, can spare the time to listen to these voices, even if most consider those distant cries to be irrelevant at best, or annoying at worst.
Momoka Hanyuu's career got back on track as Mitsukue got used to her changes. For Haruka Shino though, the happiest moment was when she received a package after the program where she talked about the strange illness aired. In it was one of her new albums released after going independent, and a photo album her relatives had put together, including photos of her childhood and her parents... and a letter, which she read with tears in her eyes.
'We thought you had changed. But when we saw you on TV, we realized that you've always been the same Haruka. Always timid, always scared, always crying, but always brave when it comes to things that really mattered.'

modules.moduleDescription:
The camera chases through a narrow alley shrouded in morning mist. The stone pavement is still damp from the previous night's rain. Momoka Hanyuu, wearing a coarse cotton haori, trots along while waving to the director holding the microphone: 'Let me finish saying hello first.'
At the alley's entrance, the first extra is an old craftsman selling kerosene lamps. He wipes his blackened palms on his apron and hands over the lamp he's just repaired. Momoka accepts it with a smile and thanks him earnestly. A little farther on is the young man who owns the bookshop. He's just been selected as a second extra. He stands under a weather-worn signboard and somewhat bashfully speaks his single line: 'Yes, my lord.' Nevertheless, Momoka painstakingly rehearses it with him again and again. The camera follows her through the corridor. The shopkeeper is simmering stew. Just as she lifts the lid, the steam bursts against the lens, and she blurts out a string of apologies. At the confectionery, the clerk gently brushes aside the children who are straining to peek in. Momoka makes a silly face at the doorway as she passes by, and everyone laughs. The boom mic keeps bumping against the low eaves, picking up the chime of wind bells and the cries of the vendors. Every single sound on the street is recorded on the tape, as the reels spin round and round.
Before filming begins in the afternoon, Momoka sits on the rear bench of a prop cart. Around her, coachmen, vendors, and apprentices hired for the day crowd in to watch as she pins up a little girl's hair. The camera lingers on a strand of loose hair at her neck, damp with sweat, then slowly pulls back. The camera sweeps across the faded lattice windows of the townhouses, the moss-covered stone lanterns, and the power lines strung like webs between the wooden houses. No one could have possibly imagined that years later all of this would be reduced to ruins in a sudden eruption of violence.
On this day, everyone is hard at work on a film that still feels underdeveloped. Laughter, chatter, and the clicking of the camera create a din that reverberates through every nook and cranny in Kajimachi.
The final scene the director films that day shows Momoka standing on a bridge over the river, holding a floral bouquet that the crew gave her to celebrate the ending of filming. She turns back around to wave directly at the camera. The sunset casts a golden edge along the brim of her hat. In the background, the extras gradually disperse, their shadows trailing behind them as they head home. No one hurries to take down the planks laid across the river, as if filming will continue tomorrow with the same scene.
That's the end of the outtake reel. Momoka's room is now silent, save for the ticking of the clock. She curls up into a ball on the sofa. On the TV screen, her younger self still stands on the bridge, waving at the camera. The river is dyed by the setting sun, thick and gleaming like boiled honey. She keeps watching for a long time, until the screen reverts back to the blue standby display. Only then does she raise the remote and switch it off. The room goes dark at once. A sliver of light peeks through from outside, faintly illuminating the small plant she keeps by her window and the faded photograph beside it—just like the sunset that slipped through the lattice windows of the old wooden house and brightened her heart so many years ago.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, let's try a simple test. How many of the snacks I put on the coffee table did you sneak off with?

Don't worry, Doctor. It's true I pay no attention to my surroundings when I'm deep in thought, but Dendie and Axie will keep me from bumping into anything or anyone. Who're they, you ask? Why, my mechanical arms here. There's a lot they can do.

The kids have given me a lot of nicknames, like 'Squinty' or 'Four-Armed Braintalker'. It's fine, and even normal I'd say. Kids their age just hate being seen through. Though, hehe. If they're unhappy about it, they could simply practice and try to trick me.

My Arts are all about perceiving and manipulating electrical signals. That lets me understand the people around me better, though it also makes me oversensitive to details. For example, your right trapezius muscle has been discharging an abnormal signal, so I think you should adjust your sitting posture, Doctor.

Doctor, I'm glad to see your face in my classroom. The Infected of Ursus walk the razor's edge, but—correct, there are many ways to deal with those who employ violence to conceal weakness. It seems you know quite a bit, so don't we conduct a pop quiz right now?

Do non-Sarkaz races also have the cultural concept of the soul? A complex question. Though, the signals I see in human bodies are not just the pulsing rhythm of life, but also emotions in bloom engraved within. Sometimes they are just blazingly bright, like the flames of a soul.

Doctor, I'm glad to see your body's signals indicate you've had a stable lifestyle lately. That wasn't sarcasm, you don't have to confess your negligence. Physical health aside, I think it's good to keep a steady rhythm, like the readings on a medical instrument—a quiet waveform means approaching death, while a noisy one says disease is on the way.

There was a time when Rosmontis's body was like two lost fowlbeasts shrieking in fright. I'd hold her until she fell asleep, and they would 'peck' at me. I'm glad she can sleep on her own now, though I admit it leaves me a little lonely.

Are you tired, Doctor? Alright, since you've worked so hard today, come, hold my hand. Feel your nerves pulse, think of them as a gentle tune. Now, let's softly sway to the warm beat—until all your exhaustion fades away.
Comms terminal set to silent. Don't worry, you won't miss any important news with me here.
According to Amiya's instruction, I take orders directly from you now, Doctor. I handle communications and intelligence. But of course, feel free to come to me with any life issues.
It's obvious which side will win, considering our overwhelming information supremacy.
I get the most gratification as a communications intelligence officer when my information is used to its full potential. So keep at it, Doctor!

Doctor, Blaze, and the rest of you—just come out. It's cute you thought you could spring a surprise on me. Still hiding? A round of hide-and-seek, hmm? You're all so in touch with your inner children. Alright then. Let's start with the Doctor—
Carry on with your war room business, I'll propose suggestions as needed.
Trust me, I'll always manage to locate you, no matter what sort of danger you may find yourselves in.
All packed and ready? Let's go then.
Enemy signal detected. All units, prepare for battle.
Doctor, what kind of message do you want me to transmit?
I've intercepted some fascinating intel, Doctor.
Relax, their comms will be paralyzed as long as I'm here.
Verified all allied units in position. Everything's fine, don't worry.
Sorry, this isn't the way out, but a trap I set for you.
Enjoy a little solo sojourn to the information silo.
I'll jam their signals while the rest of you move.
Sadly, there's no controlling the battlefield with brute force alone.
How was the battle, Doctor? You want my evaluation? Dendie and Axie have already given you my answer, haven't they?
No further enemy signals in range. Mission complete, perfectly executed. Phew... Alright, Doctor, give me a high-five!
I have their signals in my head now. They won't get away.
Don't lose heart, Doctor. We'll win next time, alright?
Rhodes Island's signal still puts me at ease.
Doctor, did I not tell you to behave yourself?
Are you heading over to the meeting too, Doctor? Let's go together then.
Arknights.

Thank you, Doctor, till the deck will do... No, I'm not drunk... It's just, there's always so much joy and excitement in everyone's signals this time of year. It always gets me a little dizzy. I suppose this is a good problem to have. Happy New Year, Doctor.
Doctor, were you looking for me?

Doctor, I just sent you a map. It shows the locations of everyone who wishes to celebrate your birthday. I've already planned the shortest route you can take, and you should be done by dinner time, if there aren't any hiccups on the way. The question mark at the end? That's my present for you, I hope you're excited for it.

We've lost a lot of people, but there are always more joining our ranks. Gradually, the newbies inherit their seniors' ideas as they in turn become mentors to others. Doctor, judging from the signals I'm getting, sometimes I even find myself mistaken—I get the feeling my comrades never change.

The kids have given me a lot of nicknames, like 'Squinty' or 'Four-Armed Braintalker'. It's fine, and even normal I'd say. Kids their age just hate being seen through. Though, hehe. If they're unhappy about it, they could simply practice and try to trick me.

My Arts are all about perceiving and manipulating electrical signals. That lets me understand the people around me better, though it also makes me oversensitive to details. For example, your right trapezius muscle has been discharging an abnormal signal, so I think you should adjust your sitting posture, Doctor.

Do non-Sarkaz races also have the cultural concept of the soul? A complex question. Though, the signals I see in human bodies are not just the pulsing rhythm of life, but also emotions in bloom engraved within. Sometimes they are just blazingly bright, like the flames of a soul.

Doctor, I'm glad to see your body's signals indicate you've had a stable lifestyle lately. That wasn't sarcasm, you don't have to confess your negligence. Are you tired, Doctor? Alright, since you've worked so hard today, come, hold my hand. Feel your nerves pulse, think of them as a gentle tune. Now, let's softly sway to the warm beat—until all your exhaustion fades away.
Comms terminal set to silent. Don't worry, you won't miss any important news with me here.
According to Amiya's instruction, I take orders directly from you now, Doctor. I handle communications and intelligence. But of course, feel free to come to me with any life issues.
It's obvious which side will win, considering our overwhelming information supremacy.
I get the most gratification as a communications intelligence officer when my information is used to its full potential. So keep at it, Doctor!

Doctor, Blaze, and the rest of you—just come out. It's cute you thought you could spring a surprise on me. Still hiding? A round of hide-and-seek, hmm? You're all so in touch with your inner children. Alright then. Let's start with the Doctor—
Carry on with your war room business, I'll propose suggestions as needed.
Trust me, I'll always manage to locate you, no matter what sort of danger you may find yourselves in.
All packed and ready? Let's go then.
Enemy signal detected. All units, prepare for battle.
Doctor, what kind of message do you want me to transmit?
I've intercepted some fascinating intel, Doctor.
Relax, their comms will be paralyzed as long as I'm here.
Verified all allied units in position. Everything's fine, don't worry.
Sorry, this isn't the way out, but a trap I set for you.
Enjoy a little solo sojourn to the information silo.
I'll jam their signals while the rest of you move.
Sadly, there's no controlling the battlefield with brute force alone.
How was the battle, Doctor? You want my evaluation? Dendie and Axie have already given you my answer, haven't they?
No further enemy signals in range. Mission complete, perfectly executed. Phew... Alright, Doctor, give me a high-five!
I have their signals in my head now. They won't get away.
Don't lose heart, Doctor. We'll win next time, alright?
Rhodes Island's signal still puts me at ease.
Doctor, did I not tell you to behave yourself?
Are you heading over to the meeting too, Doctor? Let's go together then.
Arknights.

Thank you, Doctor, till the deck will do... No, I'm not drunk... It's just, there's always so much joy and excitement in everyone's signals this time of year. It always gets me a little dizzy. I suppose this is a good problem to have. Happy New Year, Doctor.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Originium crystals can be observed on the surface of Operator Raidian's body.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Under normal circumstances, Operator Raidian diligently follows the Medical Department's instructions in taking her medication and using her Arts in moderation, providing a sterling example for other operators to follow... Under normal circumstances, that is.
handbook.promotionRecord:
Welcome back, Doctor.
Perhaps you'll be surprised to read this card. Perhaps your long slumber has clouded your mind, making you forget your name and where you are. There is no need to worry. Trust that this is a place you built, where you once stood, with people who stood side-by-side with you. People who share your ideals... people who miss you.
Your slippers are on the left side of the bed. Your favorite bedtime book is in the drawer on the left. If you have headaches or nightmares, there is powdered hot chocolate in the drawer under the nightstand. They always help.
I'll have someone leave this card in your room, perhaps with a flower. I know you would probably prefer a snack—like a box of cookies or some liqueur-filled chocolates. Well, I do worry about your dietary habits, but I'll leave one of those two for you.
Try to exercise self-restraint and spread it out over a number of days, rather than finish it all in one go.
Anyway, I'm glad you're back. That's all I wanted to say—welcome back, Doctor.
—Raidian

You find this card on your desk along with a dried flower, a box of liqueur-filled chocolate, a box of butter cookies, and a small jar of sugar cubes.
archives:
[Operator Raidian's Personal Profile]
Native of Ursus, Elite Operator of Rhodes Island. Able to perceive electrical signals through Originium Arts.
Current scope of duties includes communications, intelligence processing, and field operations. Noted for her gentle and polite demeanor.
Graduated early from Marynin Girls' High School to study neuroscience at the University of Deity Grypherburg. Regularly participated in research and fieldwork during her studies.
...

[Permission verified... full profile unlocked]

[Ursus Patrol Unit Report (Fragment)]
Serafina Ivanovna Petrova is no longer in Ursus territory.
Investigation and a raid on Petrova's residence has confirmed that she is in dereliction of her duties and expresses clear sympathies for the Infected. She had ■■■■■ assisted ■■■■■.
Documents retrieved during the raid reveal that Petrova made contact with Leithanien five months ago and formalized their cooperation one and a half months ago, in exchange for a safe escape.

[Audio Log]
'Petrova? I think I remember the name...'
'Ah, yes—the girl from Ursus!'
(Rustling of clothes. The speaker seems to have shifted postures.)
'She always had a smile on her face, even when she was fleeing Ursus. (A soft sigh.) I had... some personal connections that got me work from the Kurfürst, which involved sneaking her out from right under the nose of the Patrol Unit in exchange for some sort of list she had.
'Wasn't an easy job, but it wasn't the first time either.
'Still... she was a little different. When we were at the border, she spent a long time looking back. I asked her if she missed her home, but she said she was thinking of her old workplace—weird, isn't it? Who on Terra would love their work that much?
'Never mind. I guess she was a workaholic. She did well in Leithanien. Maybe the best of anyone I've smuggled. She fit in well in Leithanien, but she didn't like the place.
'The last time I saw her, she was with a group of refugees heading to Kazdel...'
(Brief silence)
'I don't know why she gave up a nice apartment to get mixed up with a bunch of refugees. It's not exactly an easy path, and I wouldn't be there to escort her... There were rumors later that she joined some group by the name of 'Babel'. Not sure if they're true or not.
'But she never really cared where she lived. She was like that since her Ursus days.
'Strange girl, really.'

[Operator Registration Update]
Operator Raidian originally joined Babel at the invitation of Theresa while in Kazdel. She provided invaluable communications support to Babel units on Kazdelian battlefields, at great burden to herself, significantly increasing Babel's operational flexibility.
Raidian stayed at Rhodes Island after the Babel Incident, and began participating in field operations at Whitesmith's recommendation, joining the ranks of Rhodes Island's first elite operators.

Overall, there were two causes for the incident. The first was the suspension of the stool races due to both the dangers and the toll they were taking on the work stools, resulting in a void in entertainment offerings. The second was the increase in gatherings for dining and drinking amongst the elite operators. While there is always someone or other away on a mission, these gatherings are highly valued by the operators. Sometimes bets are made over a drink, usually involving some sort of skill contest. Some are fine, some are silly, absurd and inexplicable. The latter kind always sees more participants, and it is more likely that someone will lose their heads, causing things to spiral out of control. Blaze shouted her approval when Mechanist proposed an unconventionally-powered robot arena for the third time. Misery pondered the idea quietly, shifting his eyes between a bottle and the ground, but Raidian put a hand on the three of them—at the same time—before Misery could do anything. One of the perks of having four hands, apparently. A witness recalls that she even used her fourth hand to flip the meat on the grill and put it on Mantra's plate. 'The meat's getting burnt,' she said. 'I have a better game for you, if you really want to play...' She continued, 'A competition that involves philosophy, fate, probability, and challenging yourself.' No one knew if she was drunk. She continued to wear her familiar smile, with no change in her complexion. Was she drunk? The rest exchanged glances in silence, trying to get their alcohol-addled brains spinning... Could it be? That Raidian, who always unfailingly delivers drunkards to their dorm rooms after a long night of partying, and provides them hangover patches the next day? Mechanist coughed and asked her what she had in mind. She drew back all her hands and said, dead-pan, 'Rock-paper-scissors. Loser has to write mission reports for the winner, for a week.' It was only when someone lost eight times in a row despite showing nothing but rock that people began to suspect that something was not right. Was she using her Arts? Did their bioelectrical signals betray their own thoughts? Finally, the long-awaited scissors appeared. 'Hehe...' She leaned back against her chair, her speech slightly slurred. She was undoubtedly drunk. 'I... win... yay...!'

[Maintenance Log, Dendie and Axie]

Feb 11. Dendie submitted for inspection.
Request: The bearing on the second joint of Dendie's middle finger is not moving smoothly. There seems to be some kind of foreign object, possibly gravel or broken glass. Please be careful of sharp objects when performing maintenance.
Engineering Comment: Examination complete. Broken glass removed from joint. Did this have something to do with the beaker explosion at the lab yesterday? You didn't have to get involved... However, the auto-adjustment function of the robotic arm, designed to keep it from getting stuck, didn't seem to be working. You should bring Axie in too when you have time.

Feb 13. Axie submitted for inspection.
Request: Brought Axie as requested.
Engineering Comment: Done. Also lubricated the joints so it'll stop making that creaking noise.
Request: Come to think of it, I'm naturally right-handed... Maybe that's caused more wear and tear on Axie. Perhaps I should add another right hand to make things a little easier for it...
Engineering Comment: Four arms are not enough for you? The best you can do, IMO, is stop taking on too much missions.

Mar 20. Dendie and Axie's regular checkup.
Request: Haven't had any tough missions lately, so I haven't brought them in for a while. Thank goodness—I feel like I've been troubling you too much last month. Anyway, I'm going to make a report now and I'll just leave the gift on your desk. Happy birthday.
Engineering Comment: I'm sixteen! I'm not a little girl anymore and I don't need storybooks! Fine. Never mind. The repairs are done, and I put the stickers that Rosmontis left on it. I also applied special tempered films on the stickers so they won't peel off and are waterproof now. Even a direct hit by a bullet would only leave a small dent.

Mar 27. Feature upgrade for Dendie and Axie.
Engineering Comment: I'll come and get Dendie and Axie from you tomorrow.
Engineering Comment: You said you wanted to add a bubble spray to the medicine dispenser? I didn't have time back then, but now I have an idea...
Engineering Comment: By the way, it's not a thank-you gift for that storybook!
Request: Generally speaking, efficiency and clarity is expected in communications, but I still manage to understand what you mean.

A child once asked Raidian, 'Can you hear my thoughts through electrical signals?'
It is a question that many have asked, if not out loud. In theory, they might understand that electrical signals do not communicate the finer nuances of thought and emotion, but this question keeps popping up from the bottom of their hearts, as irrational as it may be.
'Of course not.' Raidian crouches down before the child as she examines the knee they had accidentally scraped. 'It's nothing that powerful. I'm not a mind reader, you know?'
'But you can always tell where I am, and what I need. When I'm sad, you always find me and try to make me feel better.' The child gazes at her, eyes wide open.

They used to call her 'Mind Reader' behind her back, those who feared her.
She had her own room in the interrogation department during her time in Ursus. Guards would bring her 'suspicious individuals', and they would tremble in their chair as though facing a monster. She would then close her eyes and feel the chaotic electrical signals dart through the room, flashing like a screen full of static.

Anxiety, high adrenaline levels, increased body temperature, unsteady electrical signals.
It's fear... no. Don't speculate on emotions. Analyze information. Determine truth from falsehood. Focus on facts, not feelings. That was her job. She was no 'Mind Reader', but the military's lie detector, a convenient tool.
Raidian opened her eyes and saw the old woman cowering in her chair, coughing, trying to pull at her hand. She could sense the old woman's facial muscles twitching, and tears flowing through the valleys formed by the wrinkles on her face.
'She's telling the truth,' said Raidian. 'She doesn't know where those Infected are.'

For the first time, she decided to be 'Raidian', not 'Mind Reader', not a lie detector.
'I don't need to be able to read minds for that,' said Raidian, as she wrapped the scraped knee in bandages. 'I notice what you need, how you feel, and everything else, because I care about you.'

'Come on, let's head to Medical together.' She stood up and gave the child a hand.
'But... weren't you going to check on the medicine in the mailroom?'
'There's no rush. We'll go to Medical first.'
They walked in the direction of the Medical Department. Behind them, Rhodes Island-stamped packages were stacked up in the waiting area, including personal letters, commercial goods, private documents, supplies for trading, and humanitarian donations.
They all had a destination and a recipient, be it Columbia, Kjerag, Rim Billiton, or Ursus.

modules.moduleDescription:
Raidian is busy putting on a show for the children in the Rhodes Island Activity Room.
'Dives' line up neatly and pass through a ring of 'Cycles'. 'Centers' circle above the children trying to swat them down, fighting back with rubber bullet headshots.
Performing intricate actions with a dozen machines controlled with Arts is a highly demanding task, which is why she has not yet looked at the report her team member brought her. After all, if it were really so important, she would have made an appointment in the meeting room, not a room full of children where what they are about to discuss would be decidedly out-of-place.
A few minutes later, the performance comes to a close, and the machines become toys in the children's hands. Raidian takes a seat in a corner with her team member and takes the mission report.
'Thanks, Agate.' A mechanical arm pats the specialist operator's head. The operator almost instinctively flinches, but some other part of her brain quickly takes over, and she quietly accepts the gesture of approval.
Raidian scans the report and puts it in her pocket.
'Another field mission. Are you ready?'
Agate answers by tapping her knife lightly.
'Then I'll go prepare. Give me a minute.'
...
As soon as Agate reports the coordinates, Raidian's machines begin operating with ruthless efficiency.
As Dives appear in the enemy's view, Cycles empty their munitions into the enemy's backs, and Centers dive towards fleeing enemies, however, Agate sees in her mind the scene of these machines playing with the children, even as the enemies' screams reach her ears.
The gadgets, once a source of joy for the children, now sow confusion among the enemies, then shock, and a fear that no stealth or interference can hide, and that's when Raidian would sense the signals and send the 'children's messengers' straight to the enemy's location, announcing the ending of the 'game'.
Cleaning up the battlefield does not take long, and Raidian was still interrogating the prisoners when Agate gets back. Agate knows it will not take long for the prisoners to break, for she herself was once an enemy of Rhodes Island, with first-hand experience of Raidian's 'hospitality'. As fate would have it, she would eventually become part of Raidian's team, after she contracted Oripathy and ended up on Rhodes Island. As such, she could claim more familiarity with her captain than most.
Just like those adorable yet deadly machines, Raidian can be gentle and cold-hearted in equal measure. However, while she used to never hesitate to show a mercilessness as brutal as Ursus's winters, that piercing coldness is now wrapped in snowmelt of early spring, only to reveal itself when necessary.
Agate is roused by a Dive that nudges her gently. She looks up to find that Raidian has finished her interrogation and tucked the unconscious enemies away in an inconspicuous location. She is waving at her from a short distance away. The sun sets in the west, dragging a long shadow in Agate's direction.
She walks forward, into the warm shadow.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Give those documents here. Steady diligence paves the way to grand vision. During my cultivation retreat, I would grade ninety-nine assignments for the Tianshis every day—Halt. Where do you think you're going? Are you planning to dump your work on me to loaf about like the rest of them? Very well. Ignorance of consequence is bliss.

The case is closed. I can only hope Blaze is no longer shackled by her past, though it's hard not to worry for someone with her temperament. Never mind, I am simply visiting this time around—She won't be back for another two weeks? Ahem, staying a few more days will do me no harm. If there is anything I can help with, just say the word.

I must stress that Lei Fa is neither for quick-charging batteries nor invoking rain and storm! This Tianshi garb attracts many curious questions, and I am compelled to answer them all—Repairing a burnt circuit...? Give it here. This has nothing to do with Lei Fa either! I simply have a lot of practical experience in this field.

Zuo Le has been taking on more important duties at the Sui Regulator, but he still possesses the heart of a youth. He may seem a cautious young man, but he lets emotion get the better of him at crucial moments. How is one not meant to worry...? Why are you looking at me like that? I promised my sworn sister I would look after him, so naturally I'm concerned for him—Seriously, why are you looking at me like that?

During my studies at the Tianshi Bureaus, I would never dare to neglect my Lei Fa drills or memorization of the law. But work at the Judicial Review Office requires human interaction. I was at a loss, but I came to realize something at last: when all is said and done, what both roles seek is nothing more than the truth.

I may have shed my mandarin's robe, but I do not dwell on it. As a former enforcer of the law, I am well aware of its imperfections. There are times when swords are chipped and thunder falls silent. The law, Lei Fa, and the longsword are simply tools to punish evil and drive out wickedness. So long as the wielder is of resolute heart, there is nothing they cannot overcome.

Of course Tianshis are ordinary people, not cultivators of immortality. The Tianshi Bureaus were placed atop a mountain's peak simply for solitude's sake, allowing students to focus on their studies. Inconvenient? The Originium contraptions produced by the Chamber of Alchemy are perfectly sufficient to our daily needs. Besides, one can ride a Tianshi's Wing to the Baizao market and back in the span of a single joss stick. There's nothing inconvenient about it.

You are worried. If life's challenges have left you with a weary heart, then follow me back to the Tianshi Bureaus to seclude your mind. Choose a research topic to your liking, suffer the torment of fanciful and enthusiastic Tianshis for a few years, and your heart shall be clear as crystal— To decline with such formality... Are my jokes still too serious?

I once saw a dastardly criminal who had been pronounced innocent struck by a bolt from the blue on his way home. Not far off, there was my little uncle who had no business there. I had hoped to question him, but in the end, I hid it away in my heart—Why am I telling you? Weren't we exchanging secrets?!

Do not push yourself. As a leader, you should recuperate when appropriate. A well-rested mind is an agile, observant mind. You can't finish your work? You want my help? Ridiculous! Preposterous! ...Give it here.

I am here to terminate my investigation authorization with your company. And here is my new application for—'Thank goodness'? I am applying as an ordinary visitor, merely here to talk. I, Leizi of Great Yan's Tianshi Bureaus, do beg your pardon for my continued presence.
It is worth considering Originium Arts doctrine in a complex battlefield environment.
I do not grant my trust lightly, but Rhodes Island has proven itself a trustworthy organization. Do not disappoint me. Oh, I was talking over you? My apologies. Please, go ahead.

When I first joined the Judicial Review Office, I strove to be the best in all things. I thought the higher I stood, the more I could do. And yet, it was the same thought that bade me leave. Do I regret it? No. Listen to the rumbling of the thunder. Where can its mighty roar not be heard? Where can its brilliant bolts not reach?
When one learns from experience, the lessons never cease.
Levin crack umbra, luminate the path.
With my blade, I decree—
There is no cure for the shameless.
I am here.
A fine decision.
Practice without principle is the height of folly.
Amidst lightning flash, thund'rous sword shall clash!
Five thunders, smite the wicked!
With trine blade shall evil be excised, with righteous fulgur's strike shall demons die!
Tremble, villains! Quake, ye ghouls! For thunder roars, and heaven shakes!
There is no flight from Heaven's bolts!
You should maintain such a high standard in future battles. You are the one who sets the standard, of course, but that does not mean you can be complacent!
You have improved. Less admonition next time? That would be complacency. I rescind my earlier praise!
Phew...What you need is time to clear your mind. As one of Rhodes Island's leaders, you must not make the same mistake twice. Remember this.
Stand and fight alongside me! I know you are not so easily defeated!
My idle days must be spent on thorough study. If there are any further explosions outside my door—There won't be? Very well. I trust you.
Calm mind, tranquil heart—I shall not bicker with you.
It's only a handshake, no need to be so cautious. I haven't shocked anybody in years—Ah. Static does not count.
Arknights.

Fresh atmosphere brought by Spring squalls, many wills make new walls—Does this call for a little more passion? Hmm, I'll clench a fist at the end. Alright, from the top. What do you mean, 'there's no need'? Since Rhodes Island invited me to participate in the New Year's performance, I shall give my full effort!
According to the schedule, you should not be resting here right now, Doctor.

Congratulations on the anniversary of your birth. I, Leizi of the Tianshi Bureaus, offer you this device, with absolute certitude you shall put it to good use. You need only press the button—Don't point it at yourse—... Are you alright? Wake up! I was about to say you should press it when you are in danger, at which point the lightning I stored in it would be released...

I must admit, I had many reservations about Rhodes Island due to your connection with that particular case. But now, when I join you on missions, it is not for observation's sake. To aid the weak and demand justice are not such different goals. May our collaboration continue on.

I may have shed my mandarin's robe, but I do not dwell on it. As a former enforcer of the law, I am well aware of its imperfections. There are times when swords are chipped and thunder falls silent. The law, Lei Fa, and the longsword are simply tools to punish evil and drive out wickedness. So long as the wielder is of resolute heart, there is nothing they cannot overcome.

Of course Tianshis are ordinary people, not cultivators of immortality. The Tianshi Bureaus were placed atop a mountain's peak simply for solitude's sake, allowing students to focus on their studies. Inconvenient? The Originium contraptions produced by the Chamber of Alchemy are perfectly sufficient to our daily needs. Besides, one can ride a Tianshi's Wing to the Baizao market and back in the span of a single joss stick. There's nothing inconvenient about it.

You are worried. If life's challenges have left you with a weary heart, then follow me back to the Tianshi Bureaus to seclude your mind. Choose a research topic to your liking, suffer the torment of fanciful and enthusiastic Tianshis for a few years, and your heart shall be clear as crystal— To decline with such formality... Are my jokes still too serious?

I once saw a dastardly criminal who had been pronounced innocent struck by a bolt from the blue on his way home. Not far off, there was my little uncle who had no business there. I had hoped to question him, but in the end, I hid it away in my heart—Why am I telling you? Weren't we exchanging secrets?!

Do not push yourself. As a leader, you should recuperate when appropriate. A well-rested mind is an agile, observant mind. You can't finish your work? You want my help? Ridiculous! Preposterous! ...Give it here.

I am here to terminate my investigation authorization with your company. And here is my new application for—'Thank goodness'? I am applying as an ordinary visitor, merely here to talk. I, Leizi of Great Yan's Tianshi Bureaus, do beg your pardon for my continued presence.
It is worth considering Originium Arts doctrine in a complex battlefield environment.
I do not grant my trust lightly, but Rhodes Island has proven itself a trustworthy organization. Do not disappoint me. Oh, I was talking over you? My apologies. Please, go ahead.

When I first joined the Judicial Review Office, I strove to be the best in all things. I thought the higher I stood, the more I could do. And yet, it was the same thought that bade me leave. Do I regret it? No. Listen to the rumbling of the thunder. Where can its mighty roar not be heard? Where can its brilliant bolts not reach?
When one learns from experience, the lessons never cease.
Levin crack umbra, luminate the path.
With my blade, I decree—
There is no cure for the shameless.
I am here.
A fine decision.
Practice without principle is the height of folly.
Amidst lightning flash, thund'rous sword shall clash!
Five thunders, smite the wicked!
With trine blade shall evil be excised, with righteous fulgur's strike shall demons die!
Tremble, villains! Quake, ye ghouls! For thunder roars, and heaven shakes!
There is no flight from Heaven's bolts!
You should maintain such a high standard in future battles. You are the one who sets the standard, of course, but that does not mean you can be complacent!
You have improved. Less admonition next time? That would be complacency. I rescind my earlier praise!
Phew...What you need is time to clear your mind. As one of Rhodes Island's leaders, you must not make the same mistake twice. Remember this.
Stand and fight alongside me! I know you are not so easily defeated!
My idle days must be spent on thorough study. If there are any further explosions outside my door—There won't be? Very well. I trust you.
Calm mind, tranquil heart—I shall not bicker with you.
It's only a handshake, no need to be so cautious. I haven't shocked anybody in years—Ah. Static does not count.
Arknights.

Fresh atmosphere brought by Spring squalls, many wills make new walls—Does this call for a little more passion? Hmm, I'll clench a fist at the end. Alright, from the top. What do you mean, 'there's no need'? Since Rhodes Island invited me to participate in the New Year's performance, I shall give my full effort!
According to the schedule, you should not be resting here right now, Doctor.

Congratulations on the anniversary of your birth. I, Leizi of the Tianshi Bureaus, offer you this device, with absolute certitude you shall put it to good use. You need only press the button—Don't point it at yourse—... Are you alright? Wake up! I was about to say you should press it when you are in danger, at which point the lightning I stored in it would be released...

I must admit, I had many reservations about Rhodes Island due to your connection with that particular case. But now, when I join you on missions, it is not for observation's sake. To aid the weak and demand justice are not such different goals. May our collaboration continue on.

EN.voiceText: Give those documents here. Steady diligence paves the way to grand vision. During my cultivation retreat, I would grade ninety-nine assignments for the Tianshis every day—Halt. Where do you think you're going? Are you planning to dump your work on me to loaf about like the rest of them? Very well. Ignorance of consequence is bliss.

The case is closed. I can only hope Blaze is no longer shackled by her past, though it's hard not to worry for someone with her temperament. Never mind, I am simply visiting this time around—She won't be back for another two weeks? Ahem, staying a few more days will do me no harm. If there is anything I can help with, just say the word.

I must stress that Lei Fa is neither for quick-charging batteries nor invoking rain and storm! This Tianshi garb attracts many curious questions, and I am compelled to answer them all—Repairing a burnt circuit...? Give it here. This has nothing to do with Lei Fa either! I simply have a lot of practical experience in this field.

Zuo Le has been taking on more important duties at the Sui Regulator, but he still possesses the heart of a youth. handbook.promotionRecord:
After the matter of Mangshan Town was concluded, the geist of a silk fan followed Leizi for a while, tripping her as she walked and cooling her food when she ate. She paid it little heed, but decided to question it when she realized that it had followed her all the way to the border of town. To her surprise, she learned that the geist sought death after seeing how she had rid a sword of its geisthood with lightning.
The geist had wanted to become human for years, but had become disillusioned after seeing the chaos that engulfed Mangshan Town, and the treacherous and greedy side of humanity. Feeling that there was little meaning in becoming human after all, it believed only a quick end by lightning could grant it eternal peace.
I was curious as to how Leizi dealt with it, whether she brought the lightning down or not, but she continued with her monologue, saying that humans could be greedy and selfish, but they were also responsible for so many wonderful things in life, and that recognizing this was the first step to becoming human, and that it was understandable that the geist found it hard to accept.
I agreed with her and said that there will always be people who refuse to give in to the sinful nature of man. However, virtue need not stand alone if one finds friends who share the same ideals.
In the end, Leizi never told me what happened to the geist, but I thought I saw a pair of curious eyes on the fan that she casually took out as she was talking, taking in every detail of the world around it.
archives:
I laid down casually upon hearing the news that Leizi was visiting Rhodes Island again, then sit back up when I saw her updated resume. This time, she comes as a Tianshi, and her investigation authorization with Rhodes Island has expired. Does this mean that Rhodes Island no longer needs to be on guard with her official background?
One thing is clear at least—her movements are now regular and predictable. Thundercracks can be heard from the training room at the crack of dawn when she is not on missions, then she can be seen reading in the library in the afternoon. She completes her missions flawlessly and without complaint. She is a regular visitor to the bar with Blaze, though she never drinks herself. Other than requesting to see Zuo Le's mission assessments on her, she has never made any unusual requests.
This change in Leizi must have something to do with the case she had been working on for years, though the incessant pursuit of justice always comes at a price, especially for someone as stubborn and unwavering as her. She has never been overly concerned with titles and power, but that was hardly the only price she paid. It had long occurred to me that life would not be easy for someone like her, and the path that her lightning illuminates is often a treacherous one.
We do not pry into her private life, as long as it does not affect the operations she takes part in. Whether she sees her work here as a kind of R&R or a trial for herself, her performance is exemplary, and it has been a long time since I have received a complaint about her breaking any electrical appliances. That alone is reason enough to welcome her continued presence on Rhodes Island.

Leizi entered the Tianshi Bureaus at a young age. Her background brought her into contact with masters such as Cyanstorm Count since her youth, but even she could not become his pupil without going through the Bureaus' application process. Public examinations are the only way to be accepted into the Tianshi Bureaus; everyone is assessed in the same way, with no shortcuts or backdoors.
Yan's public examinations are famously difficult. It is extremely rare for an underage student to pass them, and many examinees have spent decades memorizing the books yet still fail to pass. The Lei Fa examination in particular requires examinees to demonstrate both outstanding aptitude for thunder-related Arts, as well as excellent knowledge and understanding of the laws of Yan. It takes considerable time for the average student to master even one of these two.
As one of the youngest students of the Tianshi Bureaus, Leizi was also known for rejecting a visit from Cyanstorm Count during her examination preparation to avoid any appearance of impropriety, even though the elderly Tianshi had only intended to give a few tips to the promising student without revealing any confidential information. In the end, she passed the examinations without any help.
There is a Yanese saying that a child's demeanor at the age of three reveals everything about the rest of their life. Leizi seems to be living proof of it: no longer burdened by holding a formal office, she enjoys chatting over a drink at the bar with Blaze. As long as her conviction remains firm, there is nothing that can break her.

These sorts of problems were commonplace in the thirteen villages and towns that I visited on my journey to the west this year. A typical case would be an old farmer whose land was forcibly purchased without receiving proper compensation. With his pleas ignored by the officials, he was forced to turn to theft to survive, but was promptly arrested. In despair over the future of his family, he was about to hang himself in front of the government office when I ran across him.
I was shocked at first, but as I studied the laws regarding the purchase and sale of land, I found that there were certain gray areas that could entrap a farmer into signing an unfair contract. I spent hours looking into books and records, but was still unable to find a legal basis to claim justice for the farmer. In the end, I offered to help him in a different way.
On the day that the land was scheduled to be handed over, the buyer came to run the farmer out. He laughed at the farmer and said the contract was signed without duress and was perfectly lawful, that he could go to the courts if he had a problem and not even heaven could do anything about it. At that moment, a crack of thunder rang out from a cloudless sky, following the buyer wherever he went. Believing that he had incurred the wrath of heaven, he finally coughed up the compensation.
The issue was resolved, but my heart remained uneasy. Thunder might achieve justice for one man, but it takes a meticulous code of law to achieve justice for all. As such, I propose the following amendments to the relevant laws...
—From Leizi's legal studies reports during her time as a student at the Tianshi Bureaus

Once we let our guard down around Leizi during her second stint on Rhodes Island, we found her to be unpretentious and easy to get along with. We were able to satisfy our curiosity and learn more about Lei Fa, a traditional school of Originium Arts that has special significance in Yan.
We knew that Lei Fa was more than just a kind of Arts for Yan, and represents both personal excellence and public justice. From Leizi's experiences during her studies, however, we've seen that the legacy of Lei Fa is passed down in a far more down-to-earth way than we thought. As a recognized heir of Lei Fa, she spends half her time at the Tianshi Bureau working on her Arts skills, learning not just how to control thunder and lightning, but also natural sciences such as meteorology and physics. The other half of her time is spent studying the laws and judgments of Yan.
Other than the use of thunder-realated Arts, heirs of Lei Fa seem no different from other law students. They usually go on to work in Yan's judiciary after they graduate. Each generation of heirs, however, work diligently on their Arts, because thunder and lightning carry great significance in Yanese culture. They represent divine judgment, signifying the people's hopes that those who do evil will by smote by lightning. Heirs of Lei Fa study Arts less for their practical value in combat, but for how they support their conviction to punish evil.
We have spoken to Leizi about her future. Although we would certainly welcome such an outstanding operator, with no official ties to any government, participating in Rhodes Island's operations for the long haul, we also understand that she cannot cast her responsibilities aside as an heir to Lei Fa.
Leizi does not avoid the topic when asked; she admits that she is thinking about returning to the Judicial Review Office, though she has not given us a specific timeline. The path to achieving spiritual excellence could take days, months, or years, but she is happy to go with her heart. With a clear goal in mind, she now takes things much easier than before.

modules.moduleDescription:
Somewhere in a Tianshi Bureau workshop, Lin Qingyan stares at the blueprints, silent in thought.
'There's no arts device that you want to make?' her senior disciple finally asks.
'...When I mentioned wanting to go down the mountain for a travel, Master sent me here first, but he didn't specify what type of item I should make. At first I thought, 'Does he think I'm too impatient? Has he sent me to craft some intricate device to still my restlessness and temper my character?' But arts devices are ultimately just tools that people use. Whether I temper my character or not is my own decision. The question I should be asking is, 'What do I want?''
She examines the blueprints one by one. From swords to staves, each blueprint is a crystallization of the Tianshi Bureau's thousand years of wisdom, dazzling in its brilliance. To call any one of them 'useless' would be the height of arrogance. But which one is Lin Qingyan truly seeking in this moment?
Her gaze falls on a dusty pile of discarded scraps in the corner.
'It was originally a portable device preloaded with Originium Arts, and it fit well enough at the waist, but its performance was disappointing. Lin, you are already at the level where lightning answers your call. Making a special device to hold it is unnecessary, isn't it?'
A device that holds lightning...
Something stirs in her. She picks up a piece of scrap and examines it. After a moment's thought, she asks her senior disciple for the blueprint, sits down, and calmly begins assembling the abandoned device.
Several days later, Lin Qingyan bids her master farewell and prepares to set off down the mountain. A small coffer hangs at her waist, filled with sharp, crackling light. When her master asks her about it, she replies:
'As a child, I trained diligently so that heaven's lightning might split the darkness of the long night. But now, I've learned that there are rights and there are wrongs on this land. There are laws, and there are human emotions. Lightning might answer my call, yet there are times when it is forbidden, times when it ought not come, and times when it may come but need not. Judgment of right and wrong lies in a single human thought. So I keep this coffer to store the lightning that is summoned in those moments, so that it may spark self-reflection.'
With that, she bows deeply and starts down the mountain.

summons.name: Cage of Chaos
summons.description: Cage blocks all enemies on its tile when created/refreshed; disappears when not blocking a target or after receiving 3 attacks from a blocked target; persists an additional 30s after Tragodia's skill ends

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, I've brought myself here in the flesh. You may stop watching my videotapes.

Ever since doing away with the suppressor on my throat, Miss.Christine has deigned to lead my vocal training, teaching me how to sing unto people's minds without damaging their psyches. You'd like to hear the results? Hm. You did once request a lullaby, which... isn't my forte. I'll need practice still.

It never struck the Crimson Troupe just how their rejection of critique, their scorn of video, laid bare their cowardice and mediocrity. I used to avoid watching anything I performed in, such was my disgust... But perhaps it's time for a better seat. I see you holding those film tickets, Doctor; you needn't hide them. I accept your invitation.

There are people after me. They are disenchanted and voracious, screaming in chaos, dying to find the maker for their crazèd flock. For how could Tragodia truly die? He is but one of countless graven images to fall on the steps—He and all his kind are wholes made of shards, idols formed from syncretism. As it was with that mad and lonely stage director, snobbish soul, old friend of mine.

I've read that evaluation report; Dr. Folinic is suggesting I exit from the frontline for the time being. I can't maintain constant sobriety, that much is true; after years with these hallucinations for company, they are among the few friends I can count on my fingers. But I remain your assassin... Call me, and let me see to the work I know best.

Upon his followers, the troupe leader bestowed masks. Before long, I will set out in companionship to find those followers, one and all. Abandon reason and surrender to violence as they may, I will simply create, perform, and weave their dreams. Till they awaken from despair, till they can reexamine their souls in the mirror, wretched yet free, for better and for worse.

Some unfamiliar operators invited me to a 'movie night' after I reboarded, and the Vampire madame from Engineering seems somewhat soft on me too. So generous is the drama, it bathes its actors in halo even outside of the silver screen. Pardon? Rhodes Island's operators trust me on principle...? Mmm. They ought to be a little warier than that.

It is harder to resist destroying beauty than demonstrating it. It's a notion I try to stifle, but is it so simple to shake my bloodstained creative impulses? They were the one excuse in the troupe to touch on love and hate; they were a poison to tempt the audience; they are an inextricable yet unwordable part of me.

I must recall—the conspiracy, the slaughter, the false performances. Does creation break me free of the shadows about me, or does it bring me closer to them? Perhaps my thirst, reignited by death, will one day finally catch fire and rage. Doctor... Witness it. Grasp it. Endorse or reject it. Do not stop it.
Close your eyes. The dark of night now shrouds your consciousness; the sharp discomfort fades. So tell me, what is it you long to see... a ship, a sea of flowers, and us... That is all you want?

Permit me to shirk our operators' curious gazes for a spell. The curtain has finally fallen on the longest play, and I need some time to reorganize my thoughts. I'm sure you understand, Doctor... Pardon? I have to sign the returnee ledger with my Wrankwood autograph?
Would that they could break free of the slaver that is Hate, what then would they do...
I've woken from a nightmare, yet I still am in the night. Would you journey with me even then, dear Doctor?

The symbol of a troupe member's honor was a medal bearing Tragodia—a sentencing to days with thought and taste imprisoned, a painful past I tried again and again to cut away. But you give me a present to delight... and I will cherish it.
The stage is set.
To lead or to dominate—they are but a hair apart.
Alas, the scent of strife; I know it well.
Below the stage stirs not a soul.
Here I perform as me.
The apron and the wings are but the same.
I am everywhere.
The shadow beneath your feet is not your own.
The killing urge doth seize your flesh.
The burning hate doth speak your minds.
Resist me not; come to my song.
Shh... Listen.
Heeding your direction always leads so simply to ideal results. I ought to be on guard...
Stay the curtain call... the time is not yet come.
Flee... until your nightmares catch up to you again.
If this is not the ending in your heart, then rewrite it.
...Could you take some of those film posters off the walls?
Yes, this attire is too formal.
Once this one-act play is... roughly ready, would you like to be the first to watch?
Arknights.

On and on do new days come, yet shadows squat in the crevices of bygone days, so loath to leave. Doctor, be careful, please. Don't wallow too deeply in feelings of regret, in cursing fate. Accept failure, unease, fear... and then carry on walking.
History and murders aside, Wrankwood is a fine vacation spot.

Pierced by Originium crystal, this larynx of mine is a ruthless weapon, and proof of how the arts intoxicate me. Now that I've finally recovered my singing technique, I wonder, would you mind if... As you wish, then. Allow me to dedicate this long-overdue ballad to you. Happy birthday, Doctor.

Perhaps this sailing ship we stand on is a clear glass reflection, and Rhodes Island is but a fantasy woven by you... Yet oneiric emotions can move just as deeply as waking ones; if you believe this is all one beautiful dream, don't wake so soon.
