Uh… thank you. I'm having a hard time getting used to this Sargonian alcohol. I miss Columbian kale soda.
That's true. I've lost a few fights with those ameeri guards, and sometimes it wasn't even close. But there's still time, I'll get my chance.

The padishahs and local warriors look down on Columbian composite swords, just because they're designed for urban combat. But I'll show them the potential of combining modern technology with traditional tactics someday.
Remember, it's vital to stay hydrated, Doctor. Once you spend a whole month in the wilds of Sargon, during the dry season, without seeing so much as the mirage of an oasis… you'll get it.

At first, there weren't many tribes who believed I'm actually descended from the Qarnsayf. Can't blame them, considering how the legend has faded from history. You believed me from the start? Oh… I mean, thank you…

My dream is to host a martial arts tournament in Sargon, and gather all the warriors from all the lands, so they can share in the glory of the Qarnsayf. You should come too, and bring the best of Rhodes Island with you! Yeah, it's a promise, Doctor!
You can rest safely here. We're not in the wilds.
Hello, Doctor. I'm Hadiya, descendant of the Sargonian Qarnsayf tribe. I've come to study at Rhodes Island in order to overcome the challenges that the wilds have set for me.
Sargon warriors say that combat is the way to grow, but I can learn in this way too. Let's get started.
I'm still a very long way from my goal, but please accept my gratitude.
You honor my tribe when you honor me. Thank you for the recognition.
An opportunity to try out some new moves.
Like the wilds of Sargon, the battlefield is more dangerous than it looks. Make sure you know what you're doing.
Is your equipment ready? It all comes down to this—time to fight!
Which weapon would you like to be on the receiving end of?
My turn, finally.
What tactics do you want me to use?
I hope it's a worthy foe.
Do you know what these horns signify?
In the name of the Qarnsayf!
In the name of the wilds!
I have more than one weapon.
Take this!
I always knew I would win a memorable victory someday.
Victories like these are what Sargonian warriors live for.
No, I can't be content with the limitations of my sword. For the sake of my tribe.
Defeat is but the herald of victory. Let's pull back for now.
Ah… It's been a long time since I've had a solid roof over my head.
Be careful, or my horns might hurt you.
Curious about my sword? Here, try it out. Oh, and be careful about the spring blade in the staff.
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor. How would you like to celebrate the holiday? Are we going with Sargonian tradition, or Columbian custom, or do you have some other arrangement in mind? Either way, I'm with you.
What challenge do you have for me today, Doctor?

Today is your birthday, and I think it would do you good to set work aside for a while and go out for a walk. The landscapes of Sargon are spectacular, but you didn't seem to have time for them. Come, consider today's excursion my gift to you.
Looks like we're both a step closer to our goal. Let's celebrate this with a Columbian high-five! We've got a long way to go in the days to come.

handbook.profile: The Sargonian-Columbian Hadiya is a descendant of the Qarnsayf, a legendary warrior tribe of the desert. She joined Rhodes Island in Sargon as part of her ambition to improve her combat techniques. She currently receives training and participates in field missions at the Sargonian branch office of Rhodes Island.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Hadiya shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Before joining Rhodes Island, Operator Hadiya spent an extended time in the Sargonian wilderness without proper protection, resulting in BOCD numbers close to the infection threshold. As she is expected to spend significant time in the field, we have arranged additional tests in order to prepare proper protection for her. While Hadiya's awareness of the risks inherent in wilderness environments is lacking, she has proven cooperative with our work, which has greatly facilitated our efforts.

Based on her own account of her activities, she has been quite lucky to avoid contracting Oripathy so far. Unlike some tribal warriors, however, she is very receptive to scientific methods, and has already put in a request for other warriors from her tribe to receive similar checkups and training on Originium protection, pending approval by the Medical Department.
—Medical Department Note
handbook.promotionRecord:
She could hardly feel her legs anymore.
Through the swaying light of the firepot, she looked at the lord ameer sitting behind the table, who was gazing at her with narrowed eyes. She knew she had to maintain control of her body and not waver, because the slightest sign of weakness would give him an excuse to deny her hard work.
First, the trial of recitement. She used the techniques that Anat taught her.
Second, the trial of stamina. Long years of training carried her through.
At last, the duel with the lord ameer's elite guard. There was no time for rest before this last trial. Thoroughly exhausted, she faced off against the hulking shieldguard. None of the faces illuminated by firelight were cheering for her. She could hear the crowd roar whenever the guard parried her attacks—
'Finish her off!'
When she hooked the edge of the shield with her staff and leapt into the air with the momentum of her opponent's charge, then flicked the sword to unfold the blades and cut the guard's necklace, none of the sounds around the stage mattered anymore.
'As per our agreement, victory is mine, lord ameer.' She could feel the words in her throat, but was not sure if she actually vocalized them or not.
The reaction of the lord ameer told her that she had. It was only her third victory, with twelve more to go, but she knew she was on the right path.
She took the token and turned around to walk towards the exit. Her legs had been numb, but now they were strong again, and her steps were no longer heavy.
She left behind the light of the firepots, and gazed out at the wilderness to see the sun rising upon the horizon.
archives:
Although Hadiya first encountered Rhodes Island in Sargon, and was assigned to the Sargonian branch after she was hired, it is obvious that she is not your average Sargonian.
Her style is very different from tribal warriors. She wields a staff with her right hand and a sword with her left, both containing complex mechanisms and axle-connected blades. The staff has foldable hooked blades on one end and a blunt hammer on the other, allowing her to employ both lethal and non-lethal means to neutralize enemies in close combat. Meanwhile, the short hilt of the sword makes it easy to perform thrusting motions when wielded on its own. An elaborate connector mechanism allows the two weapons to be combined into one, whereby the staff's hammer is retracted, the folding blades extended, and the shape of the sword's blade also changes, allowing her to respond to different situations and ranges. Hadiya had these weapons custom-made for her during her time in Columbia, and their design and construction clearly reflect Columbian technological thinking, making them very different from Sargonian weapons. The techniques she demonstrates in training are also different from traditional Sargonian techniques. She is an expert at utilizing cover and obstacles in close-quarters combat, relying on guile rather than strength, and creating an advantage through the versatility of her weapon. On the other hand, she is less comfortable fighting in wide-open spaces. She admits that she is still unfamiliar with the Sargonian wilderness, having developed her habits on the streets of Columbia and in training rooms. She recognizes that this is an area she needs to improve on as part of her new responsibilities, and she often approaches other Sargonian operators to pick their brains.

[Training Room Audio Log]
'Don't you find Hadiya's conversations with other Sargonian warriors really interesting?'
'What do you mean?'
'She always wants to learn the details of their weapons, how they're built, how they work, what environments they're good in.
'Most of the time, though, the only answer she gets is:
'Don't think. Just chop.'

The experience of growing up in Columbia will always be part of her. As she has often told other operators in the Sargon area, she knew that she was destined to come to this wilderness, but she also knows that it will hard to shake her Columbian habits, even once the glory of the Qarnsayf is restored.

'I grew up in a small community in a nomadic city,' said Hadiya while chatting with other operators during break time. 'It wasn't a very wealthy district, but it was always lively, with people coming from all kinds of places, and Sargon is just one of them.
'Every group has its own unique customs, character, and views. To me, though, it always felt so cohesive.
'Everyone's habits and pastimes had become Columbianized. Watching Wrankwood movies over soda and fried fowlbeast, making a fuss during district elections, and so on.
'The movies were great though! I should bring the latest pop music next time.'

While Hadiya is happy to talk about the culture and customs of Columbia, she has never shown an intention to import them to Sargon. When asked about the reason, she said she did not want to do so, because it would ruin the purity of Sargon in her mind.
In her veneration of the wilderness, she is, indeed, a proper Sargonian—a remark from many of her colleagues.

Hadiya went through many hardships when rebuilding her tribe.
The name Qarnsayf exists only in historical records. Their territory no longer exists, nor have they left behind any extant relics, or first-hand witnesses to their exploits. This is why many lords ameer privately harbor doubts about the veracity of the legendary tribe's existence, even though The Book of Sargon contains detailed records of the Qarnsayf and their battles.
Hadiya's father's generation claimed to be the descendants of the Qarnsayf, and passed down their ancestors' teachings and the responsibility of rebuilding the tribe to hers. Although their appearance matches the depictions of the Qarnsayf in the records, and it is true that many Qarnsayf tribesmen left Sargon to become mercenaries, this is hardly enough to convince the Padishah to grant them new territory, much less make their name known throughout the tribes.
The local Padishah's challenge presented even more obstacles to her path. In order to earn the Padishah's trust and have him officially recognize the tribe and its territory, Hadiya must earn the recommendation of fifteen lords ameer and obtain their tokens—no mean feat when each one has a different demand. Defeating a lord ameer's guards in combat is merely the first step: some would not even give her the opportunity until she passed a test of history, which is hardly her strong suit. As such, at this time, Hadiya has only earned the approval of two lords ameer who allowed her to challenge their soldiers directly, and there is a long way to go until she completes the Padishah's task.
Hadiya has never complained about this. She is often seen in the break room watching Columbian movies, or chatting with colleagues about city life, showing no sign of worry about the progress of the challenge.
When others ask about it, her answer is this: If you fail, try again until you succeed.
She has never doubted that she will succeed.

[Columbian Department of Immigration Audio Log 044]
'Here are the reports on the ten Sargonians. Well, nine Sargonians now.'
'What happened?'
'One was deathly ill before crossing the border. Already dead by the time the troops found them.'
'Where are they? Still in custody?'
'Yes. It's a band of wandering mercenaries, not immigrants who entered through official channels. The military has concerns about their background and doesn't want to let them in.'
'Why don't they just deport them? Why hand them over to us?'
'Deport them where? Their employer, well, doesn't exist anymore, so that's out of the question. And the situation in Sargon is pretty chaotic right now. These ten seem to be from the same tribe, and most likely from somewhere our intel indicates a massacre occurred. The military is concerned that they might resort to desperate measures if not handled properly. I was there at the detention center, and I saw the kind of look in their eyes you only see in people who've seen hell. I'd only seen it in veterans of the Revolutionary War before.'
'So General Sfax doesn't want to be responsible for whatever happens if they're let loose. They want us to make the decision.'
'Do you want to review the report?'
'No need. Tell the general to let them in. Our mission is to absorb different types of immigrants from various places, and these Sargonians fit our needs.'
'Yes, sir, I'll let him know.'
'One more thing. Mark their papers and file them under 'Special Immigrants.' For reference when drafting future management policies.'
'Yes, sir.'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: I-I can read these… let me help you.
S-Sorry… I speak so slow. D-Doctor Warfarin said it can be, cured, but it will take… very long. It's okay, I'm already… used to it. Um, I just hope you're not… annoyed.

Wh-What's in my hand? No, not herbs, a, a kind of moss. The miners, they use it to light fires, and also, make tea. It looks pretty? Da. On the tundra, it's really easy to see, so everyone picked all of them long ago. This is… the last bunch I have, and I… want to keep it.
S-Sound, the alarm? You want me to, show you how we work in the mines…? Okay. Actually, it's not really a bell we ring, but it's… really loud. No, you have to, cover your ears. You must.

In the mines, it's very easy to, lose track of time. So I stay outside, helping them to count. They can't stay there too long, or they'll… die. One hundred and eleven, one hundred and twelve, one hundred and thirteen… like that. I count my numbers really, smoothly? Ah—whuh?

When you, speak into a cave, there's always a strange response. When I laugh, it laughs. When I'm mad at it, it's mad at me. Actually, some people are like the caves—Rankin, he saw too many… complicated things, and in the end… he became complicated too.

This letter, and the wheat ear inside it, they sent it to me, from the border. Happy? Da. I thought, everyone would separate, and never see each other again. Strange, whenever I think about their smiles, my eyes... well up with tears. Huh? That's... not weird?

H-Have you heard this story? Parents go out to shovel snow, but soon, someone knocks on the door. The child goes to open the door, and sees a manglerbeast standing, just as we do— I will never— no, it's not just because of Babushka Nadia. Y-You're right. Real family, wouldn't force me to, open the door.

N-No, I wasn't spacing out! I was counting… down until the sun sets. I don't want to… see it go away. In the north, the sun is, precious, and I'm scared it won't come back one day—it will, tomorrow? And y-you're, willing to stay with me… until it comes back up? Really?
You've been working for, so long… Do you need to rest for a bit…? I will remember… to wake you up.
H-How do you do, Doctor! Everyone calls me… Vetochki, um—oh, yes! It means twig in Ursine!
I just… need to k-keep everyone safe… and that's all, right?
I'm not scared of… hardship, or pain, either! I'll work hard… and train even more, you can… trust me on this.
This badge is for—me? But I haven't done enough. There's still so many Infected… I will help… many more people! Um, yes. You're right, we're… all in this together.
Oh, okay.
Sound… the alarm!
Please, be careful and… stay safe.
Watch out.
I… can do it!
I… got it!
Don't be scared!
D-Don't come any… closer.
Seven hundred and twenty-three, Seven hundred and twenty-two, Seven hundred and twenty-one… live on…
Fifty-nine, sixty. One, two… deep breaths…
Just, just hold on for a while longer…
I-It's time!
We… did it?
C-Can we take a break now?
Everyone… stay close to me.
W-We have to go back, some of our comrades are still… out there!
This place is… so warm.
Could you… l-let go, please!
Once upon a time, there was a… snowman who got, lost… have you, heard this story before?
Arknights.

Towards, the left, da… ah, it's crooked again. Higher on the right… just a little—yes, perfect! Thank you, for helping me, put up these festival, decorations, Doctor! We'll get to, ring in the new year, soon, so… would you like to, give it a try?
D-Doctor, you're right on time… oh, I, ah, just arrived too.
There are so many, presents on the table… ah, Doctor! When did you get back? Th-This necklace? It's an amulet I made, with colorful stones. I wanted to—here, for you. Happy birthday.

Since I was small, I always thought—I thought, pain wasn't so bad. Maybe I, deserve the pain. But—what about others? What about the people in places I've, never been? They shouldn't have to suffer. Rhodes Island… has given me a lot of 'painkillers', and I want to, share them with more people.

handbook.profile: Formerly a miner in the Central Far North Mining District of Ursus, Vetochki is currently receiving treatment at Rhodes Island, where she is also undergoing standard combat training and participates out of her own volition in Infected rescue missions as a field operator.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 15%
Crystal distribution is visible on the surface of the body, and her respiratory system is significantly affected by infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.29u/L
As a result of being born with congenital Oripathy and growing up in a high-Originium environment in the mines, Operator Vetochki suffers from serious Oripathy. She also suffers from mild to moderate speech impairment, a lingering effect of an episode of encephalitis that she suffered during childhood, for which Medical has created a treatment plan. Prior to her official onboarding, Mantra applied for psychological intervention treatment and the mental health rehabilitation program for her, signed and approved by Amiya personally.
handbook.promotionRecord: [Classified Log] ...Our investigation in Ursus has come to an end. We are now able to determine that the individual who crossed paths with Mantra in the Ursus Far North before disappearing, confirmed to be one of the Yurodstvo, had been in the Central Far North Mining District since at least 1096, living with Operator Vetochki under the identity of 'Nadia'. From Vetochki's statements in her counseling sessions, we have been able to piece together how the Yurodstvo arrived, after filtering out the statements that were clearly contradictory. With that limited information, we were able to correlate our hypotheses on the internal situation of Ursus based on possible sightings of Yurodstvo across Ursus between 1080 and 1095 (see Appendix B-2)... [Audio Log] 'I saw, the window, broken. The door, wouldn't open. I knew, babushka was, inside. 'She put her back, against the door, like she was, afraid that, someone would, barge in, and see her. 'I saw, red... lots of red, flow out, from the door crack. 'Mom and Dad... lots of red, that same red. I knew it was—death. 'I... think I, buried babushka.' (Edit marker) 'Legends say, when it's, snowing so hard, you can't, open your eyes... your dead, family will, come to you, when you're, walking alone. 'That was, what I was, thinking, and then, I saw, someone, walk towards me. 'A faint, shadow, getting closer... I ran, and I fell. 'The shadow, didn't stop, it walked, past me. I got up, and shouted— 'She looked back, and I saw... it was, Babushka Nadia! 'She just, went away, for a while, and came back. 'I didn't want, her to, go away again.' (Edit marker) 'G-Grave? Whose... grave?' 'Babushka? But babushka... she was... with me? 'No, no... then, who did I, bury?' [Classified Log]...It must be emphasized that the Yurodstvo has no emotions. It feels neither joy nor anger, love nor hate. Its appearance reflects the expectations of those who gaze upon it, while its actions are guided by certain rules that do not follow human reason or logic. Its actions in 1096—heading to the Far North and lingering there for several years—may seem curious to many, but it is entirely fitting with Yurodstvo logic and instinct. A suicide of despair, something that goes against the creeds of most religions, was sufficient to drive the Yurodstvo to attempt to 'rectify' the wrong. It transmitted the tremendous pain of the orphan left by the suicide, guiding all around it into destruction. 'The only path to salvation is enduring pain without end.' This is the closest summary we can get to the concept in our language. Sometimes, the victim might mistake it as a path to 'love'. —Mantra's annotation to Appendix B-2 of the ■■■■■ Report
archives:
4am—Wake up, check the water tank, boil water or melt snow. 4:30am—Assemble by the mining cart rails and shovel snow. If no snow, go out to forage firewood and edible moss. 6am—Return to quarters, fill water bottle, have breakfast. Before 3pm—Count the time in front of the mine entrance, and ring the bell precisely to signal the end of the shift, preventing anyone from suffocating in the mines. 3pm—Have lunch, which is the last meal of the day, and continue working until dark. If sunset comes early, work until the Patrol Unit leaves. Before retiring for the night, shovel snow to prevent it from blocking the door the next morning...
This was a day in the life of Vetochki, bell-toller at the Central Far North Mining District of Ursus.
'Vetochki' is what everyone has called her since the day she was born, and the other miners thought she had long forgotten her real name, but she was able to recite it before Rhodes Island's HR operators, one syllable at a time—Anya Ivanovna Smirnova. In Ursine tradition, the name of a child takes after their parents.
Vetochki's parents were miners too. They managed to save her life from the great flu that swept the Far North, but could not find medicine for the complications from encephalitis. After several nights of prayer, they began contacting workers who lost their children from lack of food and medicine, and attempted to organize a strike for the sake of the children to come. They failed.
Vetochki is not afraid to talk about it, though she does not remember much about what happened. All she could do was try to remember her own name, silently reciting the syllables that once belonged to her parents, over and over.
The other miners protected her after her parents were executed. She became bell-toller at an age when she was too young to lift a pickaxe, and it became her job to sit at the entrance and count the time, avoiding the ordeal of descending into the mines. Ringing the bell fends off the shadow of death, and it is a job that she always performed admirably. At counseling sessions, she called it her duty.

I saw the replica she made in her spare time, though it looks more like a gong than a bell.
—HR Operator

She has never seen a real bell, and the others never corrected her... Before escaping the mines, she tied her 'bell' onto a shield, in order to protect those who once protected her.
—Raidian

[Audio Log]
Her condition is unusual: a speech impairment caused by a brain condition. It's not a mental disorder, and her intelligence is unaffected. There's no need to go out of your way to speak slowly when talking to her! Just because she talks slower doesn't mean she has any hearing problems. As a matter of fact, she scored significantly above average in mental acuity compared to others in her age group. Heck, she's probably smarter than you were at her age. The point being, there's no need for special accommodation in this regard. As I said, her condition is perfectly normal. Wait, did I say it was unusual? Same thing, same difference.
—Warfarin

Vetochki's counselor writes in a report, 'Vetochki's speech disability has not negatively impacted her self-esteem; she is simply concerned that the listener might ignore what she says because of it.
Vetochki maintained her childhood habit for some time after she came to Rhodes Island, organizing the words she wanted to say in her mind before articulating them word-by-word. Controlling the muscles of her throat and maintaining a steady speech rhythm are a chore for her, but she never abbreviates simply to save effort, or gives up on talking entirely. It is not 'being brave' to communicate what she wants to communicate, it is a necessity. Fortunately, there are plenty of people on Rhodes Island who are willing to listen.
Vetochki has made friends with several operators around the same age, and the group often works on coloring books in the games room in their free time. They soon found that she was always the first to complete the coloring, something that she herself was also surprised by. After finishing coloring, they turn to drawing whatever comes to mind on blank paper, free of constraints. They will draw their rooms, their families, the places they want to go... They did not need to talk, for their drawings revealed their thoughts and emotions. One time, they realized that they had accidentally drawn on one of Frostleaf's blank vocabulary books, and they cried out in surprise before falling over in laughter.
Frostleaf did not say anything upon hearing Vetochki's apology. She simply thought for a bit, put an unnamed tape in her music player, then put her headphones on Vetochki's head. They spent an entire afternoon gazing wordlessly at the swirling bubbles in the washing machines, listening to Frostleaf's mix-tape from beginning to end.

[Audio Log]
There are a lot of ways to express yourself. I understood her, and she understood me. I don't see any 'impairment' in her.
—Frostleaf

Vetochki brought a pile of 'herbs' with her from Ursus, dried moss that she used in various ways to soothe pain. Analysis by the Medical Department revealed that the moss had no pain-killing effect; all it did was irritate the bowels. Therefore, Vetochki's 'treatment' involved little more than enduring the pain of Oripathy through sheer force of will.
Vetochki was finally convinced to stop taking her 'herbs', though this probably had something to do with the fact that there was little left. She could be spotted on the deck from time to time, sniffing at the last patch of dried moss. Perhaps the scent of the tundra brought back memories.
When she learned from our gardening-inclined operators that certain types of dried moss are not truly dead and can grow again in the proper environment, she immediately got herself a fine porcelain pot, planting the moss in soil. Then she waited and waited, but the dried color of the moss never changed.
One day, she took the pot out of her room and placed it in a bright, well-ventilated corner of the corridors.
A few days later, someone left a watering can next to it, perhaps one of the operators who frequent the greenhouses.
A few more days later, someone added some peat soil to the pot, which provides better conditions for moss, as well as a vial of fertilizer.
Yet a few more days later, someone drew a small sun on the pot, and placed a small humidifier next to it.
The moss seemed different, more moist than before, but it did not seem that anyone was actively taking care of it.
A few months later, Vetochki ran into the lounge with the pot of moss in her hands, and set it down in the Green Corner, where other operators have placed their own plants from every corner of Terra. There, it is always green and vibrant, regardless of the season or time of day.
Now, there is a little pot of moss there too, with tiny flowers growing proudly on top.
The experienced gardeners know, of course, that moss does not bloom. It seems that seeds from elsewhere have drifted onto the dead moss, taking root and growing strong enough to bloom.
Does Vetochki know that? Everyone who has seen the pot knows that that is not important.

[Rhodes Island Task Record]
Date: 1101-■-■
Location: Ursus wilderness, ■■km from Grypherburg
We have left the Polar Night Zone, and Grypherburg is in sight. At dawn, we received a signal from operators located in Grypherburg.
The Doctor and Amiya made the decision for us to pull out of Ursus and review the information we have before deciding our next move. The surviving miners with us are mostly in stable condition. They will enter Grypherburg under Eloysius's protection as 'witnesses'. We cannot take everyone, but we will take a few who are in dire need of medical attention.
We say goodbye tonight and proceed to the evac point under the cover of night...

Vetochki has never seen Deity Grypherburg. She has heard the others talk about the streetlamps, the domes, and the aroma of freshly baked bread, but she has a hard time imagining what it looks like. But now... it is but a stone's throw away.
She is already making plans for her first trip to the magnificent city. She wants to see everything there is to see on the first day, but is concerned that she will expend all her excitement and curiosity in the first hour. She knows that she and the others will become 'witnesses', testifying against the Grand Duchess—but it is Grypherburg, that warm place which she has heard about so many times.
Eloysius soon poured cold water on the idea. Even today, Grypherburg would never allow a group of Infected to openly go out onto the streets to admire the lights. Vetochki knew little about the city, and with each thing she learned, the cold winds of Ursus blew away a little bit more of her warm illusion.
As such, she did not have many regrets about missing Grypherburg when Amiya and Raidian proposed that she receive treatment at Rhodes Island. She was more concerned that her friends were headed there as 'witnesses' and that they could not come with her.
Vetochki declined our invitation and returned to the miners. When she looked up again, she saw that great Grypherburg was, after all, no more than a little blurry speck on the horizon. She closed her eyes in front of the fire. Here, at least she could be with friends, and tell them her thoughts. When she did so, however, she was surprised to find that those familiar faces earnestly advised her to leave.
The miners wanted to give her a token, a promise that they would meet again, but they had nothing on them. So they each grabbed a bunch of dried grass with snow on it and put it in her hand.
Her eyes red, Vetochki came to the Rhodes Island delegation, asking when they would leave. Raidian took her hand, dried grass and all, and said, 'After dark.'

[Rhodes Island Task Record]
Date: 1101-■-■
Location: Ursus wilderness, ■■km from Grypherburg
...The blizzard grew stronger after night fell, providing ideal cover for our retreat. Half a kilometer from the camp, however, the raging wind and snow interfered with signals, making it difficult to tell which way we were going, or if we were even making progress at all, or just going around in circles.
Suddenly, Vetochki cried out and pointed into the distance, where lights were floating above the horizon. The Doctor soon realized that it was the torches carried by the surviving miners led by Eloysius, heading towards Grypherburg.
According to the plan, they did not need to travel in the middle of a blizzard. It was only when we saw tears stream down Vetochki's face that we realized it was more than a goodbye, more than a guiding light, more than a gift, more than a memory... It was something more complex, more sincere, something that keeps all of us going.

modules.moduleDescription:
'Hope this letter finds you well, Vetochki. We're doing good, and the wheat fields aren't as noisy as the mines. You should have come with us, haha. But I guess Rhodes Island is treating you well? There's a recent photo of us in the envelope. Who would have thought that these Reunion folks would have cameras?'
'About the watch you mentioned in the last letter, I asked the craftsmen here, but they didn't know the reason either. Oh, the weather hasn't been great and we need to harvest the crops before it rains. Will write again later.'
Vetochki picks up the photo. There are miners laughing in it, but Rankin's figure is nowhere to be seen. The pocket watch was from Rankin. Why doesn't he write back himself?
Vetochki picks up a pen.
'<i>Uchitel<i> Rankin: The pocket watch that you gave me has stopped working, and I'm not sure why. Could you write back when you have time?'
Vetochki looks at the watch, wondering whom it used to belong to. Rankin never said anything about how he came into possession of it. Perhaps it belonged to one of the researchers who died.
Both Rankin and herself have cared for the watch like its original owner, leaving not a single mark on it. Vetochki pauses and picks it up again. No, Rankin has left no mark upon it.
The reply letter arrived soon, but it was not what she had hoped to read.
'Vetochki, I'm so sorry. I don't even know where to start...'
...
Vetochki takes out a piece of paper and tries to write back. She has always been a smooth writer, without even a hint of the stuttering that plagues her speech, but right now the pen feels so heavy she can hardly even hold it. The lines she writes are broken, disconnected, like words stuffed into a corner of her heart. She grabs her own wrist and tries to stop the trembling, to no avail.
No! She tosses the pen aside and knocks over her toolbox. She finds a screwdriver and decides to fix the watch herself.
She is unfamiliar with precision instruments, and her hands are not as steady as they normally are. The screwdriver leaves a conspicuous mark on the shiny metal shell, breaking the perfection that she and Rankin had maintained.
She closes her eyes, but still sees the words in that letter.
'We don't talk about Rankin much anymore, but we haven't forgotten about him.'
'He died on the way to the Ursus-Kazimierz border. We didn't realize you didn't know. I'm so sorry, Vetochki.'
...
She touches the mark on the shell with her fingertip, until the feeling no longer brings her fear.
She opens her eyes, and finds that it looks like part of a letter.
Her hands still trembling, she picks up the screwdriver again, not to repair the watch, but to etch a couple of names upon it.

LINKAGE.voiceText: It's funny, Umiri-chan always handles these things for us in Ave Mujica. So here, I have to adjust to managing my own schedule.

Lately, I've been stargazing on the deck with Astesia-san. The stars in Terra's sky are nothing like the ones I know. And when I tell her about our version of astronomy, I can almost see her hanging on every word I say.
Huh? You want me to teach you how to write lyrics...? Wait, Doctor, don't look at my terminal!

The cap and sunglasses? They're for wearing in crowded places, I guess. I work in the performing arts, so I'm kind of... a celebrity? I guess... Wait, Doctor, could it be you're a celebrity on Terra? Heheh. Look, you always have the hood on.
Sora-san always has such a warming effect on people, even when she's not performing. It'd be nice if I could fill everyone with that kind of warmth too.

I'd rather heal us all through music than fight. But... I get it. Becoming stronger is how I stay by Saki-chan's side. That's why I'll always keep putting in the effort, whether here on Terra or back in our world.

Ever since coming to Rhodes Island, we members of Ave Mujica have been spending a lot more time together. Once work's done for the day, we head to the studio to practice... It's kind of like we're all in a school club.

Ave Mujica has always meant so much to Saki-chan. And knowing how she treasures it, I want to protect it for her... I want to keep being Mujica's frontwoman, where I can live, breathe, and embody Mujica's world.

Ending up in a strange place and having to bond with strange people has taken a lot of energy, I'll admit, but getting to learn so much in exchange has all been worth it. I still barely know right from left here, but... I'd like to keep on bonding with the people of Rhodes Island, I think.
Maybe I'll brew some coffee and wait around until the Doctor wakes up?
Hello, I'm Uika... Misumi. Huh? You already heard about me from Saki-chan? How did she describe me, can you tell me?!
Are these all... actual battles you taped?
Rhodes Island's training program is incredible! I feel like it's building every part of me up at once. This is going to make concerts so much easier too!
I don't know when I'll end up home again. Is it really okay for you to pour so much into me, despite that...? Alright, thank you. I'll be sure to work hard to meet your expectations, Doctor.
As the squad's frontwoman, I'll lead the way for you all.
I've never been a leader to anyone before, but... I'll serve as a good example for you all!
Be careful out there!
Don't let your guard down. We can definitely win this!
I'll help out!
Doctor, I'm trusting you.
To your curtain fall... an elegy.
To our victory... a paean.
I'm going to sing.
Saki-chan, everyone, I'll protect you!
I'll cover you now!
Don't panic!
After getting back, let's take a nice hot bath, put on some relaxing music, and really unwind.
We're really getting into sync here!
I just hope nobody got hurt...
It's okay, I... I'll always be by your side.
It's really nice in here, isn't it!
One moment, let me put my guitar away... Okay, sorry about that. What do you need, Doctor?
Doctor! Want to go see the stars together?
Arknights.
Back in our world, everyone makes a wish on New Year's. Like this―you put your hands together, and close your eyes... If you have a wish, give it a try. It'll be nice if yours comes true too.
Good timing, I was just brewing coffee. Do you want some?

Happy birthday, Doctor! That tape's got a couple of songs on it. We wrote them for you, and for everyone at Rhodes Island. So even after we return to our old world someday, you'll still have these songs by your side forever.

When I first got here, I thought I was practically useless. But Rhodes Island is such a warm place, isn't it? It takes in any point of view, it gave me a role that I could play―I guess what I'm saying is, maybe I've earned the right to pride myself, as a member of Rhodes Island?

handbook.profile: Uika Misumi, the charismatic guitarist-vocalist of Ave Mujica, as well as a member of the idol unit sumimi. Her hobbies include stargazing. Concern for Sakiko also appears to be a forefront preoccupation of hers.

handbook.promotionRecord:
[Iris's Notes]
Uika has spent her life living in guilt. Though she stands by Sakiko's side, where she has always longed to be, her heart remains trapped in the past. When she feared that telling the truth would destroy the relationship they had, she found herself paralyzed in place.
When Sakiko was in pain, Uika believed that it was her and her lies who caused that pain to Sakiko, and that there was nothing Uika could do to help her. The end result was that she could not be there by Sakiko's side to support her.
One day, Uika will understand that she cannot simply hide her true feelings beneath a perfect smile. There will come a time when she must face herself.
Uika will not remember all that transpired on Terra when she wakes from the dream. But perhaps, a part of her experiences here will stay with her and give her courage—
The courage to face her own sorrow, and to move forward.
archives: With an infectiously bright smile and excellent communication skills, Uika Misumi has fit in well at Rhodes Island. Throughout her time diligently learning the ins-and-outs of working here, Uika has earned the trust of those aboard Rhodes just like the other members of Ave Mujica.

Though she is only in her first year of high school, Uika has already made a successful debut as a member of sumimi, an idol group from her home country. A diligent hard worker, Uika has a wonderful voice and outstanding guitar skills, and also writes her own songs and lyrics. She was scouted for Ave Mujica by Sakiko.
As guitarist-vocalist of Ave Mujica, Uika gives her everything for the band, and her deep love for it is plain for everyone to see.

Uika and Sakiko are childhood friends, which is the reason Uika joined the band. To Uika, Sakiko is more than just a friend; she is someone Uika has always aspired after.
At Rhodes Island, the pair often go up to the deck to watch the stars. Though the night sky of Terra is strange and unfamiliar, when shared with Sakiko, there could be nothing more beautiful to Uika.

We have noticed that Uika seems to put up certain subtle barriers in her interactions with us. It is not that she is not being sincere, but there is a sense that she is intentionally refraining from expressing her opinion. Compared to taking about her own thoughts, she seems to prefer to know about what Sakiko thinks. Uika's feelings toward Sakiko are more than just care or aspiration; there seem to be deeper, darker feelings within.

modules.moduleDescription: It was while wandering around Rhodes Island absentmindedly that Uika met Astesia. Uika has been enchanted by the elegant yet mystifying astrology of Terra at first sight, and is happy to find a passionate kindred spirit in Astesia. The two become friends instantly. In making Astesia's divination room a regular destination, Uika begins to learn divination herself. Terra's sky is altogether not the sky Uika knew, and its every unknown is a fierce draw to her. Keeping an observation log of the stars as Astesia does, perusing the material Astesia gathers, sometimes having Astesia tell her fortune, she finds herself partaking in all sorts of particular little rituals while gazing the stellar sea. What fascinates Uika about divination isn't the results as much as the very method itself, and she picks up some sword skills involved in the divination ritual too. Feeling the stars' aspects as Astesia can is out of her reach, but Uika enjoys her time with astrology all the same. The days pass, and the two grow closer than ever. One day, they make time for tea brewed by Astesia, as they are sitting beside a miniature revolving planetarium. 'You really do love the stars, don't you, Uika? There aren't many at Rhodes Island who could say much about them. Terra's night sky and its astrology are both plagued with mystery, so it's rare anyone devotes their time and attention just out of love. Why do you look at the stars, I wonder?' Uika lapses into thought, then smiles and answers. 'Looking at the stars calms me down... they give me courage to deal with the pressure and negative emotions in life. That's why they're so special to me.' 'Really? So you're not, say, entrusting them with your feelings toward someone special?' 'Eh? Wh-What makes you think that?!' Uika has never flustered in front of Astesia until now. 'Well, whenever I see you looking up at the starry sky without a word, or learning how to divine... I see that look in your eyes—you hope to share that moment with a treasured one, and you pray for their happiness.' 'W-Was it really that easy to tell...?' Flustered, Uika's cheeks reddened. 'There's nothing embarrassing about it! I'm just like you. So I know just how you feel.' 'You do...?' 'I do. I have my dear little sister here at Rhodes Island too, and I have to keep going for her sake. Oh, but she does keep telling me how stubborn I am... Heheh. I have a ways to go as a big sister myself.' Oh. She sounds just like... I see. Maybe that's why we clicked so well. 'I know stargazing is a personal hobby of yours, but you're just as interested in divination, aren't you? Say, are you hoping to divine someone's fortune?' 'Oh, Astesia-san, you really...' Uika means to underline her gratitude with that, but Astesia suddenly leans in closer, brimming with intrigue. 'Is it family? Or a friend? Are they at Rhodes Island? Or back in your home country?' 'Er, well... it's—a little complicated, to be honest...'

LINKAGE.voiceText: If there's nothing to do, I'll... be here.
Since when was I in the Activity Room...? Since... before you came in...
Vegetables... could grow well here.
You want me to play the guitar? Okay.
I got this fragrance from Perfumer-san. She says Gloria uses it too.
Heheh... It's nice to... meet expectations.
So you... also waver, and can't make up your mind... I... do that a lot...
Saki once said... we're all 'badgers in the same hole'.
Here, nobody recognizes... Minami-chan and Ta-kun...
Did I wake you up? Sorry.
Mutsumi Wakaba... Nice to meet you.
I can tell... this isn't just for show. These people, they really died.
I need... more practice...
You're... praising me...
Okay.
I think... Saki should be better...
Let's get started.
Enemies... they're coming.
I'm... ready.
I'm prepared.
I've got no... choice...
I can't... fail.
I'll try...
These enemies aren't all that scary.
Just don't... think at all...
Just do it like I practiced.
Thank goodness.
I didn't... fail this time.
Thank you for... covering for me...
I... messed things up again...
I'll be... right here.
What is it?
I'm practicing.
Arknights.
I was on stage just now... No, not Ave Mujica. The Rhodes Island play. I was a tree.
Doctor. I didn't have any nightmares, last night... What about you?
Happy... birthday. This is… your present.
It's so lively outside. Are you sure you're not going...? You're staying in? Okay.

handbook.profile: Mutsumi Wakaba, guitarist of Ave Mujica. Quiet and of few words, she helps out with simple tasks aboard Rhodes Island, and has her own little patch in the Convalescent Garden for growing produce.

handbook.promotionRecord:
[Iris's Notes]
Mutsumi has spent her entire life under the gaze of others—from her parents, from the entertainment industry, and from society at large, all wanting 'Mutsumi Wakaba' to become who they want her to be.
Under such pressure, a terrified and helpless Mutsumi played the role of a good daughter and a future star like her mother, with acting that surpassed even her mother in skill.
Mutsumi played countless 'roles' in order to protect herself. She grew more numb every time she took the stage or exited it as one of these roles, and stopped thinking about anything other than being the Mutsumi Wakaba that people wanted to see.
May Mutsumi's experiences in Terra stay with her when she wakes from the dream, giving her courage—
The courage to accept herself, the courage to accept 'Mutsumi Wakaba'.
archives: Like Sakiko Togawa, Mutsumi Wakaba comes from a well-off family. Born to famous parents, she had been the center of attention from a young age, and was childhood friends with Sakiko. Though Mutsumi often struggles to communicate her feelings, it is crystal clear how important Sakiko is to her, and how she quietly supports Sakiko.

Mutsumi's struggles with communication have continued on Rhodes Island. She tends to help out with Sakiko's work where she can, seldom interacting with others on her own.
She can sometimes be found tending to fruits and vegetables on her own in the Convalescent Garden. She shows little sign of emotion when other operators talk to her, the conversation ending after a couple of short exchanges. That said, it wasn't long before people noticed that Mutsumi does not only work on her own plot; she also helps care for plants in other areas. To return the favor, the other operators help her out in kind without saying a word, working together to keep the garden beautiful.
In a later development, operators began to find paper bags at their dormitory doors, filled with produce planted by Mutsumi—in her own way, an utmost expression of her gratitude.

Sakiko has asked us not to put too much pressure on Mutsumi. Mutsumi's mother is a famous actress and her father a famous comedian, leading the entertainment industry and the public to place great expectations on her, something that has troubled her all her life. Outside of her remarkable family circumstances, however, she is simply a kind-hearted girl who struggles with communication.
Sakiko tells us that she knows she cannot shelter Mutsumi all the time, but at least she wants to give Mutsumi a place where she can feel safe and comfortable.

Mutsumi does not talk much, but her kind heart is there for everyone to see. She always works hard to complete her missions, and other operators are impressed about how much she listens to others, as can be seen from her mission reports. As a matter of fact, Mutsumi is quite sensitive to what others say, and it is precisely her desire to live up to other people's expectations that has created pressure for her. She keeps these struggles to herself, only pushing herself harder. This personality trait has led to her suffering many times over. Sakiko, Mutsumi's childhood friend, is the only one who understands her pain. Hopefully, the support of other Rhodes Island operators will make life a little easier for Mutsumi here.

modules.moduleDescription: Sakiko is worried for Mutsumi. It's been a while since the advent of their life at Rhodes Island, but Mutsumi remains her silent self. She is there for missions and practice, but one hardly ever sees her mingling with the other operators. Sakiko knows how Mutsumi always struggles with putting her feelings into words. Hoping she isn't being stressed out, Sakiko decides to pay her a visit. Tending to the fruits and vegetables in the Convalescent Garden is one of Mutsumi's small little pleasures. Sakiko knows she enjoys spending time there. As Sakiko goes to the garden, she finds Mutsumi is right there in the garden. She isn't even sure why she's so nervous as she slips into a corner. From there, she catches Mutsumi's voice in conversation. 'Is Mutsumi talking to somebody...?' Sakiko's heart makes a light pirouette of joy. She catches little snatches of the discussion here and there—Terran plant cultivation and growth stages, the Garden's environmental regulator systems, what kinds of produce the operators like. 'As you say, Lancet-2, watering isn't a trade without its tricks.' 'Indeed. If you're in need of a hand, I will gladly help—save water, or have it be mineral-enriched, just tell me what you need and I'll make the adjustments.' 'Thank you...' 'However, I can't make any promises about the results. I'm only acting based on the knowledge I have available, after all...' 'Hey! What's with all that negativity? Take pride in yourself! We WILL do this!' 'Okay, THRM-EX. The lighting system's on you.' 'My passion goes out to you, Madam Wakaba! Leave it to me! I've never been assigned with such a delicate mission before, but have no fear, I'll show you a job done perfectly! You have it on my name that I won't be exploding!' '...Please don't.' 'I came under the assumption my knowledge was necessary to renovate the Convalescent Garden... Did you really call me here for this frivolity? No hard feelings, but I'm taking my leave.' 'Master Friston-3, we ask for your assistance too.' 'Don't push me, Castle-3! What? Stay here and make sure nobody thieves the vegetables?!' 'Now then, what do you seek from me? ...You wish to learn how these plants are nurtured and how the pests are kept at bay? I shan't mind. Tending to the young ones is one of life's many pleasant distractions.' 'By our powers combined, the sprouting of the largest cucumber on Rhodes Island is nigh! I'm sure Closure will be STUNNED by our efforts!' '...Hmph. What a waste of time.' Sakiko feels relief wash over her. Mutsumi has made this many friends at Rhodes Island! Not having caught the conversation in its entirety, Sakiko doesn't know what those new friends' names are. I shall ask Mutsumi about them whenever the opportunity comes up, she thinks to herself, exiting the Garden. As expected, Mutsumi succeeded in cultivating an enormous cucumber. The excessively maverick methods employed, however, had seen the cucumber's composition mutate, and any further cultivation ended up forbidden. For her part, Mutsumi kept her silence on the whole matter, and so Sakiko never found out who those friends of hers were.

LINKAGE.voiceText: You can leave that paperwork, I handled it already. Any issues, Doctor?

I've noticed Rhodes Island's ops don't tend to hold back on strength or personality. But nobody clashes with anyone. They're all able to treat each other with respect. I don't know what to make of it, honestly.
Vigna invited me to see her perform live. She's got impressive guitar skills. I'm really looking forward to it.
No need for concern. Practice time and rest time are both fully blocked out on my schedule, and I've given myself plenty of leeway in my work hours. I'm never going to collapse.
As long as Rhodes Island is going to look after me, I owe it to your people to help you out.

The relationship between you and Amiya-san is a good influence on everyone else. Just one of those Rhodes things. The people here all think of each other as family. I'm just as honored to be able to contribute.
These honey biscuits Ceobe-san likes are good. It's hard to stop eating them.
I know everyone at Rhodes Island has their own troubles, but they all prop each other up through whatever they're going through. I really owe a lot to them, especially you, Doctor. I'm very thankful.
A boatloads of squads requested for me to help them out with things again. I'll work through each task one by one for everyone at Rhodes Island.
Hmm... Doctor, I see you're still working at it. Here, a chocolate panna cotta to keep you going.
Umiri Yahata. If you need anything, just ask.
I like the efficiency. I'm taking notes.
I'm just doing what I'm supposed to.
I'm happy that everyone at Rhodes Island has accepted me. Perhaps they might even be able to fulfill my wishes too, don't you think?
Got it.
You want me to lead? Understood.
Let's get going.
I expected this. Let's go.
Here.
Hmm? Need me?
In position.
Right on target.
Leave it to me.
This is easy.
Hrnph!
Excuse me.
Mission complete. Couldn't have done it without you all.
That was some nice leadership, Doctor.
That was a close call. We need more practice under our belt.
Let's hustle. We're not going to leave anyone behind.
So this is the area I can freely utilize? Where's the training room then?
Eh?
Yes. I'm here.
Arknights.
Doctor. Happy New Year. I'm looking forward to our new journey ahead.
Hello, Doctor. Want to head to training?
There you are. Doctor, happy birthday. Here's your cake and your present. I guarantee it'll be good. I've had that store's cake before.

You know. Little by little I've opened up, here at Rhodes Island. Now I can put my own thoughts out there without worrying what others think of me. I have the people of Rhodes Island to thank for that, as well as you. So thank you, Doctor.

handbook.promotionRecord:
[Iris's Notes]
On a subconscious level, Umiri is aware that the reason she cannot establish relations of trust with others is because she cannot bare her true heart to them.
She must overcome her past trauma and step out of her comfort zone, and once again reveal her heart to her friends.
When the day should come that Umiri wakes from the dream and forgets all that transpired within, may a part of what she experienced here remain with her and give her courage—
The courage to face others with her true heart.
archives:
Our first impression was that Ave Mujica was merely a student band that had stumbled upon Rhodes Island. Our thinking changed, however, as they blended into Rhodes, and began to ask how they could help.
We were surprised at how quickly Umiri Yahata absorbed new knowledge and put it into practice, and how she took the initiative in communication and working with others, supporting her team in the same way that the bass supports the rest of the band.
She is always calm, never flustered regardless of the situation—at least, so we thought.

'Umiri helps out our planning work here at Rhodes. She'll draft us a whole array of plans, all of them easy to understand and execute on. She's highly reliable, and we owe more than our fair share to her.'
A very fast learner, Umiri quickly earned the trust of many teams with her thorough planning and schedule management.
She is quick to grasp the mission objective and see it through without a hitch, making her the ideal partner.
'She's a serious and brisk worker, but there's always this distance between her and us...' So operators who work with her may feel on occasion, but quickly dismiss it, assuming they're just overthinking it.

It is true that Umiri has kept her distance from those around her, but it is not because she is wary of others.
She was overly eager in her first band, frequently giving instructions that she believed would help the band succeed, but ended up drawing the ire of the other band members, causing the band to fall apart.

It is easy to forget that Umiri is still a young student facing challenges appropriate to her age, so outstanding are her bass skills and management ability.
She pushes herself hard with a schedule that is packed to the brim between work and practice, as well as a rigorous training regimen.
Despite her image of perfection, Umiri can find it stressful when things do not go according to plan. Binge shopping at the Rhodes Island shop is her way of blowing off steam. While the operators there are overjoyed to see her, and take photos of her with both hands full of shopping bags as commemoration, they also remind her not to go overboard with her purchases.

modules.moduleDescription: One day, Ave Mujica are practicing as usual. But after running through one song, Sakiko pauses and asks, 'Yahata-san, you seem quite distracted. Is something the matter?' Past Umiri has managed her schedule to a T, easily playing for multiple bands at once with room to spare. In recent days, however, she seems almost tired, which the entire band including Sakiko find more than peculiar. Is she still adjusting to working at Rhodes Island? Umiri is silent for a spell, then gives her response while still chewing on it. '...I'll deal with it ASAP. I have no intention of causing trouble for any of you.' 'I see. Well then, let us continue practice.' Sakiko drops the issue, while the others trust that Umiri, being Umiri, can handle whatever the problem she is having is. Practice ends, and away from prying eyes, Umiri swiftly makes for a gym. Not the typical training room used by other operators, but a set of older facilities further away from the dorms, and hardly patronized these days. Alone in the gym, dinnertime notwithstanding, Umiri uncaps a bottle of protein shake. By all accounts, that is to be her dinner tonight. Chugging the tasteless protein drink, Umiri casts an eye over her schedule. Three hours of training first, and then she is finally on break. '...That was a slip-up. I'll need to put more effort into adjusting to life here. 'Kay and the Sankta operators keep inviting me to try out sweets, and it's not like I can refuse. Which means I'll have to double my normal training amount in order to work all the excess off.' Letting out a deep sigh, Umiri sets about her final training session of the day. The Sanktas of Rhodes Island have taken a great liking to Umiri. Why? Because she is one of the few people who would go out for dessert with them (Ceobe being one of the few others, of course). Most operators politely decline their invitations, but Umiri always accepts happily with genuine enthusiasm. Truth is, she is merely being courteous too, and never takes more than a bite or two. Little does she know that those half-hearted nibbles are exactly what have been quietly fueling her rising popularity. Throwing herself into training as she works to maintain her physique, Umiri is none the wiser—her Sankta friends are carrying a Laterano's brand new Sugar Glazed Pudding Butter Croissant Tower (serves ten in Lateran units) and on the hunt for her right this moment.

LINKAGE.voiceText: Ah, Doc! Say, anything need doing?
Oh, my god! If I did a vlog in here I might rake in major views, maybe? No, c'mon, obviously I'm not really!
I'm kiiiiiiinda busy right now, save it for later~
You ever notice how Rhodes Island is just full of all kinds of operators? Everyone's got their own goals, their own talents, it's a real show. I kinda wanna get stuck in and interview around!
Why do I volunteer for practice? Obviously you give everything you've got for your dream, right?

Whaaat? You've got more work for me? Alright, but in exchange... No, nonono, I'm kidding! If you and Amiya-chan are gonna put your trust in me like that, what am I to do but nyam-up and work my butt off!
No way! Do you see all the cute ops here at Rhodes Island?! SO blessed! Just need to get them in a makeup vid... Ahah, I can see the views rolling in already!
So like, a ton of the kids in Medical are fans of me now! So I'm thinking, rule no.1, gotta give the fans what they want, right?

I keep thinking lately. About reaching my goals. 'Cause doing whatever it takes, grinding away all on my own, that's been me. But hey, maybe it's nice to detour a little too, once in a while. That might be because everyone at Rhodes Island is so nice.
Huuuh. Doc fell asleep. Well, if you're asking to get pranked, who am I to say no? Nah, kidding♪
Good morn-nyamu-nyamu! New hire Nyamuchi reporting in! Nice to meetcha♪
Hell yeah~♪ Can't stop Nyamuchi evolving~
What's this? Oh, I get it, you're in with the Nyamuchi fans now?
That's right, I've been putting in tons of work, yeah? Keep that praise coming my way, yeah?
...Okay.
Wait, so I'm leading? Not Sakiko?
Okay, showtime~
Ah, enemy spotteeeed!
I'm right here~
Hmm? Need me?
C'mere, c'mere!
I got this~
I'll show you what I'm really made of!
Take that!
Let's turn up the energy!
Nuh-uh-uh!
Ahahah! We make a seriously great team, huh?
Total victory! This means time for an afterparty! C'mon, let's do it!
Grrgh... Next time, I'll nail it...
Are you gonna be a downer? 'Cause we need to think about what went wrong and why.
Oh, wow! This is a killer spot you Rhodies have got!
Nyamutto♪
Hey, chill out, chill out~
Arknights.
Happy New Year! Another year of heading onward and upward for me! That's right, you too, Doc, onward and upward♪
Nice work out there, Doc!
Happy birthday~! Here you go, a present for you. Now, can I expect something nice when Nyamu's day rolls around?
Must be the Nyamuchi influence livening up Rhodes today, no doubt about it. Where's my thanks, Doc? Thank me~!

handbook.promotionRecord:
[Iris's Notes]
Sailing for her goal in a straight line comes naturally to Nyamu, be it in dreams or reality; it is a notion she takes for granted.
It is fortunate, then, that she could rediscover the love she once abandoned.
She will not remember what transpired here when she wakes from the dream and returns to her old life, but she will continue to pursue her ideals. May a part of this dream stay with her and give her courage—
The courage to reach out to what she loves.
archives: Nyamu Yūtenji demonstrated great curiosity about Rhodes Island the moment she set foot on the ship. Outside of work, she can often be seen studying Rhodes Island and Terra in the archives, always declining with a smile when asked if she's in need of any help. There are still many mysteries about her.

Nyamu is not just a very physically capable drummer; her bright and friendly personality has also made her many friends amongst the operators. Yet she is also highly observant, and sensitive to changes in other people's moods. By inferring what people are thinking based on their expression and body language, she is able to respond appropriately and maintain a positive atmosphere.
Everyone in the Medical Department recognizes how kind and gentle Nyamu is, though she is loath to admit it herself.

We thought it Nyamu's talent that allowed her to perform so well, both in her band and in her work at Rhodes Island.
It was only later that we learned it was not simply about talent, but the constant hard work that she puts in on her own. She is never satisfied, always pushing herself to move forward, as though the idea she could be at a standstill angers and terrifies her.
Hopefully, she will find the opportunity to slow down and take a little time off while she is on Rhodes Island.

Nyamu will spare no effort in pursuit of her dreams.
We have come to a hypothesis based on her actions and on excerpts of information from other Mujica members.
Nyamu is used to following the path that she believes to be most efficient, paying no heed to what other people think. Indeed, she could not even spare the time to think about whether she should give up or not.
In the presence of true genius, she found herself both awed and envious, and such emotions further fuel her fire.

modules.moduleDescription: Nyamu is at Goldenglow's salon, doing makeup for a little child. 'Just a little blush, and you've got a natural shine to make the sun jealous! You're looking great!' 'Thank you, Miss Nyamu! When my stone disease is better, do you think I can become as pretty as you?' 'Of course you can! And I'll do your makeup even cuter for you then.' 'How about, you become my teacher then! And, and I want you to teach me how to play the drums all cool as well!' The child moved her limbs about, mimicking Nyamu's playing. 'Ooh, I'm a strict teacher. You sure you're ready?' Nyamu grinned. 'But first you heal up, then you can work on your skills, capiche?' 'Capiche! I'm gonna listen to everything the doctors say! Mom says if I do that, I'm sure to get better!' 'Good, good, there's a good kid. Listen, my name? It's 'Nyamu', which means 'young wheat'. See, wheat always grows stronger even when trampled on. If you wanna be my apprentice, you've gotta promise never to give up, just like me.' 'I promise! Okay, I've gotta go now! Miss Nyamu, Miss Goldenglow, bye-bye!' Rhodes Island was host to plenty of young, carefree children like her. For them, getting prettied up by Goldenglow and Nyamu was a form of bragging rights. 'You're incredible, Nyamu. You can play the drums, you can do makeup... I can't help but be in awe. How did you learn to do so many things?' 'How, huh...? I look at all the talent around me and I'm like, I wanna work harder to catch up to them! Also, if we're playing the compliments game, your hairdressing skills are out of this world!' 'Y-You're just saying that! I've still got so much to learn...' Goldenglow replies with a chuckle, before adding on. 'Also, Nyamu, I've got to say, you're really good with children.' 'Yeah, thank the brats in the family. My big brothers and sisters used to care for me a lot when I was little, then I took over to look after my li'l sibs.' 'Me too! I guess we've both got heaps of siblings in the family!' 'Ahahah, no kidding. But yeah, I think that's why I'm pretty good at handling kids now.' Hearing those words, Goldenglow smiles and doesn't respond. Nyamu, for her part, looks perplexed at the reaction. 'Hmm? Something funny about that?' 'No, no. It's just... I wouldn't call it 'handling' kids.' Goldenglow pauses, then adds. 'I mean, you should see how you look while you're talking to the kids. You treat them with genuine care.' Nyamu looks away, a touch embarrassed, and doesn't have anything to say for a while after that. All the while, Goldenglow returns to cleaning up the salon, smile still on her face.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: How long are you gonna sit there, Doctor? Don't you want to go out and play? Work? Where's the fun in that? Come on, put this stuff down and let's go have some fun!

Mitsukue is a special place! There's plenty of good food and fun to be had, handsome boys and beautiful girls everywhere you look. And the best part? Anything you want, you can find it there—as long as you're not concerned about authenticity!
This one, and this... that should be enough... oh, hi, Doctor! I'm putting new stickers on my gun, and I've got some left over. Anything you want to sticker up? I can spare a few.
Final lap! Come on, come on! Faster, faster—argh, allllmost... Hm? No, I didn't bet. Spent all my money at the beginning of the month. I'm just watching the stream for the thrill of it.

This place is just the right length and width, and hardly anyone ever comes by... Get yelled at? A tongue-lashing is no big deal! Okay. One phone call, and we'll have a pachinko machine here tomorrow!

My gran's first lesson for me was that the truth doesn't matter, and the means don't matter either. The fake gems she appraised would end up on fancy ladies, bought for eye-popping money. And our fake guns protect the Lucky Star just fine.

One Lucky Star's enough trouble; I can't imagine what it takes to run a whole Rhodes Island... Huh? The people I picked up? They... weren't any trouble; just gave them some medicine and let them lie down…

Oh no, look at this! There's another new idol in Mitsukue! Momoka's fan club has already lost a bunch of members... Me? Of course I'm staying true! I'm her most loyal fan, even if I don't have the money to buy any merch. My love for Momoka is true!

Towers built from bubbles teeter, and everyone goes grasping for a star in their final moments... my star appeared when I was on the verge of freezing to death, the night I was abandoned by my parents as an infant. She gave me a home.
Huh? The Dr.{@nickname}'s not in the office today… Guess I'll have to find somebody else... who should I pick? Can't be a complainer, a miser, or sane enough to keep clear…

Kichisei the Unerring, reporting in! Come to the Lucky Star in Mitsukue for all your needs, whether you need a gem appraiser, a fence, or an information broker. I am always at your service during business hours.
Real guns... they use them differently from gran…
Wow, working for you lot pays so much better than the yakuza.
Rest assured. You're always VIPs at the Lucky Star.
Breaktime's…. over, I guess.
I'm the leader? Alright, better to work for you than to stick my neck out for someone else.
Come with me, I know a secret passage.
Mm, just as I thought.
Hm? What's that?
Yeah, yeah, heard you the first time...
Loaded... check.
Something suspicious up ahead, two hundred meters.
The gun may be fake, but yeah, that's all it takes.
I don't need to aim!
Hope you enjoy this!
Unerring!
*laughter* Well done! Did anyone get a pic of that? I want to print it out and put it up on the door of the Lucky Star!
Good job! Dismissed. Go do whatever you want, and see you next time!
I guess we're done. Can I hit the pachi… Err, can I take a game break now?
Whoa, whoa, we pissed off the wrong guy! Run! Move those legs! Let's get out of here!
This is a nice little space. Maybe I can get a few arcade cabinets set up... no, you didn't hear me say anything.
Hey! Take it easy... I'm not a broken vending machine you can fix with a smack, you know!
Wooo... Good timing. I was about to sneak out for a drink... wanna join me?
Arknights.
The Lucky Star's open all night today! Not that there are many guests at this hour, but it's one of grandma's old sayings. When the Lucky Star stays open, good fortune comes often.
Irrashaimase... oops, I guess I let the old habits slip in. What brings you here, Doctor?
Hey, Doctor, wanna know the plan for your birthday party? For this low, low price, I'll tell you what surprise Amiya has in store for you, and what 'surprise' Elysium has…
After today is tomorrow. After tomorrow another tomorrow—come find me again tomorrow, Doctor.
