archives:
After Gavial saw through her 'trick' and 'punished' her, Tomimi decided to follow Gavial to Rhodes Island and become an operator. Tomimi has little knowledge of life outside her tribe. Her impressions of the outside world come entirely from her conversation with Inam and from the books that were commissioned. When she first came to Rhodes Island, she was the same as two other operators, making a variety of common sense blunders during her trial-and-error phase. However, she quickly completed her transition thanks to her adaptability, and transformed from the leader of a small tribe on the border of Sargon into a Caster Operator with a unique personal flair. 
When Tomimi first applied to become an operator, some of the other operators in charge of the testing process initially were opposed to letting her become a Caster. In the eyes of Casters who have been trained under the theoretical framework of modern Originium Arts, Tomimi's use of Originium Arts is brutish and backwards, particularly her preference towards melee combat which runs contrary to what is typically required of Casters. When the testers gathered around to discuss their opinions, one interesting question was front and foremost:
'What's the difference between her and Gavial?' 
'Gavial wouldn't actually force people.' 
'I think that's only because she's too busy.' 
'But ultimately, they decided to let Tomimi become a Caster, and in terms of her training policy, they did not ask her to conform to the standards of modern Casters and instead allowed her to implement her own fighting style. The reason is, after observing Tomimi's fighting style, they determined that there was some value in studying it. 'Injecting' your own Arts into a wand in order to fill it with lethal power is, from a certain perspective, an utterly fanciful notion. Casters themselves tend to be intellectually curious people as well. After acknowledging Tomimi's combat abilities, a small group of Casters adopted the belief that 'Casters ought to be physically strong.' They even began to hope that a new school of Originium Arts would form through Tomimi's growth— Of course, even if this was to succeed, that'll be some time in the future.

When talking to Tomimi, there is always one topic that cannot be avoided: Gavial. As soon as this name is mentioned, the normally taciturn Tomimi will instantly open her inner chatterbox, praising Gavial's goodness as if her life depended on her. This degree of enthusiasm may be a match for that of the fans stuck outside the gates of Monster Siren Records HQ waiting for a chance to meet their idols. If you put yourself in her shoes though, Tomimi becoming like this may have been inevitable. Pretend that there's a beautiful young girl. Outside, she's the queen of the playground, and not even the adults can handle her. Everyone wants to be her friend, but she's always at your doorstep, sharing meals with you and asking you to play, showering you with her geniality and grace— What kind of person wouldn't be moved?! Furthermore, this wonderful young girl was stabbed by Originium in the mines in order to protect Tomimi, and ended up contracting Oripathy because of it. Even the bestselling authors of Columbia dare not write such heart-wrenching passages lightly, but this is not a work of fiction. It is Tomimi's truth, and that is why she is so devoted to Gavial. After that, Tomimi dedicated herself to attending Gavial, though the latter mistook this as 'exclusion.' After violently beating down all challengers at the Mahuizzotia, Gavial left the tribe. As for what happened afterwards, please refer to the reports from relevant individuals following Gavial's return from her hometown in Sargon. According to the report summary, the reason why Tomimi thought of using a rocket launcher to shoot down the Doctor's aircraft may simply have been because she hadn't seen Gavial in a long time, nothing more. Tomimi has not pulled any crazy stunts like this since coming to Rhodes Island with Gavial. 

'My word, is there really no need to publish a book on Tomimi's antics? A movie would do fine too. They'd be smash hits for sure.' 
'Keep going on about that, if you want Gavial to smack you.' 
'Don't worry, the relevant parties are... a bit slow.' 
'......'
'Um, in that case, I'll be counting on you for the script for the annual festival.' 
'Change things up a little bit though. We'll get beaten up if they recognize themselves!' 
'You got it. Just leave it to me. '

After returning to Rhodes Island, the Doctor asked Tomimi how she had come up with all those terrible ideas. After waffling around for quite some time, Tomimi brought out a number of books that had titles such as these:
'Only One Step Until The New You', 'You're a Winner', 'Learn Business Management in 100 Days'...
Then, she took out a list of books that often appeared on the bestseller lists of bookstores, mostly related to fashion, self-help, and management. Without a doubt, the contents of these books gave Tomimi some dubious directions when it came to her understanding of the real world. For example... she really tried to apply this corporate management system to the members of the 'Gavial's Will' tribe, demanding that everyone wear a uniform, shout slogans, and fight like a Lupo (note that she had no idea what a Lupo was prior to joining Rhodes Island). Though the tribe had no complaints due to Tomimi's abilities, after she left, everyone in the tribe quickly lapsed into their old, comfortable ways. With this in mind, the rocket launcher incident was probably inspired by one of these books. 
Fortunately, Tomimi was able to pick up a number of practical life skills. She is already familiar with storing items in a limited space, an ability that has earned her the praise of dorm staff. In addition, she is proficient in the use of expedition tools, able to explore the wilds without assistance. Nor will she ever again make the mistake of getting trapped in a mine by accident and putting herself in danger. However, Rhodes Island is different from the hometown of her Acahualla tribe. Gone is the near-infinite space she had back there to store her various collectibles. Under Gavial's persuasion, she has begun to screen her treasures, keeping only the most valuable things in a backpack that she carries on her person. 
All things considered, one cannot say that Tomimi is unintelligent, but rather, all her energy goes into the wrong areas.

Tomimi's tail grew again. 
By itself, this is not a bad thing, as the Archosaurus people are proud of having large tails. 
But Tomimi's tail doesn't only grow longer, it also grows thicker. 
As for the proper ideal of what a tail should be like, the Archosaurs themselves have not reached a consensus. The dispute betwen 'thick tails' and 'fine tails' still continues to this day. 
Tomimi isn't invested in this issue and is perfectly fine with whatever size or length tail she may have, and Gavial is also in agreement. 
Nevertheless, her tail is a bit heavy, and sometimes causes inconveniences in day-to-day life. Upon the Doctor's recommendation, Tomimi finally decided to use a tail clamp made especially for Archosaurus use. 
People often hear Tomimi lamenting: 'When I was little, my tail was the same thickness as Gavial's. Why'd it end up growing so much more?' 
Tomimi couldn't decide whether to keep her tail as it is or to grit her teeth and trim down on it. 
On one hand, a thick tail is quite popular and can even bring some unexpected benefits on the battlefield. As a bonus, Gavial likes to squeeze it. 
On the other hand, this tail sometimes poses inconveniences to others, and it may be difficult to find good-looking outfits that can accommodate such a large tail. 
As a result, this question had been bothering Tomimi for a long time. 
She needed someone to help her make the decision and implement her choice. 
Who do you think that person was?

modules.moduleDescription:
(Relaxing music)
'Hello there. Yes, you in front of the screen. Before we begin meditation, let's find the most snug chair to sit in that you can, and get nice and comfortable on it.'
That's gotta be this one. I can even stick my tail out between the seat and backrest.
It's a bit of a squeeze, but that's fine. The magazine said meditation helps you lose weight, so if I just clamp down where I want my weight to get lost, I bet it'll work even better.

'Keep your body upright, don't lean back. Let your tail hang down naturally, and put your hands on your lap if you want. Relax your shoulders. Keep your airways open. Relax your core.'
No, I think I need to sit a little more firm.
I cut out Gavial's signature from a medical history file last night. I need to be ready, just in case she comes looking for me.

'First, we'll do some deep breathing. In... out. In... out.'
In—out—in—out—

'And we'll repeat that, twelve times in total. In... out.'
That's so many times—wait, no, I need to stay focused! In, out! In, out!

'Feel... your inner... peace.'
My cheeks are all hot. Does this count as peace? I guess so.

'Close your eyes. Let all your pressure fall away. And then, inside your mind, picture a beautiful wish.'
Beautiful wish? I want to be able to help Gavial out!
If Gavial wants to be a doctor, then I'll sort out everything else for her! I'll lead the tribe, I'll be a lord ameer, I'll even fight the fights I don't want to!

'And then, hold that beautiful feeling inside your mind.'
And then Gavial will praise me for doing good, and she'll say, Tomimi, you're the one I can count on most, you're always helping me out with stuff—

'Now before your eyes, a beautiful scene is going to appear.'
Gavial... in front of me... telling me I'm the most reliable ever?!
Waaaaaahhhh!

'Now focus on your breathing...'
'Yo, Tomimi. There you are.'
'Ga-Ga-Ga-Ga-Gavial! Have I been helping you out?'

'Don't try to control your breathing. Concentrate on the feelings that surround it...'
'Huh? A bunch, I guess.'
'Really?!'

'Don't try to follow any thoughts...'
'I mean, not the time with the rocket launcher. But down in Zeruertza, and when we headed back to Acahualla, right? You were right there helping me—hey, hold on, quit swishing your tail. You're gonna wreck that chair—'
Crash.

'Imagine yourself inhaling pure energy, exhaling your muddied, negative emotions...'
'Gavial gave me that tail clamp just yesterdayyyyy!'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: I hope you're not a pain to deal with like Monica, Doctor.
Monica sure has a weird taste. Did you know she thought about using things like Seer or Baker as her code name? Incandescence sounds about normal now, yeah?
Skadi and Specter are Ægirs, like me. Whenever I see them, I feel like… You know, my heart starts racing. Geez… If this is what I think it is, maybe I should dress up…

To be honest, I wasn't really interested in coming to Rhodes Island at first. After all, Monica was the one you hired, and I'm just her bodyguard. But then she didn't need one anymore and finding a new job gets my tentacles all tied in a knot, so I decided to tag along and take my chances here.

Monica and I lived together back in Iberia. Taking care of someone as unorganized and impulsive as her was a pesky chore… But she was the best option I had. I don't get along with my family and she was the one who took me in.

The Inquisition used to give me loads of trouble for my crossbow. They'd disassemble it, inspect the structure, and then give me a tongue-lashing for modifying it to look like a rifle. Yep, I know my weapon gives people the wrong idea, but I don't care. The Inquisition eventually gave up and just asked that I don't go scaring people with it. Heheh.

Doctor, Rhodes Island doesn't have anything against operators making friends, right? Nah, I was just thinking about hanging out with those Laterano folks. I have been into their guns since I was little, so I tried to style one myself. And that's how this beauty came to be.

You know, my Mom once told me that something happened to me when I was little, but I can't remember it for the life of me. Mom doesn't seem too eager to tell me, either. Meh. I'm doing fine now, so I guess it mustn't have been a big deal.

I gotta hand it to you, Doctor. Taking care of Monica alone takes everything out of me, but you have to take care of so many operators… Anyway, let me know if you ever need help. You know, you're not the only caretaker around here.
Your work-rest balance is all out of whack, just like Monica. Alright… where's the blanket…

I used to be Monica's... Err, I guess it's Incandescence now... Anyway, I used to be her bodyguard. She finally found herself a proper job now, so I'm free to do other stuff. That's all. Hope we get along well.
So this is how the pros do things...

Before I came, I thought to myself, a security guard at a pharmaceutical company would be pretty chill. And if I didn't make the cut, janitorial work would also be fine. Not gonna lie, I'm starting to regret my decision a bit.
Honestly, I never thought I'd achieve something like this... You know, getting stronger wasn't on my list before, but this feeling isn't half bad. Thanks, Doctor.
Time for the mission? Got it.
I'm leading? Mm... I'll try my best.
Hope we don't find trouble.
Shoot, here we go again.
Ready to move.
I'd like to listen to some music.
Enemy unaware, for now.
The visibility's pretty good here.
Breathe… Focus…
Hello. And goodbye.
That person's pretty fashionable…
So many enemies. How annoying.
Doctor, want some candy? You can relax now. I'm spent, too.
I'll double-check to see if we missed anything.
That's good enough, right? Saves us both the trouble.
Let's go, Doctor. I've secured the retreat route.
Guess I'll take a look around first.
Hey...
Doctor, is there anything I can help with?
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor. This is my first time celebrating with so many people, and it's not bad at all. Oh, speaking of which, I was supposed to write a letter to Mom before I left, but I totally forgot. Gotta write one now.
Doctor, want some candy?

Happy birthday! Here's your present. I bought Monica one, and it worked really well, so I got you one, too. The bane of you people with messed-up work and rest schedules: an ultra-mega alarm clock. Fail to follow a schedule and you'll get an alarm loud enough to cause a tsunami.

I never had many plans for the future to begin with, and I never thought I'd come this far. Looking back, I made the right decision to come here with Monica... How do I see the future now? Hm... Man, what a question. I got nothing.

handbook.profile:
Born in Iberia, Andreana serves as a bodyguard to Operator Incandescence. The two joined Rhodes Island together. 
She came with a strong foundation as a sniper. After receiving professional training, she has served well as a Sniper Operator.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Andreana has no signs of Originium infections. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Andreana rarely comes into contact with Originium.
handbook.promotionRecord:
Regarding Andreana's strange physical condition upon encountering Operators Skadi and Specter, as well as the similar Arts deficiency she expresses, Medical has performed several physical examinations using different methods and approaches. 
The results showed no new information. We were only able to conclude, once again, that she is a lot stronger overall than the average person. To use Dr. Warfarin's phrasing, 'What the hell? At this level, we can't compare her to Skadi's physique at all.' While there is some ambiguity in that statement, it is true that when compared to Skadi, Andreana's physical prowess could well be explained by better physical development. There are always those who are naturally strong. Let's just say that making her a Sniper Operator may be a bit beneath her. But Rhodes Island won't interfere with her personal choice. 
All in all, after confirming no anomalies in her physical condition, the matter has been closed. But, to be on the safe side, Medical still recommends Andreana receive regular checkups.
archives:
A laid-back Iberian. 
She tends to be slow to speak, and shows little on her face. When Andreana first came to Rhodes Island, she was mistaken for the quiet, uncommunicative type. But after getting to know her, and seeing how caring this great listener is, that impression quickly collapsed.

While Andreana speaks often of Iberia, she and Incandescence came to us through a branch office in Rim Billiton. 
Of course, this is to be expected, considering Rhodes Island does not and cannot have an office in Iberia. In fact, there's only one kind of Iberian we find outside Iberia, as far as we know——the ones who decided to leave. Incandescence, Andreana and their respective families left Iberia together to settle in Rim Billiton. The two submitted their resumes to Rhodes Island not long after. 
As for why they brought their families, Andreana appears troubled when posed with the question. She insisted on learning to shoot, despite her family's objections. That troubled their relationship and she ran away from home, where she met Incandescence. But in the end, family ties are tough to break. The two families ultimately made contact and agreed to leave Iberia as a group.

Andreana's hobbies certainly draw the eye. Particularly the gun she is never seen without. 
When she first joined Rhodes Island, her weapon perplexed many of our operators who were familiar with guns— Questions such as: 'She's a Lateranan who looks like an Iberian?' 'Did she rob a Lateranan? Such a badass?' 'Iberians can use guns too?' swirled around endlessly. After all, Blacksteel's guns are assumed to be some kind of corporate secret, but a non-Laterano freelance mercenary strutting around with a huge gun gets people talking. 
Of course, everything becomes clear once you see her shoot an inkball out of that thing. Apparently, it's a modified crossbow made to look like a gun. Because Andreana is a committed firearms enthusiast. 
According to her, Laterano culture has had a strong influence on the Iberians, who often display an affection for it. After seeing one of the statues in church as a child, Andreana fell in love with the weapons, and devoted herself to mechanical engineering in hopes of making a crossbow in the style of a gun, since she lacks the affinity for Originium Arts necessary to use a real one herself. 
But there is a point here worth examining, and one Andreana herself did not realize. She mentioned that she was dragged into court over the weapon several times, only to be chastised when it became clear it was not a real gun. That seems reasonable. But with the limited information we have, the Iberian courts should be very powerful. And for such an organization to grab her 'several times' for something known to be harmless the first time indicates that they may have been using it as a pretense to find something else. 
However, since we lack reliable intelligence about the internal politics of a country closed so long to outsiders, we are not able to form any concrete judgments about the situation. And since, at least according to Andreana herself, she has not been harmed or unnecessarily interrogated, we leave the matter to speculation.

[Classified Log] 
It was clear that while Kal'tsit had a detailed knowledge of both Skadi and Specter, and even seemed equally familiar with Andreana, the rest of the Medical Department staff, including Warfarin, knew little about them. And just like with the others, Kal'tsit determined that Andreana's presence at Rhodes Island would not be adverse. Or at least that the benefits of them joining us would outweigh the potential harm. Otherwise, they would have been found inadmissible. 
As for me, I don't know what the story is. Haha, Kal'tsit actually said it would be okay to tell me, but I refused. Knowing too much can get you in trouble. I'll leave this one to Kal'tsit.
What I took from her is that the difference between Andreana on one side and Specter and Skadi on the other is something like that between a drop of ink into clear water and a proper inkwell. The drop of ink is itself an infringement on the dignity of life, to the point that Kal'tsit expressed clear disdain for it: 'There are those who have reached their hands into places they do not belong. Those for whom this stupidity is very much in character.' 
——■■■

modules.moduleDescription:
After the regular checkup, Dr. Gavial wanted to take me out drinking, and I turned her down. It's not that I don't like her or anything; I think she's a fine person. I just don't like things that are a pain in the ass. 
It's noisy as hell, there's alcohol, wrist wrestling, and inevitably, a little girl named Tomimi always shows up... Any single one of these things in isolation, I can probably deal with. Some, I might even call cute, but when you smash everything together, that's what you call a pain in the ass. I much prefer enjoying a glass of juice alone on the deck to spending a night at the bar. 

I'm almost out of juice. 
One nice thing about being alone is that it's comfy. One not-so-nice thing is the fact that you get bored easily. 
I open up my toolbox with the mod kit and start to do maintenance on my 'gun.' Guess it's one form of entertainment. 
Twenty seconds, it's completely disassembled. 
Eighty-one seconds, every part's squeaky clean. 
Thirty-five seconds, the lubricant on all the metal parts has been replaced. 
Fifteen seconds, the reassembly is complete. 
If the thing in my hand was the real deal, I'd be able to do a whole lot more with the mod kit. Unfortunately, it's just a weirdly-shaped crossbow that fires a special ink bullet. Doesn't actually use Originium or anything sensational like that. 
Some things only work in the right hands. Trying to force them onto others won't end well. 

Just as I was deciding if I wanted to get a second glass of juice, I hear a few other people step onto the deck. Other than the sound of their footsteps, they aren't making any other noises. The people wisely keep their distance from me and stop on the side of the deck. 
Before long, I hear a soft singing voice from them. I look back, and as expected, it's a group of Abyssal Hunters. 
As soon as I see the three of them, my heart starts to beat faster. I once told to the Doctor it was love at first sight, though of course that was a joke. In reality, my best guess was that this unusual physiological reaction was probably related to that incident when I was a child. But I've never asked about it, nor do I think about it much. Wouldn't be able to get any answers anyway, and all the thinking in the world wouldn't solve the problem. In the end, I'd just be causing extra issues for myself. 
And I have a hunch – it'd be a hundred times more of a pain in the ass than Gavial dragging me to a hundred bars for a hundred nights. 
So, as long as that thing stays far, far away from my daily life, I'm good. I have no desire to throw myself headlong into something that's gonna be a pain in the ass. 
But occasionally, every so often... 
When I close my eyes, I'll see that person. I have no idea who that person is, but I can tell, they're at the center of this whole mess. 
Someone wrapped in the smell of the sea, a robed Iberian... 
I stand up and sling the gun over my shoulder, pick up the only toolbox messy enough to be my own, and go to grab my second cup of juice.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Ehi, Doctor, got anything fun to do?
Tsk, goddamn peppers... I gotta find a way to make them disappear from the canteen forever.
I heard Yanese got some old sayings similar to 'Catch the moment'. Heh, the line I like. Don't you think it suits me very well? The future? Meh, I'll let Aosta chew on those sorts of things.
Oi, Doctor, don't just sit there all day. Why don't we have some fun, like… remodeling your whole office?
Aosta once said I wouldn't live long like this. At the time, I told him, what's the point of long life if I can't do what I want?
Fight for what you want, snatch what you like. I don't know the meaning of the word 'Surrender'!
I think up what to do, Aosta thinks up how to do it, and Broca makes sure we get it done together. That's how we've always gotten by, and it's how we ended up here.
Doctor, what are you doing all frowny-faced over there? If there's anything weighing on you, just lay it on me. I'm good at that sort of stuff.
Say, Doctor, if someday you decide to quit running Rhodes Island, why not come along with us? Chiave doesn't take orders from anyone, but in your case, I'll make an exception.
Ehi, Doctor... You fell asleep? Whatever, I'll be back later.
Yo, are you the Doctor? Hello, and well met. The name's Chiave. Starting today, I'm your goon!
Whoa-ho-ho... Hey Aosta, check this out! Give me a moment and I'll be even stronger than these guys!
Huh? Promotion? What do you mean?
Incredible. There are just too many interesting people here at Rhodes Island. How am I supposed to just stay in my seat? I've gotta get stronger and stronger!
Ha, here we go!
Listen up, everyone, I have a plan!
Haha, let's go make some noise!
Just gotta knock 'em all down, right?
Still not my turn yet?
C'mon, don't make me yawn.
I can't wait any longer!
Haha, I'm gonna end you all!
Take this!
Hey! Why are you running?!
Yeah, yeah, you've all done a great JOB!
I'm on FIRE!
Hah, now this is the fun stuff!
Ah. Where's the challenge in that, Doctor?
Huh? I left a few? Never even saw 'em.
Shit, for real?!
ello, bruthas and sistahs!
What is it?
Yo, Doctor, you're in a pretty good mood.
Arknights.

Doctor! Aosta, Broca, and I have a new New Year's plan. Heh heh, once I tell you, you're in on the game. We're going to swap out all the chocolate sauce in the canteen for Siracusan meat sauce, then— Huh? Doctor, where are you going?! Don't you tell Dr. Kal'tsit!
Ehi Doc, did you have a good meal?

Ehi, Doctor, Happy birthday! Ta-dah— Check out this model car. I made it myself. It's yours now. Truth be told, if the conditions were right, I would've built you an actual car. Well, I guess that's a promise. Doctor, come visit me in Siracusa sometime and I'll trade this for a real car.

Rhodes Island's got all these heavies, plus smart people like you. One day, someday, I'm gonna do something big that'll rock the whole world! At the very least, I'll do it before I die! Uh, I should try to stay alive...? I guess you're right, haha…

handbook.profile:
Chiave, former employee of a mechanic shop in a small city in Siracusa, later became the leader of his own gang. 
After a certain incident, he led two of his men to join Rhodes Island and is now active as a front-line attacker.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of his internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in his circulatory system, confirming him to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Originium crystals are present on the surface of the body, but in small quantities. The disease progression has been effectively controlled. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
Although condition is currently relatively stable, it may deteriorate due to late treatment.
archives:
This Vulpo is a man who always carries around a hearty smile. 
'No respect for people or the law.' It is said that these words were used to describe his attitude when he first joined Rhodes Island and met Dr. Kal'tsit. He spent the rest of his first day in the infirmary. 
He will do whatever pops up in his mind. Although what he does is often laughable, there seems to be some magic within him that compels others to join him on his absurd antics.

Compared with Broca's hostility and Aosta's caution, Chiave, as their leader, was basically the first one to get integrated into Rhodes Island. On his second day, he basically already was accustomed to the general mood around the ship. 
According to his own account, he dropped out of school and worked as the employee of a mechanic shop in the city, of course privately participating in some local gang activities. 
That is, until he met Aosta. The two struck up a congenial relationship and worked together, later rescuing Broca and recruiting him to join. The three moved together until they were rescued by a nearby Rhodes Island during a chase.

As a result of his experience working as a mechanic, Chiave is the best at modifying weapons among the three. 
Unlike the impression his appearances give to other people, he is quite accomplished within his profession. Whether working directly on modern vehicles or souping them up, he maintains an impressive skillset. As an extension of his interests, he also has some knowledge in electrical appliances. 
However, unlike Broca, though Chiave is generally well-liked among other operators, he is often described as 'having a bad rap.' 
Because of his tendencies to push the boundaries in all aspects of life and work, he often adds truly head-scratching modifications to the things he's working on. Even when working on other peoples' things, he shows little regard for that and has caused some truly ridiculous outcomes. Now, everyone is a bit more cautious about handing their personal belongings over to him for retrofitting.

Aosta's terse evaluation of Chiave probably sums it up best — 'He's not gonna live long like this.' 
It must be pointed out that Chiave is not an extraordinarily strong man: he doesn't possess profound strategic wisdom, nor does he have exceptional combat prowess. He is very ordinary in many respects, and the sum of his combat effectiveness can be regarded as average at best. He is prone to flights of fancy, and often does things half-heartedly. To be frank, it would not be surprising if he was found dead in a ditch on the side of the road one day. 
However, this is what's astounding about him. 
Let's do something a bit dramatic to illustrate the point— Everyone in the room will say 'Chiave? Oh, that arrogant guy.' But without fail, most people will smile and add another sentence — 'But that's just the kind of person he is.' And some of these people will not hesitate to help him when they learn that he is in trouble. This is a good indicator of Chiave's popularity. He always leaves a deep impression upon others that makes it impossible to truly hate him. 
Of course, speaking from another angle, if he really was to suddenly leave us prematurely, most people would probably get over it pretty quickly, because 'that's just the kind of person he is.' 
That is the contradictory and fascinating person that Chiave is.

modules.moduleDescription:
Chiave's been taking notice of that girl for a while now.
She's a Lupo, not the kind that attracts attention at first sight, but she's got a pair of sharp, twitchy ears, and they always stand up whenever she's face-to-face with him. She's withdrawn but decently polite, seems to be a well-raised young lady, but none of that's what he's really focused on.
No, Chiave's started noticing her because she keeps coming to the garage, but she's got nothing to fix. Not just that, but she keeps walking over to him, asking him questions about work. She struck him as the annoying sort of amateur, the kind he'd just say a few words to get off his back. Later, though, something made him change his mind about her: a customer came complaining to his boss about how Chiave installed vertical jets and sprayed graffiti on his car without permission while fixing it up, and filed it all under repair costs. The girl made herself known at that point, said she thought Chiave's mods were super sick, and even footed the compensation for him.
'Huh, this chick's got some taste,' was Chiave's mental comment.
One day, she shows up in front of Chiave again, this time with a fancy cake for him. He wants to refuse her, but she says, 'I'll get fat if I eat too much cake, so I may as well give the rest to you,' pushing him to begrudgingly accept it. He's surprised to find, though, that he's had this kind of cake before, and it's his favorite. He's got a million thanks for the girl, so he decides to get her a precious gift in return, the likes of which have never been seen before. He explains his idea his buds—Broca and Aosta—and asks them to help out. Broca's naturally on planning and prototyping duty, and Aosta's not so convinced by Chiave's proposition, but reluctantly designs the exterior and gives input on some of the finer details, while Chiave himself handles the imagination bomb he's throwing down in the making of it all. Finally, after working several nights straight, the three's masterpiece of blood and sweat is ready to see the light of day.
The next time the girl visits the garage, everything plays out as they envisioned. With music playing that Broca put on in advance, Chiave (with some effort) presents her with the gift, and recites his speech: 'You like it? It's a jack I made especially for you! Even if you get fatter now, you can hoist yourself up into your car with this. You'll never need to worry about packing on weight again.'
And since then, not once has the girl been seen at the garage again. But in the Chiave Gang's collection, there is now an unusually shaped, repainted jack, serving as an heirloom of the Chiave Gang to be forever stowed away.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, you'll be working hard today? Then, I'll stay with you. If you slack off, then I'll use this staff... Like this... and give you a smack on the head. Bonk, bonk.

Beeswax, Beeswax, Beeswax... Mm, okay. I should get used to it after reading it a few more times. Oh, Doctor, do you need something? I'm just trying to get used to hearing my code name... so I don't fail to react and get made fun of when others call me.
This bug... Midnight seemed very scared of it and jumped up into the air as soon as he saw it, so I helped him catch it. But, where should we put it now... Um, Doctor, why are you backing away?
My clothes are a bit big, so I feel at ease when they drape over my body. I like that sensation. But, sometimes, I'll accidentally step on them—Uu, uwah, ahh...! ...Fweh, I tripped again... Ow…

The new piece the Folk Song Association put out this month is my new favorite song. Oh, you've never heard of them before, Doctor? The full name is the Folk Song and Originium Arts Research Association... Still haven't heard about it? What about the Electro-music Arts Alliance? How about the Rap and Folk Joint Vantage? Haven't heard of any of them?

The mark on my head? Ah... this is a ceremonial emblem passed down from generation to generation in my tribe, and it is a symbol of our Golden Gods' blessings on our tribe and our people. The faceless gods will protect us, no matter where we go, whether or not we remember them...

Leaving the tribe and traveling to other cities and countries is a rite of passage for all our tribespeople. Only by completing it can one become a fully-fledged adult like my sister. Um, Doctor, you believe I can handle it, don't you?

Hehe, my horns are big and pretty, right? There aren't many people in the tribe who can boast horns like mine! The secret to maintaining them is to apply essential oils once a day, gently massage them with a soft brush—W-Wait, Doctor, I haven't finished today's routine yet, even you can't just touch them like that!

Doctor, please come here. Mm, okay, close your eyes, and let me touch your forehead. The scorching sun, the raging storm, and waves of golden sand washing across the desert. The gods set foot upon the land where we were nurtured, and bestowed our tribe with their blessings. Now, I will share this blessing with you, Doctor.
Zz... zzz... Sister... you dummy... zzz... mm... H-Huh, Doctor? I fell asleep...? Sleeptalking? Did I say something?
Hmm... Wah, excuse me, I let my mind wander. Hello, Doctor, I am, my code name is... Umm... Ah, I remember! It's Beeswax. Do you like it? My tribe helped pick it for me.
Hm...? I have to watch all of this?
Promotion? Mm... I don't quite understand.
Doctor, perhaps the path that lies ahead for Rhodes Island is destined to be long and treacherous, but please remember, the gods' decrees and my blessings... will always be with you.
Umm... where are we going this time?
I'm the leader...? Even though I'm not sure how you select your team leaders, I'll try my best.
Well then, let's go.
Someone's over there. Everyone, please be careful.
Yes, I'm here.
How can I help?
Over here? Leave it to me.
The land beneath my feet is the domain of the gods.
Devour them.
Crush them.
Sleep beneath the golden sands.
This is the blessing of the gods.
May they also receive the blessing of the gods…
Phew... It's over. Doctor, was I able to be of use?
Ooh, they got away! Mm... but I guess that's fine?
We can't do this anymore, Doctor. I'll hold the enemies back, so please escape!
What a spotless room... It'd be troublesome if I accidentally spilled sand over it, right?
W-Woah... I stepped on my clothes again…
Ah, Doctor, please look at this! I caught another bug!
Arknights.

Wepet renpet neferet, Doctor. It's an important day, so the first thing I did was a little horn care. Now my friends can come touch them... Oh, touching my horns, you can't feel how well I've kept them? Hm, that's okay. You don't have horns. I don't blame you.
Doctor, I've been waiting.

It's your birthday today, Doctor? Okay. Let me give you my blessing. Please close your eyes and imagine an endless desert. In the desert, a priest knocks the staff on the ground. The sound signifies the gods' blessings are drawing near, and each step kicks up a sandstorm... Huh? Why did you start coughing?

Even now, I still haven't figured out what my sister is up to. But having traveled with Rhodes Island for so long, I've seen lots of sights like the ones in the magazines, but with my own eyes. When I go back to my people, I'll probably see more clearly the blessings of the gods.

The mark on my head? Ah... this is a ceremonial emblem passed down from generation to generation in my tribe, and it is a symbol of our Golden Gods' blessings on our tribe and our people. The faceless gods will protect us, no matter where we go, whether or not we remember them...

Leaving the tribe and traveling to other cities and countries is a rite of passage for all our tribespeople. Only by completing it can one become a fully-fledged adult like my sister. Um, Doctor, you believe I can handle it, don't you?

Hehe, my horns are big and pretty, right? There aren't many people in the tribe who can boast horns like mine! The secret to maintaining them is to apply essential oils once a day, gently massage them with a soft brush—W-Wait, Doctor, I haven't finished today's routine yet, even you can't just touch them like that!

Doctor, please come here. Mm, okay, close your eyes, and let me touch your forehead. The scorching sun, the raging storm, and waves of golden sand washing across the desert. The gods set foot upon the land where we were nurtured, and bestowed our tribe with their blessings. Now, I will share this blessing with you, Doctor.
Zz... zzz... Sister... you dummy... zzz... mm... H-Huh, Doctor? I fell asleep...? Sleeptalking? Did I say something?
Hmm... Wah, excuse me, I let my mind wander. Hello, Doctor, I am, my code name is... Umm... Ah, I remember! It's Beeswax. Do you like it? My tribe helped pick it for me.
Hm...? I have to watch all of this?
Promotion? Mm... I don't quite understand.
Doctor, perhaps the path that lies ahead for Rhodes Island is destined to be long and treacherous, but please remember, the gods' decrees and my blessings... will always be with you.
Umm... where are we going this time?
I'm the leader...? Even though I'm not sure how you select your team leaders, I'll try my best.
Well then, let's go.
Someone's over there. Everyone, please be careful.
Yes, I'm here.
How can I help?
Over here? Leave it to me.
The land beneath my feet is the domain of the gods.
Devour them.
Crush them.
Sleep beneath the golden sands.
This is the blessing of the gods.
May they also receive the blessing of the gods…
Phew... It's over. Doctor, was I able to be of use?
Ooh, they got away! Mm... but I guess that's fine?
We can't do this anymore, Doctor. I'll hold the enemies back, so please escape!
What a spotless room... It'd be troublesome if I accidentally spilled sand over it, right?
W-Woah... I stepped on my clothes again…
Ah, Doctor, please look at this! I caught another bug!
Arknights.

Wepet renpet neferet, Doctor. It's an important day, so the first thing I did was a little horn care. Now my friends can come touch them... Oh, touching my horns, you can't feel how well I've kept them? Hm, that's okay. You don't have horns. I don't blame you.
Doctor, I've been waiting.

It's your birthday today, Doctor? Okay. Let me give you my blessing. Please close your eyes and imagine an endless desert. In the desert, a priest knocks the staff on the ground. The sound signifies the gods' blessings are drawing near, and each step kicks up a sandstorm... Huh? Why did you start coughing?

Even now, I still haven't figured out what my sister is up to. But having traveled with Rhodes Island for so long, I've seen lots of sights like the ones in the magazines, but with my own eyes. When I go back to my people, I'll probably see more clearly the blessings of the gods.

handbook.profile:
Operator Beeswax, a member of an ancient tribe from the depths of the deserts of Sargon, contacted us of her own initiative and asked to board the ship in order to locate someone. After learning that the person of interest will not be returning to the ship for the time being, Miss Beeswax has applied to join and travel with Rhodes Island, waiting for the time she can reunite with relative. 
Beeswax has passed the entrance examination and has been given the official Operator status, and now serves as a Caster for Rhodes Island. This will be the first stop in her lengthy journey of discovery.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Beeswax has no signs of Originium infections. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.11u/L
Operator Beeswax seldom comes in contact with Originium in her living environment.

Although coming into contact with Originium is inevitable through the course of using Originium Arts, not only has she not fallen ill, but she even seems to be quite healthy - healthier than most of us, in fact. Have you seen the color and sheen of her horns? I could tell at a glance that little girl has nothing wrong with her!
—Warfarin
handbook.promotionRecord:
Every operator has their own journey, and in this case, Rhodes Island is just the first step of Beeswax's journey, not the end. 
We may be in each others' company for the time being, like-minded and hand-in-hand, but we will all find our own direction one day. There will come a day when we go our separate ways. 
No two roads completely overlap; while they may intersect at times, an intersection is just that. 

But do remember that no matter where we go, her blessings will always follow us.
archives:
Miss Beeswax made no attempts to hide her purpose for seeking out Rhodes Island. In fact, she was rather candid throughout the entire meeting, and this straightforward demeanor was consistent with the experiences she had described. In front of us was a young woman who had stepped away from home for the first time, without a deceptive bone in her body or a reason to be wary of others. 
According to her statement, Miss Beeswax contacted Rhodes Island in order to find a blood relative who had left the tribe first on a journey. After verification, we found that her relative indeed is an active operator, and belongs to one of our affiliated departments. However, that individual is currently on a secret mission and cannot return to the landship any time soon. 
Upon hearing this, Beeswax was visibly dejected. This young Caprinae from the golden sands does not usually display many expressions, but when her shoulders and eyelids droop, one can see subtle hints of the sense of loss she undoubtedly feels. Fortunately, these depressive bouts rarely last long, and she quickly regains her vitality. 
At this time, Miss Beeswax made the first important decision since leaving her home to embark on this journey. 
She decided to become a part of Rhodes Island.

Operator Beeswax cherishes her two horns greatly, and almost all operators who've talked to her are aware of this. 
Among Caprinae, Forte, and other horned races, the horns are a very important part of one's appearance. Akin to the booming and developing beauty industry here, horn care services arose to meet the demand and are well-received. However, even among the operators who are more concerned about their image, very few will make a conscious effort to focus on their appearance. Operators, like Beeswax, who pay close attention their appearance to the point of mastering skills relevant to those interests are among the minority. 
Every day, Beeswax sets aside a bit of time to maintain her large, curved horns. This maintenance process usually involves multiple steps such as wiping them down with a fine cloth, applying essential oils, soft brush care, and polish. Beeswax always completes each step meticulously, ensuring that nothing is omitted. Through her persistent effort, her horns have achieved a remarkable state of lustre, shape, and hardness. 
Through our inquiries with other Caprinae operators, we have established that even by Caprinae standards, Beeswax's horns are magnificent, a rare and beautiful sight to behold. 
After finishing her daily care, Beeswax often provides help to operators who need it, making her very popular within certain small circles.

The heart of the Sargon desert is difficult to traverse, and even experienced Messengers find it difficult to reach the deepest portions. In Beeswax's tribe, it is not unusual for young members of the tribe to go on journeys to the outside world and bring back what they see. Because these journeys have become traditions in their own rights, this particular tribe is unlike many others in that it does not totally reject novel things from the outside. 
In addition to these journeys, one or two veteran Messengers may visit each year at certain times to bring the latest news to clan members, including the most recent music magazines. 
Beeswax does not appear to be someone who is incredibly shrewd; rather, she is straightforward and easy to understand. She loves music as well. When she left home, she brought with her a number of magazines issued by the Music Society, and these new publications became quite popular among the Caster teams. Even Beeswax herself quick integrated, smoothly establishing good relationships with the other operators. 
Though Beeswax doesn't talk much, is quiet most of the time, and tends to lose her train of thought, by no means is she simple-minded. In choosing to officially become an Operator of Rhodes Island, Beeswax did not rush to her decision, but had to weigh a variety of considerations. 
The fact that she chose to stay to wait for her relative, while certainly her primary reason, is only one of several considerations. After a bit of inquiry, we determined that Beeswax believes that her time at Rhodes Island will serve as valuable experience to help her pass her tribe's rites of passage to adulthood— or rather, she sees working with Rhodes Island as one rung of that trial. 
After comprehensive deliberation, we also saw no reason to deny the participation of a talented and powerful Caster. On one hand, the addition of Beeswax is beneficial to us. On the other hand, we believe that such an option will help Beeswax as well, and Rhodes Island will be able to provide her with many further opportunities to understand this land. 

As an addendum, the young Caprinae waited for several months before picking out her official code name. After writing to her hometown for help, she finally decided on the name she now uses.

The heart of Sargon is a vast region with a harsh environment, home to a large number of small and medium-sized tribes. Among them, some ancient tribes lack means of communicating with the outside world, and often retain their unique customs and traditions. Although the Caprinae tribe to which Beeswax belongs does not fall under this category, it still retains its customs despite regular contact with the outside world. 
Though many view the so-called 'pagan' beliefs of these tribes as little more than barbaric vestiges of a primitive legacy, there are a few researchers who have been trying to ascertain the true source of these ancient beliefs. 
Operator Beeswax is not shy about sharing her beliefs. From her descriptions, she tends to use more abstract expressions, trying to depict a conceptual existence rather than a physical object of worship with an actual image. In fact, even though Beeswax claimed to have received the blessings of the gods, she admitted that she had frankly never directly seen these gods.

modules.moduleDescription:
When a Rhodes Island squad rescued the slender Elafia girl of about eleven or twelve from slave traffickers, she did not cry nor make any noise. Nor respond to any questions pointed at her. A considerable headache for the squad's strait-laced captain, who promptly placed the child in Beeswax's care and left to pursue the fleeing slavers.
The captain in all his extroversion likely felt awkward about it, but Beeswax did not. Once she realized the child had no intention of speaking, she turned her attention instead to the jungle, fresh and verdant.
After stepping away for a while, she happened to notice the girl staring at her horns. The two made eye contact, the girl immediately averted her gaze. They repeated this a few times, and then Beeswax moved to speak:
'You can touch them, if you're curious.'
The girl's eyes opened wide.
'I'm not lying.'
She hesitantly stood up, approached Beeswax, and cautiously, nervously reached her arm out, as if a timid fowl was on her hand. She gave the lightest touch.
'So pretty...'
Something Beeswax had heard from many a horned or antlered operator before. It embarrassed and flustered her at first, but she learned in time to reply with a 'yours are wonderful, too,' as was polite.
Be that so, the sight of the Elafia rescued only moments ago from slavers—soiled, undernourished, even missing a chunk from her antlers—drove a new response to her mind.
'I can make yours just as pretty. Okay?'
March's spring breeze still carried a chill. The young Elafia sat on the ground. Beeswax cleared the tangle of dirty cotton from her antlers, then took out a care kit. A gauze to wipe the stains away, then a soft brush to clean the dust out from the crevices where the bone forked.
The Elafia lowered her head, screwing her eyes shut, as if she were taking part in a solemn ceremony of sorts.
Once the cleaning was over, Beeswax took a sanding block and a small file and worked patiently at the dried-out keratin of the Elafia's antlers, before applying a layer of essential oils with due care. All done, she brought out a miniature length of ribbon from her kit, and tied a small bow upon the antler's break.
'There we are.'
Beeswax passed the girl a pocket mirror.
The girl shied from looking at first, but eventually, she stole a glance, before finally fixing her gaze on it, eyes wide open. A blush bloomed across her sapped face, beyond herself with excitement.
Beeswax stood up and gave a stretch, before hurriedly remembering the last step had been left undone.
She gave her head a light rapping, and drew from her pocket a tiny, golden stone, wrapped tightly in thread. She tied it to the antler left unbroken, working the cord as she recited softly to the Elafia:
'May the gods bless you. May you be blessed to live in neither bondage nor hunger. May you be blessed to live as do the burning sun, the storms, and the golden plains of sand, in eternal beauty and strength.'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Before you leave, I'm responsible for protecting you.
Doctor, I'd like to quickly increase the charge my body can carry. An operator who uses electricity? I'll give it a crack.
Ore identification? Try Leonhardt. Not my wheelhouse, I'm afraid.
The boss at Rhine Lab frowned every time she saw me, like I was a pest. What a bother. When did I do anything to her?
My ears perked up? No worries. Just a zap. Not too bad, honestly. It'll settle down soon enough.

This beauty cost me two years of scraping by and a load of debt, but worth every coin. Without it, those Cautus black market profiteers would've dumped me on some mining ship. Living the good life now is all thanks to my sparky friend here.
Oh, there you are. Got these fresh, ice-cold salted edamame, fancy a nibble? Not even a bite? You've gotta appreciate food like this. Just give it a go.

Leonhardt's a noisy drama magnet. Much calmer here with you. What? He's gotten himself cornered by Medical over some dodgy jokes? That guy never learns. Guess I gotta defuse this mess. Doctor, want to come along?

I look out for Leon because we've been like that since we were kids. If he's in a bind, I sort it out, and he does the same for me. But the two of us, we don't know each other like that. Just because you bandage my wounds doesn't mean we're close, got it? ...I said the same thing last time? Tsk, damn it.
Huh?! Oh, it's you. I'm good, just… catching my breath for a bit. If you wanna join me, I can shift over.
Catastrophe Messenger bodyguard, Ayerscarpe. Good to meet you.
Impressive. Professional. I'll take note.
I think I've been overpaid recently. A promotion? Got it. Thanks.
Being a bodyguard isn't a matter of defense. It's about control. Controlling the space around your target and neutralizing threats. Want me to demonstrate?
Squad assembled, awaiting deployment.
Begin the operation at your own pace.
No anomalies detected. Squad good to go.
Target located. Move out.
Righto.
Awaiting your command.
Device, activate.
Let's get to work.
It's over.
Your life is mine!
The best defense is a good offense.
This isn't win or lose. This is life and death.
You handled that impressively. Hmph. Congratulations.
Perfect timing. We should get going.
I'm willing to believe those escapees were on purpose.
Don't worry about me. Just make sure you get back okay.
I'll leave the arrangements to you. I have no demands.
Don't touch my ears.
Is something bothering you? You can tell me.
Arknights.

I can think of a flashy Cautus who'll go out today to sing and dance, then pass out somewhere. Yeah… about time he crashed out. I'll go pick him up and then head off to sleep. See you around, Doctor. Happy New Year.
Is there something you need?

Here, salted edamame. What are you staring at? You think I shelled them just for you? I eat pre-shelled ones sometimes too, it's a different texture… Why am I still eating whole pods? Just force of habit. Eat yours. Happy birthday.

I've saved up quite a bit of money this year. Since coming to Rhodes Island, Leon and I have more stable incomes. He hasn't mentioned it, but it's been a while since I got him anything. No point letting the money sit there. What should I buy? Doctor, do you have any suggestions?

Bodyguard to the Catastrophe Messenger Leonhardt, coming with him to Rhodes Island. He brings his experience in escorting, investigation, guerilla warfare, and infiltration under complex conditions. 
He enters the battlefield with an unconventional weapon purchased from Rim Billiton's black market and can provide a variety of short and medium-range attacks for his squad, exterminating enemies as his only means of protecting important targets.

'That golden-haired Cautus must have provided this guy with a bit of his own protective Arts. Otherwise, he would've turned into ash long ago given the kind of work environments mentioned in his file.' —A not very polite Medic
'Abdominal area feels pretty good on palpation.' —Medic's addendum
handbook.promotionRecord:
Ayerscarpe is a very strange person. 
Even though I know that we shouldn't be quick to judge others, he really is a strange person. 
For example, take his habit of eating salted edamame. 
I know some people who think food from the East is new and exotic and have a desire to try it, and sometimes they'll even really like it. 
But I cannot understand his particular way of eating. 
He eats them, shell and everything. 
He just pops the entire pod into his mouth. 
I didn't know either at first, and originally thought that was how you were supposed to eat them. I gave it a try, and thought that these were inedible, and decided that whoever came up with the idea of eating these things must've been crazy. 
But then, someone told me to peel the pod. 
Ayerscarpe even made a little box to take with him that is specifically for edamame, which he probably eats as a snack. 
As for why, I can't don't why. 
Oh, right, there's one other thing. The guy thinks he runs on electricity. 
I'm serious. 
I have no idea if his weapon electrocutes people, but when I see his ears tremble, I'm pretty sure there's some electricity involved. 
What's more, he always goes around asking those electricity-based operators if he can bum some electricity from them. 
I'm talking Greyy, that guy who fixes the electrical outlets, and Leizi. 
He walked up to Leizi like a plank one day and asked, 'is there some way for me to quickly increase the charge my body can carry?' 
Is he stupid?! 
I feel even worse for that little Victorian hairstylist. They already have to deal with getting shocked by static electricity all the time due to their Oripathy, but now there's this guy who's always asking, 'Can you shock me real quick?' Absolute maniac! 
————A certain file manager's evaluation in the appendix
archives:
Before joining Rhodes Island, Ayerscarpe was the bodyguard to Leonhardt, a Catastrophe Messenger. His main job was to protect Leonhardt from harm during his investigations and assessments of Catastrophes. Combined with Leonhardt's cleverness, the duo rarely run into sticky situations. Most of the time, Ayerscarpe only needs to accompany him on walks, help carry equipment, or listen to his friend's incessantly prattling about what he thinks is cool — at least until the moment when a crisis comes and he is required to perform his duties.
There are many ways for a bodyguard to protect his target. Some people prefer using defensive measures to mitigate the damage, others are good at arranging traps to deter an enemy's attack. However, Ayerscarpe's preferred method of defense is to eradicate the enemies. Though he is a man of few words, his ferocious attacks indeed confirm his status as an operator who believes that the best defense is a good offense.

Ayerscarpe's chosen method of defense is extremely risky and does not conform to the logic of ordinary people. However, the operator himself is well-suited for carrying out his duties in this manner. In addition to having excellent combat skills and rapid reaction times, part of this operator's success is owed to the special weapon that he carries. 
There has been no official name given to this weapon as of yet, and the nicknames that the operator himself has chosen, such as 'my baby,' or 'nice guy,' have no reference value whatsoever. Due to the operating mode of the weapon itself, we've temporarily named it 'RT-01.' 
Since there is no weapon or even weapon class similar to RT-01 within our scope of knowledge, we believe that this is an experimental weapon. According to Ayerscape, this weapon was purchased from Rim Billiton's black market. Rim Billiton has developed many small-scale private mining companies due to its robust mining industry. The turnover and conglomeration rate among these companies are high, which indirectly promotes the black market. Many resources will circulate here before eventually reaching the hands of private individuals, organizations, or even foreign forces. Because Ayerscarpe overcame great difficulties to acquire this weapon, and the weapon itself boasts excellent performance, he is extremely fond of RT-01. When asked to describe any deficiencies, he'll only point out that it 'produces some slight noise from time to time.' 
The operator in charge of weapon inspections said he didn't hear anything, but Ayerscarpe insists that he hears it loud and clear.

Ayerscarpe and Leonhardt have been friends since childhood, and the two also divide labor amongst each other very cleanly. Leonhardt takes on jobs that require negotiation or involve minerals, and Ayerscarpe takes on tasks that require superior athleticism or uncovering things that can't be discovered by others. Don't be fooled by the fact that he often exchanges harsh words with his old friend — he will never make Leonhardt look bad in front of others, and if something ever happens to him, he is the first to rush over. When Leonhardt became a Catastrophe Messenger, Ayerscarpe volunteered to become Leonhardt's private bodyguard. Since Ayerscarpe acquired his unique set of weapons, it would be more profitable to take on jobs of his own rather than protecting the Catastrophe Messenger, but Ayerscarpe stubbornly insists on remaining his friend's bodyguard, while also making it clear that the other party needs to pay up. All in all, Leonhard, not wealthy in the first place, ended up allocating most of his salary to Ayerscarpe, ending up in an even tighter financial situation as a result. 
Although we didn't know how Ayerscarpe controlled these funds before, we were able to investigate the flow of funds between the two after he became an operator, and the results were mind-blowing. 
Leonhardt's concept of managing money is rather laissez-faire. While he is good at making money, he's also good at spending it. After joining Rhodes Island, his shopping list grew longer than ever due to stable living arrangements and a higher salary. Except for work-related tools such as dune buggies, which have questionable usability in general circumstances, Leonhardt's stash of new and interesting things has indeed been growing. Most of these items simply reflect his personal taste, but others are for gifting to young operators who he deems to 'not be cool enough,' and he often offers these gifts in a way that is hard to refuse. Sometimes, his consumption habits have caused been problematic, such as when he couldn't pay the bills one time. This time, he has had Ayerscarpe to cover for him.
Ayerscarpe's lifestyle has always been very frugal. Other than spending money on necessary living expenses and salted edamame, Ayerscarpe has been saving his money, and he basically returns the 'payment' he received from serving as Leonhardt's bodyguard to his friend at the right time. He knows that Leonhardt doesn't know how to save money, and he knows that sooner or later, he wouldn't be able to purchase something that he actually needed. At that time, he'll use that money to buy things for his friend and send it over to him. Even now when there is no direct financial connection between the two, he still often draws from his savings to fill in the gap for Leonhardt. Of course, he also knows that Leonhardt will repay him in due time. This is the mutual understanding formed after many years of cooperation, and demonstrates the trust between the two friends.

'We found a signal transmitter on Ayerscarpe's weapon, which has already been dismantled, that the operator had no knowledge of.' 
'The signal sent from the transmitter automatically searches for a valid port, performs a second transmission, before eliminating all traces until it reaches the target.' 
'Most countries' military-grade communications equipment does not have this level of technology.' 
'After cracking the transmission path of the launcher and simulating a transmission, we have reason to believe—'
'It's Rhine Lab. I can tell just from looking at it.' 
'The signal's final destination is a port located in Ursus.' 
'After being intercepted by a node halfway through, it modified the target port before immediately deleting the data. This is an old trick.' 
'Do you really think Ursus knows how to make a weapon like this?' 
'A reloading blade-gun, a self-calibrating gun, automatic hover blades.' 
'Only Rhine Labs has the capacity to deliberately integrate these technologies into a single system.' 
'I see.' 
'So——'
'How did a Columbian experimental weapon end up in Rim Billiton, in the hands of a young man who has nothing to do with them?' 
'......'
This whole situation has Rhine Lab's fingerprints all over it. Let me give you a hypothetical.' 
'Sure.' 
'On Terra, there will always be people with extraordinary talents.' 
'It is a joy to craft weapons for them.' 
'When these weapons are manufactured and their wielders seem to possess all the power in the world within their hands, buyers will arrive in droves to snag up these weapons.' 
'In the hands of ordinary people, these 'divine' weapons are not even as useful as a logging hatchet.' 
'As for what Rhine Labs did, I actually have an idea.' 
'They designed a 'divine weapon,' but realized that it is nothing but a hatchet.' 
'This thing?' 
'This is a failed design.' 
'While the design seems well-integrated as a whole, the Originium undergoes serious leakage problems during conversion, and the accuracy of the hovering blades is unsatisfactory.' 
'If not in the hands of someone who has a hobby of getting electrocuted, this weapon is not usable at all.' 
'How do we deal with this then?' 
'Deal with? There's no need for that. Saria couldn't see eye-to-eye about the way certain departments in Rhine Lab did things, but she wouldn't do anything about these weapon owners.' 
'Our biggest fear is that Rhine Lab will use the signal transmitter to take control of the device and do something unspeakable.' 
'Since we found out about it, it should be fine now that we've destroyed it.' 
'As for what Rhine Lab will do with the data they obtained, will they find another target to experiment upon, or will they create the hatchet that can slay a god?' 
'So, what does this have to do with Rhodes Island?' 
—Unknown time, Rhodes Island, unidentified surveillance recording

modules.moduleDescription:
<Portable Wildland Stimulant: Preparation, Instruction and Efficacy>
[Preparation and Instruction]
1. Prepare some cooked edamame. Do not salt or peel them.
2. Prepare a device to freeze the edamame. I will use my own edamame box here as a demonstration: this much freezing is just right.
3. Prepare a device to discharge electricity. I'll demonstrate with my trusty sidekick here: this much power leakage is just right.
4. Lower the voltage of the discharge device and shock the edamame until the juice inside carries a slight charge.
5. Eat.
[Efficacy]
In the barrens, maintaining a clear mind can be a real challenge. The boundless wilderness, the sweeping dust storms, the glow reflecting from the active Originium clouds in the sky, the howl of the wind blowing through Originium crystal clusters... It's easy to gradually lose your sense of self and fall into a trance-like state where you won't notice incoming dangers.
Chew the edamame along with its shell. The hairs of the shell can stimulate the mouth, thus keeping the user's nerves active.
Frozen edamame can stimulate the gums and make it easier to stay awake.
The slightly-charged juices can give a tingling jolt, thus sharpening the user's perception.
Proper stimulation can prevent people from falling into a stupor. This is the only way to survive in the wilderness.

'You've put a weird amount of thought into this manual, Ayers.'
'Quit flapping your gums, Leon. A lot of operators have been coming by the last few days, asking me for the secret to staying awake in the wilds. I'm sick of giving the same explanation again and again.'
'I guess it's true that your manual could stop people from coming, but... to be honest, I'm surprised those hobbies of yours can actually come in handy.'
'That's a nice bonus. Edamame is delicious, and I find the electric jolt refreshing.'
'Well, whatever floats your boat. At first, I was worried you were forcing yourself to do all that just to stay awake protecting me...'
'Do I seem like that kind of person?'
'Not really. Remember the first time you ate edamame? With shell and everything? You didn't know to peel it back then and we were worried it'd cause some sort of problem, but instead you seemed happy as could be.'
'I remember. That was when the mining ship broke down in the barrens. By the time we got it huffing and puffing to the next mine, everyone was already delirious with hunger. It was the first time I had food that could just snap you back to your senses, and it really stuck with me.'
'Wait, so it all comes back to waking you up after all? You know, I'm starting to feel a little sorry for you, Ayers.'
'No, it's because edamame is delicious, and I find the electric jolt refreshing.'
'...Alright then. Whatever floats your boat.'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Tabletop, 60 points. Floor, 63 points. Air quality...... 56 points. There's room for improvement, Doctor.

Have you experienced any bodily discomfort recently? Umm, dry skin, stiff shoulders... dry eyeballs, hair loss, fatigue? ...Very good, just old problems then, nothing serious. As long as you start exercising, these problems should go away in no time.
Life in the Medical Department is just daily meetings, visits around the Island, learning the operators' physical conditions, and developing new drugs. Nothing really fresh or exciting.
Mother, no matter where you are, please watch over me.

Thanks for always taking care of us medics. I feel so much less anxiety while working, and I'm very happy. Of course, there are troublesome things to deal with as well, for example, when Blaze comes back, her body is always covered in blood, each and every time! Does she know how hard it is to clean up those bodily fluids?

How many times have I told you, don't stay up late, and don't overeat! You just won't listen, right? How are you going to take care of your health then? You might as well spend the rest of your life in that chair!! ...... I'm sorry, I need to go calm down first.
I never quite know what Dr. Kal'tsit is thinking. Has she always been that... unique? I hope I can catch up to her one day, even if it's in just one area.
As long as the wicked can be punished, what's a little bit of criticism? I don't mind spilling these poisons on my enemies. They deserve it.
The word 'Ursus' only gives me pain. I don't want to hear it, not again for the rest of my life. But it's giant, its voice deafening, and I'm the only one it's going to drive mad.

You also know that your previous environmental cleanliness evaluation scores weren't very high, right? If you don't turn things around, Doctor, you'll be on the business end of the Rhodes Island sanitation crane. ... I'll help you take care of these for now, so make sure you clean up the rest in your free time.

I am Folinic from the Medical Department, and I am now participating in field medic missions. Meanwhile, per Dr. Kal'tsit's request, I will also help you manage your health. I look forward to working with you.
It seems that the volume of drug input was insufficient last time, and it should be able to achieve its intended effect next time at triple the dosage.
Thank you for your acknowledgment. I am simply doing what I should.
One day, I will become as capable a physician as Dr. Kal'tsit. Just you wait and see.
Medical support ready. I'll protect everyone's life.
Medical support has covered the whole squad. The rest is up to you, Doctor.
No problem, I can handle some psychological burden.
Enemy engaged. Prepare for counterattack and treatment.
Haven't decided yet?
The clock's ticking.
Medical support has arrived.
Permission to attack has been granted.
Start medication.
Don't worry, the effects will kick in soon.
Three, two, one!
Overdose decoction prepared, begin use!
I was able to be of some help, right?
Saving medical supplies is a good thing, but there's no need for that on the battlefield, is there?
Luckily, it's just a scratch. Just apply a bandage after cleansing the wound.
Transfer the wounded! Get ready for emergency operation! Prepare for intraosseous infusion!
Inspection complete. This area is habitable.
Huh?
Sometimes the things I say to you can be a bit... excessive, but you should also recognize that you have your shortcomings, all right?
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor. Why don't we take this chance to look back on your health over the last year? Let's see... Forget it. I have to admit my management of your health still has room for improvement. I will work extra hard on that this year.
You've been working hard.

Happy birthday, Doctor. I prepared a gift for you. This is a neck massager developed by the Medical Department. Why don't you give it a try now? It might hurt a little, but it's good for your health. Hey, don't try to escape. I will manage your health one way or another.

Ever since my mother went missing, I haven't had a place to call home. Rhodes Island is the closest I have. Dr. Kal'tsit invested her ideals in this company, and so have I. Doctor, bear witness to my determination.

Thanks for always taking care of us medics. I feel so much less anxiety while working, and I'm very happy. Of course, there are troublesome things to deal with as well, for example, when Blaze comes back, her body is always covered in blood, each and every time! Does she know how hard it is to clean up those bodily fluids?

How many times have I told you, don't stay up late, and don't overeat! You just won't listen, right? How are you going to take care of your health then? You might as well spend the rest of your life in that chair!! ...... I'm sorry, I need to go calm down first.
I never quite know what Dr. Kal'tsit is thinking. Has she always been that... unique? I hope I can catch up to her one day, even if it's in just one area.
As long as the wicked can be punished, what's a little bit of criticism? I don't mind spilling these poisons on my enemies. They deserve it.
The word 'Ursus' only gives me pain. I don't want to hear it, not again for the rest of my life. But it's giant, its voice deafening, and I'm the only one it's going to drive mad.

You also know that your previous environmental cleanliness evaluation scores weren't very high, right? I'll help you take care of these for now, so make sure you clean up the rest in your free time.
