handbook.profile:
Gloria Rebel Pasbelletti is a Victorian operating under the code name Nightmare. Before her induction into Rhodes Island, she was a college student with two specialties: advanced medical Arts and intervention counseling. Skilled in both medical and combat Arts, she currently works in Rhodes Island's triage section. 
Note: She is a good candidate for Special Management. The paperwork has been signed by Lena and is effective immediately.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 16%
Surveillance is recommended for rare cases like this. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.33u/L 
Infection is in mid-stage and continues to spread. First-level medical plan recommended. Pathological Monitoring Protocol Label: Red (signed by Dr. Kal'tsit, see medical file for more detail).
archives:
[Gloria] 
Attempting to analyze Gloria is a long and difficult process ('Gloria,'her real name, is used in this report at her own request). In many therapy sessions, she clearly felt anxiety and panic, refusing to answer any questions in one session, leaving communication at a standstill. Using flowers and aromatherapy to relax her has been extremely effective thus far. After she understood the significance of her treatment and that none of the content of her sessions would be made public, her true meek nature gradually started to show.

[Gloria's Background] 
Gloria was born in a small, artsy city in Victoria. Her mother worked at the local hospital. Gloria did not show interest in Originium until middle school. Although she has shown a unique talent for it in her tests at Rhodes Island, she still does not want to deal with it. 
Gloria worked hard to become a medical student, either due to her mother's expectation or her own desire. However, her infection disrupted her future plans. Today, Gloria is still unable to recall how she got infected (it is worth noting her sessions all alluded to an alternate personality, 'Nightmare,' and it seemed only 'Nightmare' could recall how it happened). Temporary memory loss is a common symptom of Oripathy, so all investigations should take that into account.
According to our intel, Gloria had at least six months of combat experience before joining Rhodes Island. Her militant 'Nightmare' personality seems to be the one behind the stint.

[Gloria's Arts and Staff] 
Because of her studies on the medical application of Originium and her experiences as an infected, she can use medical arts to heal her teammates while also adept at combat arts. Her ability to do many types of arts is the basis for her role at Rhodes Island.
According to Gloria's own account, the staff her father left her has its own power. A number of tests done by warlock Operators has found the staff can increase the effectiveness of healing arts, but they must be performed in a manner similar to hypnosis. Feedback from test subjects also indicated they almost always dreamed in this hypnotized state. According to observation, the subjects quickly entered REM state, but did not experience other aspects of a normal sleep cycle. They remained in this state until awakened.

[Gloria and Nightmare] 
It is not unusual for Oripathy to cause Multiple Personality Disorder, but Gloria, who is currently on a conservative treatment plan, is different from other Operators in stable condition. Her condition has a major hurdle: In moments where Gloria loses control, the very aggressive Nightmare takes over. 
However, studies have indicated that Nightmare is the dominant personality and is very much awake inside Gloria. They have even seen Nightmare trying to regain control over her body. 
The medical team was unable to assimilate Gloria and Nightmare into one personality despite counseling. Should we continue to let her work for Rhodes Island when she still has Nightmare? A doctor will have to develop a relationship with Gloria before we can make that decision. 
Note: Dr. Kal'tsit made this statement about Gloria: 
'Integrating her personalities is her only option.' 
However, she did not specify which personality would become dominant after assimilation.

modules.moduleDescription:
CONSULTATION RECORDING N-02 20:37
Are you feeling better now, Gloria?
A bit. I'm sorry, it happened again...
That's alright. Are the flowers and fragrances here able to calm you down?
Yes...
Is 'Nightmare' causing your panic?
I don't know.
Gloria, for this consultation, I'd like to chat with you. I'll need you to try not to let 'Nightmare' come out. Can you do that?
I... I can try.
Good, I trust in you. If she's about to come out, you warn me as loudly as you can, okay?
Mm. Let's begin. Last consultation, you said you were awake while 'Nightmare' came out. What did it feel like, during that time?
It felt like... like I was sitting in front of a big screen. The sounds, and pictures... were all really clear, but I wasn't able to do anything.
You did something to take back control of your body. Can you describe that?
I ran and ran, and there were all these threads pulling at me, sticky, and dark, and I was pulling those threads... [COUGH], [COUGH]!
Gloria, are you alright? You have a very bad cough there.
Could I have a cup of water, doctor?
Here.
Thank you.
Let's continue. Were you doing that because you don't like 'Nightmare' occupying your body? So you'd like to get rid of her?
No, I just feel... helpless. Like if I don't do this, I'll lose something.
What do you think of 'Nightmare'?
She's different from me. She does things I can't do. It scares me a little.
Do you consider the two of you independent from each other?
Probably.
Suppose, and this is only me supposing, that one day, out of the two of you, only you were left. How would you feel?
I don't know... [COUGH] Sorry, I need more water.
Relax, it's okay. Now, we're going to try a slightly different method for our chat.
I'm going to have you recall some quite deep memories. Don't worry, I promise it can't hurt you in any way.
Mm. Watch my three fingers carefully. One by one, I'll bend them down, and they'll sink slowly into the deepest parts of your mind.
Three.
Two.
One.
Are you Gloria?
Yes.
Gloria, can you recall when 'Nightmare' first emerged?
I don't remember exactly when, just... that night, I had a bad dream.
A bad dream?
Mm, I dreamed there was a white wall, with very bright corridor lights, and lots of people, and a lot of blood... and then, she appeared.
So she first appeared in your dream?
Yes.
Was she doing anything?
I remember, I dreamed she... saved me.
She saved you? And did she do anything else?
Ah... [COUGH]! Water, I need...
Calm down, take me through slowly.
Here—agh! That's my hand!
Heh. Heheh.
'Nightmare'! But why wasn't there any sign?
Oh, Gloria clearly warned you, you just didn't notice. What did you think? My imitation of her's quite a good one, isn't it?
Requesting backup! 'Nightmare'—
Hush, not loud. Now, do you think that really was a bad dream? And just which of us could be after the Originium?
The twinflower, the doublet... truth and lie. How are you supposed to tell them apart?
Alright, now listen to me. Hand over the Originium...
—RECORDING ENDS HERE.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Heheh, Dr. {@nickname}, What can I do for you today?
Combat missions take up most of my job, where I just havoc around with my hammer... It feels nice to get to sort files like this every once in a while.

When I worked for RIM Billiton, I was in charge of a lot of things: mining ores, doing geological surveys with electromagnets, all kinds of stuff. Hmm... sounds like a mouthful, right? To put it simply, I smashed what blocks the way and kept digging down!
Amiya has a lot on her shoulders. If only I could help share her burden a little... And perhaps yours too, Doctor. Don't hesitate to let me know if there's anything you need help with!
Providing cover, trailblazing, area denial... I might not be able to literally shield my teammates like the Defender Operators, but I can still protect everyone in my own way!
Did... did I manage to keep everyone safe?... *Sign of Relief* I'm so rapt... Please, Doctor, from now on, let me stay with you and Amiya!
Doctor, want a cabbage veggie salad with mushroom pies? Yep, I made three servings! Yours, mine, and another for Amiya. She loves the pies I make!

The running backs on the football field are unstoppable. They just keep charging forward in spite of everything, all to clear a path for their teammates. And then they just fall down and leave it to everyone else to finish the job. Isn't that sort of like what I do? It's very cool! I hope I don't have to get tackled though.

Doctor, as long as I get to stay with you and Amiya, it's enough for me. Memories belong in the past, while the future is waiting for us to color it in. Amiya and I will continue to create more memories with you in the days to come!
Doctor, seems you've got some time to spare... Then let's go get groceries for tea tonight!
Savage, from RIM Billiton, reporting for duty! The moment I got the message from you and Amiya, I rushed right over to see what I could do. Huh? You don't remember anything? Strewth!
Ooh, I see. Uh-huh… I totally understand it now!
I feel a lot better taking orders from you, Doctor. I won't let you down!
Don't worry, Doctor. No matter how many enemies there are, as long as you're with me, I'll smash 'em all!
Savage, in position!
Everyone, follow me closely!
Begin the attack!
Target located. Attack!
I'm ready!
What's next?
Leave it to me!
This one's mine!
Haaaa!
Mjolnir-3, full power!
Piece of cake!
Incoming!
Hmm, guess no mission's too difficult for us!
What? It's over already? Easy-peasy!
...I'd give my performance a C.
It's too dangerous here! We have to fall back!
Huh? You're really trusting me with work this detail-oriented?
Hmm? Nnngg?
All done with work for the day!
Arknights.
Happy New Year, Doctor! And also to you, Amiya, my little beaut~ Here's to the year you grow tall as a tree. And Doctor, here's to... augh, well, here's to a lighter workload! No more overtime!
Yahoo~ Doctor! Good morning!

Happy birthday, Doctor! I remember you used to love—oh, I bet you don't remember yourself, do you? Oh well, I'm sure you'll still love this butter and pulled-meat pie! It's the taste of a happy life. Amiya's words.

I'm a little dazed all of a sudden, seeing everyone at Rhodes Island so happy. After all we've been through, just having you and Amiya here, safe and sound, is already more than I could ask for. I'll be with you from here on out, fighting to preserve this happiness.

handbook.profile:
Savage was originally part of Rim Billiton Mining Company's security forces. She was an exemplary agent, known for taking down hard targets and protecting key company executives. 
She now serves as a guard for a Rhodes Island combat squad.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
No Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.15u/L 
Take care when performing missions. 

Savage is in incredibly good health. If only everyone could be as healthy as her...
--Medic Operator Hibiscus
handbook.promotionRecord:
Savage made it clear she considers Amiya and Kal'tsit old-fashioned.
Savage also stated her identity shouldn't matter to Rhodes Island. She believes as long as she is helping her friends, what and where her mission takes her is unimportant.
She will probably continue to fight as the only one who truly knows her limits.
archives:
Savage uses special Originium Arts in battle that detonate the ground struck by her hammer fractions of a second after impact. She has taken down difficult targets with these Arts.
After a reverse-engineering study on her hammer, the engineering staff found her hammer was not armed with a blasting device at all, but rather, it acted as an unconventional staff. Savage uses the Originium housed inside the hammer to create the blasts.
Although she doesn't fully understand the principles behind this power, when she is manipulating the hammer, she always unleashes tremendous explosive power. 
Other important information cannot be verified without further research.

Savage earned her codename thanks to the massive destruction she causes both in combat and on mining missions. The codename also matches her physique. 
However, despite her name, Savage is a fairly kind and cheerful Operator. She is known to be friendly, reliable, and fun both on and off the battlefield. 
Note though, she is quite fierce when on the football field, so try not to yell at her while she's playing.

Savage plays a very important role in combat. She clears obstacles to facilitate direct attacks against the enemy. She is also quite effective at protecting her teammates, and casualties are almost always lower than expected with her on a mission.
Sometimes she likes to get in the kitchen and make vegetable soups, mushroom pies, and other Rim Billitonian cuisine for her fellow Operators.
Many Operators call her dishes comfort food.
She has been known to pitch in and help her teammates when she can, and she is increasingly well-liked.
Please do not post the names of suitors she has rejected on the bulletin board in the lounge. Thank you for your cooperation.

[Classified Log] I have already spoken with Savage, and she understands our current situation. It is an issue between her and the Doctor. 
At least Savage will fight for Amiya, and that is enough for now. 
I hope we have enough gumption to resolve this deadlock. 
--Kal'tsit

modules.moduleDescription:
Mum's very cross with the big Cautus girl scratching her head in front of her.
'Trying to sneak out again! If you don't rest, I'll MAKE you rest, I'm warning you!'
Savage lifts away the giant basket of carrots perched atop her mum's head.
'Fresh, sweet, and crunchy! Just perfect for this trip's rations. I'll bring the leftover ones back, Mum, and then you can make carrot pie!'
Mum leaps up and gives Savage a few raps on the head. 'These are for you to rest up at home, and let your health come back to you!
'Ever since you came back from that abandoned mine all a muddle, it's like your motor's never stopped.
'If you're not banging on about how you met a ghost, then you're trying to run out of doors... Stuffing all our family plans, that's you. You've got me at wit's end.'
She can't possibly explain to her mother that that wasn't a ghost sighting, but on the other hand, it is true the mysterious stranger with the little rabbit hasn't left a trace for her to find.
It's as if whoever they were, they never existed in these lands at all.
How?
'You went somewhere, suddenly passed out, then the people who were with you all vanished into thin air.
'Ghost stories like that are a penny a piece for the workers here. That's just life in the mines.'
'They were NOT just ghosts haunting Rim Billy!'
Even though it was the briefest of encounters, Savage remembers the warmth of the girl curled up sleeping in her arms that evening. Moreover, when she spent every bit of her strength smashing apart boulders to rescue them from that collapsed mineshaft, the mysterious stranger clearly bled.
They never told her where their journey's destination lay, but when the mysterious stranger was alone, tightly wrapped in solemn silence, Savage knows she caught a glimpse of them gazing into the starry sky, and to lands far away.
Who could be waiting for them up ahead?
Savage doesn't know, but they need her help.
'Mum, I'm not going to make it! I still have to go to the maintenance crew and check if they've fixed my hammer yet!'
Her mother knows this passionate girl of hers. Ever since she was little, once she got fixated on something, she'd never let it go.
'Oi, you forgot to empty the letterbox again, it's been more than a week now. Honestly, you make me doubt if you can take care of yourself...'
But that letter Savage had ignored for days is what finally calms her down. Stuffed inside is a design, drawn by hand, for a weapon just for her—and in the corner is a doodle of three people. Plus, a note.
'Miss, pardon us for not saying goodbye. The Doctor is very sorry that you broke your weapon to help us.'
Putting the letter away, Savage lets out a deep breath. She absolutely can't wait to hit the road again.
A strong gut feeling tells her that in the end, they'll meet once again, and finish their journey.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: So... I have to just stand here and not do anything? Laaaame.
These gauntlets aren't that heavy. See? Even a dainty little girl like me can carry 'em around real easy.
You remember fighting by my side before? Can't say I remember fighting by yours, sorry... I just fight for what's right, that's all.

Hah. That boxer, Beehunter? She's really something! I enjoyed sparring with her so much, I had to throw out some serious moves. And she's got an amazing honey collection too. Wanna visit her with me next time? You gotta learn some kung fu first, though.

Reading a movie magazine...? Well, guess what? The 'hot kung-fu actress' mentioned in this article is ME! What? You don't believe me? Come on, look! This is me, can't you tell? C'mon, that's definitely me!
Do I regret forgoing my previous life? Well, sometimes, of course. But the world ain't kind to us Infected. Lots of places I'm not allowed to go. It blows.
There's a street full of food stalls in the neighboring city. And... a candy shop over there? And a theme park? Aww, Doctor, can I get a day off? I wanna check out these places!

Am I satisfied with life at Rhodes Island, you ask? Hm, to be honest... It's even sweeter than what they show in the movies! I got cool opponents to practice with, top-notch food, and by working here, I'm doing something good for the world! What could be better!

Doctor, look! What do you think about this script? Oh, who's gonna act in it, you wonder? You and I are gonna be the main characters! There's this scene where we leap from the roof of a thirty-story building and slide all the way down. Isn't that cool? Hey! Come back! Wait!
You're catching some z's, eh? Guess I'll slack off for a bit too. Man, this couch is so fluffy!
You swear you've seen my face before? Probably saw it in a movie I was in! Call me FEater, and what I do from here is your call!
It's over? Come on, let's watch just a while longer. We're almost at the fun part!
Oooh! A promotion! Thanks so much, Doctor!
This here's the perfect opportunity to show you some REAL kung fu!
All right, it's show time!
Huh? I'm the leader? Not sure how it'll go, but...
This is gonna be exciting!
I'm FEater. Pleased to beat you!
Un-huh.
Here we go!
All right!
Show time!
HI-YAH!
This is straight out of one of my movies!
From flexibility comes power!
Who says a movie star couldn't be a real kung-fu master!
Wow, it's over?
It's over already? I was just starting to get warmed up.
Hey, it's no biggie. Just a few scratches and bruises.
Aw... I just wanna go home and sleep...
Now that's stylin'!
Stop that, I'm getting dizzy!
Hey, Doctor, want my autograph? I'll take a pic with you if you want, too!
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor! Hehe, back in the old days, theaters would screen my movies this time every year, all playing to a full house!  Still, can't live in the past forever. I gotta punch ahead, and people gotta move on forward. Let's forget all our grievances for today!
Did you have breakfast yet, Doctor?

Doctor, happy birthday! There's this saying that 'life's a movie you can't reshoot,' so when it comes to a key scene, you've gotta live life like you're on fire! Any birthday wishes, Doctor? Gimme a wish as cool as the lead of an action movie, and I'll help you make it come true!

After I became an Infected, I thought for a bit that my career and my life were both over. Rhodes didn't just rein in my illness, but also gave me a fresh start. Standing up again in dire straits is exactly what the hero does, right? Doctor, Let's climb back to the top, together!

handbook.profile: A famous action movie star from Yan, FEater was forced to give up her film career after contracting Oripathy. She found a new purpose in life at Rhodes Island.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7.2% 
Visible traces of Originium on the subject's right leg, but it has not yet crystallized. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L 
FEater's infection is still in early stages and has yet to substantially impact her health.
archives: FEater studied martial arts for many years prior to entering the film industry. She is the heir to the Tie Yi Liu He Quan, the Universal Fist of the Iron Will, one of Yan's great martial arts traditions. FEater has mastered all Five Elements, Eight Strikes, and Twelve Forms of her art, giving her the ability to deal devastating blows in the blink of an eye.

After contracting Oripathy, FEater's acting career and aspirations came to a screeching halt. But she didn't give into depression like one might expect, since movies to her were just one vehicle for delivering righteousness. The optimistic former star quickly landed back on her feet.

Even after becoming a movie star, even having been a legendary martial arts master, FEater has always been someone very approachable. In fact, she is actually rather naive and gets along easily with other Operators. Her hobbies include movies, of course, as well as Yan food, and chugging alcohol with a friendly crowd.

modules.moduleDescription: 'Ah-choo... ah-choo...' Outside the kitchen door, everyone is wiping their noses, sneezing one after another like there's no tomorrow, even their eyes sealed shut. The culprit: a pungent, choking aroma wafting from a crack in the door, inflaming everyone's nostrils, tickling their throats. 'Ah-choo... ah-choo...' Despite how unbearable it is, nobody's willing to take even one step away. People are still flowing into the cafeteria, in fact. 'Is—Is it ready? Is FEater still inside?' '*cough* *cough*... Yeah, you can hear the banging. She's probably still chopping chilis.' 'So spicy... I—I'm almost at my limit... ah-choo!' 'Then you'd better get out of here... *cough* *cough*...' 'No way am I letting you jump my spot... ah-choo!' With a 'crrrk,' the kitchen door swings open, and in an instant, the entire room is filled with a scent rich and stimulating. Right behind it comes FEater carrying a plate, her smile brimming with satisfaction. 'It's done! Step on up and try it, guys. I've even added my hometown chili paste for a special touch.' Seeing the brilliant red pepper slices and vividly shining chili oil, the crowd craning to steal a look just a moment before is now hush-silent. They share looks of alarm at each other, each sporting their own unique expression. 'Don't let it scare you! Sit down and try!' 'I assume... it's going to be very spicy, FEater?' 'Nope, not spicy at all. I just tasted it.' 'Then I suppose I will.' No sooner do the words come out than the crowd parts perfectly into two, and under the admiring attention of all, one lone operator walks up to the table, rubs her hands, and picks up a pair of chopsticks with a tremble. 'Come on, try!' As if unable to withstand FEater's expectant gaze, the operator's chopsticks chatter like teeth, with a sharp clack-clack-clack-clack. Finally, after circling above the plate a few times, they descend, carefully picking up a piece of meat not totally stuffed with peppers. She lifts the chopsticks high and gives them a shake, then two, hoping the chili seeds and peppercorns will fall out of the roll of meat, and right away senses it still won't be enough, leading her to wipe it a few times against the edge of the plate. Only once it's wiped bare of all excess oil does she finally take a deep breath, and prepare to put it in her mouth. 'Wait, give it a rinse in your glass!' The prompting voice from the crowd enters her ears, and she sees the light. Her chopsticks make an about face and dunk the meat in her drinking glass, and instantly, what was clear warm water is now scarlet throughout, beads of oil floating about within. The sight of the meat's original, fair color greets her. The operator sighs with palpable relief, and scarfs it down in one clean go. 'How is it? Good?' asks FEater with a wink. '*cough* *cough* *cough* *cough*... Wh—Where's my water? *cough* *cough*—' '*glug* *glug*...' 'Hey, isn't that the water she just...' 'Pppffffhh—!'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Umm, excuse me… I've been waiting here... for two hours…
Sorry… I know people keep ignoring me... But... my Arts aren't to blame…
My Arts... make me undetectable to people... in certain environments…
I… I've never had any friends... S-surely no one wants a friend that…  they can't even notice… right?
My tail... It curls up when I'm not fighting... So please, don't be afraid…
Doctor... you can leave the dangerous work to me... After all... my Arts were made for that…
These ID tags around my neck… I collected them... I like holding onto evidence... that someone once existed...
Don't let that 'Nightmare' girl near me!... She's dangerous... My Arts don't work on her... Why…?
I… I really want to cure my Oripathy. But if it's cured... what's going to happen to my Arts?... If they're gone, will I... still be of any use...?
Doctor's ignoring me… I don't like it, hmph...
I'm Manticore... My Arts can take out lives silently... Please don't be scared, you're not my target…
Thank you... I-I'm looking forward to you teaching me... more...
Finally, I got a promotion... I always thought I wasn't good enough… so you didn't promote me…
Did I... manage to help you? I don't have anywhere else to go... My home is here... at Rhodes Island... So please, let me protect it with you...
Okay...
Nobody will like me... as their captain...
Please don't leave me behind…
Please choose tactics that make use of my Arts... even if it's something crafty and underhanded... I won't mind...
I-I'm ready...
I'm…right here…
Manticore… going dark…
Ready... to ambush...
That must... really hurt…
Please, Don't come close…
I don't like this... either...
Farewell…
Even in such terrible battles… your judgement and decisions didn't seem to waver… You're incredible, Doctor…
A victory by all means... Still...
I can handle the runaways... if you wish...
I'm sorry... It's all my fault...
I'll sit... in the corner...
Eeeeeek!
Thank you for paying attention to me... I know it's your job... but it still makes me happy…
Arknights.
Happy New Year... More people have  noticed me... in the last year... I'm a little scared, but... a lot of them are very warm, and kind... So, I'm going to try as hard as I can... to adapt...
Hello... Doctor...
I'll just put the present on the table and leave... Doctor, happy birthday... Eek! Did-did you notice me...? Um, Happy birthday to you... Doctor.
I don't want to go through the experience... of losing a friend again... I will defend everyone, with my own life. Even if it's somewhere none of them will see me...

handbook.profile:
Much of Manticore's history is unknown. It is known that prior to her employment at Rhodes Island, she had engaged in the 'removal' of certain individuals. She has excellent stealth, infiltration, and surprise attack skills.
Now she serves as a Specialist Operator who provides these unique services for Rhodes Island.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 12% 
Operator has no obvious ore lesions on the surface of her body. Tests have revealed the presence of crystals internally, however. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.32u/L 
Due to the presence of Originium within the Operator's internal organs, the Operator's shows an elevated blood crystal content.
archives:
Manticore is gentle, shy, and sometimes even gives others the feeling that she's afraid. She speaks in a hesitant tone and often stammers. She rarely finishes a sentence in one attempt, and she appears very stiff when communicating with other Operators. She would probably be more comfortable talking to a rock.
Additionally, her rare invisibility ability has become a major hindrance to communication. It has completely prevented her from improving her interpersonal skills. It may be necessary to suggest additional treatment solutions to help Manticore develop her social skills.

We communicate with Manticore by writing messages on paper. Oripathy has given her the ability to turn invisible (the report on this ability needs additional processing). It has been confirmed through interactive experiments that her ability does not transfer to inanimate objects, so paper communication has proved a suitable way to communicate with this operator.
After communication, Manticore likes to leave behind little gifts that smell sweetly of violets.

Manticore was born in Sargon. Because most of the background she provided could not be validated, Manticore's experience cannot be confirmed. What is known is that Manticore has undergone relatively comprehensive special operations training and has at least one year of operative experience under her belt.
The investigation into her special operations training unit was unsuccessful, and Sargon intelligence did not provide any valuable clues. Currently only unconfirmed and less than reliable intelligence from Sargon spies indicate there is a group of people who house Originium Arts users with special abilities in this area. These individuals are using special training methods to kill Sargon aristocrats or operatives from other nations.
Because of Manticore's vague background, she has been designated a special type of Oripathy patient at Rhodes Island. Any applications requesting use of Manticore in special operations or combat will first need to be submitted to Dr. Kal'tsit for approval.

[Manticore's Ability's Test Record] 
Test subject: Manticore. 
Test objective: To probe the usefulness of the subject's abilities and Originium Arts. 
Test content: To find Manticore while she is in hiding and to defend against her while she is in action. 
Test participants: An Operator who has worked with Manticore on several missions. 
Randomly select two Operators from all of the Operators available. 
Among them must be at least one Caster Operator or non-Caster Operator with high Originium adaptability. 
Test results: The test took place on a terrain simulating a complex environment. During the test period, none of the three Operators were able to locate the whereabouts of Manticore. When Manticore went on the offensive, some of the Operators managed to defend against her attacks using their quick reaction times and combat experience, while Manticore managed to successfully attack the others. 
Feedback results: According to the explanations provided by the Operators, Manticore could not be captured using visual means. Some of the Operators with better Originium adaptability reported feeling a strange atmosphere that instantly made them as though they were in danger. 
The above process has been recorded in its entirety. If you wish to view it, you must request it from the relevant department.

modules.moduleDescription:
A note stuck on the general store's warehouse door reads:
Sorry, I had to leave half an hour early today to see a doctor. I'm not feeling too good. I've been having a few sudden, intense aches, I think the part where I got scratched hasn't healed normally. I've already taken stock of everything for today, and those people who didn't like me didn't follow as far as the store. No worries.

A note stuck on the shabby bottle of perfume reads:
Thank you for always being with me all this time, and always being able to find me. This is a present for you. I know it's far from enough as a thank you, so if there's anything else I can do for you, please be sure to tell me right away.
Also, my sickness is mostly set to keep getting worse... If in time, this present can remind you of me every now and then, then I'm happy. It's alright if you can't remember me too.

A note fallen in the market's grit paving reads:
Hello, do you need help sorting out goods or cleaning up dust? I can do other work too. I'd like to work in exchange for some food. You might not notice where I am, but please don't worry. I'll do everything as earnestly as possible.

A note trapped beneath the dagger reads:
Mission complete.

A note stuck in the corner of the bulletin board of a Rhodes Island lounge, almost covered by the neighboring rainbow of stickers reads:
Everyone at the get-together sang very well. I didn't think it was one bit noisy. But if you decide to move to a more soundproofed room next time, could you put a notice up on the bulletin board beforehand?
Thank you to the person who recommended me drinks. I liked that sour and sweet dark orange one a lot.
—Manticore

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Yahoo, Doctor! Whacha doing? Looks like fun!
Does Rhodes Island have a karaoke place? It'd be great if we had a place to sing the night away, especially when we don't have battles to fight!
My job as an idol is to make the fans happy with my songs and performances. But what should I do as an operator of Rhodes Island... ?
Hi, hi, Doctor! Anything I can help with? Don't judge me by my look— I actually do some heavy lifting at Penguin Logistics.

Yup, my special skill is singing! I can do a cappella, lead vocals, choir singing, pop music, and I can even rap, yo yo! But, I guess that's not a very useful skill for an Operator. If only I had a more practical skill…
M-My ears...? Uh, I can't tell you! A-And even if you ask Texas, she's not going to tell you either! Ehhh—Sorry, I'll explain if I get the chance someday…

You know, Texas actually saved my life. She also taught me so much I never knew. Which is why I... want to be there with her whenever I can... I, uhh, I'm just trying to show my gratitude for her, that's all!
You think I look upset? Um... it's because... Exusiai went on a mission with Texas again, right? If only I were as good as Exusiai…
Doctor! Could you teach me to use a weapon? My songs have no practical use except for support and encouragement. If I could fight with a weapon... What? You're not good at fighting either?!
Texas... are you listening to my song?
(｡･∀･)ﾉﾞHiiii! I'm the loveable idol from Monster Siren Records: Sora! Oops, sorry, introducing myself like this at Rhodes Island must be kinda weird. Aww…
Leveling—up!
A promotion? Do we also have an idol ranking on Rhodes Island?
I can feel the surge in my heart. It's like back to my first concert. I'm just delighted that you trust me so much, Doctor! All my hard work has paid off! Hmm? My ears? Wh-What about them?
As a squad member, I'll try my best to learn from the basics!
I'm the leader? Is that like standing at the center of the idol group?
Singing on the battlefield... Now that's a fresh experience!
If only my music could put an end to all this fighting...
Is it my turn?
Yes, I can handle this!
It's show time!
Alright, let's make some noise!
Come on, we can do it!
You have my full support!
Now we change the game!
Don't lose heart, we can win this one!
I heard your cheering loud and clear, everyone! Thank you!
Awesome! A smashing victory! Texas, did you see how I sparkled on the stage?
We did a good job, team. Thank you for your hard work!
I'm sorry... I wasn't good enough to be your help...
This place is much bigger than the dorms at Penguin Logistics!
Sparkle spark!
Ehehe, thanks, Doctor!
Arknights.

It looks like I can't hold a solo live this year, but that doesn't change my desire to sing. Happy New Year! This year, I'm going to bring even more smiles to my fans—um, no, that's not the word... Oh, right! I'm going to bring even more music to everyone at Rhodes Island!
I hope you have a fantastic day, Doctor!

A lot of fans say my singing can bring people true happiness, and I really hope they're right. Doctor, today I've got a song just for you. Happy birthday! This is for a beautiful life and a cheerful you, all year long!

Idols and Messengers are both jobs about passing on love. Seeing fans and audiences smile is a source of happiness in my own life. I'm sure, together with everyone at Rhodes Island, we can spread this blessing even further. It's a tiny little dream, but I'll do my best to make it come true!

handbook.promotionRecord:
That Sora lass, she managed to fool her fans with impeccable illusions, making them believe she's a Lupo. 
Perhaps she thought she'd stand out as a Lupo? That does make sense from the trendy perspective... 
And that kid, I've seen idols before and they didn't impress me. But then Sora came along and I finally understood why some people worship stars. 
Anyway, I taught her an even better way of concealment, usable at any time, so she won't ever need to try to cover her own identity anymore. 
Also, I shall design more attire for her to help further her career. 
—Orchid
archives:
A minor celebrity/pop idol girl in Lungmen. 
Cute, playful, vivacious, the epitome of the word 'girl.' 
Still cannot strike a balance between being an idol and an Operator, but is making strides.

Miss Sora could've chosen a more conventional fighting style, but at her own insistence, Dr. Kal'tsit ultimately designed a custom program for her to better develop her natural talent. 
To her credit, Sora put in way more effort than a typical Supporter Operator. Anyone would admit that she was practically born to sing, and the results of this program surpassed all expectations. 
Of course, someone who sings on a battlefield draws plenty of enemy attention, so Sora requires more bodyguards than usual. However, she is certainly worth the strategic compromise.

Penguin Logistics naturally had to 'negotiate' with Sora's management agency in order to allow a pop idol to become a courier. 
Given that a codename was also part of the package, it's fair to assume that the 'negotiation' wasn't conventional at all, because no agency in its right mind would expose its valuable asset to potential harm without getting something in return. 
Rhodes Island is a fair operation, and for the other party to make such a great compromise, Penguin Logistics certainly would pay a huge cost without any underhanded coercion. 
Then, what is the cost for Sora to become a PL Operator while retaining her pop idol status? The official contract is too long and complicated to go into here, though it could probably be summed up in three clauses: 
One, Penguin Logistics is responsible for Sora's personal safety, and must not let her make any appearance that would damage her image as a pop idol. 
Two, wherever Sora goes on a mission, Penguin Logistics is obligated to do their best to promote her and increase her popularity as they see fit, as well as absorbing all costs incurred. 
Three, including events or activities described in Clause 2, all revenue derived from Sora's performance as an entertainer must go to the management agency. 
Violation of any clause is ground for the agency to terminate the contract to revoke Sora as an Operator. 
Following PL's partnership with Rhodes Island, the latter also assumed all the obligations. After all, who wouldn't want a girl as adorable as Sora to be the biggest star in the world?

People always ask: Maybe Sora is a good entertainer, but is she a good Operator? 
The answer is affirmative. 
She's not too hung up about needing someone to protect her, nor does she wallow in self-pity over not being able to defend others with a weapon. She knows her limits and stays within them. No one has to worry about that. 
However, that doesn't mean she wishes harm to come to those who guard her, nor does it mean she refuses to pick up arms in defense of others. She's no good at it, but that doesn't keep her from trying. 
Every day between practice sessions, Sora clumsily trains her weapon proficiency, hoping to contribute a bit more in battle. 
It's thoughts like that which truly make Sora special.

modules.moduleDescription:
A silver nanny van enters a Penguin Logistics safehouse's closest dropoff point. Cases big and small are hauled out from it.
Clearly, their owner plans to stick around for the long haul. Once every case is finally inside, a Lupo who's been waiting around saunters by the pop idol, stoops down, and nabs a pair of plastic sticks out of an open cardboard box.
'If I'm remembering right... these are glowsticks for the fans?'
'—Huh? Uh, yeah, a fan sent me these. Texas, how come you know what they're for?'
'...I've been to your concerts, and seen your tapes. Hard not to notice all these glowing in a sea of dark.'
'Ohh, I see,' Sora mumbles, casting a brief look around her before returning her gaze.
'So, um, you wanna go to another one? A concert, I mean?'
'When?'
'It could be right here, right now, or maybe tomorrow? I mean, look—' Sora pulls away from the glowsticks, and points around at the boxes. 'This is everything you need to hold a concert, everything you need to live as an idol.'
'I was bringing all of this here... so I could invite you, all of you, to an exclusive show for Penguin Logistics!'
The stage is erected from cardboard boxes, the loudspeakers and panel lighting propped high on the package shelves. Sora includes every hit single from each of her albums in the setlist, pouring her heart and soul, all her thanks, all her passion, and all her most beautiful wishes into her singing and dancing. Aside from the stage size and audience numbers, this concert's no different from the rest, nor is the support from her fans...
...Wait wait wait, what's going on?
Sora's eyes grow wide—Exusiai's using her rifle to shoot at the metal plates hung on either side, the sound bright and clear and somehow keeping perfectly in time with the music; Croissant's next to her banging her maracas on her shield; even Texas is using her sword stance to brandish her glowsticks, her expression stern and serious as ever, making the gap all the more hilarious.
Only Emperor sits aloof in this absurd scene, listening silently and intently, like he's the only one actually concentrating on being a spectator.
Sora almost hears the canned audience laughter play in her head, and she cracks up too. This concert is everyone's concert, the chorus of Penguin Logistics.

'I think that was the most unforgettable concert I've ever had.'
'Shucks, Sora, ya go and hold such a special performance just fer us, s'obvious we gotta give somethin' back somehow. Ain't that so, Baws?'
'All I can say is, not bad for bubblegum pop.'
'I think I'mma translate for him: Sora, you sing MIGHTY fine!'
'Yeah. It was amazing.'
'And don't forget, our accompaniment was spot on too!'
At first, Sora shakes her head, then nods, and keeps nodding. She grins, and with all the gratitude she has, runs straight into her circle of friends' giant group hug.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Greetings, I'm here for my shift… That's a peculiar look on your face. Do I seem so unreliable?
We don't throw ourselves into battle because we want to. We just have a stronger will to survive than most. If you understand, that alone would be enough.

Zima, the girls, and I all came from different schools. But all the students in the city knew the legends of General Zima. Doesn't that sound cool? Literally. Zima is Ursine for 'winter', you see. Hm, yes.
How did we escape from Chernobog? Hmm... you really don't want to know. Sometimes the truth is better left untold.
Oh? I'm reading a mystery novel… As a matter of fact, it taught me some lessons that proved useful in getting me through that terrible time.
My favorite books? Hmm, I enjoy topics like politics, economics, and dialectical materialism… Baking magazines and stuff like that are nice too.
Home? My hometown? Obviously, we can't go back there. You know as well as I do that there's nothing left of it. Even if we rebuilt Chernobog, I still…
Rhodes Island is safe. And there are so many books here in your office... If I could, I'd really prefer to stay here…
What will I do in the future? Hmm… No idea. My books don't have an answer for that. I hope someone will offer me one, someday…
Such a twist is beyond my imagination. 'Every last one of the passengers on this train, you're all murderers!'
I am Istina. I'm still a student, but I was recruited for my ability to use Arts… Yes, it is rather strange for a student to serve here, isn't it?
You want me to be stronger?
Do you feel like you understand me better now? Naive, you're far from really knowing me.

Now that you've offered me such recognition, I will reveal my true power. Allow me to demonstrate by reducing this office to a fine powder… Just kidding. There are too many precious books here. I would never do something so awful.
Understood.
Hmm… The team is somewhat different from what I imagined.
Let's show our determination, earnestness, and boundless passion.
May the star of victory shine upon us.
What is it, Doctor?
Go ahead.
I have a distaste for war.
It seems we must fight.
Come at me.
Please, no need to rush.
Let us take it slow.
Time to teach you a lesson.
Why do they fight... even when it may cost them their lives? What do they gain from it?
Doctor, if you have to commend us, now is the time.
Those enemies who fled... We probably won't see them again.
Neither our numbers nor our efforts were sufficient…
A secret room, where, shall we say, interesting things happen.
What?!
It's too noisy here, I'd rather read in the Doctor's office.
Arknights.

No, I, I'm not honey-drunk, Sonya just poured me a, a little, but I just felt I should convey to you, a, Happy New Year... Er, are these Sonya's flowers? For the New Year? Why is this flower, burning hot to the touch…
Hello, Doctor.

Happy birthday, Doctor. This hardcover is my gift to you—Ah, well done, you've discerned without so much as a flip that it contains not literature, but cake. No, I wasn't at all hoping to see you scoop up a handful of icing…

'The Silver Branch', 'Mathematical Theory of Originium Arts', 'Superpropositional Logic'... Hm? I'm going through the books I've read this year. Suspense fiction has its merits, but dipping into all manner of knowledge is comforting, in a sense. It lets me believe, undeniably, that I am moving forward.

handbook.profile:
Before the Chernobog incident, Istina was a middle school student. In school, she wrote many articles about Originium Arts. Her areas of expertise include: Arts, detective literature, and sociology.
In a number of tests, she has demonstrated an excellent aptitude for control-type Originium Arts. She has been approved for service in battle. She also provides intel and data processing services for Rhodes Island.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

Operator shows no signs of infection at this time.

This Operator has rarely come into contact with Originium.
archives:
Istina is cool-headed and rational, though somewhat introverted. She often absorbs herself in her hobbies: the meticulous study of more profound Originium Arts, the study of the latest social theories, observation of others and their relationships, and fashion. 
Over the course of her multiple interactions with the Ursus Student Group, Istina displayed rare communication abilities and an assured manner, and gave clear and focused answers. We are certain that Istina intends to hold proactive exchanges with Rhodes Island, and may be a positive factor in communication with the Ursus Student Self-government Group.

It is now known that the 'Ursus Student Self-government Group' was originally proposed by Istina. The group's establishment helped the Ursus students work together and get past the initial phase of isolation and mutual distrust. 
During consultation, Istina keenly answered several questions concerning Zima. Istina believes that although Zima is rude and sometimes unreasonable, she attaches great importance to her companions in the Self-Governing Group and is a competent leader. And if she could add her own input during operations, this would be even better. 
While discussing Zima, the Doctor made many pointed remarks, but Istina gave opposing opinions. Istina believes that Zima will not become a destabilizing force for Rhodes Island, and that to believe that her ambitions extend only as far as Rhodes Island would be to underestimate her.

Istina was born in Chernobog, a city in the Empire of Ursus. Her parents were both employed in local agencies. During the periodic riots by student organizations, Istina declined to participate and instead chose to read quietly. As she had no interest in the loud music and partying of her peers, she began to read some particularly interesting books coming out of Londinium, Victoria at the time. From these, she started to reevalute everything she thought she knew, and began to see everything in a new light.

With regard to her whereabouts during the Chernobog incident, Istina modestly and succinctly declined to answer, but she showed several changes of emotion in doing so. On account of Rhodes Island's current policies and the need to protect certain company secrets, investigations into the Ursus Student Self-government Group have temporarily ceased. 
In view of the background investigation into the Ursus Student Groups, there is no need to question Istina's background. Because of this, it is advisable to use psychologically founded methods to communicate with Ursus students. Future options for cooperation should be provided based on the suitability and independence of the student union members.
Note: Based on Istina's intense level of interest in the books in the Doctor's office, it is advisable to give her a degree of reading privileges.

modules.moduleDescription:
Pastry flour 180g; cystymilk 120g; icing sugar 90g; dried berries 60g; fowl yolk 22g; salt 1g
They might be the most basic cookies, but Gummy loves these.
Let cystymilk sit at room temperature, then add the icing sugar. Once evenly folded in, add the fowl yolk. Dice the dried berries finely (full chunks will be slightly sour). Sift in pastry flour, knead until smooth, then trim and cut into 4 x 4cm squares.
NB: If these are for Sonya, make bigger. Natalya likes more salt in hers. Drizzle honey for Rosalind's.
Place in freezer to rest for 1hr, then transfer straight into a preheated 170°C oven for 20min until done.
......
I see... And I thought all along the chief would turn out to be the true mastermind! Now that I look back at previous descriptions, he did plenty that he wouldn't have done otherwise. Blatantly letting the protagonist go on with the investigation, making such a solemn vow at the meeting, and him and his wife truly being in love all along, not a political marriage... He even began by committing suicide...
The author's deliberately crafted narrative tricks may have had their impact, but I did still let first impressions blind me to many unusual details.
It may be that people truly can be affected by information from all sides given specific circumstances, and end up overlooking facts that should have been obvious.
I've overlooked a lot, that much is true.
This is something I'll have to reflect on frequently in future.
......
I've borrowed several books from the Doctor throughout my time here at Rhodes Island. As a student, I've certainly been through things most others my age have not yet. It's beyond me to more deeply comprehend some conundrums posed in books with my current level of knowledge, but with my experiences, perhaps the author's intent is something I can feel out.
Pertinently, the passage on the 'mass' in Chashcha Lesa: 'Those who have done wrong once find they are not punished, for those around them who know of it will opt to turn one's blind eye to carry on living one's 'days of well-being,' so accordingly the wrongdoers will then go to do wrong a second and third time. May there merely be one willing to fix their firm eye and raise their voice, and this chaos can be dispelled.'
May there merely be one willing to fix their firm eye and raise their voice, and this chaos can be dispelled.

—Excerpts from Istina's reading notes

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Hm? You're here to pray? Sorry, I'm busy right now.
Hm? Yes, I'm the current Karlan Saintess. But everyone swamped by work deserves a little break from time to time, don't you think?
Wasting time on trivial affairs is what I call slacking off. What I'm doing right now is… taking the opportunity to recharge.
Work hard, play hard, right? Don't force all those rigid rules on me.
The Karlan Goddess? We share a good relationship, thanks to my duty as the Saintess.
I'd be happy to help you, but the life of a Karlan Saintess is a busy one. Well, I guess I'll make an exception for you this once, but please make it short.

My sis... Ensia... you people at Rhodes Island are all pretty fond of her, right? So it's not like she received any special treatment from that guy. And now... well, I think I get it now. It's fine like this. I'll just keep watching over her. It's fine.

I twisted my ankle once when I was a kid. My brother carried me on his back all night, going from house to house until someone agreed to take us in. I decided that very moment that I wanted to grow up to become someone like my brother! But now... heh, forget it.

Huh? How did you find me? I'll freeze your toes—Um? Coffee? For me? Thanks. Oh, right, Doctor, wanna hang out here with me for a while? The view is pretty nice. But let's keep it a secret, okay? A secret between just the two of us—aw, this coffee is so bitter!
It's rare to get to rest like this.
Shh, I sneaked out—oh, um, hi, HR Director! I... I'm here to lend my powers to Rhodes Island. Pramanix, Karlan Saintess, at your service. Bless you, my friend.
I hear a voice... repeating something in my head...
'You shall emerge victorious one day.' This is the pledge of Karlan, and what I'm praying for as well.
Since when did you need blessings too? Can you wait a bit? I'll get ready.
May the Holy Mt. Karlan be with us.
Follow the bells and you'll find the way.
Let me pray towards the mountains for you.
Impurities must be purged.
Be careful.
I am ready.
Let us begin.
You have my blessings.
O Spirits, hear my prayer.
Here come the bells, cold winds binding my enemies.
These powers are a gift from the Holy Mountain.
As the bells ring, the impenetrable armor shall be no more.
It was simple, thanks to the Spirits' power.
The light of Karlan was shining on us.
If only we could have won without bloodshed... just my wish...
It's not looking good... I suggest we retreat at once.
It's a really peaceful place.
Hm?
Close your eyes and I'll bring you somewhere new... Do keep your eyes closed, okay?
Arknights.

What am I doing here? You see, Doctor, Ensia's aboard Rhodes Island, and as her big sister, it's only natural for me to pay her a visit on New Year's. You won't have the heart to let Ensia spend the holiday out there alone, would you? How very cruel that would be.
You have my blessings, Doctor.
So—how does it taste? Nice and cool, isn't it? It's my own handmade frosted chocolate. Do you like it? Good, that's a relief, I really spent a lot of time studying it.

My brother's here too? Oh, no need to worry, Doctor, we all know what our business is. On this day, we're no more than operators for Rhodes Island. This place is like a little pocket, and I'm here from time to time just to relax, not for anything else.

Hm? Yes, I'm the current Karlan Saintess. But everyone swamped by work deserves a little break from time to time, don't you think?
Wasting time on trivial affairs is what I call slacking off. What I'm doing right now is… taking the opportunity to recharge.
Work hard, play hard, right? Don't force all those rigid rules on me.
The Karlan Goddess? We share a good relationship, thanks to my duty as the Saintess.
I'd be happy to help you, but the life of a Karlan Saintess is a busy one. Well, I guess I'll make an exception for you this once, but please make it short.

My sis... Ensia... you people at Rhodes Island are all pretty fond of her, right? So it's not like she received any special treatment from that guy. And now... well, I think I get it now. It's fine like this. I'll just keep watching over her. It's fine.

I twisted my ankle once when I was a kid. My brother carried me on his back all night, going from house to house until someone agreed to take us in. I decided that very moment that I wanted to grow up to become someone like my brother! But now... heh, forget it.

Huh? How did you find me? I'll freeze your toes—Um? Coffee? For me? Thanks. Oh, right, Doctor, wanna hang out here with me for a while? The view is pretty nice. But let's keep it a secret, okay? A secret between just the two of us—aw, this coffee is so bitter!
It's rare to get to rest like this.

I hear a voice... repeating something in my head...

handbook.profile: Pramanix is a Karlan Saintess born in Kjerag, the leader of the entire religion of her homeland. She uses the holy bell given to her by the gods to summon the power of wind and snow. She came to Rhodes Island by secret means, and the post she holds as well as how long she's held it are both confidential.

handbook.promotionRecord: Pramanix's bell was given to her by the gods. According to legend, its sound can summon ice and snow strong enough to extinguish flames and wrap the world in cold. In reality, it does not live up to such exaggerated stories, but it is still a much stronger weapon than most ordinary staves. It should be noted that when ringing the bell, it must be accompanied by a prayer. If the bell does not sound, then its wielder will be encased in ice. If a mistake is made in the prayer, the Arts will be cast upon the bell-wielder herself. Essentially, no one but Pramanix is capable of using the bell.
archives: The Karlan Saintess, the Enlightened One, and the Praised One...all of these titles belong to Pramanix and Pramanix alone. As the supreme leader of the entire religion of Kjerag, she has a series of special privileges. Even her older brother, nominally Kjerag's most senior official, SilverAsh, must bow to her in public. She is honored, perfect, and divine. She brings glory to Kjerag. Yet nobody knows that in her heart, she is suffering.

The ceremony for canonizing a new saint is sacred, but brutal. After the current saint passes away, girls of the appropriate age all head to the shrine where a saint is chosen. Only the girl hit by the first drop of water from the thawing ice obtains the right to be the saint. Afterward, the chosen one takes the trial bell and sets out from the shrine. They follow Heaven's Road up the mountain to the Residence of the Gods. Once they hang the trial bell upon its hook there, the trial is over. En route, it is customary for the girl to nod her head every three steps and ring the bell every five. Those who break this custom lose their chance to become saints. The new saint is born from the thawing snow on the second day. Because Heaven's Road is long and winding, the trial is very severe. Some give up immediately. Others collapse on the side of the road. Only those who have a solid constitution, strength, piety, and the protection of the gods will have the chance to become the saint.

Aside from the elders of the Vine-Bead Court, Pramanix also has to deal with the everyday affairs of the clergy: visiting statesmen, conducting all manner of religious ceremonies, and deciphering countless scriptures. There are so many tasks that she is sometimes overwhelmed with pressure, to the point of being unable to breathe. Because of this, she has to come up with clever methods to relax. It is then that she unloads her burden and reveals her true nature.

If she hadn't become saint, Pramanix might still be at the old Silverash residence, fiddling with her favorite silks, drinking tea, or reading books into the afternoon. However, her brother made a difficult decision, and they reached a compromise. The two have since broken off contact with one another. Even their blood relation cannot make up for the disappointment Pramanix feels toward SilverAsh. Apart from polite greetings in public, the two haven't had a conversation since.

modules.moduleDescription:
A fireplace tirelessly burns away in a meditation room lit by crepuscular rays. Generations of Kjerag Saintesses sat here deep in thought upon deciphering their ancient scriptures, digesting the ideas and their meaning to the people of the Snow Realm.
'Enya. Enya!'
Enya awakens from her slumber, wipes her mouth, and touches her warm cheeks heated by the fireplace. She flashes an embarrassed smile.
'Sorry, Kjarr...'
'Enciodes, Head of Clan Silverash, was just here.'
'Now? To see me?'
'No. He had only a few words of blessing for the Saintess and asked me to deliver this to you.'
Enya takes a small, delicate bell with intricate engravings from the maid. She lifts the thing and gently shakes it, filling the room with a pleasant and melodious ringing.
'He called it a gift for the Saintess, a product of the factories now operating in Silverash territory. There are many more such bells, hanging in the fields down below.'
Enya fixes her gaze on the gift. She fully understands Enciodes's meaning. When she was a child, he joined her in making bells from the scrap iron discarded by their father's factories. They hung the bells together with Ensia in the vast fields, waiting for the wind to ring them.
'Would you kindly stow it for me? Along with the other gifts from before.'
She hesitates for a moment before stopping the maid.
'I recall something in the bottom cabinet at my bedside. Do please bring it to me. Thank you.'
The maid returns with a half-finished scarf, clearly made for a man. The soft threads intertwine, the fabric thick, the needlework flawless. What is done can be described as no less than perfect.
'This must be...'
'I began making this for Enciodes when he was away in Victoria. I intended to finish it and gift it to him when he returned. For various reasons, it has remained incomplete.'
'You've kept it with you all these years... You still hold a glimmer of hope for him?'
'Kjarr, over the course of my life as the Saintess, I've read all the scriptures in the sanctuary. The texts document a thousand years of Kjerag history. And yet, there is one question the scriptures do not appear to answer.'
'And what is that?'
'How to knit.'
Enya falls into silence. She recalls a time, long ago, when her father sat by the window, knitting scarves for his children. Sunlight bathed his face. Her brother was practicing his swordsmanship outside, and her sister was perusing a book of mountain landscape paintings. She quietly watched by her father's side, one needle at a time, committing it all to the deepest part of her memory. This is how she learned to knit.
The texts contain plenty of knowledge, but there are some questions they will never answer. Or perhaps she already knew the answer to her knitting question, her family questions, her questions about the future.
'Tomorrow is the Tri-Clan Council, yes?'
'Indeed. The other two clans are likely to unite against Clan Silverash. I do wonder how Enciodes will respond.'
'No matter how he does, in the end, the matter will no doubt fall to me.'
'Are you so certain?'
'He is a Silverash, as am I.'
Enya punctuates her statement by standing up, startling her maid. She uses all her strength to throw open the heavy curtains. For the first time in a thousand years, sunlight floods the dim room.
She stands in the light, needles dancing between her fingers. The new thread merges with that already woven. She continues her needlework, not for any man in particular, but for the future the scarf represents.
'The children of Clan Silverash each walk their own paths.'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Uh... Doctor, you really need to work out more, you know.
Everyone's really nice here at Rhodes Island. Too nice to prank. Oh, is it time for lunch? I'll help!
Mountaineering's not just a hobby of mine, it's my career! You heard me: career!
The hoop on my leg? Oh, you mean what it's for? It's just for decoration. I've got this crystal over here, see. Wanna touch?
My brother sent Matterhorn to look after me, didn't he…? Ugh, why can't he just come out and tell me what he's thinking? It drives me mad.

I've always wanted to climb the holy Mt. Karlan, and I've only wanted it even more since my sister left us and became the Saintess. So Doctor, train me more, yeah? So one day I can reach the peak of Mt. Karlan and bring my sister home.
When it comes to Mountaineering, I won't lose to anyone! No one knows these tools better than me. They make great weapons too!

Yeah, Oripathy really changed me. But if I keep wallowing in self-pity, that wouldn't be like me, right? So, no matter what lies in wait in the future... I should continue working hard on my chosen path.
Ah, it's snowing... We Silverashes can't go back to the way we were... I get that. Everything's changed. Only the snow is the same—the same snowflakes that I watched falling back home.
Doctoooor? Doctooooor! Heeeey! Fine, if you're just gonna sleep, then so be it. Bye-bye!
I'm Cliffheart, and I live to conquer the peaks! It's nice to meet you!
Hmm... what a novel experience!
Promotion? Wow! Let's celebrate with some cake. Look, I grabbed these from Logistics. It's fine!
Well, well, you really know what you're doing, Doctor! That's right, I'm really talented. You'd better use my power well!
All right? I'm feeling motivated! Time to climb all the way to the top!
Eh? You want me to lead? This is all so sudden...
Say goodbye to the reckless Cliffheart. I'm taking things seriously from here on out.
I'll show them what I can do!
Here!
Over here?
Leave it to me!
I'm raring to go!
I'veeee got yoooou!
My hook never misses! I've got this!
Amateurs are doomed to fall to their death!
For the Silverash name!
There ain't no mountain too high, no situation too bleak!
Of course we won with me around!
Wow, they sure are good at running away!
Dangit... I messed up...
It's so warm here... I'll hang out over here for a while!
W-wait! Whuah!
I'm gonna teach you all about Mountaineering next time, Doctor! You'll love it, I promise!
Arknights.

Happy New Year! Look, Doctor, I've prepared all this Mountaineering gear for you. Let's go! Huh? It's still midnight, you say? It's fine! We need to set off earlier so that we can catch the sunrise at the peak.
Mornin', Doctor!

Doctor, happy birthday! Speaking of which, lemme have a look at what my brother gave you! Aww... he's still into this pricey boring ornament stuff. Zero times as practical as my present. Anyway, check this out, Doctor! A choice set of climbing equipment, just for you. Once the weather's good, let's go scale some mountains!

My brother and sister are still butting heads, but their relationship's smoothed out a bunch, I can feel it. Gotta thank you for melting the ice between them, Doctor. But still, I really wish hanging around home was as chill as being at Rhodes Island…

Mornin', Doctor!

Doctor, happy birthday! Speaking of which, lemme have a look at what my brother gave you! Aww... he's still into this pricey boring ornament stuff. Zero times as practical as my present. Anyway, check this out, Doctor! A choice set of climbing equipment, just for you. Once the weather's good, let's go scale some mountains!

My brother and sister are still butting heads, but their relationship's smoothed out a bunch, I can feel it. Gotta thank you for melting the ice between them, Doctor. But still, I really wish hanging around home was as chill as being at Rhodes Island…

EN.voiceText: Uh... Doctor, you really need to work out more, you know.
Everyone's really nice here at Rhodes Island. Too nice to prank. Oh, is it time for lunch? I'll help!
Mountaineering's not just a hobby of mine, it's my career! You heard me: career!
The hoop on my leg? Oh, you mean what it's for? It's just for decoration. I've got this crystal over here, see. Wanna touch?
My brother sent Matterhorn to look after me, didn't he…? Ugh, why can't he just come out and tell me what he's thinking? It drives me mad.

I've always wanted to climb the holy Mt. Karlan, and I've only wanted it even more since my sister left us and became the Saintess. So Doctor, train me more, yeah? So one day I can reach the peak of Mt. Karlan and bring my sister home.
When it comes to Mountaineering, I won't lose to anyone! No one knows these tools better than me. They make great weapons too!

Yeah, Oripathy really changed me. But if I keep wallowing in self-pity, that wouldn't be like me, right? So, no matter what lies in wait in the future... I should continue working hard on my chosen path.
Ah, it's snowing... We Silverashes can't go back to the way we were... I get that. Everything's changed. Only the snow is the same—the same snowflakes that I watched falling back home.
Doctoooor? Doctooooor! Heeeey! Fine, if you're just gonna sleep, then so be it. Bye-bye!
I'm Cliffheart, and I live to conquer the peaks! It's nice to meet you!
Hmm... what a novel experience!
Promotion? Wow! Let's celebrate with some cake. Look, I grabbed these from Logistics. It's fine!
Well, well, you really know what you're doing, Doctor! That's right, I'm really talented. You'd better use my power well!
All right? I'm feeling motivated! Time to climb all the way to the top!
Eh? You want me to lead? This is all so sudden...
Say goodbye to the reckless Cliffheart. I'm taking things seriously from here on out.
I'll show them what I can do!
Here!
Over here?
Leave it to me!
I'm raring to go!
I'veeee got yoooou!
My hook never misses! I've got this!
Amateurs are doomed to fall to their death!
For the Silverash name!
There ain't no mountain too high, no situation too bleak!
Of course we won with me around!
Wow, they sure are good at running away!
Dangit... I messed up...
It's so warm here... I'll hang out over here for a while!
W-wait! Whuah!
I'm gonna teach you all about Mountaineering next time, Doctor! You'll love it, I promise!

handbook.profile: Cliffheart is a Rhodes Island Operator who was born in Kjerag. She is a specialist in rock and mountain climbing and is proficient with all kinds of climbing tools. Currently she is undergoing treatment for Oripathy at Rhodes Island.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7%
Due to puncturing by an Originium stone, Operator exhibits visible Originium crystals at the puncture site.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.28u/L
Course of infection is transitioning to the middle-term but has not yet had a significant impact upon the infected.
handbook.promotionRecord: Cliffheart seems to always instill feelings of cheer and optimism in those she meets, though her soul burns with the desire to inflict mischief. If you bite into a piece of cake only to find it full of beans, or your employee card has gone missing, there's a high probability that Cliffheart is responsible. If not, then she'll likely find out who is. Making mischief and exposing other mischief makers are two of her favorite pastimes.
archives: Cliffheart is a natural explorer and climber. Her reflexes and endurance far exceed what normal people could think possible. With even the simplest of items, Cliffheart is capable of traversing obstacles that would stop most people in their tracks. Cliffheart is more comfortable using her climbing instruments than a traditional melee weapon. Even on the battlefield, she uses these tools as weapons. Don't question the power of her snow spade or ice pick - in the hands of the right person, even instruments such as these can be lethal.

While attempting to climb the holy mountain, Cliffheart was pierced by an Originium stone during an unexpected landslide and thus became Infected. Fortunately, most of the people of Kjerag hold no prejudice against the Infected, and Cliffheart still managed to lead a normal life. Still, in order to make the Originium crystals on her body not appear so conspicuous, she takes clever steps to hide it. Thus, even outside Kjerag, she is free to move as she pleases.

As a member of the Silverash Family, she garners a lot of attention despite not appearing as elite as her older brother and sister. Unlike her siblings, she is not bound by any official position and thus is free to speak. Therefore, she often mingles with the common people, listening to their stories, learning about their lives, and studying their skills. She then uses these things she's learned to contribute to her clan.

Whatever peace the Silverash Family had came to an end when Pramanix was anointed saint. SilverAsh could no longer interacted with Cliffheart in the open, and Pramanix couldn't communicate with either of them because of her newfound official position. This made Cliffheart furious, but she understood that there was no way for the three of them to be as they once were. There was nothing she could do to fix the situation, and this feeling of helplessness made her disheartened for the first time in her life. Still, if there were anything she could do to reunite with her brother and sister, she'd gladly do what it takes.

modules.moduleDescription:
What does 'peak' mean to a climber?
A sort of height? Physically, mentally, in all sorts of senses... you conquer this height, you touch the sky, you prove your own worth.
That seems to be exactly it, yet it's not that simple.
At least, to Miss Ensia, it's not that simple.
While in Kjerag, mountain-climbing to her was less about conquering something and more about connecting something. At the foot is her brother, Sir Enciodes, and the whole Silverash family, and atop the mountain is her sister, the Saintess of all Kjerag.
She's already scaled Karlan before, and whether to conquer or connect, she's succeeded.
But we've received word today that Miss Ensia has taken gold in a Bolívarian mountaineering event.
An honor she's put her life on the line for, with dangers beyond anyone's imagination.
The hosts' climate monitoring systems had malfunctioned, and the competitors were faced midway with a snowstorm and a series of ice cracks out of nowhere. With the vast majority having no way forward, the hosts announced the event was suspended, and organized a squad to rescue any competitors who hadn't yet returned to base camp. On top of that, Miss Ensia had lost her communications gear, insulated tent, and part of her food supply while escaping danger. In these extreme circumstances, every second longer out there was a matter of life or death, but she'd already overcome the most difficult, perilous ice ridge known to Terra, and the summit was calling. So, should she retreat, or should she turn around and continue up?
......
After Miss Ensia came to, the first thing she reportedly said to the medical personnel was this: 'The sight from the summit was amazing!'
The hosts proclaimed the event still valid, and gave the trophy to Miss Ensia, as the one and only award-winner.
The distant peaks beyond Kjerag have none of Kjeragandr's divine protection. Miss Ensia was no more than a competitor from strange parts. She succeeded in planting her flag at the very top, all just for a view of the unknown.
......
To end today's special program, we leave you with a quote from the hosts' speech when they gave the award:
'She is a true climber.'
—Special report made on-the-spot by the network after news of Cliffheart winning a Bolívarian mountaineering event made its way back to Kjerag. Above extracts are taken from body of report.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: I'm keeping an eye on our surroundings. So far everything seems fine.
You should know that some of those eyes on you hold nothing but malice. You're not safe, not even at Rhodes Island.
Don't be afraid of those hostiles hiding in the shadow. No matter how those criminals try to hide, they can't escape my eyes.
I'll have my revenge... even if I must lose my life for it.
My clan, my friends, they all perished in the woods of our hometown... The only ones who mourned them were the trees, which gave unto them their leaves.
This crossbow is manufactured for the sole purpose of punishing sinners. The day will come when I use it to pass my final judgement on those who deserve it.
Meteorite... we used to be friends. On the day my hometown was destroyed, we were part of the small group that managed to escape.
Since then, I've never stopped searching for the traitor who led the rebel army to our town. Could it be Meteorite? No, I... It couldn't be her...
...Oh, did I fall asleep? Sorry, I've been spending more time patrolling these days... It's fine, you say? But... um, thank you for caring.
I'd like to take a nap...
Firewatch here. I'm a sniper. To avenge my fallen clan, I need all the power I can get.
I need more power...
Thanks for appointing me to this position.
Thank you for the promotion. I hope you'll keep using my powers for the right thing. If you don't, however...
The team is complete.
Got it.
All Operators, get ready!
Enemies spotted. Taking action.
Understood.
Awaiting instructions.
Searching for enemies.
I am in position.
Laying suppressive fire.
Target locked.
Strike inbound.
Firing!
I'm not done until I have my revenge...
All targets eliminated. Mission complete.
Mission accomplished, request search for remaining hostiles.
Retreating... immediately...
I'm not used to being in a room with so many people...
Huh!?
Uh, please don't touch my antlers... it tickles...
Arknights.

New Year's? It's noisy, but I remember days like this back in the forest. We used to sing around the campfire, give each other bracelets weaved from vines... Do you want to hear the songs of my homeland? I've never forgotten them.
Huh? Oh, it's you, Doctor.
You want to hear my harmonica? Fine. What are you in the mood for?… Calm and leisurely… Alright, here's a little tune called 'Greenleaves.'
Today will be noisy. I think I'll find a quiet place to hide. Have fun with Meteorite and the others.
