CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: *Yaaawn*... Doctor, could I take a quick break?
Don't worry about my bow. I keep it well maintained. It's much tougher than you, so stop asking about it already.
There are so many interesting people at Rhodes Island. Would be nice if I could make a friend or two to travel with.
Nowadays, the Knights of Kazimierz are little more than a bunch of musclehead jocks, or clowns obsessed with billboards and firework shows. Man, it's so lame.
I was planning to return home after finishing this job, but now I've changed my mind. Why, you ask? You should know better than to ask a girl a question like that.

Want to know the origin of my codename? You see, there are different ranks for the Knight Assassins in Kazimierz. There's three Darksteel and two Lazurite assassins above me, but I and I alone bear the rank of Platinum, from now till the day I die. So I figured it'd make a good codename.
Ah, it's Miss Nearl! No, no, I wasn't going to lay a hand on her. I'm just worried she's going to charge at me with her hammer.
Kazimierz is... a boring place. *Sigh*, I'm almost mad at how much more amusing life here at Rhodes Island is.

Have you thought about how you're going to maintain your relations with everyone here at Rhodes Island? You know, all suits of armor have small gaps which leave you vulnerable, and that's where the enemies always try to jam their blades. One hit to your weak point can bring down everything you've painstakingly built.
I'm so bored. Hoping something amusing happens.
Assassin of the Armorless Union of Kazimierz here as per our agreement. What am I called? Hmm... Call me Platinum, then. Nice to meet you.
Good. My bow feels even lighter. Thank you.
Promotion? Isn't the rank of Platinum already intimidating enough? Oh, you are an interesting one.
Hah. Do you have the guts to gaze upon the true face of the one called Platinum, my dear Doctor?
Platinum, reporting for duty.
Really? I'm commanding? It's not my strongest suit, but all right.
Will this battle be an interesting one?
You may as well attack at the same time. You're all too weak anyway.
Your orders?
Who's my target?
I'll make them disappear.
Moving to intercept.
First, break their legs.
Second, break their armor.
And third, pierce their flesh.
Now, it's checkmate!
Nice. I had quite an enjoyable time.
Checkmate. I'm sorry, but victory is mine.
What a pity that we left some alive.
Don't give up... He who laughs last laughs best.
The atmosphere here is surprisingly good.
Huh?!
Want to go on a walk? If you're busy, there's always next time.
Arknights.

Huh? Wasn't expecting to run into you here. Me? I'm just feeling the breeze. It's too noisy down there, and too many people. I want to be alone. Hm. Still sticking yourself here like a little dope after you've learned my answer? Could it be... You want to stay with me a bit longer? Ugh—whatever, this place is boring. How about we just ditch in secret?
You look well, Doctor.

A kind little reminder from me. Those tickets I gave you WILL expire. Don't make me tie you up and drag you there, okay? ...Day after tomorrow? Alright, it's a deal then. No backsies. What, why am I smiling? Is this your first time going to an amusement park with someone? That's cute. Interpret it however you like, little dummy.

Missions: boring, enemies: boring, but it's still way better than Kazimierz no matter how you slice it. Just getting further and further away from there feels great. The wind from Kazimierz will never again blow my arrows off its mark, and I never want to breathe its air ever again.

Want to go on a walk? If you're busy, there's always next time.
Arknights.

Huh? Wasn't expecting to run into you here. Me? I'm just feeling the breeze. It's too noisy down there, and too many people. I want to be alone. Hm. Still sticking yourself here like a little dope after you've learned my answer? Could it be... You want to stay with me a bit longer? Ugh—whatever, this place is boring. How about we just ditch in secret?
You look well, Doctor.

A kind little reminder from me. Those tickets I gave you WILL expire. Don't make me tie you up and drag you there, okay? ...Day after tomorrow? Alright, it's a deal then. No backsies. What, why am I smiling? Is this your first time going to an amusement park with someone? That's cute. Interpret it however you like, little dummy.

Missions: boring, enemies: boring, but it's still way better than Kazimierz no matter how you slice it. Just getting further and further away from there feels great. The wind from Kazimierz will never again blow my arrows off its mark, and I never want to breathe its air ever again.

Platinum was previously an assassin for the Kazimierz Armorless Union. The rest of her background is unknown. She has demonstrated considerable talent and special tactical accomplishments in high-mobility operations, clearance, and urban warfare.
Under the leadership of Dr. Kal'tsit, she is a Sniper Operator for Rhodes Island.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

Operator shows no signs of infection at this time.

This Operator has rarely come into contact with Originium. 

Physical indicators have all tested at normal levels. After the conclusion of the examination process, I have taken over this Operator's relevant investigation and data files.
- Kal'tsit
handbook.promotionRecord:
Currently, all of the intelligence Rhodes Island has regarding the Kazimierz Armorless Union comes from Platinum herself and should not be regarded as the full truth. 
At the same time, when conducting secret missions into the large cities of Kazimierz, attention must be paid to the next steps the Armorless Union takes. Rhodes Island should be vigilant of other groups of unknown alignment operating in the shadows.
archives:
The only information that has been confirmed about Platinum is her hometown in Kazimierz. All other information that Platinum shares must be taken with a grain of salt, including medical data like chest size and weight. Platinum prefers to falsify this data (often through threats and blackmail) as she believes 
'A girl should be allowed to have her secrets!'
Therefore, most of the information in Platinum's file has no value. 
Of course, core records and non-public materials are still subject to close scrutiny.

The Knight-Assassins are a secret military force cultivated by the various forces of Kazimierz during political struggles with rogue knights. 
The story goes that in order to counter the rogue knights who were well versed in combat, the Knight Assassins utilized special assassination and guerrilla combat techniques. Consequently, they launched a relentless campaign of destruction against the rogue knights that refused to cooperate with the reigning government. 
Although it is impossible to verify the authenticity of these rumors, Platinum does exhibit some of the skills that could have been used to fight the Kazimierz knights. Both in aspects that can't be measured as well as her measurable if incredible bow skills, under special circumstances, Platinum poses a huge threat to armored targets. 
In light of these findings, investigations into Platinum must continue.

In the end, Platinum chose to join the team directly led by Dr. Kal'tsit in order to develop her own strengths and to prove that her relationship with Rhodes Island was genuine. This is an acceptable result for Rhodes Island. 
Aside from teasing other Operators, shirking her daily chores, and other minor rule violations, Platinum has proven that she has the essence of an outstanding Operator. 
Even so, Platinum needs to make sure she applies for 'read permission' from management and not steal glances during the data compilation process.
I hope Dr. Kal'tsit will consider putting an end to some of her more outrageous behaviors. Thank you.

[Classified Log] 
Even though Platinum currently follows my instructions and orders, she seems to care little for Rhodes Island itself. Even from the perspective of the employment relationship, Rhodes Island's pay may not be able to satisfy her. As such, it is critical we seriously consider whether Platinum will remain loyal. 
Of course, according to my personal observations, the relationship between Platinum and Rhodes Island is mostly derived from her trust in the Doctor. 
In other words, as long as Platinum's relationship with the Doctor is strong enough, she will continue to hold considerable value for Rhodes Island. 
There are multiple ways we can go about removing the variable factors in this situation. Strengthening our relationship to dispel excessive notions of independence ought to be feasible. 
- Kal'tsit

modules.moduleDescription:
Off went Platinum to Sami for her vacation.
She'd invited the Doctor too, but just as she didn't hope for a raise to her pitifully low Rhodes Island salary anytime soon, she didn't truly expect the Doctor, buried somewhere under that mountain of paperwork, to tag along with her.
Still, she got herself two months of vacation. So that was great.
After setting foot on Sami soil, a Columbian graciously led her to her villa. Snow was falling on the plains, and across it quietly traveled a procession of people, the one at the head bearing flowers plucked from who-knows-where. They all silently followed him, walking towards the lakeside.
Amongst them, a child slipped and fell to the ground, and Platinum helped them back up, petals falling into her palms as she did. Her mind flicked back to the past, when she was still an independent knight. To fans flocking to give her flowers—beautiful ones, fragrant ones, ones that seemed like they'd last forever. The flower-bearing procession was now some distance away when she had the sudden urge to see who they were giving them to.
Looming by the lakeside was a deep white altar, all around which they laid the flowers.
'They're honoring the memory of a deceased hero. The one leading 'em's a descendant. It's a custom of their tribe,' explained Platinum's Columbian hire.
They cast the flowers into the lake and began to dance, singing a nameless song whose melody was deep and somber, and they beat a flame alight. Some wept, while others spoke silently mouthed words, pure and reverent light flickering in their eyes.
Platinum and the Columbian watched from afar as they shared food around the bonfire, before they drew she herself in. Language failed to connect them, but mood did not, and there she tried a cup of local wine, and was given a red flower by an elderly woman.
'Too noisy...' she thought. Soon after, the child who'd fallen over pulled her by the hand and merrily spun around, running as he did for the bonfire before bringing more food back.
She accepted his kindness, and watched the people before her.
The tribe raised the hero. The hero fought Ursus all his life, then died on the border. Countless descendants had come in his memory to tell her, a simple stranger, his story. The story of an escaped assassin, of what was hidden inside a meat pie cut open and swallowed by knife and fork, of a soft napkin wiping non-existent bloodstains and crumbs.
The lakeside was a distance from the plains, and the Columbian still stood wrapped in a blanket far away, illuminated by the villas' twinkling lights, waiting for Platinum to give the word to lead the way. Platinum stood by the bonfire, simply watching the people, never saying a word.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Greetings, Doctor. You're glowing today. To see you so well... it's all I could ever hope for.
I prepared an antidote to nullify the effects of any common poison. I'd like you to take one dose before every battle. Do you mind?
Actually, the toxin in my body is an ingredient in some high-quality medicines. That's why Dr. Kal'tsit needs me in her lab a lot.
Hmm, why do you keep staring at me... You mean, it's because my eye color is special? Is that a compliment, Doctor?
I'm the one our enemies fear the most. After all, who wouldn't want to kill me before I can torture them to death with my poison? What really worries me is that my teammates might think the same…
Why am I staring at this cake? Actually... I baked it to share with everyone, but no one wanted it... Would you like to try it, Doctor?
Doctor, you're always wearing the same outfit. How about I choose some new clothes for you? I think I have pretty good taste. Oh... it's a uniform? So you can't change it? Okay…
I'm 'toxic'... so people prefer to stay away from me. But now I have you by my side, Doctor, and I'm really, really happy.

My body isn't that different from everyone else. I may be 'toxic,' but nothing bad will happen if someone touches me. Doctor, if you can prove this to everyone, then maybe they won't always keep away from me. Could you... hold my hand out there?
Doctor? Oh, already asleep. Gotta find a blanket to keep the Doctor warm...
Nice to meet you, I'm Blue Poison. I'm sure Dr. Kal'tsit must have told you about me. In that case, it'll be up to you to decide how to use my 'toxic' powers.
I think I hear the sound of toxic liquid boiling, like music to my ears.
Thank you so much... I'm so glad I get to help out in all these battles. It's like a dream come true.

I used to hold back and hide my 'toxic' self, but now I've accepted what I am, trying to move forward to change my fate. I have you to thank for helping me make this shift, Doctor. You have my sincerest gratitude.
Great. I'm good at supporting assaults.
I'd be much better off supporting the others. Wouldn't want my poison to harm you, Doctor...
Everyone, there's no need for you all to stand so far from me...
I prepared a 'gift' for you. Like it?
Awaiting your orders.
Please don't be scared of me.
Don't worry, my poison is not contagious.
My toxicant is ready.
My toxins will slowly burn your life away...
Are you hallucinating?
Honey to me, poison to you.
Poison kiss.
Use poison to fight the evils and crimes... Isn't that ironic to you?
I've got a poison to melt away all these remains in an instant. Want me to show you?
Good, finished before my clothes got dirty.
How ridiculous. Feels like I killed myself with my own poison...
Resting when you're tired helps you focus on your work.
Huh?
D-Did you just touch me? C-Can you do that again? Please?
Arknights.

Well there, Doctor, Happy New Year. Although, given what day it is, won't you take your uniform off? I was assuming you'd put on something new, but maybe you just don't pay much attention to your appearence.  It's a little frustrating—I have no idea what would be a good gift for you.
Hello, Doctor.

Doctor, happy birthday. A dessert from me—please, take it. And if it's okay, I'd like you to give it a taste right now. What is it? Everyone's watching? I don't see the problem. You're a regular whenever I make snacks, aren't you?

I am a 'toxic' person, but I still have a place of my own here... It makes me so happy. The operators might still be slightly scared of me, but that's it. They don't reject me that much. Just give it enough time, and the relationships between us will be fine, won't they?

Now a sniper with Rhodes Island, she regularly contributes her expertise in toxicology research.

archives:
Although her personality is quite lovely, Blue Poison's abilities are in fact as terrifying as the rumors say, which has undoubtedly become a hindrance for her when communicating with other operators. But when she finishes her combat work and quietly undertakes the medical task of curing poison, the sincere, peaceful girl behind her deadly abilities shows through. 
The small crossbow she uses has proven to be a powerful long-range weapon, and the tips coated with her toxic serum make a hit even more lethal. Still, Blue Poison never lets an enemy die in agony, deeming that far too cruel.

According to Blue Poison's personal account, she realized the truth behind 'poison' when she was little, i.e., any creature, living or not, has weaknesses that can be magnified and exploited to a fatal end. 
The toxin produced by her venomous abilities is monitored and sampled daily by Dr. Kal'tsit personally. Blue Poison feels better about Rhodes Island's diversity, and the group's open-mindedness to her abilities such that she can use them to her full potential. 
She is more defensive on the issue of describing herself as 'toxic.' The question was if would she accept her poisonous nature if the other operators accepted her and no longer kept their distance? Blue Poison didn't give a straight answer, politely deflecting the question as usual. 
Does she still hate her powers? Or has she accepted them while still feeling about her relationship with other people? It's something only the Doctor can figure out with Blue Poison.

What is certain is that Blue Poison's toxic reputation has grown due to her unique combat techniques, which will no doubt impact her daily life. 
As for her so-called 'poison' power, the Medic Operators have never revealed any of their test results publicly. But it has been determined that normal physical contact with her will not contract the poison. In fact, her 'poison power' manifests mostly in her skill with and knowledge of poison. 
In her spare time, Blue Poison is interested in much more mundane variety things, such as baking. Operator Gummy, currently assigned to kitchen duty in Logistics, has claimed that Blue Poison's desserts are so good, they could 'convert someone who hates sweets!' Another unnamed Operator who has also tasted her treats echoed the sentiment that Blue Poison is proficient enough to start a bakery--if she made better choices in visual presentation. 
Aside from dessert making, Blue Poison has a keen sense of and passion for fashion, having already made several suggestions about her costume to Logistics and Trade.

According to a report leaked from certain secret sources, Blue Poison has been spotted in several battles against gigantic creatures. There are no images or any concrete evidence to corroborate these accounts, however. 
Blue Poison has indicated no signs of involvement in such battles, nor has she mentioned them. 
[CLASSIFIED] 
According to eyewitness accounts, Operator Blue Poison greeted Operator Specter by name when she saw her for the first time. But since Blue Poison is polite to every operator, it was dismissed as insignificant. All similar reports must be scrutinized to avoid unwanted speculations about specific operators.

modules.moduleDescription:
The dessert craze at the Rhodes Island cafeteria has gone on for close to a week now. These past few days, dinner hours have ended with numerous operators unwilling to leave, sitting at already cleared-out tables looking around in anticipation of that day's confections.
An operator who wishes to remain unnamed (and is not a Lateran) confesses to us: 'I didn't believe them at first, when they said off-menu desserts kept showing up in the canteen recently. Then last night, my very idea of desserts got completely upended.'
We only half-believed it ourselves when we squeezed into the dessert section and pulled out what looked like an extremely ordinary 'lemon' from amidst the cakes. Not normally eaten whole, we cut the fruit open and got the familiar lemony scent, and even saw its glistening juices flow out from the cut. However, once we tasted the tart-yet-sweet, faintly milk-flavored layers of cake that made up the 'pulp' inside, like the other operators we were blown away by the chef's ingenuity and maestro-level craft.
We attempted to interview the few operators that typically make their way in and out of the cafeteria kitchen, but all of them smiled and refused to answer our questions. In the end, with Operator Ceobe serving as an avenue for our breakthrough, we finally obtained enough leads to discover the maker... no, the artist of these desserts.
We found the operator in question at the Medical Department. She was busy at the time, and could not spare us an interview.
As Operator Honeyberry (who just so happened to be free) informed us, the chef has recently been busy assisting Medical with developing pharmaceuticals more appealing to children.
A significant number of child patients are aboard Rhodes Island, and the question of how to improve their compliance in taking medication has always vexed our medics. Many children instinctively make a show of resistance when faced with liquid or tablet doses that they hate the taste of. The vast majority of Medic operators can imagine that the simple addition of sugar wouldn't rid a drug of its strange flavor.
As of now, though, Medical has developed several successful formulations with this operator's help. Making use of her precise grasp on flavor and color, she's not only been able to conceal the uniquely offputting taste of these drugs, but has taken full advantage of the opportunity, using these medical flavors as a base to create aromas that make your mouth water. Following strict safety tests, these preparations have been provided to the children to immediately fantastic results. According to the little patients, taking medicine on time has suddenly become something to look forward to.
(Underneath this news article is written in small font: She didn't want us to publish this draft out of shyness, and used more desserts to bribe us to that end... I mean, we couldn't not listen to her!)

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Good day. Please allow me a moment of prayer... before I resume my work for the day...
O benevolent Herald, hear my prayer: please watch over my dreams and ward my soul…
Hehehe… Cutting things... cutting things is such fun... Yes, some things were disconnected from the very beginning, their integrity only a false fiction...
Ehehehe... Hahahah... AHHAHAHAHAH!
Ehehe…Why were you dodging my sight? So pointless... because I already know exactly what your heart desires...
I have always, always wanted to bring you to a special place... A place where secrets are imparted...
What did you do to me...? Why was I made to drink that strange medicine? Who brought me to this place? PLEASE ANSWER ME!
That person's words are the complete and utter truth... Dissecting them, dismembering them, disemboweling them... it all grants them salvation...!
You see many things in your dreams that are hard to comprehend?... Those things you see are that soul's despairful tidings... And I, as the messenger, here to convey this exhortation to you... heh…
Hearken... Hear the whispers of vast creation's master, echoing from the deep...
I am Specter, that is what the spirits call me... That kind doctor informed me that I may receive further treatment by helping Rhodes Island... Yes, of course, my powers are yours to command.
Power... is flowing into me...
I have no right to go against your will...
Will this position be a new source of joy for me...? Or... will working for you become my life's joy...?
Good night, my brothers and sisters.
As you wish.
This will be a path paved with sacrifice.
All these lost souls on the battlefield... I offer them to you.
Humbly awaiting your command.
Please let me know the results.
I come from the depth of the ocean…
You are the one who woke me.
Grant joy unto me!
Return to the abyss!
I care not for valueless ones.
There's no escape.
I have conquered all trials you gave me... Were you watching me?
Please guide these lost souls to peaceful enlightenment...!
None of you shall leave this place!
They shall pay for this... They must pay…
May I ask you to assign me to a room where I can see the starry sky?
Heheh...
Doctor... What is it inside you… that is driving me to this blissful ecstasy?
Arknights.

Another year has passed? Ahh, how long my years were spent in the sea, so long I cannot even remember how I last spent them... Never we mind. Tell me, Doctor, would you like to be with me by the windowsill today, to watch the stars?
You are... Ah, the Doctor, isn't it?

How did I spend birthdays before now? Heheh. I don't remember too clearly... While I'm still lucid, Doctor, take this. An illuminous pearl, to be a valuable speck of light to you in the dark of night, there among illusory visions…

Heheheh. I may have seen some vision or other... You should be careful, Doctor. On the route you've chosen, disaster is unavoidable, and it is far more, and far closer, than you ever bargained for. And I—will live in the true field of battle…

handbook.profile:
Specter, true identity unknown, records missing. Demonstrated extraordinary ability in combating large creatures and destroying sturdy targets, speculated to correlate with extensive prior combat experience. 
Now stationed as a Guard at Rhodes Island.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value:
No Originium crystals are visible on the surface of body, but confirmed Infected by medical examination.
More clinical research is required to fully diagnose Specter's Infection status.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests done on Specter showed a blurry outline around her internal organs, with visible abnormal dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating signs of Infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 14% 
While Specter has no visible Originium crystals on the surface of her body, her nervous system has suffered a case of severe Infection, the cause behind which remains unknown. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.31u/L 
Still within manageable range. Even then, without knowing the specific cause for her Infection, test data cannot accurately reflect her condition and are of little use. 

In addition, Specter is plagued by severe mental health issues, including but not limited to: memory loss, emotional instability, and lack of self-awareness. Unfortunately, I am not a neurologist nor a psychiatrist and thus unqualified to speculate on the cause or solution, but I wish to make note of her mental condition in her file. 
—Medic Operator Silence
handbook.promotionRecord:
Folksong of a Faraway Land: 
When she prayed 
The stars ceased to shimmer 
And when she wept 
The night let out a smile 
And as she lamented 
The anguish sprawled upon her madness 

—From Operator Specter's personal belongings
archives:
It was difficult probing into Specter's past. When Rhodes Island took her in, she showed temporary lucidity until she lapsed into psychosis before treatment could be administered. 
In her day-to-day life, Specter's mental condition remains unstable, thus greatly limiting her social interactions with other Operators. 
Medical staff will continue administering regular tests and treatment, although success has been limited to date.

Based on intel gathered, Specter was once a nun residing at a convent. The matter was not investigated further due to her current mental state and Rhodes Island's present goals. 
However, Dr. Kal'tsit believes Specter's past is closely linked to that convent, which is also likely hiding the truth behind her mysterious past.

The medical department's in-depth examination revealed Oripathy to be the cause of Specter's deteriorating physical health. 
Furthermore, Specter lacked both the necessary aptitude and knowledge to wield Originium Arts. This is puzzling and greatly impacts her combat ability. 
Despite her difficulties, Specter was still devastatingly powerful during her missions, to the point of unsettlement. She undoubtedly has incredible room for growth and improvement. 
Even more important is her polarizing attitudes in combat and in her daily life. 
She is demure and quiet in battle (other than a few occasional mumbles to herself), with a mindless tendency to follow orders to the end, completely unaware of potential danger and obstacles. Her inability to react has endangered her safety more than once. 
It can be concluded that Specter is a vital part of the squad, but a commander must also adapt to her single-mindedness and plan accordingly.

[Classified Log] 
In actuality, when Specter first approached Rhodes Island, she was articulate and sincere, claiming she had just escaped confinement and wished to deliver a message. 
However, she fell silent before she could finish conveying it. In her last moments of sanity, she told the Operator who retrieved her that she has once again gotten entangled in a dark conspiracy. 
After she failed to tear off her habit, she then descended into madness.

modules.moduleDescription:
Specter clutches the candle holder tight. She remembers it. But it should not be here.
The Medical Department operators visited her a moment ago. They pricked an ever-so-cautious drop of blood from her finger, then left her alone to recite prayer from her heart, liturgical meanings discerned by none. They tend to her body, attempt to heal her rended ego—they would not bestow her such a vile gift as this.
She touches the candlelight, but the fingertip feels no hint of warmth. A momentary lucidity and tranquility race ashore like foam. The edges of the waves wash over her throat cut wide open, and zealotry, scorched sun-dry in darkness, extinguishes its bellows. In the same moment, white flame climbs her wrist, sets her nun's habit alight, and leaps from her shoulder to sink into her sweeping hair.
Through the candlelight, she looks within. Laurentina stands before a statue. The Stygian sea encases a dome teeming with lights. The figure freed from raw stone lingers in her eyes, and its shadow chisels out an alcove. There, Laurentina lifts a machine to cut stone, a 'Little Handy' roving in circles beside her, swallowing up the fragments that pitter-patter against the floor.
Through the candlelight, she looks within. Rallying cries. Piercing whistles and sawblades all around as far as the eye can see, gristle and blood peeled from body, bones met together and fractured apart. The hunters born beneath domes are tearing apart the barriers of flesh now before them, their enemies falling to the seafloor as raindrops to the surface. A lance severs open a cavity; an incisive and clarion order; amidst ocean's currents Laurentina charges in. She hears singing.
Through the candlelight, she looks within. The statue behind the candle holder is virgin holy white, and when it weeps, it casts a shadow. She is sliced apart, to then be mended; sliced apart again, to then be mended again. Finally, they use Specter to slice apart Laurentina, and allow the seeds of dry land to root within her body. Thus, the sister kneels before the candle holder, grips her pendant tight, recites prayer from her heart, liturgical meanings discerned by none.
Through the candlelight, she looks within. The door to the treatment ward is pulled open. A familiar scent. A lithe yet firm echo of footsteps strikes down the candle holder, melting it into the lights of the corridor. Specter curls up, dreaming a peaceful dream so rare for her. In her dream, she burns atop the candle holder, as if she is its fourth flame.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Ehi, Doctor. Hope you don't mind if I bring my weapons inside. I'll plop myself right over here.
Somebody out to get you, huh? Then have a long, hard think about who you might've wronged in the past.
If someone's out for revenge on you, don't hesitate, just take them out. Once you decide to pick up a weapon, you don't need a reason to kill.
It's been a while... I see that Texas made some friends. Hehehe... Affascinante! Can't wait to get to know them!
You think I'm an assassin, huh? Yeah, alright. Call me whatever you want. I can be anyone, do anything, kill anyone anytime. Just so long as I want to!
I love power, Doctor. And you offered me a job where I can use my power to my heart's content... Love it. Honestly, the only joy I get out of this insane world is using my power to conquer it.
Texas? Ha, she's afraid of me, but I don't wanna do anything to her, except maybe try to bring back the old Texas. The one we got here's a cucciolo impaurito.
That red one... oh... Doctor, keep her away from me! She'd definitely kill me in a fight. But I have this feeling... this feeling... ugh, why do I want to fight her so badly?
You want to know what happened between me and Texas? Hehe, you don't have a single idea of what you are sticking your nose into. You'll find out the truth someday, but not from me.
Sleep tight... enjoy your sweet dreams while you still can.
A great evil stands in the way of justice. My master, in the name of hatred and revenge, lead the weak onward!
Don't you just love how I keep getting more and more powerful?
Hahaha! Bene! I love how much you trust me. You can't say the same for Texas, right?
Molto bene! That's more like it! Strength, unfettered and unchained! That's what I'm talking about!
Make Texas the leader!
Put Texas on my team!
Haha, you people... I don't think I'll even remember your faces after this one... Anyway, let's just get started.
We're fighting you guys? Then please do your bestest job, or I'll be really bored.
Show me what you've got.
Tell me, what's your plan?
Solid positioning.
Ahahaha!
C'mon! C'eri quasi, tesoro!
Can you do it?
Just try me!
You'll have to try harder than that!
It's over? Ah, che noia!
Hahaha, sliced 'em up like a millefoglie. How do you like it?
Not my best work. You can lay it on me for letting a few get away.
Bravo! Now I want to crush them that much harder! Hahaha!
Hm? Did I see a red shadow flash by?
Haha!
The more I get to know you, the better I understand Texas. I Love it.
Arknights.

Where's Texas? It's almost time for the countdown, shouldn't she be at Rhodes Island? Hah, to think I don't even get to see her on a day like this. Where are those precious friends of hers? I'm going to find Texas. Wanna come with, Doctor?
Heh. Ciao, Doctor.

Is it so strange that I got you a gift? Do you not like it, or did you just not expect it…? I can tell by your face, you loved my gift, didn't you? What did Texas give you? Let me see! Whose do you like better?

Here, take some whiskey, add a little amaretto, then put it on the rocks. Wanna sip? Hehe. In Siracusa, we call this a 'Luci Spente,' and one sip means you're killing the guy next to you. Texas? She'll never tell you this, but she used to love this drink. Come, salute!

handbook.profile:
Lappland's real identity is unknown, her background a mystery. She has demonstrated impressive destructive prowess in tactical assaults and search-and-destroy missions. 
She is currently a special ops Operator for Rhodes Island.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 13% 
Operator Lappland showed a massive amount of crystal formation. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.27u/L 
Strict monitoring of Operator Lappland's condition is required.
archives:
We have struggled to understand Lappland's personality. Some consider her simply mad, despite how polite and personable she can be in daily life. She actively seeks out people to converse with, indulging her taste for gallows humor, eager to see how her conversation partners will respond. Still, we know Lappland to be a dangerous element, and even at her most well-behaved, she remains frightening. 
Lappland has been marked for close medical observation due to severe symptoms of Oripathy. 
According to as yet unconfirmed reports, Lappland might have come from a certain family in Siracusa known for moving in certain dangerous circles, but scouring all active and inactive lists involving Siracusa failed to connect Lappland to any of the families. Because of the extreme risk involved in probing the Siracusan families, the investigation has been terminated.

Lappland's Oripathy symptoms go beyond the physical to cause an abnormal obsession toward a certain target of hers, even spurring her to excessive violence. 
Although Rhodes Island has exerted some degree of control over her behavior while deployed, she still does more or less whatever she wants in battle, which has been a problem for coordinated operations with her teammates. 
Lappland's rather unique symptoms seem to enhance her fighting abilities--very rare among Infected. Her weapon, a specially designed eastern-style sword, complements her Arts. She appears to wield her Originium Arts untrained, through raw talent alone. Even though Lappland's powers decay rapidly when released, her deceptive fighting style and explosive offensive abilities have allowed her to master her weaknesses. 
Furthermore, Lappland's uncanny ability to discern weaknesses neutralizes virtually any advantage an opponent with Originium Arts or other special abilities may have. She is able to counter her enemy's attacks completely after only a few moments of observation.

Based on scattered reports and eyewitness accounts, Operator Lappland has a close personal connection to Penguin Logistics employee Texas, a liaison from the company to Rhodes Island. Texas, for her part, makes a concerted effort to avoid contact with Lappland. Still, in situations where they were forced to work together, Lappland has not gone out of her way to antagonize Texas. In fact, she seems to be taking some degree of pleasure in Texas playing hard-to-get, as it were. 
Lappland treats other PL personnel cordially, but they have not warmed to her, and their meetings are always rather awkward (though thankfully rare). 
Lappland tries to get along with other Rhodes Island Operators, as long as no one gets in her way. 
[Classified Log] 
All Lupo Operators display a guarded reaction to Operator Projekt Red's presence, with Operator Lappland exhibiting the most intense, most uncontrollable aura of dread and animosity, as well as inexplicable euphoria. Until a solution is devised to mitigate the tension, keeping the two separated is advised.

[Classified Log]
Comment accessed from another classified source: 
In the future, you may want to think carefully about how you handle Lappland. 
She's alone wolf (note: this is Lupo slang for a Lupo ostracized from the community) who's been hurt. She's lost her family and will never truly be a part of another one. 
You don't need to know what's been keeping her alive till now, and you can try to heal her wounds, but remember this: Madness can never be healed. 
Nothing in her past should happen again. 
If you still decide to keep her around, you'll ultimately be faced with a choice... Maybe you're not yet mentally ready to fight her. 
So please, listen to my advice again: For your sake and the sake of those you care about, do choose wisely.

modules.moduleDescription:
The smith thought long and hard before crafting the weapon.
The head of Famiglia Saluzzo had approached in person, requesting a unique weapon for his daughter.
He accepted the commission not only out of respect for the famiglia's influence—
The swordsmith from Higashi believed that a blade reflects one's soul, and to wield one is to grasp one's destiny.
He once forged a nodachi requiring the strength of five men; of course, the samurai who wielded it was invincible on the battlefield, yet was plagued by injuries in his old age, eventually taking his own life due to that festering anger towards himself.
He once forged a splendorous and dignified blade concealing a razor edge for a rare king. The weapon granted the king an aura of gravitas that permeated the land, and the king never had to wield it against any enemy throughout his entire life.
He once wished to demonstrate his loyalty to Signora Sicilia like the others, yet was rejected nonchalantly. It was then he came to understand how she ruled this country replete with violence, as well as the weariness and helplessness she hid.
But now, he had no idea what sort of fangs this strange young wolf should bear.
An exquisite rapier, because she would inherit her father's eccentricity and elusiveness?
A deadly great-axe, because she could not ignore the call of the wild in her blood?
No, neither would suffice. The smith tossed the half-finished weapon into the furnace's flames.
She was cruel, elegant and elusive as her father, yet something altogether different.
'It's still not ready? My dear father did say to wait until my coming-of-age ceremony, but our enemies wish to see it tonight.'
The swordsmith explained that he was trying to forge a blade worthy of her. But the more he racked his brain, the harder it became to imagine what such a weapon would actually look like.
'How about these?'
She haphazardly picked up a pair of swords.
Once upon a time, he had hoped to create a weapon that would serve as a testament to his skill. This pair of swords had demanded too much of his ingenuity, becoming more and more complex in the process. They sufficed as a conduit for Arts, but had become terribly unwieldy in the process, unable to even be sheathed.
'A failure, destined to never be completed?' The white wolf waved the blades around and bared a smile—'I think I like the sound of that.'
The smith pleaded that her unique soul deserved a weapon far more special.
'I'm afraid you have the wrong idea, sir. What I came here for was a tool. These are sturdy, and more than suitable to kill with. I like the craftsmanship, and plan to keep using them. That's good enough for me.'
The despairing smith could do nothing but watch her leave.
Perhaps, his finest work was something he had rejected as a failure.
Perhaps, any soul that could be defined by a weapon was too empty to begin with.
That night, the renowned swordsmith announced his retirement, and Lappland of Famiglia Saluzzo wielded her iconic blades for the first time—
From that day on, the people would call them 'The Young Fang.'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: If you got enemies about, just scream. I'll keep ya safe.
Where's that kid gone off to? Y'know, her... the really tanned shorty who's always trailing our Master... 'Morgan' is her nam- Oi! Stop right there!
You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours, we keep it real that way, yeah? You treat me with respect, I'll do the same for you.
Seems our Majesty's really into your place. Don't see that every day, seeing as we're never anywhere same for long.
Work or what have ya, you've gotta have guts!
Whoa, whoa, chew before you swallow, mate! HEY! SOMEONE BRING US MORE MEAT! This girl's got an empty belly to fill!
Bleeding Morgan... she might seem like a layabout mostly, but she's our tactician when push comes to shove. Gets the job done. Gets on my nerves otherwise, though, and she loves it. Tch...
Doesn't she look brilliant, like a liege with a hammer in hand? I'm even more keen to see the look of her holding a sword, though.
Out with it! Don't beat around the bush, just say it: who do you want dealt with?
Tch. look at you spacing out like an idiot... Your own bloody fault if a tiger bites you.
I'm Indra. I don't have any of those weird crazy powers -- I let my fists do the talking. Nice to meet ya!
Niiice, this is good stuff.
Promotions are great, almost as great as fighting is!
Don't be afraid. I'll protect ya.
Where's the battlefield?
So, who's in the market for a walloping?
Mind your own sodding business and let me be!
Come on! Show me what you've got!
Oi!
Get on with it, plod!
Haha!
All right, it's my turn!
You bastard!
Nothing can stop me!
You're dead meat!
Give it up!
That's the stuff! That's what I call a kick!
You don't go home happy without some bloodshed!
Tch, we've got some who fled. Bunch of cowards.
Not bad... But I'll get you back for this!
What's this room about? More of a squeeze than anywhere I've been.
Oi! You got a bleedin' death wish?
C'mere, lemme get my arms around you! Yes, I mean hug you!
Arknights.
Ooh! Gotcher end-of-year bonus? Haha, I must be due for one too, scrapping so much on your behalf! You and me, we're fellows now, no two ways about it! Get up, I'm taking you out for food!
What's up, Doctor!

Hah, it's your birthday today, then. Here's a prezzie: these brass knuckles. They're the tiger's choice, get all your average muckers done and dusted! You should learn to watch yourself too, I say. Can't always count on me being there when you're in danger, right? Still, if I'm around and anyone picks on you, their arse is good as kicked!

Vina trusts Rhodes Island. That's why I take orders from you, no hesitation. But you listen here, Doctor. You need to feel the weight of that trust. Else I'll make you feel it, even if I need my fists to do it—and I don't mean wanting to scrap with you. But you just keep what I've said in mind.

handbook.profile: The leader of the Glasgow Gang's fighters in Victoria. During the war, she fought courageously alongside Vina Victoria and the Exemplars. After the war, she returned to Norport to continue running the Slobberknocker boxing gym. As one of our main points of contact at Rhodes Island's Victoria office, she is often invited to participate in practical combat training (essentially serving as a sparring partner) and occasionally helps Vina Victoria deliver messages back to Rhodes Island.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9%
No visible Originium crystals have been observed on the surface of Indra's body. Though her disease is currently under control, she needs to be closely monitored.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Indra was injured during operations in Victoria, and became infected after long-term exposure to high levels of Originium particulate concentration.
After the war, she repeatedly refused the specialized physical exams prepared by Medical. Instead, she directed her colleagues, who had come to volunteer as medics, to treat local citizens first. At least three colleagues have raised objections to her indifference towards her own health.
'Tons of Londiniers who need help more than I do. 'Sides, I have to book a checkup at some point, else Vina'll duff me up. Again.'
——Operator Indra's reply
archives: Technique was not what allowed her to survive for years on the street, but rather raw force and combat instincts. She developed into a great fighter through street brawling since childhood, and her confidence in her own two powerful fists enabled her to defeat countless foes.

Glasgow hung out in the slums of Victoria, getting their start as a street gang led by Morgan and Indra. They carved out their turf and survived in the anarchy, until Siege showed up and handed the supremely confident Indra her first ever defeat.

It wasn't just a simple defeat, since Siege's character and vision converted both Indra and Morgan into loyal friends and cohorts. Even though Siege never liked to pull rank, Indra still saw herself as Siege's most devoted follower and would do anything for her. Who knew a thug too lazy to be bothered with the concept of knighthood would exemplify the spirit far more than the official knights of Kazimierz?

The straightforward Indra hates sly, glib people who play games. Face to face, out in the open, that's what fighting is all about! Only cowards would act like a weasel! Her bold personality has made many like-minded colleagues her buddies at Rhodes Island. They would spar and discuss battles in the gym, then go for a big feast together after a sweaty workout and mock the supposedly 'brainy' Operators behind their backs. What else could be better than this in life?

modules.moduleDescription:
Keep a steady form, and control your pace. This is what the leader of Norport Borough's gang would tell herself. Indra could barely keep herself conscious, but she used all her will to keep herself together and face the enemy head-on. Here, at the decisive moment, all she ought to need was one more jab.
'You still want to go?' The calm voice of the opposing party was nearly drowned out by the sound of her own heavy gasps for air.
Loose silver hairs drooped down across her forehead, blocking her vision and blurring out the golden figure standing firm before her, illuminated by a streetlamp. 'Don't be so quick to call yourself the winner, you little shite! I ain't lost yet!' Indra adjusts her breathing and secretly shifts her center of gravity to behind her left hip, all while gathering her hair firmly behind her shoulders. She raises her fists and clenches her fingers, gripping her shabby brass knuckles even tighter than ever before.
'I'll help you remember, outsider. This here street's mine—Indra of the Glasgow Gang!' As soon as the words were out of her mouth, the silver figure suddenly steps forward, pouncing upon her opponent faster than the eye could see. She lifts her left fist as if putting every last ounce of strength into this one strike, but then commands her body to turn and instead funnel all that strength into her right fist.
Indra hears the golden-haired girl mutter in her ear: 'I'll remember alright, Indra of the Glasgow Gang.' A tranquil voice, as she always was. Indra still remembers that after, she lost her balance, she fully expected the cold embrace of the cement road, but that hard sensation looming large in her imagination never came. Through closed eyes, it was like she had... fallen onto a ball of sunshine.
'Run? Run from what? Sorry Vina, I was daydreaming a bit, didn't hear ya.'
'How to Fight with the Glasgow Gang. This was your work, wasn't it? Rule Number Four, and this is the most important rule: When it comes time to run, remember to run.'
'Ah, yeah! Pretty much sums up every street fight I've gotten into over the years.'
'That night we first met, why didn't you run?'
'Gonna have to have a think on that one.' Indra lowers her head and contemplates for a moment. 'Back then, whenever we ran from a fight, it was so we could survive. For scroungers on the street, nothing's more important'n staying alive. But...'
'But?' Siege sits up, facing herself towards Indra.
Indra raises her head, looking right back at Siege. Under the flickering lights of the boxing gym, two pairs of golden eyes face each other, and she sees herself reflected in the Aslan's eyes.
'But there's no Feline who doesn't like some time under the sun, right?' Indra draws back the corners of her mouth, impishly baring an ivory grin.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: We're changing shifts right now, Doctor. Just ignore me and get on with your work.
Back in BSW, I was appointed as a BPRS... you know, Biochemical Protection Response Staff. You can probably imagine what it was like... bulky hazmat suit and all that...
Hmm? You think I'm a clean freak? Well, Doctor, I see you're unexpectedly direct! I admire your courage.
Some of the Operators' rooms are in dire need of cleaning. For example, the one belonging to that high-and-mighty teacher's pet. What do you think?
You want to see the intricate pattern on my sword up close? Sure, hold it tight, then. Don't let go—it'll heat up to 2,500 degrees Celcius in 3 seconds! Haha, just kidding! Don't be scared!
Stay clear of that room full of chemical haze, toxins and harmful radiation... that's right, I mean Dr. Kal'tsit's lab.
You're asking me for advice regarding the prevention of biochemical contamination? Well, for example... always brush your teeth after eating?
Liskarm's been looking so flashy since she got her promotion. 'Hey! Hot girl here! Get your gunsight on me!' I bet that's how she greets the enemies.
Good golly, if this is how free life is at Rhodes Island then I might just quit my job at BSW. Liskarm would be upset, though.
There's a mosquito on your arm, Doctor.
I'm chemical specialist operator, Franka, here to do my bit to help minimize the pollution wrought by Originium.
I could perform these techniques anywhere, anytime!
Wooow, you're giving me a promotion? I'm having a lot more fun here than at BSW.
*Giggle*, you want to see my sword at its most glorious? Too bad, Doctor—you're not qualified yet! If you work at it, maybe one day you'll gain the privilege!
All right, I'm ready.
The best thing about training capable subordinates, is that I get to let them handle all the annoying stuff for me.
Well, let's go, then.
Too bad... these people have already been contaminated. In that case...
Gotta hurry!
No time to hesitate.
Offense isn't what I trained for, but hey...
Heavy defenders are SO scary... Hehe, just kidding.
Weak spot, Sighted!
Let's burn it up!
Hold your breath now.
Tricked you!
Obsession with power is a fool's game.
That was perfect from start to finish. Well done.
Just as expected.
What, you still have time for that upset face? Fall back now.
Say, do you have black tea here?
Need something?
Want to hear about my time at BSW?
Arknights.
Thanks for the end-of-year bonus, Doctor! It motivates me to work even harder next year. If you've got any tough missions, leave them to me! (Now to get a bonus from Blacksteel too...)
Gooood morning, Doctor!
Happy birthday, Doctor! Here's your gift, no tricks attached. Don't forget to make your wish and make it come true! You only live once, after all.

Rhodes Island is a more interesting place than Blacksteel. The medics always look like they're attending my funeral when I get a checkup. It scares me... Yeah, yeah, I know, I'll be good and listen. I have too much on my bucket list to give up now.

handbook.profile:
Franka, biohazard protection and response specialist for Blacksteel Worldwide, is very experienced and proficient in VIP protection, raid, and combat support operations. 
She is currently undergoing treatment for Oripathy at Rhodes Island and providing professional security as a Blacksteel Operator.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9% 
Operator Franka showed conspicuous symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.34u/L 
Infection approaching mid-stage but currently not spreading, condition stable.
archives:
Blacksteel, aka. Blacksteel Worldwide, is a contractor whose core service is providing private security services. Headquartered in Columbia, Blacksteel is now riding a crest thanks to the growing business influence of Columbia. 
To combat the Originium infection crisis, Blacksteel set up a special unit known as the 'Biochemical Protection Response Staff' (BPRS). Operator Franka is a member of this unit tasked with guaranteeing the safety of all Bio Department operations. 
Unlike most Blacksteel specialists who are always serious to the point of being dour, Franka seems more light-hearted, progressive, and is even a bit of a prankster--her victims including both enemies and her own colleagues. 
No matter the situation she faces, Franka is able to keep calm and persuade others to trust in her calculated words. 
For a professional Operator, Franka submitted a relatively truthful personal profile and resume, as well as a standard cooperation agreement, voluntary treatment waiver, and other binding contracts. Based on that, Franka may be accorded the appropriate level of trust.

Franka's combat style is often considered enigmatic and unpredictable, as befitting her peculiar personality. Rather than dealing the most damage, she focuses on making herself come off as 'harmless.' 
Franka's weapon of choice are a rapier and a dagger. She favors a rapier forged from Originium that, when combined with her own Originium Arts, produces a huge amount of heat (while still retaining its shape). It is especially effective against targets in heavy metal armor. It is very easy to overlook her light gear and weapons, leading to a gross underestimation of her combat prowess. 
On the other hand, the close-up melee style she prefers also can put her in peril. While she may be good enough to end the enemy before her life is threatened, to alleviate concerns, the head of the BPRS project teamed the smart but radical Franka with the level-headed Liskarm, making them a complementary duo in combat.

As shown in the limited files provided by Blacksteel, Operator Franka contracted Oripathy during an escort mission for the BPRS Department (project designation and actual operation are both classified). Blacksteel used newly acquired intel to contact the little-known Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals and arranged on-site treatment for Franka, also seizing the opportunity to reach several agreements with the company.
Franka's arrival filled a gap in experienced Operators for Rhodes Island, and she shows great interest in her new surroundings in return. Her professionalism helped her integrate in no time, making her an essential part of combat missions. The mood on Rhodes Island, in turn, has felt the impact of Franka's presence. 
For example, during her tenure as the swordfighting instructor for reserve Operators, she 'initiated' every newbie in 'Columbian style training', i.e., hazing. At the same time, she held almost nothing back in passing on her knowledge and experience to the rookies. 
To those on Rhodes Island, their biggest impression of Franka, besides her professional combat instruction and unique combat style, is her regular clashing with her partner Liskarm.

The bond between Franka and Rhodes Island hinges solely on the agreements between Blacksteel and the company. She seems more and more like a Rhodes Island Operator each day now, though, and she is quite proud of that. 
Oripathy has not bothered Franka in any way so far. She still goes about life in her own unique way, busy with work and combat, while continuing to look for fun and excitement on the job.

modules.moduleDescription:
Tenth routine physical examination. 
Oripathy prognosis is stable, Originium Arts have improved due to disease progression, and the new Arts Unit prepared beforehand has been loaded. Subsequently, thermite blade's power will be greatly increased. 
Well, huh... Looking at things this way, Originium only sucks when it acts up and hurts a lot. But other than that, it doesn't get in the way of my life, and can even help me in battle. Isn't that pretty decent? 
Hmm, maybe that's what I'll tell the teacher’s pet the next time I see her. Can't wait to see what kind of face she makes. 
Wonder how she'd even respond to that... 
'Your health isn't some kind of game!' 
'What's so decent about that? You're actually going to die!' 
Sheesh, what's the big deal anyway? You only live once, right? So why not enjoy it? 
'Didn't you say you wanted to go traveling across the world? With Oripathy...' 
...... 
...... 
Yeah, about that travel planner... 
I'm not gonna get to check off a lot of things from my bucket list. 
It sucks that I didn't even make it through a tenth of my list before getting sick. And some of the places still on it don't welcome the Infected at all. The vast tundras of Ursus, Londinium's eclectic manors, Leithanien's concert halls, Kazimierz's knight tournament arenas, the thousands of fowlbeasts sweeping across Sargon's deserts... 
I wanted to see all of them, with her. 
Might as well cross them out now... 
Jeez, why am I thinking about all these things anyway... It's all because of that teacher’s pet. I listen to her nagging too much. Even when she's not here, I hear her voice in my head. 
Stop thinking about these things. 
...... 
Let's keep those plans after all. 
Rhodes Island is still moving forward, so I have to keep moving forward. 
Maybe one day... 
Just maybe, those places will open their doors to welcome the Infected.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: My next mission is to protect you, Doctor.
I don't say much? That's because I'd rather avoid thinking about most things.
Our job is to deliver life and death.
I usually listen to Sora's songs when I'm driving.
Cigarette? Oh, no, this is chocolate. You've gotta replenish your energy regularly. Which reminds me... do you want some coffee?
How long have I worked for Penguin Logistics? When did I start...? I don't even know how long it's been.
Watch out for the Red Wolf. She's not evil, but... she's not like us.
No matter how hard I run, my past will catch up to me one day.
My independent lifestyle and rowdy friends have brought me a lot of trouble... but I kind of like it this way.
Is it time for a break?
Code name Texas. I'm responsible for driving, moving cargo, and keeping our people safe. Try to get the mission briefings as concise as possible, please.
Thanks.
This will work as payment.
Thanks for trusting me, Doctor.
What do you need?
I'm not good at barking orders.
Let's go.
Exusiai, cover me.
Awaiting orders.
Got it.
Draw swords!
Let's begin.
Hah!
You can't stop me.
Cut them to pieces!
Shut up.
Whew... No problem.
Weaklings.
A few of them got through.
I may have underestimated this operation.
Do you need any supplies? Just let me know.
What is it, Doctor?
Arknights.

Happy New Year. I was just about to give these to Exusiai. She said she'd be hosting a big party tonight, to celebrate her results not being rock bottom. The other girls? Croissant was hauling a huge batch of goods she got in earlier, so I figure she's got a stall laid out now. As for Sora... have you heard her new single, Doctor? I'm pretty into it.
Morning.
Here's a box of vinyls from the boss's collection. I got it from Lungmen. Take it, Doctor. No need to worry about my boss. Happy birthday.
I like how Rhodes Island does its anniversaries. Here's a couple wine truffles I just picked up, rum and bitter almond flavor. Tastes pretty good. Why don't you give them a try?

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Texas showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Texas sometimes delivers packages with Originium content, but it has not caused infection to date.
handbook.promotionRecord:
Texas is a handful. Even when she lets you get close, she won't spare more than a few words. It took me a long time to figure out whether we were cool or not. 
Sigh. Anyone trying to be her friend is in for a reckoning. 
—Exusiai
archives:
A taciturn messenger. 
According to her own account, she's not hiding anything, just has nothing to say. 
Though she gives off the impression being a loner, she is often seen with her fellow Penguin Logistics employees.

While Texas may be quiet, her fighting style is anything but. It's best described as tempestuous. 
At Rhodes Island, Operators without formal training are actually the majority, but when it comes to the use of weapons, most will follow established protocols. Texas, however, doesn't. 
While she is a bit more reserved now, one can still see vestiges of an idea that she herself might not be aware of - her belief that the singular purpose of all weaponry is to kill.

Her Lupo origin, her conspicuous fur color, her notable combat style, and of course, her name, all point to her ties with the faded Texas family, a once-famous clan whose name is now forgotten to most. 
If that's the case, Texas's past is probably astonishing beyond imagination, as indicated by the Texas name itself. 
On the one hand, even with Rhodes Island's intel network, very little is known about the family's fate. On the other hand, Texas never felt the need to elaborate on her past, so there isn't a pressing need to delve into it. After all, her past may one day catch up to her, just as she predicts.

Although Texas never discusses her past, that's not the same as actively avoiding the topic. It's more like apathy. 
From the way she has adapted to her current life, it's obvious she isn't running from anything. Routine work, bickering colleagues, Lungmen, and Rhodes Island are now everything to her. 
We could sum it up like this: 
When the past does catch up to her, she will face it with composure--unless it disrupts her present, then we'll witness the genuine rage inside her.

modules.moduleDescription:
Lungmen Guard Department/Transcript:
'Yes, Ah Sir, I remember clearly, it was a young Lupo lady, black hair and orange eyes, carrying a briefcase. Her name's Texas, you said? I've never heard it. I keep to myself, you know.'
'What happened? Everything was normal, I was there at the counter spacing out. A little shop like ours doesn't do much business at three in the afternoon. Students are still in school, and the office types come by at noon to stretch their limbs for a bit before their bosses pull them back to work. I suppose officers like you on patrol mind our business now and again. Do you know Madame Oni? The tall, tall Inspector with a horn on her head? She and I—'
'Black suits! Er, I was a little nervous, there must've been twenty in all. Us ordinary folks never see things like that. They were all rushing Miss Texas and that briefcase, and whatever they had in their hands, they were shiny and glinting! You see something like that for real, I dare say, and it makes those movies look like child's play! You know, Ah Sir, I'm a professional, I've seen every kung fu movie to ever come out in Lungmen, but the way Miss Texas squared up was completely different. She doesn't even seem that old. I don't dare imagine where she learned those insane moves, or how she got so trained.'
'Right, the camera has me hiding under the counter, but I heard it all crystal clear! A dagger got sent flying and landed right next to me! Then a red-haired Sankta came in, I think probably to help Miss Texas, because I heard them say hi. She was called Exusiai? And then there was this whole massive rumble, that was something wild! I could feel my own liver shaking!'
'Then it all died down, and I found the guts to come out from under the counter, and the black suits were all on the ground, and my shop was—ah, you don't have to worry about that, there were two big stars who came by later on. Miss Sora was one, and then the other was that rapping Liberi. They compensated me wonderfully, enough I could fix up my shop and open a cystybeast meatball stall.'
'What about Texas? Er, she... she picked out some snacks after it went down and went to me to pay. It was the kind that's really popular with schoolkids, the biscuit sticks with the coating. She bought a whole handful of boxes. Chocolate, vanilla and the new salted one, and she bought a woven bag for a dollar too.'
'What do you mean, I'm not telling you anything useful? You listen to me, that bag is designed by our shop! It's got cartoons on it!'
'Alright, enough from me. Still, Ah Sir, there's one more thing—do you L.G.D. people know this Miss Texas? Tell her for me: the reward from her stamp card came in, a limited edition baseball cap, so if she can drop in when she's got the time...'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: I'm here to help. So? Whose ass are we kicking next?
You can't go out without permission? Что? Aren't you the one in charge? Screw the rules, let's just get out.
You said something? My headphones were on.
The leader of Rhodes Island looks younger than even Istina. How can you let a kid like that go to battle?!
Why do I stare at you all the time? 'cause I'm onto you, gotta see what you're doing.
Every soldier wants to be the general. And I trust you have no opinion on me taking your position someday?
Plans for the future? Don't have any. You got a problem with that? I'm still young, no need to plan ahead.
I found Istina and the girls out there in the field. We used to have a bunch more, too. What happened to them…? I dealt with 'em. Had no choice, they wouldn't play nice.
Huh? Chernobog? Who'd ever wanna go back to that miserable city? We've got new lives here at Rhodes Island. So, let's keep it together, Doctor.
…You really finished all your work?

I'm Zima, leader of the Ursus Student Self-governing Group. I can make do without one, but my comrades need a place to call home. Let's cut the crap, gimme a job to do. I know lodging here ain't free.
Not too bad.
A promotion? Cool! So I'll keep getting promoted if I keep doing a good job knocking heads, yeah?
I'll be frank: if I keep getting promoted, I might end up replacing you someday. Oh, you think I'm joking? Sorry, pal, I'm dead serious here.
Don't care if I'm leading or following. Whatever.
What a pain...
Time to go.
Roll out.
Duh, it's me!
I'm heading into the thick of it.
Spineless scumbags.
Hah.
What're you scared of?!
Bring it on, bastards!
For power and glory!
Victory or death!
Who else has a death wish? Happy to help!
Not bad. A solid win.
Anyway, this place is ours now.
Man, you suck. Get lost!
What do you want me to do here?
Huh?
Hey, you're getting better at giving orders these days. I bet you also see the fun in fighting now, eh?
Arknights.

Morning. Everyone's so damned noisy today. All those grown-ass people running around crazy excited for New Year's like a bunch of kids… Say, you aren't planning to waste the first day of the year sitting around here, are you? I bought a whole ton of fireworks, so you're gonna come have some fun with me.
You need something?

Privet, this one's for you. Hey, who said you could open it right now? Whatever, not like it's anything special. It plays music, same model as mine. Gets the job done, as far as I'm concerned… You've had my back for a while, so a little token of appreciation is the least I can do. Happy birthday, Doctor.

Rhodes Island gave us a place to live. I'm not about to forget that. I'm gonna get stronger, strong enough to make sure I'm worthy of the 'General Zima' title - for my comrades. Now, you'd better work twice as hard from here on, or that chair's gonna be mine. I'm dead serious!

Every soldier wants to be the general. And I trust you have no opinion on me taking your position someday?
Plans for the future? Don't have any. You got a problem with that? I'm still young, no need to plan ahead.
I found Istina and the girls out there in the field. We used to have a bunch more, too. What happened to them…? I dealt with 'em. Had no choice, they wouldn't play nice.
Huh? Chernobog? Who'd ever wanna go back to that miserable city? We've got new lives here at Rhodes Island. So, let's keep it together, Doctor.
…You really finished all your work?

I'm Zima, leader of the Ursus Student Self-governing Group. I can make do without one, but my comrades need a place to call home. Let's cut the crap, gimme a job to do. I know lodging here ain't free.
Not too bad.
A promotion? Cool! So I'll keep getting promoted if I keep doing a good job knocking heads, yeah?
I'll be frank: if I keep getting promoted, I might end up replacing you someday. Oh, you think I'm joking? Sorry, pal, I'm dead serious here.
Don't care if I'm leading or following. Whatever.
What a pain...
Time to go.
Roll out.
Duh, it's me!
I'm heading into the thick of it.
Spineless scumbags.
Hah.
What're you scared of?!
Bring it on, bastards!
For power and glory!
Victory or death!
Who else has a death wish? Happy to help!
Not bad. A solid win.
Anyway, this place is ours now.
Man, you suck. Get lost!
What do you want me to do here?
Huh?
Hey, you're getting better at giving orders these days. I bet you also see the fun in fighting now, eh?
Arknights.

Morning. Everyone's so damned noisy today. All those grown-ass people running around crazy excited for New Year's like a bunch of kids… Say, you aren't planning to waste the first day of the year sitting around here, are you? I bought a whole ton of fireworks, so you're gonna come have some fun with me.
You need something?

Privet, this one's for you. Hey, who said you could open it right now? Whatever, not like it's anything special. It plays music, same model as mine. Gets the job done, as far as I'm concerned… You've had my back for a while, so a little token of appreciation is the least I can do. Happy birthday, Doctor.

Rhodes Island gave us a place to live. I'm not about to forget that. I'm gonna get stronger, strong enough to make sure I'm worthy of the 'General Zima' title - for my comrades. Now, you'd better work twice as hard from here on, or that chair's gonna be mine. I'm dead serious!

archives:
Zima defies most people's preconceived notions of what an Ursine person should be, expecting her to be irascible and sensitive. When she has something to say, she says it directly, and doesn't much consider what kind of impact it's going to leave her targets. What is certain is that Zima feels her words and actions are acceptable. Even so, as soon as she feels like one of her friends is being bullied or treated unfairly, she will stick up for them regardless of the circumstances.
As a result, childish jokes should be kept to a minimum in her presence. As for dealing with young Operators, a flexible attitude must be maintained.
The short of it is that Operators should watch what they say around Zima. They should be somewhat honest, but also help Zima understand that she and Rhodes Island share mutual interests.

Zima was born in the city of Chernobog in the Empire of Ursus. Reports have indicated that in recent years, student groups have become a popular way for young Ursines to organize. Influenced by the cultures of countries like Victoria and Columbia, they spend all day immersed in rock music, beer, and fight clubs. The leader of every group of students has their own nickname. Zima's first nickname was, appropriately, 'Zima,' a nickname given to her by the leader of the eastern campus's student group after she defeated him. A separate group called her 'General' (a derisive in-joke within that group - Ursans often joke that 'Generals' are incompetent and untrustworthy). However, after the annihilation of all the other student groups around the campus, people began to merge the two nicknames, and began to call her 'General Zima.'

It is clear that ever since the Chernobog incident, the surviving Ursus students have gathered in a loose group around Zima called the 'Ursus Student Self-government Group.' According to reports from some Operators, the students use Istina's room as a place to gather. They call it 'The Classroom.' We should maintain a schedule of periodic observations of this group's daily activities.

Zima's recent reading list: 
Nikolamina - Fine summer reading!
Jump! - Special Edition - One of the year's Top Ten Recommendations
The Death of Ilyich, the Suspect - (Recommended Genre: Detective Literature)
Friedrich's Theory of War - (Volkhov Press, reissued in October)
......
Despite how she seems, Zima does not show any indication of poor reading skills. The breadth of the genres she reads has left us with a deep impression. Perhaps we need to re-consider what we think of as popular literature among the middle school female population.

modules.moduleName: A Graduation Gift for Генерал Мороз
modules.moduleDescription: Behind Zima's back, someone gently prods her with a finger. She doesn't turn to look. She knows, instinctively, that it's Istina reminding her that her earphones are on too loud. Zima likes to listen to music, and especially cherishes an electronic genre popular among the Ursus youth known as 'hardbass,' the pumping rhythm and heart-shaking bass of the tracks always fires her up, and her limbs can hardly resist the urge to fill with the beat—a desire to throw hands and feet and bust down the joyless everyday, an eagerness to free her tied-up mind always ready to color her soul. There was a time where she'd sometimes wear earphones in battle too, grooving to the rhythm and stepping to the beat while cleaning up bandit nobodies. Following one training session, Dobermann sternly pointed out to her that 'as I see it, you're simply venting your violence.' Zima sneered at that, and nothing more. Anyone could tell she wasn't the impulsive girl she seemed, for she could distinguish between people she could openly challenge verbally without fear of blowback—like the Doctor—and people who really cared about the rules, for whom rebellion was best kept internal. For youth like her, knowing that distinction was one of the principles of survival. Her other instructor thought differently. Nearl was by no means strict with Zima's attitude, but the Kazimierz knight's invulnerability and tacit, solid endurance left Zima frustrated and powerless. Nearl even listened to a few of her favorite tracks and told her 'It's fine music. Very full of energy.' Zima eyed her somewhat warily at that. 'You gonna lecture me or something?' The knight of Kazimierz shook her head. 'No. Whatever music you listen to, I have no objections.' That was nice enough, but what came next was less pleasing to hear. 'But you still lack the strength to allow yourself to be distracted in battle. If you wish to earn a passing grade from me, this won't do.' Zima couldn't help but glare at her. 'I will hold on to your player and earphones for now.' The knight of Kazimierz paid no mind to General Zima's fury; instead calmly speaking words she had never heard before, now even from her parents. 'Come now, no need for that frown. I'll spar with you using one hand; once you can best me like that, and are qualified to lead a team, I'll gift you a new set.' 'Kazimierz's latest model. I've no doubt you'll like it.' '......' General Zima traces her hand over the latest Kazimierzian communicator-slash-player on her wrist, without a word cutting off the music she had playing and switching it over to access her squad's comms channel. Her teammates chatter away, the mix of voices no less relaxed than the pumping hardbass rhythm. Zima listens for a while, not realizing she's unconsciously moving her leg, tapping out a rhythm. In her head now spins a rhythm more passionate, more fervent than her most beloved of tunes. Alright, Zima has to admit, she does like this new model a lot— She's all fired up, and doesn't even need any music.

Deep Sleep Mode enabled... Zzzzz... Setting advanced config and power interface... Zzzzz…
My racial traits, in conjunction with my infection, may cause me to fall asleep in mid-conversation. Do not be alarmed.
I met Dr. Silence at Rhine Lab. I assisted her with data and risk analysis on a secret project.
Warning! Formatting Rhodes Island database... Don't worry. It's just a joke. Please don't panic.
