......
Hello. Excuse me. Do you need any help?
......
In response to your question, Ptilopsis replies: Correct. The conversation interface that you are communicating with is Ptilopsis herself. 
As Rhodes Island's published data maintenance assistant, Ptilopsis has the authority for complete reference, free commenting, and some limited modification privileges.
At the same time, the Data Recording Officer is currently involved in the dialogue recording workflow procedure. All clearly defined searches will be recorded.
......
Message has been clearly received.
Ptilopsis is currently a senior medical Operator at Rhodes Island. Like Dr. Silence, she is a former member of the Rhine Lab Project Department.
At present, it is our long-term goal to introduce modern medical technologies and related Originium Arts research as primary medical projects at Rhodes Island.
Ptilopsis has acted as assistant to Dr. Silence in compiling and presenting several Oripathy treatment programs and serves a critical role in data recording and analysis.
In addition, Ptilopsis has also assisted to a certain extent with the day to day management of an infected Operator named Ifrit.
......

......
Initializing message exchange interface. I am Ptilopsis. How can I help you?
......
Are you looking for information on the status of Ptilopsis's illness?
Understood. Please wait a moment.
Based on your search keywords, I have found the following results:
Ptilopsis, confirmed infected.
Symptoms: Narcolepsy.
Clinical observations: Without any indication...
...
......
............
Without any indication, patient will suddenly fall into a sleeping state.
......Yes, after awakening, I have read the conversation log over, and have returned to the topic we were discussing before I fell asleep.
 Dr. Silence has drawn up a treatment plan for my illness that has already been incorporated into my daily schedule.
Returning to the previous topic.
The primary effects of Ptilopsis's Oripathy are an intensification of her racial characteristics, abnormal sleep mode functions, and disrupted biological nerve transmission.
Ptilopsis is unable to predict what effects on her daily efficiency will come as a result of these disruptions.
On the other hand, Oripathy has a certain significance for Ptilopsis. Yes, we must not judge subjectively something that objectively exists.
Oripathy has given Ptilopsis a new perspective on everything before her; a new understanding.
She now sees herself, others, and this world in a new light. And also...she has a better appreciation for the sky above.
Every day I wonder, as the Originium granules course through my veins, how to analyze and calculate the information they carry.
While they consume my body, I should try to derive some meaning from them.
For Ptilopsis, this is the foremost question to ponder from here on.
......

......
Ptilopsis has received your request, but has denied access.
Ptilopsis has denied your request to view information on the 'Diαbolic Crisis.'
You are not allowed to read any classified information related to Rhine Lab.
All internal documents related to Ifrit, Silence, Saria, and any other Operators are encrypted.
I personally advise against mentioning these subjects.
I'm very sorry.
......
Me?
You what to know what role Ptilopsis plays in all of this?
That's simple. I can answer that.
Ptilopsis maintains a neutral stance at all times.
I maintain unbiased data, eliminate uncertainty caused by emotion, and avoid fatal errors during calculation and operation.
Therefore, when Ptilopsis judges that a Rhine Lab operation will put Ptilopsis's chosen outcome in jeopardy, Ptilopsis will directly refuse to process the command.
However, do understand that Rhine Lab's research includes many possibilities for pushing this world into the future.
This cannot be stopped simply because it has a dark side to it.
This is all the information I can share with you about Ptilopsis's position for the time being.

modules.moduleDescription:
'If Originium really has the ability to store information, and we are able to decode and translate it, then Columbia's science and technology will surge forward by leaps and bounds!' 
'I've encountered a bottleneck. Current electronic computational devices are not able to handle the enormous amount of information contained within Originium. I need a more suitable computational carrier...' 
'Having a person do it?! This is certainly a bold line of thinking. I... have to give it some thought.' 
'The prototype decoding device using a human computational carrier has been manufactured. Now, I just need a test subject with a clear mind and quick reflexes, preferably with a good understanding of computers and data.' 
'Subject selection complete. Subject codename: Ptilopsis.' 
'There is nobody in Rhine Lab more suitable than she is. Though my supervisor advised me to keep the experiment a secret from her due to its risks, I still informed her of the various possibilities that might arise during this experiment. This is my line in the sand, as a citizen of Columbia, and as a person.' 
'She agreed! She agreed! I knew it, I just knew she'd agree! I knew she'd be the one!' 
'I've already taught her the key points and operating procedures of the preliminary phase. She's a quick learner, and tomorrow, the experiment will begin. I trust we will join hands to usher in Columbia's future.' 
'The experiment has been going very smoothly, and all the data has fallen within the control range. We'll keep following this pace, and soon enough... Just a little more... Wait, no, no, no! This shouldn't be happening! H-Hurry, unplug her––' 
'The failsafe mechanisms activated in time, but... she still sustained injuries... Her brain...' 
'And the Originium infection...' 
'(Short, intermittent sobbing sounds)' 
'The higher-ups have already sent for emergency dispatchers, but, but this...' 
'It's my fault... It's all my fault...' 
'Based on the information she received before, I made a chip that can be inserted inside the body. This chip should be able to replace a portion of her brain's functions.' 
'Several of the department heads seem quite fond of this suggestion. Hmph. I know what they're thinking.' 
'The implant procedure was successful, but she's unresponsive.' 
'She's awake! But her language functions... seem to have some problems.' 
'She told me, another voice appeared inside her head, one that did not belong to any of the languages she knew. It placed a huge burden on her psyche.' 
'Only the use of machine logic language could soothe the pain.' 
'She is the first person in Columbia to survive a chip transplant operation. This is a pioneering achievement.' 
'But the world through her eyes seems to have become something altogether different.' 
'I also implanted a chip into my own brain, and the wound still aches, but I want to know how the information inside the Originium has changed her.' 
'What exactly is that voice?' 
'I will reproduce the experiment.' 
––Rhine Lab, Recording of Project *UNKNOWN* Director during her lifetime

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: 还有七小时五十九分钟，没事没事，别紧张，自然点，坚持住……欸？博士，请讲！要我放轻松？我很轻松啊哈哈哈。我经常和上级共处一室的，他们都夸我办事利、利索，真的。
您说投诉信？干员向同事表白的信息意外发给了已婚人士？医疗部通知开会结果来了十头驮兽？！是上次信号调试的时候——需、需要罚多少款？一块小蛋糕和一些解释？呜……谢谢。
您真的不用我帮您泡咖啡？也不准备骂我？不，我暂时没有犯错——那您是准备开除我了吗……以前那是别人欺负我，我当然知道。我只是以为哪里都一样。我们可以和他们不一样，对吗？
博士，您能不能帮忙看看这些调查问卷？已经收上来两小时了，我还是不敢——等等！我还没准备好接受他们说我的设计是毫无价值的……反馈良好？还给了温柔的建议？我看看！
这张照片是我爬塔时被人拍到的，后来被登在报上，还好没人发现是我……其实回想起来还是有点后怕，我恐高——但想到这辈子可能都不会再去那么高的地方，我还是把它剪下来留着了。
零号公路的通讯塔运行得很顺利，但没给我的生活带来多少改变。不甘心？这次旅程的收获比名声更重要。嘉辛塔、安洁莉娜，还有您……有了大家的信任，我会把通讯塔架设到更远的地方。
没、没什么好看的！只是一些还不成形的构想……我从前以为连通整条零号公路的通讯是异想天开，但现在，我猜我有资格幻想更多了。具体是什么？等实现的那一天，您会知道的。嘿嘿。
离家这几年我到处漂泊，家里的信总是漂了几年都到不了我手里。就算知道无可奈何，内心的失落也很难消解。现在想来，我对通讯技术着迷，就是因为一次次对回信的期待都落空了吧……
我与安洁莉娜她们的友情，是从一个谎言开始的。她们为我考虑不想旧事重提，可我知道自己不该忘记。愧疚感不总是负面情绪，它让我学会珍惜真正重要的人——那些让四处漂泊的我不再孤单的人。
是看剧、听歌，还是拼模型……再不决定，珍贵的休息时间就要结束了啦——
博士好！我是新来的通讯技术工程师，参与过的项目有雷姆必拓的远程通讯网络设计，哥、哥伦比亚的源石电磁、那个、啊——在家背得好好的，完蛋了——
战场居然比想象中复杂那么多，回去要把参数全部重新设置一遍……今晚别想睡了！
技术先锋、勤劳肯学……博士，您能不能把这些表扬的话写在晋升纪念照背后？我想寄回家里，嘿嘿。
我下阶段的目标，是思考我做的事情的实际意义，不过分关注他人的评价。对了，博士您刚才准备说我什么呀……好好奇啊——
技术终归是要走出实验室的，我……接受验证。
我会确保信号通畅——不会辜负大家的信任！
发射器接收器通讯器，请保佑我一切顺利——求求了！
各位好，本次技术升级由我来演示。请……多多包涵。
信号接收良好，完毕。
我不紧张……
能落地的才是好设计。
能应用的才是好技术。
对不起对不起，下次我一定做得更好！
超导电磁发射技术，辛苦体验一下！
源石信号切割技术，麻烦感受一下！
……您就是那个不断挑刺的家伙吧？现在您满意了吗？满意了吗！
呜哇——您知道这个实验结果我等了多少天嘛！拜仪器真的有用啊！
刚才真的好紧张！希望接下来的工作也能这样圆满地完成……
博士辛苦了，谢谢您今天的指导。刚才那些错漏的数据就留给我处理吧。
本组数据不可用，记录完毕，准备重启实验。意外地冷静？我吗？也没有啦，所谓的好心态是被无数次失败锻炼出来的。
我会尽量小心调试，如果出现信号波动、设备乱飞、小范围冒火花……请务必先和我沟通，不要投诉，拜托了——
啊，您是在和我开玩笑吗？对不起没反应过来——下次我会配合的！
这是……我的一个小发明，不介意的话请拿去试用。我会来收集反馈的……您不嫌烦的话。
明日方舟。
月末总结季末总结年终总结都凑一块儿了……博士也是？那……我们把笔放下，伸展四肢让身体与地面平行，放松眼轮匝肌，呵——啊，一年就这么一天，放纵一下吧……
博士……
博士，生日快乐。这个——不是小飞虫，是外形经过改良的信号发射器。希望能在您外出工作的时候帮得上……呃呃啊啊等等，被羽兽叼走了——对不起对不起，我马上给您重做一个！
从我出生以来，好像人生中每一次向前迈步，不是形势所迫，就是因为倒霉。但我也差不多该长大了，对吗？下一步，无论如何选择，我都会从容地、坚定地、像大人一样地向前走。

我会尽量小心调试，如果出现信号波动、设备乱飞、小范围冒火花……请务必先和我沟通，不要投诉，拜托了——
啊，您是在和我开玩笑吗？对不起没反应过来——下次我会配合的！
这是……我的一个小发明，不介意的话请拿去试用。我会来收集反馈的……您不嫌烦的话。
明日方舟。
月末总结季末总结年终总结都凑一块儿了……博士也是？那……我们把笔放下，伸展四肢让身体与地面平行，放松眼轮匝肌，呵——啊，一年就这么一天，放纵一下吧……
博士……
博士，生日快乐。这个——不是小飞虫，是外形经过改良的信号发射器。希望能在您外出工作的时候帮得上……呃呃啊啊等等，被羽兽叼走了——对不起对不起，我马上给您重做一个！
从我出生以来，好像人生中每一次向前迈步，不是形势所迫，就是因为倒霉。但我也差不多该长大了，对吗？下一步，无论如何选择，我都会从容地、坚定地、像大人一样地向前走。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%

在做体检时，医疗干员发现时隙身边一直跟着的那只羽兽并不是机械羽兽，而是一只活泼的、活生生的小羽兽，甚至还是会模仿人说话的那一种。
它在干员们的百般逗弄下一直矜持地不肯开口，直到它看到时隙因为一直眼泪汪汪而被医疗干员不断安慰不要紧张后，这只羽兽终于张了张嘴，说出了第一句话：“没出息。”
时隙眼中的泪水一下子变得更多了！
handbook.promotionRecord:
时隙仔细想了想，似乎身边这只小羽兽已经陪了自己很多年。
最开始是她小时候摔了一跤，正坐在地上哭，这只小羽兽也不太会飞，在空中被气流吹翻，正好掉到了她的头发上。也许是觉得头发的触感很不错，小羽兽就在这里安然地睡下了。当时时隙又哭了几个小时，最后天黑了才止住眼泪，一边安慰自己“阿梅利亚，你不能再没出息地哭了”一边回家。小羽兽也突然开了窍，在学会飞之前先学会了学人说话：“唧，唧唧！……没出息唧唧！”
时隙对此当然不太开心，但有这样一只小动物陪在自己身边总比一个人硬撑要强——前提是羽兽不要总在她流眼泪的时候冒出来一句“没出息”。
后来她去外面上学，本以为坐上运载车的时候这只小羽兽会被吓跑，但在学校宿舍打开包裹时，时隙看到它正翻着肚皮在呼呼大睡。在她大学毕业，校长颁发毕业证书时，小羽兽又不知从哪里冒了出来，炫耀了一下它最近刚学会的新词：“唧，真厉害唧唧！”
不过这句话小羽兽只说过这一次，时隙甚至怀疑那是不是其实是自己的一次幻听。
再到后来，不论是加班在公司过夜，还是回到最便宜的晾胡萝卜干的小出租屋里休息，这只小羽兽总是扑闪着翅膀，在她的头发里挑挑拣拣弄出一个窝，再舒舒服服地睡进去。哪怕她那天从公司偷跑出去奔波维修，哪怕她跟着安洁莉娜她们一起冲进沙暴，这只小羽兽也一直跟在她的身旁。只不过那段时间它不知是怕生还是更体贴了，很少在时隙哭的时候乱说话——也可能是那阵子让她哭的理由和平时不一样吧。
在来罗德岛时，小羽兽当然也跟了来。面对看着小羽兽吃饭喝水目瞪口呆的安洁莉娜几人，时隙终于有时间好好解释，这个之前被她们当成羽兽形态重装“小飞虫”的小东西竟然是一只活的羽兽。
不过最近时隙觉得，小羽兽似乎很少说“没出息”了，可能是因为她最近已经很少流眼泪了，可能是因为她脸上笑容又多了些。那么，什么时候小羽兽会再对她说一句“真厉害”呢？
会是明天吗？时隙有些期待。
archives:
时隙干员在刚加入工程部时拘谨了很久，经常询问自己是否要给组长或者是领导泡咖啡，要不要帮他们整理文件，在其他干员向她表示其实都不用之后仍旧心有不安。
可露希尔——这个时隙眼中的“直系大领导顶头上司”——于时隙刚完成新人培训并正式加入工程部的第二天，就带着她走进一间专门供她研究罗德岛远程通讯技术的实验室，其中各项器材一应俱全。可露希尔本人不仅认真听她磕磕绊绊讲完了自己所有的技术想法，甚至在她搭建实验环境不顺利时也跟着一起熬了一个通宵完成了工作。经历了这一切之后，时隙完全地放松下来了。
她不仅在餐厅吃饭时会和安洁莉娜说“我真喜欢这里！”，在宿舍里会和嘉辛塔还有塔妮说“在这里真开心！我想做的事情都可以做！”，就连采购部的干员都反馈说时隙购买用来擦眼泪纸巾的数量都少了很多。一切都在朝着好的方向发展，看到时隙干员变成现在这副活泼开朗的样子，大家都很开心。
但在几周后，我们再次看到了时隙干员眼含泪水，委委屈屈黯然坐在餐厅的可怜模样。人事部干员大惊失色上前询问原因，时隙忍了又忍，终于还是一边抹着眼泪一边说出了原因：
“我的工作量还有加班时间……怎么反而比之前还多了好几倍不止啊！！呜！”

【实验室监控录像】
“时隙干员，我们预约了今天参观远程通讯实验室，想问问你现在忙吗？”
“……时隙干员？”
“……时隙干员，你在吗……？”
（脚步声）
“呜、呜呜呜！
“求求你了小飞虫，求求你了法杖，求求你了通讯核心！
“快点变好吧，快点变正常吧！”
“时隙干员你怎么跪在地上！快起来快起来地上多凉啊！”
“呜呜！求求你们了快点好吧！”

【罗德岛理发室监控录像】
“一泵护发素、两泵护发素、三泵护发素、四泵护发素……！
“怎、怎么头发还是这样干巴巴的……”
“呜，没事的澄闪小姐，我的头发一直都是这样……”
“时隙小姐，请再等一等，我再去找找护发精油，我一定能让你的头发变顺滑的！
“不过时隙小姐，你的发色很好看呢，其他地方都是棕色的，只有这两根辫子还有上面的刘海是纯白的！”
“其实本来都是棕色的……可能是因为压力一大我就拽自己的辫子，所以它们就变白了……”
“啊……”

【会议室工作录像】
“时隙干员，下一个宣讲的人就是你了，请做好准备哦！”
“好、好的！
“深、深呼吸，别紧张，最后一次排练：大家好我是今天来宣讲的时隙，我的主、主题是、是……
“啊完蛋了完蛋了完蛋了！”
……
“医疗干员！医疗干员！时隙干员的脸好像完全僵住了！”

在近期干员心理健康的关怀活动中，根据这几份录像，人事部干员对时隙展开了心理咨询。内容包括她是否在罗德岛的工作中感到压力过大，是否需要帮助等等。但时隙只是在害羞和抱歉中告诉人事部干员，她觉得自己现在的状态其实比之前已经好了很多，那些举动只是她遗留下来的一些习惯。
在咨询结束，时隙离开了咨询室之后，人事部干员发现几根纤细的替换通讯天线被时隙不小心遗留在了座位上。应该是在来咨询室之前，时隙仍旧在实验室里继续着她的研究。
正如心理咨询的结果显示的那样，时隙远比她看起来要更加坚强和坚定，就像这几根小小的天线，虽然很细小，看上去总是下一秒就要折断了的样子，但它却能连通城市与城市，说不定未来也能连通国家与国家。

人事部小道消息1：纵贯红土公司新上任了一位工程总监，还是一位据他们老总说要“一月内革新远程通讯技术”的工程总监。
人事部小道消息2：现在距纵贯红土公司老总发出豪言壮语已经过去了三个月。
人事部小道消息3：纵贯红土公司工程总监被目击半夜结束加班，在路边萧索枯坐（后被证实不是结束，只是加班途中下楼透气）。

在时隙干员从纵贯红土公司辞职之后，不论是小道消息还是他们后续放出的招聘启事，都能看出他们正面临着无法实现技术迭代的困难。而本来或许可以帮上他们忙的时隙干员，现在正在我们工程部的办公室里坐着，翻看着雷姆必拓最新的报纸，上面的头条新闻是《一人修好所有通讯塔的阿梅利亚，她究竟是怎么做到的？》。
新闻内容列举了不少诸如时机实力运气等等原因，不过让时隙干员来说的话，她能做到这件事，只是因为一个孩子小小的稚嫩的愿望。
小时候的时隙每天和去矿场上班的母亲告别以后，要等整整一个白天和大半个晚上，才能和终于下班回家的母亲说她一整天的经历。而有的时候她太累了睡了过去，再醒来时她总是会忘记一两件要说的事。
等她上了学、后来又考上了大学，她要等更久，信使才能把她写的信送到矿区的母亲手上，而节俭的母亲的回信则需要更久才能送到她的手上。她总是在母亲病好了以后才知道母亲生了病，母亲也总是在她偷偷哭过了很久以后才能安慰独自在外的她。
“要是能更快一点把想说的话传递给妈妈就好了”，时隙就是怀揣着这样的愿望，从矿场到小镇，从小镇到大城市，从大城市再到工作的企业……可时间没有等待她。“我一定会出人头地，一定会成为妈妈的骄傲的。”——在二代远程通讯成功通过审核时，时隙在测试阶段给母亲的终端发送的信息。母亲已经不能再收到她的消息了，但她知道测试消息会作为初始数据一直保留在系统之中，这代表着自己努力的成果，也代表着给母亲的承诺永远也不会变，不论是十年、二十年，她都会像承诺的那样继续努力，努力成为一个更厉害的人，成为可以让母亲放心的女儿，成为一个骄傲。

“妈妈，你看，我做到了……报纸上登我的名字了！”编辑好消息，犹豫了很久之后，时隙最终摁下了发送键，发出了这条消息。

提到时隙干员在来到罗德岛以后的工作，除开她为罗德岛远程通讯做出的贡献，还有一件不得不提的事情就是她和嘉辛塔干员的创业。不过，时隙最近为此很是苦恼，她们两个人组成的“初创团队”遇到了源源不断的问题：
比如第一站拉特兰，虽然距离雷姆必拓很近，但这里的风土人情和雷姆必拓大不相同。为了让拉特兰人听一下她们的企划，两人先是不间断地品尝了八十多种甜点拉近关系，又绞尽脑汁回答了“远程通讯要是能和共感结合一下就更好了”的问题，最终得到了枢机的“会再联络”的答复。又比如为了和维多利亚的贵族接洽，两人苦学了好几天社交礼仪，更别提在萨尔贡她们还没有说两句就被拉去观摩新一轮的族长选拔、米诺斯人坚称远程通讯还不如他们长跑送信更快、哥伦比亚的企业言辞犀利地指出两人的团队“根本不具备合作的资质”……
在四处碰壁后，时隙在工程部偷偷抹眼泪苦恼应该怎样推进创业，被路过的可露希尔看到，塞给了她一本据说是呕心沥血亲自编写的大作《卖货方法论》。时隙从此开始不论吃饭还是休息都捧着这本册子不断翻阅，甚至开始拜托干员联络上拜松试图获取创业经验，诗怀雅据说也被她咨询过多次……
在不懈地努力之后，时隙干员颤颤巍巍地拿着自己和嘉辛塔准备了很多天的方案开始试讲，但比内容先出现的是她眼中的泪水。不过据路过试讲会的电弧干员说，时隙干员写的内容其实已经很不错了，听众们也在讨论过后，最终决定请诗怀雅在空闲的时间对时隙干员展开特训，力求让她拥有足以说服对方的气势。
虽然现在看上去非常不顺利，但或许有一天，我们又会多出一位大名鼎鼎的企业家也说不定呢！

modules.moduleDescription:
亲爱的妈妈：
（前略）
对不起，妈妈，我一定很让你失望。我还是没敢去报名。你说我的成绩还过得去……但我的运气一向很差。“小飞虫”起飞的成功率还很低，就算勉强飞起来了，如果它在比赛现场失控，撞飞了教授的假发，又或者（被水渍模糊的大段字迹）——你知道我一直很倒霉的。不过你说得对，我会多多观察同学和教授，看看他们是怎么解决的。
（后略）
最最亲爱的妈妈：
你一定不敢相信！寄出上封信的第二天，我就去报名比赛了~起因是一个小灵感，我改进了“小飞虫”的翅膀，把它的起飞成功率堪堪提升到了——百分之五十……然后，我尝试使用同学的方法：在腿上放《流体动力学》，把核心部件涂装的颜色改成樱桃红，数到七再按开关。我感觉到了，起飞成功率绝对比百分之五十高了那么一点！运气校正也是科学的一部分对吧，嘿嘿，我就没忍住去报名了。
（后略）
我的好妈妈：
我没有想到你会担心到特地写信给爸爸，叫他也来鼓励我。放心啦，我不是没有自信，更不是迷信！只是，如果成功和失败的可能各占一半，那我上场的时候结果绝对会变成失败的那一半。现在的我技术又不够，你让我怎么办嘛……至少，每次实验前做些小仪式会让我特别安心。那感觉有点像小时候朋友笑话我被电焊弄脏了手，你拍着我后背叫我别哭——嘿嘿。当然，我也会继续改进我的设计，你别担心。
等等，我突然想到，我在比赛场上是不能做那些多余的事的！我报名的时候怎么没想起来啊啊啊！完了……（被水渍模糊的字迹）
（后略）
妈妈！
你已经看到我随信寄来的获奖证书了吧，能顺利寄到真是太好了！你知道吗，“小飞虫”就那样在评委和观众的眼皮底下稳稳地飞起来了！把涂装改成樱桃红、在口袋里藏控制阀和早饭吃胡萝卜不吐皮果然会带来好运啊！但是……我也有那么一点点希望，会不会是我每一次改进技术，才让另外百分之五十的可能性变成了无限小？会不会，其实，用来弥补运气不足的也可以是我的技术？甚至，有没有可能，我以后，真的会有一番作为？
呜……我总是尝到一点甜头就做大梦，人还是要谦虚，要谨慎啊！但是，偶尔做做梦也是可以的，你也会陪我一起做梦的，对吧，妈妈？
……当然，小仪式还是要继续做的，技术的进步也需要运气嘛，嘿嘿。

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: 'Lens will be happy to take care of any tasks meant for Miss Scene!'

'Miss Scene has won both Nature and Still-Life categories in major photography competitions. With a patient enough subject, her chances of winning the Portrait category are likely to skyrocket as well. Doctor, would you pose for Miss Scene?'
'Evaluating patience: Doctor's levels declining. Initiating comfort protocol—Miss Scene will finish shooting in less than 30 minutes. Hold on just a bit longer, please.'
'The Zalak next door is visiting Miss Scene again. She might not be laughing yet, but I can tell she's very happy.'

'Truthfully, Miss Scene was originally set to work as a full-time photographer for a photographic equipment giant in Columbia, but somehow ended up here as an operator. Lens assesses that she likely chose to leave because they wanted her to photograph subjects she did not appreciate. Yes, indeed, Miss Scene is that picky.'
W h e n   y o u   s e e   s o m e t h i n g   y o u   l i k e ,   t a k e   a   p h o t o   a n d   s a v e   i t.

'Doctor, are you attempting to make Miss Scene laugh again? She's actually already laughing, though seeing her smile requires patience. You wait, and wait, and wait some more, until the arc of her mouth reaches absolute perfection. This process might take… TBD minutes, it all depends on Miss Scene's mood today.'

'Lens has long been waiting for someone who understands Miss Scene. Now, many at Rhodes Island are willing to approach her, and this brings Lens joy. I hope that one day, Miss Scene will find a biological entity that can perfectly replace Lens.'
T h i s   c a m e r a.   F o r   y o u.   T h a n k  y o u.   D o c t o r.
'Now Playing: D.D.D. Smash Hits'.
'Photographer, Scene, and Robotic Photography Assistant, Lens. We are pleased to make your acquaintance.'  H e l l o.
'Replay requested. Repeat: replay requested.'
'Accessory upgrade complete. Miss Scene thanks you.'
I s   t h e r e   s c e n e r y   y o u   w a n t   t o   s e e?
'Teammates' data acquired.'
'Sub-data acquired.'
'Green-light, confirmed.'
'Cruise program initiated.'
'Lens is here to serve you.'
H e r e.
'Camera rolling.'
M h m m.
'Shooting—'
'Exposure—'
'Panorama—'
'Time lapse—'
C o n g r a t s.
'Mission complete! Escorting Miss Scene back to base.'
'The route back to the base seems bumpy.'
'Evacuate immediately. Repeat: Evacuate immediately.'
'Please arrange a hammock for Miss Scene. Thank you.'
Y e a h?
W a n t   a   p h o t o?
Arknights.
I  n e e d  t o  w i s h  y o u  a  h a p p y  n e w  y e a r  m y s e l f.  H a p p y  n e w  y e a r.  'Me too! Doctor, Happy New Year! Happy New Year!'
H  e  l  l  o. 'Hello! Hi!'

H a p p y  b i r t h d a y.  T h a n k  y o u  f o r  a l w a y s  l i s t e n i n g  s o  p a t i e n t l y  t o  m e.  T h i s  i s  m y  f a v o r i t e  p i c t u r e  t h i s  y e a r.  Y o u  c a n  h a v e  i t.

'Miss Scene isn't suited to such a lively party. She would be overwhelmed. So, Lens will accompany her with a drink. Doctor, what would you like Lens to do? Lens's music library has been updated with three songs. Please press here to make a selection!'

handbook.profile: Scene, photographer, specializes in using her photography auxiliary equipment, a robotic buggy named 'Lens,' to survey the battlefield. She provides visual information and works to provide field investigation and battlefield reconnaissance services to Rhodes Island. However, Scene's athletic abilities are extremely limited, so the support of logistics operators are absolutely crucial.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 1%
There are traces of Originium infection on the legs. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
The infection status is stable and there is no visible evidence of metastasis. 

'She seems to have been infected for a while now, but her Oripathy shows no signs of acceleration. I guess slow metabolism actually helps with that. However, even though there aren't any issues with her throat, I've never heard her talk. I wonder what the problem is.' —A new medic operator
handbook.promotionRecord:
[Excerpts from an Encrypted Channel - Scene's Notes] 
'Just so everyone knows, Miss Scene is the person who has won the most accolades in the Four-Country Landscape Photography Group, consisting of Columbia, Bolívar, Sargon, and Victoria - by a wide margin as well.' 

'I wanted to play a prank on her once, but I couldn't find her the entire day. She really is good at hiding.'

'You can't poke her cheeks though. She doesn't seem to mind it too much, but her buggy will get really upset. The thing slammed into me and sent me flying.' 

'Every time I greet her, she never responds. However, her buggy will keep talking, which I find quite interesting.' 

'She's the one who took the pictures in that photo album? Can you get an autograph for me?!' 

'Bro, you'll have to get in line. She only gives out four a day.' 

'Why's that?' 

'Because each autograph takes her half an hour, and there are 12 people in line right now. What do you think?'
archives:
'Quiet and Reserved.' 
Even these adjectives aren't even particularly suitable. Operator Scene isn't just quiet and reserved, she doesn't speak at all. 
As soon as she leaves her room, you could search every nook and cranny of Rhodes Island and never find her, so the only thing to do is to wait for her to return to her dorm. 
This is when Scene's auxiliary equipment, 'Lens,' really comes in handy. Fortunately, her robotic buggy is rather clunky, and makes a lot of noise. As long as you recognize this sound, operators will be able to determine where Scene is.

Earlier in Sargon, Scene's family ordered an entire auxiliary robot team from Raythean Industries for her, and 'Lens' was the leader of her robotic photography team. 
By combining cutting-edge photographic equipment with advanced all-terrain capabilities, this auxiliary robot team became the foundation of Scene's photography career. 
Before Lens could even 'speak,' Scene came to regard Lens as her best friend, and for a completely silent person like Scene, making friends is not an easy task. Therefore, it is totally understandable that she would trust her work partner more than others. 
However, Closure said one day that 'it's better to have someone who can talk with you,' and before Scene could refuse, Closure transformed Lens into a talking photography assistant. 
According to Closure, Lens stands out from the crowd. 'It contains the previous generation of Raythean Industries' auxiliary AI. All I did was give the little guy a way to express itself. There's nothing wrong with it becoming Scene's friend. After all, nobody else can understand what Scene is thinking. What is Raythean Industries doing anyway? Even if these have been discontinued, you can't just go around selling off stuff like this. In any case, this thing is very, very rare.' 

Because of this, many people believe that Lens's habit of long-windedness actually comes from Closure. Operators have occasionally reported seeing Lens communicating with Lancet-2 in the hallway, but could not figure out what the whirring and buzzing was all about. Perhaps its built-in thinking loop actually functions like this, but this quality was put on full display after the installation of a sound device. As for what goes on in the little brain of a robot, sometimes not even the owner knows. 
Do you think that Miss Scene is ever troubled by... what happened to her old partner? 
At least up until this point, I haven't received any requests from her to uninstall the sound device.

As a child, Scene was often bullied by her peers, and her teachers basically adopted a strategy of neglecting her. This quickly pushed her out of the public school system, and since then, she has only received private education. As to why, the answer was obvious: 'Who would like to make friends with someone who takes the entire day just to say a single word?' 
The isolation she had suffered through in the classroom began to spread outwards into her social sphere. Even though she was born into a noble family in Sargon, Scene has hardly attained recognition from anyone, let alone the upper crust. 
Of course, and this may be for other reasons, Scene seems to have been born with a natural insensitivity and was never put down by the harsh words of others. Even more fortunately, she found a job that she loved — Photography. 
Very quickly, Scene amassed her own fame and wealth, along with everything else that came with it. However, she remains silent and, other than occasionally taking pictures of high-ranking officials, prefers to do her work away from the commotion of crowded areas. 
While it is true that her shyness, almost 'mechanical' movements, and her statue-like postures when stationary have brought about social difficulties, these qualities have also been immense assets towards her photography career that ordinary people simply do not have. 
Furthermore, if you are fortunate enough to see Scene working on her own robotic camera team, you might think that her usual behavior is just a result of not liking to expend energy.

Unexpectedly, Lens once told Closure about the time when Scene completely had the ability to leave the site of an impending Catastrophe.
However, in order to catch the critical moment of the Catastrophe breaking, Scene was caught inside the Catastrophe and contracted Oripathy. 
According to Lens's description, we have no idea whether Scene did this to let more people learn about Catastrophes, or if she just spellbound by the view. All we know is that she continued to stay there, weaving a masterful tale about the unfolding of a Catastrophe with her camera. 
Regardless of what happened, at least Scene survived. 
After Scene contracted Oripathy, her parents consulted several medical organizations and finally decided to send her to Rhodes Island for treatment; however, they've never contacted their daughter since then. In the face of the somewhat complicated political situation in Sargon, this kind of decision seems almost natural to some operators. 
Scene herself also doesn't seem to mind. Or if she does, she hasn't told anyone. 
It didn't take long before she started to apply for the qualifications to work in the field, and even wanted to accompany operators to the battlefield in order to shoot more images. This means that Scene may be involved in battle, and possibly even lose her life. 
But she didn't let that dissuade her. Lens is very proud to say that the places they've been to have been far worse than what people in Rhodes Island can imagine, and the dangers they've encountered are far more terrifying than what they now are dealing with. 
While Scene may have already honed her skills and be able to calmly face the doubts of others, another interpretation is that she might just be very dedicated to her trade. She believes that through her eyes and her lens, she can help others who are more sensitive to images than they are to words, just like her, see more and more of the world. 
Scene very rarely says anything, but she did speak once with her dorm mates when discussing her family. She said, she believes in Lens, and deems the robot to be part of her family.
Also, she said that she believes in her parents. If her parents didn't love her, they never would've raised her in the way they did—
'Everything we are born with in life is meaningful, but you are the only one who can discover that meaning. As long as you'll go do it, we will support you.' 
Even though Scene doesn't express it, she may perhaps be very happy now. 
By the way, how did Closure manage to get a sample of Scene's voice to build Lens's audio library?! 
......
What? Does Scene use Lens to speak for her sometimes? 
Hmm, how do I know whether the one talking to me
is Lens,
or if it is actually Scene talking? 
If I had to guess? 
Let's see.......

modules.moduleDescription:
Scene is slowly moving toward her objective on her comfy little 'chair.'
Her 'chair' is formed of two mobile photography platforms moving in parallel with a wooden plank placed in-between.
Lens finds this actually rather interesting. According to the data stored in its program, you would at least need a cushion and an ergonomic backrest for something to qualify as a chair.
However, if Scene has no qualms with this being a chair, then Lens is certainly in no position to complain.
'How much longer?'
Scene asks in her usual, sluggish tone.
'Only 200 meters more! We'll be there soon!'
Although it had figured out what its owner was going to say long ago, out of courtesy and respect, Lens waited until Scene actually asked the question to reply.
'Oh.'
Scene returns to her silence.
This morning, Scene noticed a small hill as she relaxed on Rhodes Island's top deck. Although it does not compare to Sargon's tall mountains, the path they are on has nothing but flat plains, making the unexpected mountain a sight for sore eyes for Scene.
She firmly believed she would be able to take photos of the most breathtaking sceneries on that hill.
So, driven by her impulse, she immediately had Lens take care of the paperwork and borrowed a car and a few helping hands to race to the hill. This is quite the urgent issue to her, it seems.
Although there is still a ways to go before she reaches her destination, Scene has already started to think about everything:
The angle, the lighting, the colors, and the ratio.
These are questions that Scene is almost always thinking about as she goes about her everyday life.
This is her profession as well as her hobby.
'We are almost there, Miss Scene. The destination is right ahead, past those rocks! But neither the cameras nor I can climb any further. I am afraid you may have to walk the rest of the way.'
'Okay.'
Scene slowly slides down from her 'chair.'
She readies her camera and slowly makes her way up.
Step by step.
Bit by bit.
The sunlight at last reaches her eyes, revealing the world before her—
She still remembers how warm the sunshine was as it lands on her cheeks and how cool the breeze was as it brushed her arms.
She remembers the fowlbeasts' melodies, the fragrance of the flowers, the crudeness of the rocks.
The greenery extends endlessly until it reaches the blue sky.
Rays of lights pierce through the clouds up above.
Scene is always working on the composition of her photos in her head.
Yet when the scenery actually opens up before her eyes, thinking only serves to distract her from the task at hand. All she has to do is chronicle the view before her faithfully.
Raise the camera and press the shutter button.
That's all photography involves—
And what an enjoyable experience it is.
*Ka-chick*.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Hi, Doc. Have you eaten yet? Here, I got some cookies if you're hungry.

Doc, I know Aak's been a nuisance to you, but could you be lenient with him? He teases people a lot, but he's not a bad person. Also, let me know if he ever gets under your skin, I'll give him a lesson on that.
Just call on me when you're hungry, Doc, and I'll make you a little something to eat. I may not look a like a chef, but I did learn a recipe or two from Mr. Lee.
Say, Doc, do you give any lectures on machines here at Rhodes Island? I've got an interest in that stuff and was hoping I could learn something new.
Hahah, just between you and me, Doc, for the longest time I thought all detectives do the same stuff as Mr. Lee. You know, taking sips of tea at the scene of gang fights, that sort of thing.

I'm sure you already know, but with the intellect and talent that Aak's got, he's destined for great things one day. But personally, all that matters to me is that he doesn't ever go back to what he used to be.

Me and Mr. Lee, well... How should I put it... I was a bit scared of him at first. He seemed like a clever guy who's got a lot going on, which had me on edge... But now after knowing him for so many years, I know I have nothing to worry about, haha.
Hey, Doc, If you need info on something or someone, just tell me and I'll ask Mr. Lee for you. Nothing in Lungmen happens without him knowing about it.

To be honest with you, I actually don't like getting into fights. I'd much rather we could all get along with each other. But I won't back down from inevitable conflicts; there are things I'll fight to protect. Things like the agency, and now, Rhodes Island as well.
Do– Phew, almost woke the Doc up... Guess I'll take this opportunity to rest too.

You must be the doctor that Mr. Lee talked about. The name's Hung, it's a pleasure to meet you. My fields of expertise are security and repairing machinery. If you ever need a bodyguard for a public appearance, or if your TV or fridge break down, just give me a holler!
Woah, your operators never cease to amaze me... I've got to work harder.
Thanks, Doc! I'll be giving it 110% from here on out!
Doc, don't hesitate to give me all the work you need done. I might not have the brain for many things, but I've got the brawn!
A mission? I'm ready whenever.
I personally guarantee everyone's safety.
Stay close behind so we don't get split up.
Don't worry, you've got me.
I'll handle this!
Where am I needed?
I'll cover you!
I'm here to protect you all!
You shall not pass!
Anyone need healing?
You're not hurting anyone on my watch!
A little scratch ain't gonna stop me!
*pant*... *pant*... Sorry, Doc, but could you give me a minute? I'm totally burned out.
You can stay here and rest, Doc. I'll clean up the battlefield.
Stay beside me, Doc. There are still enemies around.
Hurry, Doc, climb onto my back! I'm getting you out of here!
Leave patrol duty to me.
Any broken machines need fixing?
Sup, Doc? Anything I can help you with?
Arknights.
Happy New Year, Doc! ...I'm in a good mood? Haha, of course, who wouldn't be in a good mood during a pleasant time like the New Year? Anyway, I'll be counting on you this year as well.
Morning, Doc.

Doc! Birthdays are big days that shouldn't be muddled through. You've got to celebrate right! If there's anything you want me to make, just name it! ...Sitting here with you? Is that it? Um, okay... guess I'll save those groceries I bought for another time...

Doc, congrats on making it through another year. Aak's a lot more steady than he was a year ago, and now he knows the right path to take. Waai Fu? She hasn't needed me to worry about her for a long time. By the way, Doc, it looks like Rhodes Island is holding a dinner party. Anywhere you might need me?

To be honest with you, I actually don't like getting into fights. I'd much rather we could all get along with each other. But I won't back down from inevitable conflicts; there are things I'll fight to protect. Things like the agency, and now, Rhodes Island as well.
Do– Phew, almost woke the Doc up... Guess I'll take this opportunity to rest too.

You must be the doctor that Mr. Lee talked about. The name's Hung, it's a pleasure to meet you. My fields of expertise are security and repairing machinery. If you ever need a bodyguard for a public appearance, or if your TV or fridge break down, just give me a holler!
Woah, your operators never cease to amaze me... I've got to work harder.
Thanks, Doc! I'll be giving it 110% from here on out!
Doc, don't hesitate to give me all the work you need done. I might not have the brain for many things, but I've got the brawn!
A mission? I'm ready whenever.
I personally guarantee everyone's safety.
Stay close behind so we don't get split up.
Don't worry, you've got me.
I'll handle this!
Where am I needed?
I'll cover you!
I'm here to protect you all!
You shall not pass!
Anyone need healing?
You're not hurting anyone on my watch!
A little scratch ain't gonna stop me!
*pant*... *pant*... Sorry, Doc, but could you give me a minute? I'm totally burned out.
You can stay here and rest, Doc. I'll clean up the battlefield.
Stay beside me, Doc. There are still enemies around.
Hurry, Doc, climb onto my back! I'm getting you out of here!
Leave patrol duty to me.
Any broken machines need fixing?
Sup, Doc? Anything I can help you with?
Arknights.
Happy New Year, Doc! ...I'm in a good mood? Haha, of course, who wouldn't be in a good mood during a pleasant time like the New Year? Anyway, I'll be counting on you this year as well.
Morning, Doc.

Doc! Birthdays are big days that shouldn't be muddled through. You've got to celebrate right! If there's anything you want me to make, just name it! ...Sitting here with you? Is that it? Um, okay... guess I'll save those groceries I bought for another time...

Doc, congrats on making it through another year. Aak's a lot more steady than he was a year ago, and now he knows the right path to take. Waai Fu? She hasn't needed me to worry about her for a long time. By the way, Doc, it looks like Rhodes Island is holding a dinner party. Anywhere you might need me?

archives:
This easygoing Perro is a large man.
To be honest, others can tell from a glance that he is a kind-hearted person despite his massive size. He is always considerate of others, and gets along very well with just about anybody.

Though Hung is quite humble, his superb cooking speaks for itself.
Anyone who has seen his culinary arts has showered him with praise.
As a native of Lungmen, he specializes in the area's local cuisine. In addition to being able to elevate ordinary home cooking to delicious heights, he also can concoct haute cuisine that otherwise only appears in five-star restaurants.
Surprisingly, according to his own accounts, his cooking is entirely inherited from Mr. Lee, which really makes one wonder... Just what kind of culinary monstrosity is Mr. Lee?

According to his own recollection, Hung first worked as a guard for a certain company, but his easygoing personality made him prone to bullying, eventually getting him kicked from the company. He was then invited to the agency by Mr. Lee when he was suffering from hunger and never again can he leave the business. (Note: This description was from Hung himself)
Regarding Mr. Lee and Lee's Detective Agency, while it is not suitable to describe the scope of business in detail, here is a brief summary: Lee's Detective Agency only takes investigative cases as a front, while actually accepting just about any type of work. They are known as the 'House of Everything' within Lungmen's gray zone.
According to his description of Mr. Lee, we can conclude that Lee concealed a darker secret from Hung. Though it is obvious that Hung is kind-hearted, he is no pedantic old man. He knows very well that you can't talk things through with everyone, and not every story can have a happy ending.

Hung rescued Aak from the aftermath of a gang war, at which point the two assumed their codenames. According to Mr. Lee, he chose the names on a whim at that time.
Hung treats Aak and Waai Fu as his younger brother and sister. In fact, Hung doubles as the liaison between Lee's Detective Agency and Rhodes Island, or in other words, serves as the guardian for the other two operators.
Of course, that title is also nominal in nature, since Waai Fu and Aak are both sufficiently autonomous. That being the case, unless Hung himself makes a request, Rhodes Island will not deliberately arrange them to live together or to work together.
Nevertheless, Hung's worries about his younger brother are evident through his conversations with the Doctor. He wanted Aak to see the kindness in the world, but did not know how to do so himself, and so he chose to stay with him.
Even though he hasn't realized it yet, despite Aak's somewhat nasty personality, Aak has fundamentally been influenced by Hung.

modules.moduleDescription:
Every day at half past six, Hung turns on the TV and begins to prep the day's dinner to the tune of a wuxia drama's deathblows and battlecries. There were tremendous lines at the hypermarket today, and it's already past seven by the time he gets back, with the wuxia on TV long since over. But he leaves it on out of habit anyway, and shuffles over to the kitchen to cook.
The meat's red and tender; Hung decides he'll mince it and mix in fresh spring onion, planning to fill two tiers of buns. With the meat neatly stacked on the cutting board, Hung picks up a kitchen cleaver in each hand and assumes the Meat-Chopping Stance, when suddenly a mournful wail comes from the living room TV.
'You've fallen into my hands, Zhong Dafa! You know your blood debt. It's time you finally repaid me!'
The cleaver drops with a bang, not into the meat, but straight into the cutting board. Hung shakes his ears—he only hears intermittent gasps and sobs. With no clue about what's going on, he continues the work at hand. A short while later, he tosses the filling into a bowl, and is just about to pour in a few drops of sesame oil when—
'Stop, Dacai! You can't kill him! The truth is, he's your brother!'
'Huh?' Hung abruptly lifts his head in disbelief, face blanketed with confusion, beginning to suspect he just heard wrong. More voices immediately follow.
'Ma, how can that be? I don't believe you!'
'When I divorced your ba, we each took a child. We never thought it would lead to a mess like this.'
Hung wrinkles his brows, squeezes the bottle of sesame oil, and barely gives it a single shake, only for way too much to pour out, and the bowl of mincemeat to smell to high heaven of sesame. He heaves a sigh and lays the rolled-out pieces of dough in his hand to wrap the buns, all while his ears stand attentively pricked, as if hoping to catch whatever audible clues the television might make next.
'Hmph. No need to hesitate, Zhou Dacai. Just do it.'
'Ma, what do I—what do I do...'
The buns he is pleating shut are incredibly lopsided, and he finally stops what he's doing and devotes his full attention to the ensuing conversation. Unfortunately, however, someone seems to have changed the channel, and the TV is now playing video game noises, with Waai Fu and Aak's clamorous voices reaching Hung's ears soon after, followed shortly by the sound of Lee coming in. Hung shakes his head and smiles, and places the uniquely shaped buns inside the already-boiling steamers.
The clock's hour hand has been on eight for a while now, and Hung gently uncovers the steamers, the clouds of billowing steam revealing the plump white meat buns before him, as the filling's scallion scent slyly wafts from the kitchen and spreads through the living room, subconsciously luring the people towards it and the table.
There'll always be people who say eight o'clock in Lungmen is for the eight o'clock sitcoms, but Hung knows what eight o'clock is truly for—the little round dining table, with his folks sat huddled in a circle.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, where are you going? Shouldn't you be working? Lunch? Well then, I'm coming along. There's a few things I want to buy, and I can also keep a lookout for you.

Sorry, Doctor, Rhodes Island is just a part-time job for me. I have to study hard to make sure I have a nice, normal future ahead of me. If you plan to have me aboard and on 24-hour call… Well, I'll have to ask you reconsider that.

I color coded all the documents to be sent out, the backups have already been delivered, your schedule is right here. I bought your late night snack and put it in the refrigerator. Don't forget to heat it up. And last, oh, do you need me to change the light bulb in your office for you?

Did I ever tell you about my other job? No? Well, I won't. Don't look at me like that, Doctor. There's just not much to say. If my other office worked a tenth as hard as Rhodes Island does, they'd probably have become the only detective agency in Lungmen.

You wonder where I learned martial arts? Well, I have my old codger and his weird education to thank for that. Not that I resent kung fu. Martial arts should always be a part of me if I hope to uphold justice.

Just like how people value morality, martial arts have yin and yang, right and wrong. To right those wrongs, to defeat evil, to counter bad kung fu, these are all second nature to me. The world is dark, and someone must stand for justice.

You think you just saw me? In downtown Lungmen? That may have been me. I just finished class. Hm? You saw me beat down some thugs who were harassing a passerby? And then slipped away before the police arrived? Must have been someone else. Heh heh. Definitely. You were just seeing things, that's it.

My rotten dad said he had to go find the true meaning of kung fu before he went off, and I still don't know where he is. Please! What year does he think it is? Find some common sense and learn some responsibility before you get yourself killed. But at least I haven't forgotten what he taught me: 'Martial arts have martial virtue, humans have human kindness.'

Doctor, did any mail come for me? It did? Great. These are my grades... my very important grades! It's been straight A's for me, so far. If I don't work hard enough, I'll end up regretting all the things I wasn't strong enough to do.
Falling asleep at a time like this... Oh well, I'll just finish your work for you.
Is this Rhodes Island? Nice to meet you. I'm Waai Fu, your new part-timer. Please don't go easy on me. I can handle anything you ask of me. Yes, just give me the word.
If I can fight like this here, I can definitely knock them out.
Thank you very much, Doctor. You placed your trust in me, and I won't let you down.

I often witness injustices in my life. If I ever find myself unable to stop them, I reflect on the moment, and force myself to get stronger. So, if ever you need me, don't hesitate to say so. I'll be there, with all my strength!
More evil to fight against?
I have much to learn, but I won't turn down the responsibility.
Fight evil with the fist of justice!
Like cutting weeds and pulling roots!
Yes!
Go ahead!
A last resort.
All right!
You have crossed the line too far!
Pick on someone your own size!
Don't blink! Song Do Bart Cham style!
The mind directs, the fist executes!
Foul intentions lead a foul life. Repent now. There is still time.
A strong will conquers all.
That was not enough. I need to train more.
Father... I'm still... not strong enough.
At least it's better than some old, messy detective agency.
An ambush...?! ...Doctor, don't you ever sneak up on me like that again. Now let's get you to Medical first.
You want to go for a walk? Sure, let's get going. It's safer to have me with you.
Arknights.

Doctor, happy holidays. I—I was just taking a walk. I haven't had Hung's food in forever, so the moment I slip up... It really does take a strong will to resist temptation, I still need more training... Doctor, it's not too late yet. Let's go train together!
Care for some tea, Doctor?

Doctor, happy birthday to you! Please, take this present. It's a wooden dummy. 'When seeking the way, the greatest fear is to have no master nor opponent,' so to us who wish to be martial artists, it's both an opponent and a master. Alright, let me teach you how to train with it!

Working for Rhodes Island has been valuable practical experience for me. I've learned a great deal. But I think I need more experience still, before I can decide whether or not I should stay. Whatever the future brings, I believe you and I are fighting for justice.

handbook.profile: Waai Fu is a university student from Lungmen, serving Rhodes Island from the first batch of employees hired under a secret Lungmen-Rhodes Island commercial agreement. On the recommendation of a certain firm, she took a battery of tests that showed scores wildly inconsistent with her stated identity. She clearly has substantial combat experience. Several investigations are ongoing.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there are no other signs of infection. At this time, this operator can be confirmed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Waai Fu shows no signs of Oripathy infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Waai Fu rarely interacts with Originium or its byproducts, and has a healthier physique than the average citizen. Although there is no relationship between one's physique and susceptibility to Oripathy... 
Hey, this young lady can jump between buildings and punch through a wall with her bare fists. Makes sense she's in good shape, eh? 
——Mr. Aak, who happened to pass by
handbook.promotionRecord:
'Dad, where are you going?' 
'I have to find something.' 
'Dad... don't go! I don't want to lose you, Dad!' 
'Want to see me? Then catch me!' 
'But I... How can I...?' 
'If you can't, then you're not my daughter. You must be strong!' 

Too selfish, father. 
But I can. 
In fact, I'll do it better than you ever could. I train harder than you. I'll be stronger than you.
archives:
When Waai Fu presented her recommendation to Human Resources, most of the reviewing operators had low expectations. Considering how often they see strong-looking, adventurous types show up with an air of danger, only to emerge bruised, battered, and reduced to tears by tests both physical and psychological. 
But Waai Fu came through the psychological tests with a stable disposition. Some operators assumed this was just a fluke, until she swiftly put two operators on the floor in her combat tests, drawing attention to her potential. 
Of course, these tests are only the beginning of the onboarding process.

Fear of the Infected is an expected response. Suffice it to say that if an ordinary person finds it easy to enter a group of Infected, they had either a peculiar upbringing or some as yet unknown secrets. 
In other words, the Infected are used to instilling fear in the uninfected. Such is the result of a world that treats them so. 
After learning of Rhodes Island and our work with the Infected, Waai Fu exhibited a degree of confusion. 
She hesitated when Instructor Dobermann, who is Infected, reached out to her politely. 
However, not grounds for Rhodes Island to reject an applicant. On the contrary, it is a normal reaction worth recording: real, natural and cruel. 

Waai Fu took Instructor Dobermann's hand. 
She said that upon learning of Rhodes Island's experiment that demonstrated how everyday exposure does not facilitate the spread of Oripathy, all that remained for her to do was adapt. 
'It is not habit that controls a person, but prejudice.' 
Operator Waai Fu answered Instructor Dobermann's question intensely. 
Instructor Dobermann rarely shows emotion, but this time she came out beaming.

Waai Fu has much going for her, from her impressive physique to her extraordinary, if quirky, combat techniques, all the way to her academic qualifications (She's still in school! Did you even read her resume?!), commendable work ethic, practical experience, and so much more. 
While she is quite young, Waai Fu commands the respect of many operators because she possesses that most important virtue in any good Rhodes Islander: tolerance 
This is not to say she is always walking on eggshells. If asked to describe Waai Fu in brief, most operators would probably describe her as a punisher of wrongdoing. 
Waai Fu is known to actively investigate the causes and effects of certain incidents. In some situations, such as disciplinary violations, she steps in to stop them at once. In others, such as outbursts of psychological issues some operators struggle with, she will focus on harm reduction. 
'If right and wrong were so easy to tell apart, nothing would ever go wrong.' 
Of course it's wrong to steal property from the Doctor's office. Please don't provoke Waai Fu again! Running in the corridors is dangerous! The medic operators are already overworked as it is! 

Waai Fu unquestionably fills a role Rhodes Island needs. Even though she considers her work here to be only 'part-time,' her effective performance and competent communication can be described as nothing short of excellent. 
When asked about herself, it is difficult to get Waai Fu to speak about anything other than her martial arts and the dark and messy detective office that recommended her to Rhodes Island, as well as her 'ordinary daily life.' She will disclose her personal career goals only on rare, formal occasions—— 
'I want to be the kind of person who can help people.' 
Perhaps... a bit too broad.

Is everyone here? 
First off, let me congratulate all of us here in Human Resources on a job well done. This past month has been stellar, and I think we've all earned a nice meal. On me, as always! 
Now then, I have something to discuss, pertaining to the exchange agreement between Lungmen and Rhodes Island. The first round of applicant review falls on us. We do very important work here! 
Even those of you most familiar with Rhodes Island's regulations will sometimes get confused by some wording or something, right? I know there's one line, hm, it's pretty long in the original, but paraphrased—— 
'Should an operator fail to meet the needs of Rhodes Island, regardless of motivation or action, they are ineligible for onboarding. Conversely, should an operator appear with an origin or background subject to some scrutiny, as long as they meet our needs and strictly abide by our rules, they remain eligible...' 
Something like that! The original text is very dry and very long, so I won't go over it all right now. 
Does anyone feel the need to ask 'why?' Let me provide a simple example. 

Say there is some remarkable individual who comes highly recommended, with a remarkable set of personal ideals. In order to see their ideals realized, they sacrificed many people, destroyed entire cities, and ultimately succeeded. 
No matter how great this individual or their ideals, Rhodes Island cannot accept them. We would be nothing but a platform for such a person. 
Then we have another individual, who has their share of problems. The things they do and the ways they do them may seem a bit unreasonable to us. This person submits a resume to Rhodes Island.—— 
Sit down! I know you're all eager to say 'we already have a lot of operators like that!' And there are indeed some! 
Think for a minute how many things happen each and every day in the many cities of the world. Can we settle them all ourselves? 
When an operator subjectively plans an action that would harm Rhodes Island's ideas, that operator is immediately expelled. When an operator intentionally violates Rhodes Island's rules and regulations, that operator may be eliminated before they can cause material harm. 
Even if! Even if the regulations are as they are, Rhodes Island has never once done such a thing, we have never seen such an action. Oh, not counting private wire connections. You can blame Closure for those! 
The adjudication of whether or not an operator is eligible is dependent on his will, not his rap sheet. 
Rhodes Island has the ability to observe and study its operators while also maintaining its rules and regulations. At Rhodes Island, some operators are at last able to achieve what they'd always hoped to do. 
As long as we maintain contact with them, we will respect their choices, within reason, and never force them to act against their own will. 
Sometimes, when there remains no other choice, such a thing may come to pass. 
I hope everyone understands this, just as they understand the Infected, and Rhodes Island's mission statement. 

For all candidates, the most important thing is to find them their place at Rhodes Island, and to acknowledge Rhodes Island. 
We must adhere to this in processing the applicants under this exchange agreement. Understood? 
Ah, of course, the Waai Fu girl we just approved is perfectly fine. 
'——When one is committed to constant reflection and tempering of his ideals, we are willing to serve as his forge. The bumps in this road, whether mine or yours... We will cross them together with our operators.' 
I hope you all appreciate this quote from Theresa. 

 ——Record of ■■■'s lunch meeting.

modules.moduleName: The Classic of Hung Mei Wing Chun
modules.moduleDescription:
The year she turned five, Waai Fu was taken to a study by her father. A few massive bookshelves filled the room totally full, all sorts of old books all over them, ancient records from all manner, ways and styles of martial arts. 
'Choose one, learn it. In three months, show it to me.' 
Waai Fu—still not able to read too many words—spent a while hesitating, then selected a book from the shelves caked in dust, with 'The Classic of Hung Mei Wing Chun' written on the cover. Waai Fu had no clue what kind of technique this was, or what characterized it. She simply thought it had a very nice name. 
Her father hadn't given her a single pointer, so Waai Fu had to pore over the books by herself. Yes, she didn't understand the words too well, but the phrases in there—'wicked walks vengeance heady; just employs mind and soul' and the like—flew completely over her head. But she still followed the movements in the pictures, practicing punch after punch, step after step. Assiduous, not allowing an inch of slack. 
Three months later, before her father, Waai Fu finished demonstrating the whole set of techniques, three-hundred-and-twenty-seven moves in all, flowing like nature, not a single one missed. But once her father finished watching, he furrowed his brows and sighed a rough sigh. 
'No. No good. Try again.' 
Waai Fu didn't know why, but had no alternative but to listen. 
One year later, her father began to take Waai Fu through some simple fighting exercises. He clearly didn't give it much strength, but Waai Fu still found herself caught out again and again, and every time, her father's fists would never pull back as they landed on her. 
Waai Fu didn't understand. Clearly she knew every move by heart, but why couldn't she make fluent use of them? She decided to look within the manual again for answers, and after several times parsing from cover to cover, she finally found, in one unremarkable corner, a phrase. 
'Ways aloft may decree, but man is what makes change.' 
And a few more years later, Waai Fu could recite that book in her sleep, the tomes now shelved in a nook of her room, rarely flipped through anymore. In her training, too, her father came to chide her less and less, and she felt he was becoming less strict than he was before. But suddenly, her father left home. He left behind a pair of daggers, and a single phrase. 
'I must go and find something.' 
Waai Fu was unable to comprehend just what could be worth her father abandoning her, abandoning this home, to search for. It was only a few days after that Waai Fu left home too, to live somewhere different. 
While tidying her room, she again saw the manual, and offhandedly, flipped through it. From start to end, page by page, it was like her past lay before her. She found, at the very end of the very last tome, clearly written: 'Martiality asks mastery, this only from thorough training. With no purpose and no self, there is no boundary and no end.' 
'You're right, father. I'll catch up to you, and become stronger than you.'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, do you need my help transporting anything?
This noisy metal music… Exusiai must be throwing another party. Doctor, should I go nudge her?
I'm quite good with manual labor. I also know a bit about company management. So, Doctor, is there anywhere I can be of use?
My parents were the first generation to settle in Lungmen, so I'm actually a Lungmen native… Doctor, if there's anything you'd like to know about the place, I wouldn't mind helping you out.

Doctor, if you want to know how a real logistics company operates, it'd be best to just ask me directly. Penguin Logistics is more of an exception than the rule, and though I don't mean this in a bad way, they won't make for a good reference at all.

What do I like to do outside of work? Besides just resting, I'll sometimes go with Croissant on her shopping trips, help her carry stuff, and make sure she doesn't waste too much money… Want to join us, Doctor?

I used to believe that for any company to survive in the long run, standardization and efficiency were critically important. That's why at first, I couldn't fathom how a company like Penguin Logistics could stay afloat.

After getting to know more about the people at Penguin Logistics and talking to them, I began to understand that the world is much broader than I had thought. There's nothing wrong with structure and rules, but they don't necessarily apply to everyone.
Doctor, perhaps you haven't realized this yourself, but to unite such a diverse group of people under your banner, that's no simple feat… It'd be great if I could become more like you one day.
Doctor… Oh, it's your nap time. Guess I'll tidy up this place for now.
Pleased to meet you, Doctor. My name is Bison. According to the terms of our contract, I'm now also an employee of Rhodes Island. I look forward to working with you.
Thank you very much. I will make sure to learn from this.
Thank you very much, Doctor. I believe that as long as I put my best foot forward, my hard work will be rewarded.
With Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I've seen a more expansive world than I knew… Doctor, one day, I will also find my place in this world.
A mission? Understood.
On-site command… I have some experience with that.
Yes, I've noted the mission location and objectives.
Phew… I'll get my job done.
What would you like me to do?
Is it my turn, Doctor?
I'll do my best.
Got it.
I'll hold my ground.
Hang in there a bit longer? Understood.
Don't worry, my shield still holds firm.
Way to go, Doctor! You're the kind of leader any company would want to hire.
Wow, Doctor! You really are amazing.
The basic objectives of the mission have been accomplished. This should be good enough, right?
Don't feel down, Doctor. We'll have another chance.
So this is the inside of Rhodes Island… It sure is big.
Where should I go?
Sora's new album is really good.
Arknights.

It's New Year's, so on behalf of MountainDash Logistics, I'm sending formal greetings to Rhodes Island. May everything go well for Rhodes Island's employees, and may you be safe and sound in the coming year. Also, here's a personal card from me to you, Doctor, to wish you a Happy New Year. To another great year working together.
Good morning, Doctor!

Doctor, happy birthday. Please try this bowl of long life noodles. All ingredients have been chosen with care. It has wheat from Yan, steak from Ursus, and the broth is Iberian ham. It took me months to put together, and it was still a rush to get everything in on time. I hope you like it.

My father says the most precious thing to a business is pulling everyone together under the same ideal. At Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I've seen that cohesion for myself. I have to learn from yours and Emperor's examples, in that regard.

JP.voiceText: Doctor, do you need my help transporting anything?
This noisy metal music… Exusiai must be throwing another party. Doctor, should I go nudge her?
I'm quite good with manual labor. I also know a bit about company management. So, Doctor, is there anywhere I can be of use?
My parents were the first generation to settle in Lungmen, so I'm actually a Lungmen native… Doctor, if there's anything you'd like to know about the place, I wouldn't mind helping you out.

Doctor, if you want to know how a real logistics company operates, it'd be best to just ask me directly. Penguin Logistics is more of an exception than the rule, and though I don't mean this in a bad way, they won't make for a good reference at all.

What do I like to do outside of work? Besides just resting, I'll sometimes go with Croissant on her shopping trips, help her carry stuff, and make sure she doesn't waste too much money… Want to join us, Doctor?

I used to believe that for any company to survive in the long run, standardization and efficiency were critically important. That's why at first, I couldn't fathom how a company like Penguin Logistics could stay afloat.

After getting to know more about the people at Penguin Logistics and talking to them, I began to understand that the world is much broader than I had thought. There's nothing wrong with structure and rules, but they don't necessarily apply to everyone.
Doctor, perhaps you haven't realized this yourself, but to unite such a diverse group of people under your banner, that's no simple feat… It'd be great if I could become more like you one day.
Doctor… Oh, it's your nap time. Guess I'll tidy up this place for now.
Pleased to meet you, Doctor. My name is Bison. According to the terms of our contract, I'm now also an employee of Rhodes Island. I look forward to working with you.
Thank you very much. I will make sure to learn from this.
Thank you very much, Doctor. I believe that as long as I put my best foot forward, my hard work will be rewarded.
With Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I've seen a more expansive world than I knew… Doctor, one day, I will also find my place in this world.
A mission? Understood.
On-site command… I have some experience with that.
Yes, I've noted the mission location and objectives.
Phew… I'll get my job done.
What would you like me to do?
Is it my turn, Doctor?
I'll do my best.
Got it.
I'll hold my ground.
Hang in there a bit longer? Understood.
Don't worry, my shield still holds firm.
Way to go, Doctor! You're the kind of leader any company would want to hire.
Wow, Doctor! You really are amazing.
The basic objectives of the mission have been accomplished. This should be good enough, right?
Don't feel down, Doctor. We'll have another chance.
So this is the inside of Rhodes Island… It sure is big.
Where should I go?
Sora's new album is really good.

basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there are no other signs of infection. At this time, this operator can be confirmed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Bison shows no signs of Oripathy infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.15u/L
Occasional contact with Originium due to work reasons, such as entering and exiting environments with slight Originium presence. Thanks to flawless personal protection measures, there are no signs of infection.
handbook.promotionRecord:
Due to certain circumstances, Rhodes Island had brief contact with Mr. Eurill Pides, the current CEO and head of MountainDash Logistics.
There is no doubt that Mr. Eurill is very fond of his son. Ever since Mr. Eurill's wife, Bison's mother, was admitted to Rim Billiton for medical reasons, Mr. Eurill arranged for Bison to enter the company. In the 10-or-so minutes of the meeting, Mr. Eurill's topics virtually all revolved around the topic of his son.
However, Mr. Eurill seems to be very satisfied with Bison's current arrangements with Rhodes Island. For whatever reason, Mr. Eurill seems to have no intention of bringing Bison back to MDL - as a matter of fact, he doesn't even want his son back at his side too early.
The only time was when Mr. Eurill invited Bison to visit his mother, who had only just returned from treatment in Lungmen. The overly formal letter drew a sharp contrast with Mr. Eurill's daily image, making it seem as if this wasn't a family letter at all. However, only after seeing Bison's equally formal reply did everyone realize that yes, like father, like son.
archives:
Also known as the 'Young Master', and the Director of MDL, this youthful messenger is responsible for the coordination between MountainDash Logistics and Penguin Logistics.
Despite his age, he gives off an air of reliability. In fact, he has a very rich work experience, and knows the logistics industry like the back of his hand.
However, outsiders often see him as 'the poor whipping boy of Penguin Logistics.'
Compared to Penguin Logistics, whose members are known to all have very distinctive personalities, Bison gives off the impression of being closer to the public's stereotypical transporter, calmly and safely delivering goods and information to the intended destinations.
According to him, cooperating with Penguin Logistics has made him realize his own shortcomings, but at the same time, profoundly shook his understanding of the logistics industry.

At one point, MountainDash Logistics almost monopolized the entire private logistics industry in Lungmen, spreading its influence across the whole land at the same time. The founder of this behemoth was Bison's father.
As a result of this special status, Bison received an elite education at an early age and joined the workforce while many of his peers got to enjoy a carefree childhood. From this, one can imagine why Bison displays such maturity and reliability despite his years, and the hard work that went into that. Bison's addition to MDL undoubtedly paved the foundation for the cooperation between MDL and Rhodes Island. He also temporarily worked in Penguin Logistics, and made invaluable contributions that set the stage for good relationships between the three parties.
It is often said that were it not for Bison's reliability and responsibility in spearheading the logistics industry, some Operators would continue to use the 'Penguin Logistics method' to complete their work. As a result, we must give thanks to Bison for his efforts.

Regarding his work as a messenger, Bison's steady work ethic does not just greatly eclipse that of his peers, but does not falter even in comparison to veterans who have been deeply involved within the industry. Whether conducting external operations or conducting consultations on civil work, Bison's thoughtful actions have greatly benefited both Rhodes Island as an organization, and young Operators who see him as a role model.
However, those who have known him longer will point out that it is not hard to see his more naïve, adolescent side. Though scarcely seen, Bison will unabashedly show his fascination towards the world in the face of the scenery of the North, the Laterano Church, or the wide deserts of Siracusa.
Before his father founded MDL, the young Bison accompanied his father through countless different lands. Perhaps at that time, the desire to become a transporter had already taken root within his heart. However, after the establishment of MDL, more and more responsibilities were piled upon his head, giving him no room to breathe - until he met Penguin Logistics.
'It sounded like an interesting turning point, but after working with them, the gulf between us felt impossible to describe with words.'

Mr. Emperor is incredibly capable, and also full of mysteries... Just think about it, letting Penguin Logistics operate the way it does but still managing to stay afloat is already an amazing feat! Don't you think so?
Exusiai? Hmm... There are many things I'd like to address with her, but she's not going to listen anyway.'
'Texas is their team leader, right? Even though her tendency to snack on junk food could use quite a bit of correction, I hope that she can be a bit more understanding towards her fellow Operators, especially when she's on a mission with Exusiai. Not everyone shares the level of tacit understanding that they do. I've already faced consequences for it. That's why I know it.'
'Croissant... Please put your money in the right places. Thank you!'
'Yes, everyone loves Sora's music. Especially on long trips, music is a transporter's best friend... But why does Mr. Emperor's personal mixtape always come on?'
'Doctor, perhaps you haven't realized this yourself, but the fact that you can unite so many people with very different personalities under one banner is- wait, did a Sankta just walk by? Was that Exusiai? Mr. Emperor had something important he wanted me to inform her about... Gone already? So fast! It couldn't be... Sorry, I'll be right back!'
-Bison's conversation with the Doctor while cleaning up after a heavy metal party

modules.moduleDescription:
Kazimierz. Maybe he once flinched at the impenetrably dense neon, but he knew his duty full well. The day he succeeded, concluded communications, and walked out that glass door, the eternal lights of the skyscrapers drew his shadow long, and it was only then that Bison realized it was late at night.
Laterano. At the street corner where the structure above him collapsed with a boom, Bison caught a dessert that almost hit him in the head in his shock. The grand church briefly stole away his senses with its splendor under the sunlight. Soon after, he pushed the door open, where the Legati were sat to capacity inside.
Columbia. The never-resting pioneer cities gave him a profound respect for humanity's sheer vitality, and the bleeding-edge science made him pore over every clause and turn of phrase in the contracts all the more carefully. Across from him sat several execs, and Bison was alone at the front of the desk.
Sami. He once tested his own disposition and momentarily set foot in the tundra, but unfortunately the youngster's willpower was hard-pressed to bear the might of nature. As Bison huddled in a blanket in the lodge, sipping hot water, a melodious singing voice reached his ears from outside the room. He crawled up to the window, and made a rough note of the lyrics.
Siracusa. The sandstorm in the barrens tore the map he was holding to shreds, and Bison had to make it to his destination bar going by the lights alone. He pushed the door open, and the three Lupos inside fell silent. He coolly handed over the goods and info, and turned a blind eye to the cold glint of a firearm peeking out from under the blanket.
Yan. He's back somewhere familiar, and familiar too is the party that awaits him again as he enters. Bison recalls his surprise last time candy rained down on him from all over, but now he sees the chaos before him and simply takes the shield his redheaded mentor hands him, now in a very peculiar form indeed, making it hard to tell its original design was of his father's own style.
He uses the calm and coolness he's trained on the journey thus far to look as unflustered as possible, but all the charm from across the land flashes across his brain in an instant. Mixed with the music is an explanation to the rough tune of 'We were running a delivery and hit a snag, so we just grabbed it to save our hides. The mods were to make up for that.'
Bison accepts it, this present from his father, and plunging through the tunes and the scent of apple pie, he makes his way to the bar counter and begins to write a reply.
Title, greeting, main body. He inquires about his father's health, and writes of how his recent work has gone. He lifts his eyes to see champagne flying at the face of some unknown gang's goon, and Bison swiftly tucks the letter into his pocket and raises his shield.
If one day, he could take complete charge... on one hand, Bison is trying to reckon with what all these bells-and-whistles modules are even for, and on the other, his mind is looping the thought that he's going to make this place run like an orderly, regular business for just one month!
...No, dream bigger! One year!

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, I'll be writing reports or reading nearby, just call when you need me.
I believe you reap what you sow, and have always followed that principle.
Wow, I never imagined Oripathy would have such a trait! This requires immediate testing… Um, Doctor, I'm sorry, but I need to leave now. Hmm, I wonder if there's a suitable subject on base…
The day is not complete without tea. Would you like a cup too, Doctor? I have the finest Victorian leaves here.
I've been with Schwarz since childhood. I know everything about her, including her past from before we met. Oh, but I won't give that up so easily, Doctor.
If I could find a cure for Schwarz, wouldn't that mean I could cure other Infected too...? Relax, Doctor, I'm not that selfish. But please also know that Schwarz is dearest to my heart.
Originium research is still a vastly unexplored territory, Doctor. But I just want to find a cure for Schwarz, which is why I longed to join Rhodes Island since I first heard of it.

Do you know, Doctor, that I despise those who discriminate against Schwarz on account of her infection alone? But here, she is accepted, and I can learn more about medicine. Coming to Rhodes Island was truly the right decision.

No matter how good a leader is, there's still a chance to be blinded by selfish interest, so you must watch out for that, Doctor. Hehe, but still, you don't need to worry that much. As long as I'm around, I'll put you back on the right path anytime you stray.
Falling asleep in a sitting position is a nasty habit, Doctor. Let me get you a blanket, at least.
Hello, I'm Ceylon, graduate of Victoria National University, with a major in Originium research. I start my internship at Rhodes Island today, with Dr. Kal'tsit's approval. Nice to meet you, Doctor.
An excellent application of Originium. Rhodes Island sure lives up to its reputation.
So I'm officially recognized by Rhodes Island? Thank you, Doctor, I'll work even harder.
Rhodes Island does boast terrific Originium research. If I keep working here, I'm sure I will cure Schwarz one day. Doctor, please help me on this path.
A mission? A perfect opportunity to test my Originium Arts.
Relax, I'm a confident commander.
I wonder if we'll find rare materials along the way?
Don't panic, handle it with composure.
Where are the wounded?
Hmm?
Leave the support work to me.
If you're wounded, don't move.
You're all free to focus on the mission.
Concentrate on the enemy ahead!
This one should be better for the present situation.
Phew... I feel like I just wrapped up a difficult experiment. It's tiring, but very fulfilling too.
The enemy should be gone now...  Alright then, I'm going to look around the perimeter.
If I were as good as Schwarz, they wouldn't have gotten away…
Don't just stand there, Doctor, give me a hand with the wounded!
Hm, maybe I could talk to the other doctors on base.
Wait, my hair is getting messed up!
