CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, let me help!

Doctor! You've been glued to that chair forever, and that's totally not good for you. Time for a quick workout session with me—stretch those muscles, replenish your energy. Trust me, you'll be able to work even better!

Hey, hey, Doctor! She's here at Rhodes Island! Ah, her codename should be Dur-nar now. Anyway, she's incredible! I've literally only seen her in recruitment ads before! And she's such a nice lady! She gave me so many snacks, ehehe.
Doctor, I'm way more athletic than most people my age, you know. Let me show you a standing backflip! Watch closely! Hu-ya!
This gun? Oh, it's a gun-type Arts… Uh… What's that term again? Hmm… Right, Arts Unit! I applied for it out of habit after coming here, but honestly? I still prefer my fists over Arts.
I've always known I'm lucky, but seeing the struggles of other Infected here at Rhodes Island… It's really opened my eyes. Doctor, tell me how I can help. I want to be useful.

Huh…? Oh, Doctor! I'm working on a letter to my dad. I've never told you about him? Then let me introduce him! He's the most incredible policeman ever! You've gotta hear all about his awesome stories!

Truth is, my dad's the one who recommended Rhodes Island. When he learned you could treat Oripathy, he was determined to get me here. Being apart from him is tough… I miss him so much. But I understand what matters most to him is seeing me healthy and safe.

You're almost as reliable as my dad, almost! In my book, you're the second most trustworthy person around, hehe! By the way, I've been telling my dad all about you in my letters, and now he's curious to meet you!
Doc—! Ah, Doctor's asleep. Gotta be quiet…
Nice to meet you, Doctor! I'm a new operator, codename Jackie! I used to be an auxiliary police officer in Columbia. Here's hoping we work well together!
Wow… This is even more awesome than what my dad could do!
Eh, am I getting promoted? Wow, that's awesome!
Rhodes Island's opened my eyes to so much… Maybe one day, I'll be just as amazing as my dad! Doctor, I promise I'll keep working hard, and I'm counting on your guidance!
I'm here!
I'll work hard!
Let's do our best!
Mission start!
Doctor, is it my turn?
Warm-up complete.
Leave it to me.
Time to show my skills!
Try a knuckle sandwich!
No trespassing!
Don't underestimate me!
Push it to the limit!
I thought they had us a few times there, but we did it! You're amazing, Doctor!
Doctor, Doctor, did you see how hard I worked!
Doctor, want me to chase after them?
Sorry, Doctor. If only I'd put in more effort…
Oh… It's so big inside!
Ahhhh!
Hi, Doctor!
Arknights.

Doctor, Happy New Year! This New Year, I'll be celebrating right here at Rhodes Island. Hehe, I've already written to dad, explaining how I'm learning to stand on my own, and how Rhodes Island is a place he can trust. Um, I do feel a bit lonely sometimes. But celebrating with my fellow operators makes up for it!
Ah, it's Doctor!

Doctor! Happy birthday! My dad always taught me birthdays are best spent doing something kind for others. So I'm thinking, how about we head to the kitchen? We can help the logistics operators with today's grocery delivery. Hehehe, who knows? We might just stumble upon some exciting surprises!

'Walk a mile in someone else's shoes before extending a helping hand.' Now I get why the Infected I met before didn't want to accept help or even talk much. I've learned a lot at Rhodes Island. When I return to Columbia, all this will help me become a better police officer.

handbook.profile:
A former Columbian auxiliary police officer who came to Rhodes Island to receive treatment after contracting Oripathy. 
With her father's consent, she joined Rhodes Island as an operator, displaying above average talent in close combat and participating in various missions.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected by medical examination.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3%
Due to short infection duration, only small traces of infection are visible on the surface of the body. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.16u/L
Thanks to timely treatment and physical fitness, the current prognosis is optimistic. With regular treatment, there will not be much burden on the body.
handbook.promotionRecord:
The things we encounter and the people we meet often leave me with a sense of foreboding, afraid that our efforts towards a brighter future are all for naught. 
However, whenever I see a youngster like Jackie brimming with purity, kindness and vigor, I am reminded of my conviction: To guide these youngsters along the path of learning, so that they may gain more knowledge of the world, and help make it a better place. 
——Instructor Guericke's remarks towards Jackie in her Intermediate General Studies class
archives:
An energetic Perro girl. 
She is always full of vigor and never remains down for long. As she acts friendly to everyone, she is well-liked by most operators and some older operators even treat her as a cherished sister or daughter. 
She enjoys regaling others with stories of her father's glorious deeds.

As everyone knows, most Infected are able to cast Arts without the help of an Arts Unit. 
On one hand, this is equivalent to using the Originium within one's body for casting Arts, which is likely to exacerbate one's Oripathy. On the other hand, mildly infected individuals like Jackie aren't able to channel much energy for Arts. 
For this reason, even Infected Casters often prefer to cast Arts through an Arts Unit whenever possible. Similarly, Rhodes Island provides an Arts Unit to every Caster operator. 
——In fact, the Engineering Department is very passionate about designing Arts Units of all shapes and sizes. One of their favorite pastimes is developing 'Arts Units' that look nothing like conventional units— and often don't work at all. 
The Arts Unit that hangs at Jackie's waist, gun-type Arts Unit PT-29, is the pride of the Engineering Department. 
Regrettably, even though Jackie applied for such an Arts Unit, it is only due to a habit formed while serving as an auxiliary police officer. Jackie herself is incredibly uninterested in the subject of Arts and her scores are very disappointing. Because of this, this Arts Unit is mostly an accessory to this day.

According to Jackie, her mother passed away from complications during her birth and she was single-handedly raised by her father. Jackie greatly reveres her father. 
She will happily describe in great detail how amazing of a policeman her father is, how many people he's helped and what accolades he's received. Some of her teammates can even recite her entire speech from beginning to end by heart now. 
Her story may be hyperbolic to some extent, but her father was still willing to bring his own infected daughter to Rhodes Island in person. Throughout his short stay in Rhodes Island, he never openly displayed any animosity towards the other Infected, and even remained agreeable to his daughter joining Rhodes Island after learning about some of Rhodes Island's more dubious activities. At the very least, he is not overly biased towards the Infected, even if he is just exercising self-restraint. That alone is already very rare amongst the non-Infected. 
Jackie's good manners and lively attitude in daily life is likely also a result of her father's teachings. 
From that perspective, her father is indeed a policeman worth respecting, and a good father.

Some people hold on to their hatred of the Infected even when they've become Infected themselves. Contrarily, some never hold much enmity towards the Infected, even while they're still uninfected. 
Jackie is one of those people. 
Perhaps as a result of her father's teachings, Jackie has never treated the Infected with hostility, unlike most other people. After overcoming her initial horror, she was able to quickly come to terms with her new identity as an Infected. 
It is possible that since she was showered in love from a young age, Jackie has a great capacity for love towards others——This can be considered a legitimate ability, as rare as it is. After coming to Rhodes Island, not only did this ability allow her to befriend others easily, it also gave her a new goal——To help the other Infected. 
Besides curing her Oripathy, she also wants to lend a hand to the other Infected. To her, it is only natural to do so.

modules.moduleDescription:
Earlier this week, law enforcement officials announced that the major kidnapping case that occurred earlier this weekend in Fussen Furnitureville has been cracked. All suspects are now in custody, and all hostages have been rescued and are currently receiving hospital treatment. Based on facts previously made available by the police, the syndicate responsible has been active in this state as well as our three neighbors, with a focus on hijacking and kidnapping. Seventeen cases this year alone have been linked to them, all striking panic in the populace. Working across state lines to follow developments in the case, Homeland Security employed disciplined units under a single chain of command to finally put this malicious gang behind bars. Justice has finally been served, and the citizens' lives and property safe once again.
However, this week some have continued raising doubts about the police announcement, claiming that credit for the breakthrough goes to a young officer from the auxiliary forces, who is presently unnamed but has captured public attention in recent days. Following the end of the case, footage from a number of mall cameras has circulated on the intercity net. They show a young Perro female in a city police uniform but without a badge hopping onto the furniture store's roof from a nearby building, marking the start of a one woman chase—and eventually brawl—with the gangsters, lasting a whole forty minutes, and ending with her pacifying them all before law enforcement arrived bizarrely late to the scene. The young woman in the video is exceptionally athletic, making use of furniture from every room of the house to contend with the gangsters, skillfully enough to leave many wide-eyed. In the most viral clip, eight of them have her surrounded with edged and bolt-loaded weapons, then in the blink of an eye she grabs a mysterious weapon—said by the store's owner to be no more than a steel chair whose unique design struggled to sell—after which she subdues all the gangsters in short order. The public will not be forgetting her heroism any time soon.
In response to these inquiries, law enforcement official have stated that despite her nonstandard uniform, the woman in footage was in fact a special agent they dispatched to the precinct to secretly tail the gang, with orders to take action from within and subdue the criminals. The idea that the footage shows a 'vigilante' or 'police nonfeasance' is categorically false, and rumors that their department and the criminals were 'in cahoots' are not only utterly baseless, but 'harmful to police image.'
In contrast, eyewitnesses report that after singlehandedly taking down over a dozen gangsters and freeing the hostages, the mysterious young woman was promptly arrested and taken away by police. Some have even identified her as possibly the valorous officer who rescued a number of people during a major Originium safety accident last year, and exposed the former mayor's misdeeds. Law enforcement officials have yet to comment on this. We have made a request for this 'special agent' to come to our station for an interview, which the police have refused, citing her current hospitalization.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Let's see what goodies the Doctor hides in this drawer.
I'm probably only about as big as one of Papa's legs right now. But one day, I'm gonna be as big as him, and then I'll trample all over the bad guys! Graaagh!
I'm really, really sorry! I won't run in the hallways ever again!
Fighting is super easy. I point my shield one way, and nobody can beat me. Huh? What if they get behind me? Ohyeaah... I never thought of that!
Gavial? Never heard of her. She's tough? She's famous in Sargon? Okay, whatever. I'll see for myself how tough she is.
Oh, you're talking about Gavial? I'm Gavial's number one fan. See, she even signed my shield for me. That's her autograph! I think pretty much nobody could take down Gavial, besides Papa.

Doctor, shhh, tell me the truth. Kay says Vulcan can hammer straight through the floor, can she? No? Phew... Hehe. I knew it. That means my Papa is definitely stronger. He could bust down a Rhodes smoke stack with one punch.
Do I really have to write it in the notebook...? Fine... 'I knocked over Lancet-2 today. I won't do it again.'
This is my shield. It'll be one of my greaves someday, or maybe a pauldron. Then as long as I'm standing behind you, hehe, nobody'll ever bully you.
Doctor, wake up! Someone's here to see you.

You're the boss of this training camp? And they call you the Doctor? Hrmmmm... But you don't look strong... Whatever. I'm Bubble. I may be the weakest in my tribe right now, but you're gonna train me until I'm the second strongest.
Fight! Fight! Fiiiiiight! What, why'd they stop. Is it over?
A reward for my training? Great! I can't eat it? Grrr...
I think I got a good chance of beating Kay now! Okay, lemme at her. Doctor, you can come watch!
Be good? I'll try.
I'll count down and we charge on one, okay?
Chaaarge!
Waaar!
I got this.
Haha!
Get the bad guys!
Shield up!
Traaaaaample!
Baaaaash!
Spike striiiike!
Bam!
Doctor, if you got your body as strong as your brain, you could be an awesome warrior like my Papa!
What did I tell you? I'm super strong.
Huh? Some of them got away? Did I let them through?
We can't beat them! Whatdowedo?! Whatdowedo?!
I need a way, waaay bigger room. How can anyone live in a little place like this?
Hey, that tickles.
Doctor, let's play hide-and-seek!
Arknights.
It's New Year's! We got the day off! No homework! That means it's time to challenge Kay! Doctor, you can't just sit there all day. Why don't you come wrestle with us? It'll be fun!
Doctor!
Happy birthday, Doctor! Oh, this means you've grown a whole extra year! When am I gonna get as big as you?

I have to train hard at Rhodes Island! First, I'm gonna get tougher than Kay, then I'll beat Gavial, until I finally outdo Vulcan! Then I can go back home and be a warrior as great as Papa...! Doctor, are you gonna miss me when I'm gone?

handbook.profile:
A young warrior girl from a tribe of Sargon Ceratos, she is inexperienced, with no knowledge of the norms and customs for interacting with others. Her father sent her to Rhodes Island, ostensibly for 'training,' but actually to treat her Oripathy. 
She uses a massive shield as a weapon, relying on charging and bashing tactics. She needs Rhodes Island training to ensure she doesn't make any catastrophic mistakes in actual combat.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 2%
Her left leg shows clear signs of infection. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.24u/L
Infection remains mild, but the patient is often uncooperative with treatment, and there is a possibility her situation could worsen. 

'I hope we don't get too many more difficult patients like her...'
handbook.promotionRecord:
All our Medic Operators know the futility of trying to get control of a grumpy Bubble. Putting a stop to a charging Cerato is like stopping a hulk of agricultural machinery with a brick on its accelerator.  
But Gavial has done it. 
Not only can Gavial get Bubble under control, but she has no trouble administering injections to the girl. After attempting to resist Gavial several times, to no avail, Bubble has resigned herself to her fate. 
Subsequently, Bubble came to understand Gavial's 'glorious accomplishments' and has since come to worship her. 
And Bubble has been more amenable of late. 
Thanks, Gavial! 
What's more, Bubble has started studying some close combat techniques. When asked why, she replied: 
'I want to pound Kay flat!' 
We know that when Bubble and Ceobe get into one of their 'My Papa could beat up Vulcan' sessions, they sometimes get too into it and the conflict turns physical. They have never drawn weapons and do not escalate beyond shoving. 
In terms of raw power, Bubble is a bit stronger than Ceobe, but Ceobe's extensive experience and conditioned reflexes always put Bubble at a disadvantage, and the noisy little firecracker usually finds herself overwhelmed.  
So Bubble started training. And property damage due to Bubble has also enjoyed a significant reduction. 
Maybe it won't be long before we can declare 'Bubble Crises' a thing of the past.
archives: Bubble is the daughter of a Sargon tribal warrior. Our operators made some arrangements with her father before she came to Rhodes Island. We understand she suffered direct contact with Originium while playing in the wilderness, and failure to quickly clean the wound resulted in an irreversible infection. Bubble's father asked that we accept her for treatment, but so as not to embarrass her, he requested that we register her as a reserve operator and note her purpose at Rhodes Island as 'special training.' After her tests, she became a reserve operator.

Bubble makes a lot of trouble for the adults around her, but she's exceedingly popular among children. She is playful, principled, and particularly good at embellishing her 'adventures,' which never fail to draw the kids in for a listen. Even the clever children who know her stories are exaggerated still enjoy listening to Bubble, because those stories are indeed very well-told. 
Bubble has lots of friends, but she is closest to Ceobe. The two hit it off from the first time they met, and one always goes looking for the other whenever she has free time. As for what they talk about, it's what kids always love to talk about: 
'My favorite hero could beat up your favorite hero.' 
Bubble doesn't like to study, but that hasn't kept her from learning all kinds of new phrases, techniques, and rhetorical flourishes to describe her own father during her talks with Ceobe. But the funny thing is that no matter how much vocabulary they prepare beforehand, their arguments always descend into: 'I'm big!' 'I'm bigger!' 'I'm way bigger!' Punctuated with exaggerated gestures, such confrontations can last an entire afternoon.  
I suppose that's just how kids are. 
Looks like they're having fun.

Bubble has not yet grown accustomed to the cramped quarters of Rhodes Island. She is used to life on the wide open plains of Sargon, running across the vast prairies of the wilderness. So when she first came to Rhodes Island, Bubble had an instinctive rejection of the environment. And one way she acted out against our environment was to rampage through the ship, wrecking things. 
Don't underestimate Bubble because of her size. She's trampled robots, crashed through security doors, broken down partition walls, and never once injured herself. Should you ever see her preparing to break into a run, stop her immediately and bring her to the nearest treadmill. Or toss her into the training room, which is the safest and most effective way to deal with a 'Bubble Crisis.' 
Bubble also likes to run around the battlefield during combat. Thanks to her man-sized spiked shield, she is impervious to any threat she can charge straight through. But she tends not to consider that she could still be attacked from the side or the rear, and it is necessary to have other operators cover her. Until she is able to fully comply with dispatch or complete her Defender examination, her deployments will be limited to lower threat missions.

As the daughter of a tribal warrior, Bubble is used to the expectation that she will be a warrior just like her father. Because of her bottomless respect for her father, Bubble has been working to emulate him since she was small. But we have to ask: is Bubble really suited to that kind of life? 
When other children in the tribe were learning the importance of combat skills, Bubble was rushing around, charging into things. She has far more strength and endurance than children of her same cohort, but combat prowess is more than just strength. In the words of her father: 'This girl will not be a warrior.' 
It is perhaps because he recognized this that her father did not permit Bubble to conceal her wounds and carry on with her life, and instead sent her away from the tribe, away from Sargon, and off to a new future of her own making. 
'At least here, she can have a happy life.' It's hard to imagine such words came from a fierce tribal Cerato warrior, his body well over two meters tall covered head to toe in tattoos and totems. Not long after that conversation, our newly arrived Bubble came crashing through the reception room door. Her father apologized profusely to the operator on duty, all the while holding the crying Bubble by her ear. An hour later, after the operator saw off Bubble's father, the young girl helped herself to a snack: the leaves of our potted plant. 
It seems Bubble has a lot of growing up to do.

modules.moduleDescription:
Bubble is in a horrible mood.
Just recently, she was watching the new animated film The Three Little Swashbucklers with some friends her age. Each of the heroes, seemingly just as young as them, had a shiny and glowy Originium blade and could use super-awesome techniques that made the whole screen flicker and shine like crazy, and it got everyone watching all pumped up. But then Shamare, who's always so cold, was there all alone like 'that sword's obviously just a toy' like she didn't get the mood at all.
Bubble wasn't one to say much about weapons, really. Swords were all light and fragile, and they'd never beat the cool stuff like giant axes and hammers.
But when she saw the friends she'd watched the film with get together one day and bring swords out, that really drove her nuts.
They were just like the ones in the movie! The shininess, the little button, and the dashing-ness that exuded from her friends when they lifted their swords to the air and yelled out the super-awesome move name.
And like that, a need to HAVE overtook Bubble's heart.
She couldn't steal anyone's—she'd been scolded enough times already for that—but she had no idea how she'd get one like that for herself.
By buying it? How? From who? With what? She didn't even know how many rooms were inside this metal plate box, not to mention her friends were telling her they got shipped in from Kazimierz and she can't buy one now.
Why can't Bubble get the thing she wants?! It was all her mind could dwell on, but here she is now, and she doesn't know anything, except that aside from stealing someone else's she's got no way of getting the toy. But the lessons she's been having lately, and the sense of morals educated into her, stifle her urge to snatch one.
So now Bubble can only storm around in a huff, carelessly knocking into things and yelling loudly to vent her discontent. On occasion, when she tuckers herself out, she hides away in her dorm, crying as she hugs her tribe's totem.
This helplessness weighs down on Bubble very, very hard.
Morte tastes this morsel and shares it with Shamare. After getting the rough gist of things, Shamare seeks out a psychological consultant operator at Medical, and very soon thereafter, a message is sent from HR out to Sargon...
Today is Bubble's annual 'See Papa Day,' in which her father has agreed to come visit her once a year. It's the most important day of the year to her (aside from her birthday), and Bubble forces herself to shape up and look strong, to meet Papa with a smile. Even still, once she sees him, the gloom in her heart all spills out as tears, and she can't even put her words together properly, only lie in her Papa's arms and cry away.
After the tears are done, she jumps out of her Papa's embrace, and sits silently on the couch again. And surprise! From his rucksack, her father pulls out a toy sword.
It's in this instant that Bubble's eyes shine like stars.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: The files are in order. Is that all we have to do today? Good, then why don't we talk about the operation the other day, Professor?
Try not to come too close when I use Arts, okay? ... You won't? Whatever suits you then.

Why am I calling you 'Professor'? Because I'm actually learning quite a lot from you: where to assign personnel on the battlefield, how to command, among many other things… What more reason do we need?
Here, you can have this. Some sort of candy, I think. No need to thank me. I got it from someone else anyway. Couldn't care less.

Sankta using staves is a rare sight to see, you say? Those fanatics on a non-stop shooting spree must have left you with a bad impression with their 'pews' and 'bangs.' Not all Sankta use guns as their weapons. At the very least, I don't like them.

Rather than sharing a single secret, we should exchange our secrets with each other. That's how you build a strong, equal relationship. So if you want to learn any of my secrets, you better come up with something just as saucy for me, Professor.

There are no Infected in Laterano. Once a Sankta contracts Oripathy, he is immediately exiled. But even if you become Infected, no matter where you are, you still enjoy all kinds of privilege as a Laterano... You just don't get to set foot in your homeland again, that's all.

My parents' will left me with quite a bit of trouble, and it was really a hassle to get it taken care of. If it wasn't for that uptight executor making things difficult for me, it all could've been much easier... Oh, whatever, it still went according to my plan.

I want to capture a few people to try out some new Arts in our next operation. I can't...? Alright, fine. It's a shame, but if that's what you say, Professor, maybe some other time, then. Eh? Not this time, and not ever? Geez, don't be so uptight.
Are you asleep? People who fall asleep at work get their faces drawn on, you know...? Just kidding, I know you're awake.
Codename Arene, officially joining today, it seems. So you are the Doctor... I hope we'll get along, Professor {@nickname}.
Studying tactics? Sounds kinda interesting.
This doesn't seem all that different than before. Or are you going to teach me some tricks of the trade, Professor?
Doctor, you aren't testing me, are you? Alright then, I'm just getting in the mood. Okay, starting right now, whatever happens is going to be our own little secret.
Okay, I'll follow your orders.
So actual combat for my next assignment? Okay, let me think about the deployment...
As long as we achieve our goals, it doesn't matter if the process is a little rough, huh?
Welcome. I've been waiting.
My turn?
No need to rush.
Not a bad position.
I can do whatever I want, right?
I've given my warning.
Does it hurt?
Tell me. How are you feeling right now?
That's not a bad scream at all.
That went far better than I expected. I shouldn't have thought so little of you, Professor.
That was just as expected. No surprises, even a little boring.
A few slipped past. Should I go after them? Strategically speaking, I don't recommend it.
This is quite the bad situation... You know what the appropriate course of action is now, right?
Isn't there a closer room to the Professor's?
Hmm?
We have some time to spare. Why don't we review our last mission, Professor?
Arknights.

Professor, I've learned a new trick. You can come closer this time. It's not dangerous. Put this piece of metal on your hand, then just very lightly... Look, it turned into a small firework. How about that? It's just as good as the noisy ones outside, right?
You look tired. It's okay if you sleep a little longer, Professor.

Happy birthday, Prof. {@nickname}. As you can see, I'm not too fond of overly complicated ceremonies. I hope you're not so into loud parties, either, since I'm planning to celebrate in more meaningful ways with you. Right, I mean just the two of us.

Professor, when you steer Rhodes Island, what do you weigh and consider? Enemies, friends, what we need to do, what we mustn't do... There has to be a line that we cannot cross so that we don't lose ourselves. Am I right? I see...

handbook.profile:
Operator Arene is a Laterano-born Sankta who was exiled from Laterano after contracting Oripathy during a Laterano firearm inheritance-related incident several years ago. After he departed Laterano, he left for Leithanien to pursue further studies. 
Having passed a battery of examinations, he is currently serving as a Rhodes Island Guard Operator and receiving treatment.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Crystals have appeared on his body. Infection confirmed by medical examination.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of his internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in his circulatory system, confirming him to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Small traces of infection are visible on the surface of the body. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.23u/L
Operator Arene has been receiving Oripathy-related treatment for a long time. As a result, his infection is well under control, with no trend of deterioration.
handbook.promotionRecord:
The young man refers to you as his professor. 
Both you and him should be well aware that he didn't actually mean it at first. 
But what about now? 
Perhaps you could actually teach him something. He is still learning, and he needs someone to guide him to the path he is to take.
archives:
There are many regulations in Laterano law that lay out strict, detailed stipulations for how to care for citizens who contract Oripathy in many possible scenarios. 
When a Laterano citizen contracts Oripathy, he or she continues to enjoy all of the rights guaranteed to them as part of their citizenship. However, aside from a few special cases, they are typically not allowed to remain in Laterano territory. Compared to the strict regulations many other countries and territories have for the Infected, you could say that only getting exiled from Laterano is far more lenient. That being the case, if you become Infected in Laterano, you must forever leave your homeland, never again to set foot on the place you grew up. To many Lateranos, this is understandably an unbearable proposition. 
On his own initiative, operator Arene studied in Leithanien for years after contracting Oripathy. Consequently, the hometown that he can no longer return to may very well have become nothing but a faint memory to him long ago.

Most people tend to have a rather ingrained impression of the Sankta. To them, the Sankta and their guns are inseparable concepts, and the Sankta, with their halos above their heads, are never ones to part with their precious firearms. And whenever a Sankta is unable to keep a gun due to whatever extraordinary circumstance, they would usually choose the next best thing they are allowed: long-ranged weapons like bows. 
In most cases, one would be correct to make such assumptions. That being said, there are some occasional exceptions to the norm. Operator Arene is one such exception at Rhodes Island. He is one of the few Sankta here to forgo the use of firearms, instead opting to use Originium Arts as his primary means of attack. 
The Originium Arts that Operator Arene utilizes are somewhat unusual: his Arts tend to be have toxic, disintegrative, and corrosive traits. As a result, he normally keeps away from crowds in order to mitigate any unnecessary risks. And just like the impression that others typically have of Operator Arene himself, his Originium Arts typically strike others as beautiful yet dangerous, amicable yet seclusive, and requiring extra care to approach. 
Due to his frequent use of Arts, Arene himself usually carries a faint aromatic fragrance. The fragrance's effect on others is alterable at will, and can either be rendered completely harmless or made dangerously toxic during the most crucial situations.

When Operator Arene first arrived at Rhodes Island, he was accompanied by a Notarial Hall executor. 
According to this chaperone of his, a colleague of Operator Executor's, both of Arene's parents were highly respected Laterano firearms researchers, and the two of them were frequently dragged into all kinds of Laterano firearm-related incidents thanks to their profession. It is precisely for this reason that, when Arene contracted Oripathy several years ago, his parents opted to send him, their one and only son, away from danger to Leithanien instead of keeping him close by. 
Regretfully, both of his parents were killed during a recent clandestine operation to steal Laterano firearms technology. Their will unfortunately brought Arene plenty of trouble as well—most people seem to believe that a parent would always leave every last thing they treasured to their children. In reality, the only thing that Arene's parents ever wished for was for their only son to live a peaceful life. They knew their research would undoubtedly be taken up by Laterano departments far more up to the task than him. 
Even though the crisis has mostly been averted thanks to Operator Arene's master plan, there still remains enough of a risk that, in spite of the young man's temperament, the poor executor had to escort Arene to Rhodes Island to seek his colleague's help, before taking a temporary leave to deal with some so-called problematic follow-up work. 
During his childhood, Arene's parents were often preoccupied with work and had little time to spend with their son, leaving him alone at home most of his childhood. Young children often have a hard time understanding their parents' passion for work. To the young Arene, it was guns that had stolen his parents' attention from him, and that became the source of his apathy against guns, normally admired by Sankta children far and wide. Furthermore, after his infection during the accident, he lost any opportunity to have his own gun. 
Perhaps because he departed Laterano at an early age, Arene tends to be a little sheepish around some of our other Laterano operators. Instead, he is more proactive in interacting with our Leithanian operators. One such example is Operator Eyjafjalla. The two of them had studied under the same famous professor at their university, just barely enough to make them old classmates.

When Arene first joined our ranks, it didn't take long for us to notice his completely nonchalant attitude and lack of restraint, likely a result of the environment he grew up in. 
At first, none of us thought this was a problem. After all, we have operators with all kinds of personalities here at Rhodes Island, even some particularly freewheeling Sarkaz mercenaries that we had to reluctantly learn to tolerate. Compared to them, the young boy's tendency to play pranks on operators or his mildly sadistic attitude toward his enemies were hardly issues at all. 
However, when Arene brought an enemy combatant back with him after an operation and then half-jokingly suggested practicing new Originium Arts on him, it became obvious to us that it was perhaps not a good idea to afford our still-growing adolescent operators total, unrestricted freedom. Operator Arene should no longer be allowed to do whatever he pleases. The young, sensitive Sankta is in dire need of proper guidance and instruction that, cruicially, do not bore him.

modules.moduleDescription:
The youth is unbothered by the curiosity of others, especially when it is directed toward the notebook he carries.
'It was my teacher's request.'
But during such conversations, he would always wear his usual distant smile, making no attempt to mask his indifference.
'My teacher wants me to write more.'
Of course, he's always known that people were secretly gossiping about the contents:
'Did you know? Arene takes the name of every enemy he's killed in his notebook. The Doctor had him keep a record so that he'd understand the value of life.'
'I heard the ink he uses is a deadly toxin he concocted himself. Anyone who tries to take a look at his notebook will—'
'I'm more inclined to believe he's hiding something shady in there, like data from human experimentation. The last time I saw him with a prisoner—'
'If you ask me, he's just going through a rough patch in life. He's probably just keeping a diary to sort through his feelings.'
They speculate, they doubt, but the young man simply smiles at the various comments.
He sets the notebook down on his desk and flips it open.
He pulls out a transparent fountain, as if drawing an overly sharpened dagger, and fills it with the brightly colored ink he made himself, purported to be laced with deadly toxin
'The voices of others are important, but it's your own answers that matter most.
'Write down whatever you want to tell me, and yourself, the most.'
Guns that have killed, poison with a deceiving aroma, blurry voices, the cruelty and malice inexorably hidden deep within... Many things cross his mind.
When his senses return to him, he realizes that the tip of the pen has punctured the page again, the brightly-colored ink seeping into the snow-white paper like the bloodied, grasping limbs of enemies, until everything contorts into a bottomless vortex.
Arene lets out a chuckle and casually tears out the besmirched sheet of paper.
He then closes the notebook and stashes it back in his pocket.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: No problem, Doctor. I've got your back.
How do I aim while I'm skatin'? It's a piece'a cake, no sweat. Wanna see? C'mere, put your hand on mine.

Back in the day, me and my friends thought it was sick as hell to be different. But once I got infected, I found out that wasn't cool at all. You don't let a little Originium dust run your life, you gotta grab the wheel n' steer.
An old cop taught me how to shoot a crossbow, n' his daughter threw in skateboardin' lessons. How'd I put 'em together? Pure street genius—straight up self-taught.
Don't get it twisted, skateboardin's just one of my jams... It's the first way I ever really found myself. But the good stuff comes after that. Wanna hear the whole story?

Why'd I wanna be a combat operator...? Doc, lemme ask you: what's the one thing us rowdy street kids really live for? Freedom, straight up. I'm cool to throw down for freedom, an' that's why I'm with Rhodes Island.

I'm real broken up about bein' Infected, y'know? Like that park mural I was sprayin'—left that one half-done. And I'm never gonna get those secret-recipe onion rings from that old cop again. Huh? That's all.

I came to Rhodes Island to get some help with this disease. Thought it'd be some sterile place that reeked of disinfectant, everyone all shut up in their rooms... But man was I surprised. Even though you don't allow tagging inside the cabins, that Ethan guy... Y'know what, never mind.

I figured out how to express myself with donut hamburger combos, skateboarding, and rap battles. What's your deal, Doctor? If you're feelin' burnt out, come kick it with me and Vigna. We'll... hang out. Hanging out is in our DNA. Gotta respect that.
If you're tired, just go rest. I'll be here.
Aciddrop, Operator. This skateboard's a registered piece of equipment, got it? Any issues, just hit me up.
Damn, that's cool.
A promotion, huh? Thanks. Tryin' to remember the last time somethin' like this went down. Gotta be after I won the Crab Cup…
The old man taught me to use a crossbow just so I could protect myself from the streets. Who woulda thought I'd end up usin' it to defend the freedom of the Infected.
You got it.
Teamwork's an important part of scoring too.
Let's roll.
Enemy sighted.
I'm right here.
C'mon, how should I deal with these guys?
Now I'm all pumped up.
Some sweet terrain to ride.
Ollie!
Time to show off a bit.
I'm over here.
Kickflip, then kick ass.
Good work out there, Doctor... Oh, could you help me swap a couple of bolts when we get back?
That moment you clear a challenge always gets me all hyped up.
Should we chase after 'em? If you ask me, I can still catch up.
Ugh... Can't believe this amateur wipeout...
This looks perfect for a throw… Uh, I didn't say nothin'.
Wahh!
Wanna head to the canteen together? If I nail this trip without any wipeouts, promise you'll treat me to some juice.
Arknights.
Oh, Doctor, Happy New Year! We've got a block party in a bit. Why don't you come show off your moves? You could give breakdancin' a shot? It ain't that hard, I'll teach ya!
Hey, Doctor.

You're still working? Let's go get some exercise outside. Wait, you volunteered for overtime? Doctor, ain't no point in workin' this much. Life only begins once you clock out! C'mon, what do you wanna eat? It's on me.

I used to skate to ditch class n' get away from the adults. Then, it was to lose the cops when I was out tagging. I said I did it in the name of freedom, but thinkin' back, I guess that was kinda selfish. We fight harder for other people's freedom than our own, don'tcha think? Like what we're doin' here.

handbook.profile: A street girl of Columbia, born to a normal working-class family. Her parents are both truck drivers and often work through the night, pushing Aciddrop out to the streets at a young age. From practicing skateboarding in her spare time after school to becoming a champion at local skateboarding tournaments, Aciddrop has become a renowned street icon throughout the city, and her success has drawn countless haters in the process. During a deliberate fight, Aciddrop was infected with Originium dust, later coming to Rhodes Island to seek treatment.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 4%
Operator Aciddrop's Oripathy is currently still mild, and no Originium crystals have been found on the surface of the body. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.15u/L
Aciddrop was infected as the product of manmade accident. Fortunately, the amount of Originium dust she inhaled was minute and the infection is being handled appropriately. No trend of deterioration present.
handbook.promotionRecord:
Recently... There have been some bizarre rumors aboard Rhodes Island. As we are fairly tolerant of various cultures, pop culture among the youth is, of course, rather interesting. However, due to invisible individuals playing super loud hip-hop, graffiti appearing out of thin air, and a skateboarding trend that has spread like wildfire across younger operators and patients alike... If possible, shouldn't we try to dial things down a bit? What do you all think? —The 'suggestion' of a highly-respected logistics operator to young operators such as Ethan, Aciddrop, and Vigna

However, after refugees were rescued from the ruins of a Catastrophe area, you all tagged 'Never say die' on the walls of the ruins. I can't say I'm not a fan. —A subsequent word of appreciation added by the respected logistics operator
archives:
Miss Aciddrop is an extremely 'hip' girl. This is not solely due to her interest in skateboarding, graffiti, and rap, but also due to her strong temperament. This is reflected through her open-minded attitude towards all things in life— even when undergoing a series of examinations for her Oripathy, Miss Aciddrop would only lament that she had to postpone her cycling trip, as if her free-spirited travels were of greater importance than her condition. 
By the way, Miss Aciddrop is not 'interested' in street culture. According to her own account, she was actually quite famous in her hometown prior to becoming infected: she had won many local skating competitions, children all wanted to learn how to skate from her, and she shared sibling-like bonds with some of the street artists there. —Though I first thought this was simply the boasting of a street girl, we discovered that a certain line of a famous, trendy sports brand really had plans to feature her as a model. This certainly surprised us.

During her operator assessment exam, Miss Aciddrop demonstrated an unexpected talent for sniping— strictly speaking, a very flashy talent. Though the mobility granted from being able to shoot while on a skateboard is of dubious value in actual combat, this Liberi's agility caught many operators off guard. 'It's like she's performing for a crowd,' one operator from the HR Department remarked. 
However, let this not overshadow the fact that Miss Aciddrop's proficiency with a hand crossbow is not inferior to her skill on the skateboard. It is said that she learned these skills from an old local policeman. As a student, Aciddrop was report to the police for 'excessive graffiti,' and was chased around three blocks by an old, seemingly-weak policeman. Afterwards, she was subjected to a scolding that was dozens of minutes long. After such incidents 'accidentally occurred several more times,' scolding soon turned into chatter, and the kindhearted old policeman seemed to take pity upon Aciddrop, for her parents were almost never home, leaving her to fend for herself. Intentionally or otherwise, the old policeman let his daughter become friends with Aciddrop, since the two of them were the same age. It is this daughter who first taught Aciddrop how to skate. 
'Of course, the pupil surpassed the teacher, eh?' Miss Aciddrop would happily proclaim.

Aciddrop's hometown is located in a rather remote location in Columbia. The vast land and undeveloped economy there were rich breeding grounds for the gray market to flourish. The Siracusan Mafia, local gangs, and large merchants frequently made their way in and out, and though this shady area was kept relatively orderly, the general public security is far from ideal. In order to give the young and energetic children a means to protect themselves, after hesitating again and again, the old policeman taught Aciddrop the basic techniques to operate a hand crossbow, and also made a simple weapon for her— after all, he believed that Aciddrop has a strong sense of justice and was not the kind of child who would do bad things with a weapon. 
Unfortunately, there were some issues with Aciddrop's loose definition of justice. During an unexpected auto accident, the brave Aciddrop unintentionally destroyed a gang's illegal Originium trading plan, triggering retaliation from the affected gang members. During a brawl that was disguised as a case of school bullying, gang members who were even younger than Aciddrop sprinkled Originium dust onto her.

However, Aciddrop is not one to dwell on the past, demonstrating the perseverance and strength that her youth affords her. This perseverance has supported her to face the painful aspects of life, or in other words, allowed her to take her mind off from the pain. Perhaps one day, after Miss Aciddrop's Originium is effectively suppressed, she will choose to return home. Even if she can no longer take off her identity as an Infected, she feels as if she must complete the journey she failed to finish. 
'A toast to freedom, a toast to onion rings, and a toast to myself.' —Excerpt from a speech made by Miss Aciddrop on her first day at the dorms, when she threw a cocktail party using carbonated drinks rather than liquor.

modules.moduleDescription:
They crossed the line.
The Siracusans... and Victorians... and Bolívarians. They injured an innocent child. And they stopped up the station door with bills... Should've known Columbia was like this. Always has been.
No one who could've helped that kid. Went by the nickname 'Aciddrop.' Got into competitions. Glowed like the sun on the outer dunes back then. Now she caught Oripathy. Whereabouts... unknown. I wind this tape up, that marks one month she's been missing.
Still remember how I taught her to use a crossbow. Spark in her eyes, same as my wife and kids. Touched your heart some more than a breeze in the woods, and my girl—girls—[CHUCKLE]—I thought to myself back then how I pretty much had two goddamn daughters. 'Aciddrop.' She was like part of our family. Like candy. Sometimes her father came, checked in on her. Gaulish man, built strong. Nothing but guilt and love in his eyes whenever he looked at his daughter. He and I drank. He said he didn't know how to be a good father. Could've said the same myself.
Used to figure with how our families knew each other, be one of the few fancy things in my old age, but that all changed. Overnight. Kid, uh... left two skateboards here with me. The ones I 'confiscated.' Dumped them in the junk room too. Rolled right under that army sword from Bolívar.
I'm just an old guy. Saw these things happen before—never concerned me then. Wanted to do something... only today decided what. I know, look at me, death of a salesman. Best decision maker zero years running. Heh.
[SILENCE]
Taping two copies of this. Remember to send one to the kid if anyone finds her. I'll teach you how to fry onion rings for it. Secret's in the cheese.
[SILENCE]
They've got the smarts to stick with their own. Not much chance I come out on top. Feel sorry for my girl. Her dad shouldn't be taking a risk like this. Makes me glad, though... I fessed up about all this and she was in tears. Gave me the go-ahead.
[SILENCE]
Hey, kid. My daughter's all grown up now. How about you? Where you at?
No matter where you are, I bet you'll get along just fine.
Gangs. Hah. They gonna be scarier than the Steam Knights? Fire raining from the Witch King's spire?
[SILENCE, POURING LIQUOR]
Remember this, kid.
'Cheers to freedom, cheers to onion rings, and cheers to me.'
—Video cassette, previously held under strict safekeeping at a police station, sent to Rhodes Island after a case of station theft. Sender marked 'Onion Ring Alliance.'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Need me to make you some midnight snacks, Boss?
Here you go, Boss. And this. You mentioned it before... Everyone says I have a good memory, but I don't know.
When I'm off… I practice cooking. Not just seafood. What do you like to eat, Boss?
Errr… Boss, is it usually on me to find something to talk about?
Boss, if you ever want to see a Lungmen night market, I can take you. It's fun... but not exactly safe.
Boss Lady Kal'tsit gave me special permission to use Rhodes Island's supply channels. Now I can try some new stuff. Any requests, Boss?
I had Officer Hoshiguma on me for a while, for a couple of reasons... But I know she was just looking out for me, same as the neighborhood aunties and uncles.

I've been told that with my looks, my good memory and knife skills, I was born to be a villain. I don't like that, and I've struggled to find a proper way to change myself. But after coming to Rhodes Island, I realized I should just live my own life.
Boss, do you think there's any way to put my memory to good use...? I never thought about it before, but it would be nice if I could help.
Bo... Oh, you're asleep. I'll just keep reading then.
Hey, Boss. I'm Jaye. Officer Hoshiguma said I'd be better off working here, so here I am. I know seafood, I can cook, and I'm pretty good with a knife. I think I can help.
Oh... so cooking and warfare are pretty alike…
Boss, does this mean I can expand my stall a bit more?
Boss, I figured it out. If you just treat the enemy like fish, then fighting is a lot easier.
I forgot to close up…
I know how to lead a fishing crew.
Hm? We're going?
That's a lot.
Yeah?
Right here.
I'll try.
Ughh...
Scale.
Gut.
Clean.
Slice.
Boss, did we just do something special?
Boss, is it... is it over?
Boss, should we go after them?
Boss, I think we should probably run.
I don't know if there's a suitable place to set up my stall…
Hm?
Boss, I wonder if you have any food preferences...?
Arknights.

I used to always have to close up the stall late, but now all of a sudden it's a holiday. Can't say I'm used to it... Boss, you want some late-night chow? I'm a little hungry myself. I can cook something for us both.
Hey Boss, you're looking good today.
It's your birthday today, Boss. Big day. I always remember it, but I'm no good at presents... How about I make you something to eat? Whatever you want, I'll whip it up.

When Officer Hoshiguma said I should come to Rhodes Island, I was ready to work my hands to the bone. Then I realized, I may not get paid as much as I thought I would, but the work's also easier than I thought, so I guess it balances out... I'll keep doing my best, Boss.

Lungmen seafood hawker, introduced to us by Officer Hoshiguma, onboarded as an operator after testing. 
Skilled in the use of knives, currently serves as a Specialist Operator, and a lively presence on the battlefield.

Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Jaye shows no trace of Originium infection.

Operator Jaye rarely comes into contact with Originium.
archives:
Seafood hawker with an imposing facade. 
When he first arrived, the other operators thought Hoshiguma had brought us a real rough customer. But after getting to know him, it became clear that Jaye is, in fact, very nice. 
And he really is nothing more than a seafood hawker.

Despite how he may look at first glance, Jaye has a quiet personality, even coming off a bit stiff. He enjoys reading books and improving his cooking. He would like nothing more than to live a simple life, but, as we all know, you can't always get what you want. 
Jaye reports having been sent to the slums to work at a very young age. And thanks to his appearance, as well as his skills with a knife, he was often mistaken for a triad. And since the 'triads' of the Lungmen slums often keep a low profile, mixing in with ordinary folk and setting up front businesses, suspicion fell on Jaye. The misunderstandings and misconceptions piled on top of each other, giving Jaye a reputation as a dangerous man, not to be messed with. Some rumors even labeled him the true puppetmaster behind several different gangs. 
But really, Jaye just wanted to sell his seafood. He'd haul his goods to market, and sometimes help out at the finball shop. The rumors weighed heavily on Jaye. But there was nothing he could do about them.

According to Waai Fu, Jaye is very skilled, and as warm inside as he is cold outside. He is beloved by his regulars, who include Mr. Lee of Lee's Detective Agency, a fan of both Jaye's stall and the finball shop. 
One day, after closing up his stall, Jaye came upon Waai Fu in the midst of her fight against injustice. After they got to know one another, Waai Fu realized it was Jaye's stall Mr. Lee liked so much. And as the old man sent her out on her many errands, she became much closer to Jaye. 
The upstanding Waai Fu would, from time to time, help Jaye deal with problems here and there. But that only served to confirm his reputation as a dangerous killer to the uninitiated. And Waai Fu became known as a Yan kung fu master in his service. 
Though Jaye certainly isn't the professional killer he's sometimes rumored to be, the situation in the slums is still chaotic and complex. Consequently, the question of Jaye's identity endures through the fights and scuffles around him.

So the rumors persist. But this is not to say they are entirely without benefit. 
For example, Hoshiguma developed an interest in Jaye based on these rumors. Upon coming to understand his true nature, she grew concerned for him and ultimately referred him to us at Rhodes Island. 
Hoshiguma knows about old Lungmen. And she tells us that although Jaye is not a triad, he is connected with a certain Uncle Tung, who is a known associate of the Rat King. She says that, entirely unbeknownst to Jaye, this old man has worked to help him. 
It is clear to us that Hoshiguma revealed this information not to bring suspicion upon Jaye, but to prevent any problems or misunderstandings from arising in the future. 
Jaye is just Jaye, a normal civilian who has joined Rhodes Island. And that isn't going to change.

modules.moduleDescription:
'Boy, one must choose his own path. If you wish to drift freely, you shall not starve in Lungmen. But if you wish to live peacefully, then you must master a craft. Starting today, I will teach you how to make finballs.' 
'One makes a finball the same way one makes a man, and do you know what the most important thing is?' 
'It's––' 
'Slow and steady, one step at a time!' 
'But you said the most important thing was to never lie, cheat, or steal...' 
'There are many principles required to make a man, and you would do well to remember them all!' 
'When I make finballs, I have to do every single step starting from the slaughter. So, in order to learn how to make finballs, you must also learn how to use a knife.' Uncle Tung pauses for a moment, as if sensing that the words he wanted to impart are too difficult to articulate. He squeezes out the sentence, 'I'll demonstrate one more time, watch carefully.' 
Uncle Tung takes out a rolled leather bag and spreads it across the table. A row of dazzling knives reflect a blinding light. He retrieves a lively finfish from the water tank and slaps it a few times against the chopping board, its movements soon ceasing. He then takes out knives of different shapes and sizes and in turn, removes the scales with a small knife and slices open the belly with a large knife, each step orderly and neat. He shakes the complete finfish around in his hand a few times, and it turns into several different parts, neatly placed upon the table. 
'It seems complicated, and that's because it is. I'll tell you the principle behind using a knife - practice makes perfect.' 
I follow Uncle Tung's example and learn from him. I learn to slaughter the finfish, then how to make filling, then finally how to make soup. Uncle Tung calls me a fast learner, and it doesn't take me very long to join him at the stand. 
One day, a few people come to eat finballs and order a whole lot of them. They get up and turn to leave without paying. 
Uncle Tung has always allowed credit, but I know these guys and I know they aren't going to pay. Angered, I decide to teach them a lesson, but Uncle Tung rushes over and steps between me and them. 
'It's just a few finballs, just a few coins. All you have to do is remember to make up for it next time. There's always next time.' 
I had no choice but to give up, but that makes the punks even bolder. One of them shouts: 
'You filthy hawkers, clutching books all day. Think you're all high-and-mighty or something?' 
Uncle Tung turns around to face them. I can't see the expression on his face, but the punks look like they’re staring straight into hell itself. They half-run, half-crawl over each other as they scramble away. 
That night, Uncle Tung gives me that set of knives. 
'Make sure you take care of these. They might look old, but they're not cheap.' 
'Let me tell you another principle for how you use knives. The most important thing is to hide how sharp they are.'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: It's just document sorting, right? Please, I do this stuff all the time, piece o' cake.
Doctor, come on, check out my new video. You're gonna love it.
Yeah, that's the icon. Mind giving it a click? Oh, and if it's not too much trouble, maybe the one right beside it too? Hehe, thanks a bunch.
Content! Ideas! Memes! My brain's completely blank! I'm gonna lose subs…
I'm just an amateur explorer, you know. I just plan to take a few shots and then come right back, so I won't be gone for long. Besides, nothing beats chilling at home sweet home.
Medical must've put some weird ideas in your head again, right? Ahhh… I admit, I get these little impulses every now and then, but I promise, I'll never cause you any real trouble.

Video editing is totally my specialty! So, Doctor, you want a Rhodes Island promo? Got a plan for me? All righty, lemme take a look. Hmm… Rhodes Island precautions, Nutrition PSAs, fire safety tutorials…What in the terra are these?!

I have a bad feeling; there must be a terrifying Feline lurking nearby. Doctor, stay alert! They'll catch you off-guard, leap out from some shadowy corners, and smack you to the ground with a single swipe. Eh? It won't happen?

Living together with everyone and discovering new things to film—all the good things in life are compounding! Figuring all that out led me to become an operator, so now I can share my happiness with you.
Let me sneak a quick pic. Yeah, just one shot.
'Sup everyone, welcome to the Click Channel! Eh? No filming in the Doctor's office? Fine, I guess…
Let me do the filming next time.
A promotion? Awesome! Doctor, bring it in, let's get a commemorative photo!
Re…lax… Doctor. This happens every time I get excited, but it's nothing to worry about.
'Sup, everyone!
Leave it to me!
Doctor, don't forget to take everything you need.
Let's see what interesting footage I'll get this time.
Over here!
Tell me what to do.
Fly, my drone!
Let's get to work!
Fire!
Move aside!
I see you!
Hey, smile for the camera!
I just got a killer clip! Make sure you come by and check it out after you get back to the landship.
This is awesome! It's basically a ready–made battle record.
I was so caught up in filming that somebody slipped by me.
My lens is shattered…
Time to open my stream studio!
Wah!
Hey Doctor, I got something cool to show you!
Arknights.

Oh! I just got a new idea. Hold on, where's my camera? And anywhere I can set up a tripod? Alright. Doctor, help me test this out. When the fireworks go off, just look out the window. I'll take a picture of your eyes—
Hiii—

Doctor, have you heard of fancams? It's when you mix a whole bunch of clips together. I sometimes catch you commanding when I'm filming battle records. Ta-dah! Doctor's Command Scene High-Energy Beat Fancam in Ultra HD! It's your birthday present!

Doctor! I came to Rhodes Island just to earn some travel money, but there's no way I would ever leave a company that repairs my drones for free! Even with such big Felines running around, I'm not gonna— Ahhhhh! Is that… Blaze?!

handbook.profile: Operator Click, an independent video producer who is popular online, mostly shoots content of natural scenery and survival in the wilderness. She decided on her own to join Rhodes Island and serves as a Caster, but primarily works on providing support from the rear and recording battle footage.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Click has no signs of Originium infections. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.09u/L
Operator Click rarely comes in contact with Originium.
handbook.promotionRecord: 'Upon further examination of Click's body, we found that the Originium concentration did not meet the criteria for infection. But one thing did catch our attention: when subjected to high levels of emotional stress, her iris pigmentation ratio changes and displays a distinct red color, and along with this, she becomes more aggressive. Therefore, for your safety, if you notice that her eyes have turned red and her behavior has become more aggressive when she's in your office, please press the emergency button immediately and we will... huh? That already happened?! Oh, um, then could you please describe her state at the time? ...Her toned changed, and, mhm, mhm... and no anomalies other than that. You can confirm that she didn't threaten your safety? After all, when we conducted our behavioral study, she... All right, thank you for your assistance. We may need to re-evaluate her status. Oh, that's right, you still have a meeting this afternoon, so please don't be late.' —A recording related to Click
archives: Thanks to the emergency of intercity networks and portable photography devices, taking videos and sharing them with friends is not a novel concept. Despite the fact that network transmission range is limited and uploaded videos lack the fidelity of physical photos or videotapes, this new activity has gained traction online and continues to be very trendy. Click was one of the first people to join the ranks of online video producers and launched a wide variety of content. After many attempts, she finally found her niche as an accomplished producer of outdoors videos.

Click hasn't shown any particular animosity towards Felines, but based upon her past experiences, she instinctively keeps her distance. On occasions, she will warn non-Felines to stay away from them, as if every Feline on Terra is her enemy. But in reality, Click is not afraid of Mousse, or Jessica. She'll only go into hiding in the presence of Felines like Indra or SilverAsh. Even if she tries to define her phobia towards Feline, all she can really muster up is, 'they look really scary.'

Before joining Rhodes Island, Click was struggling through a little financial problem - her photography equipment had broken down. She had hired someone to retrofit the unmanned photography drone she keeps around her. Setting aside the cost of the retrofitting and repair, the technician had moved to work in another nomadic city, and the money she had on hand was not enough to support a venture to another city. Without her drone, not only did her planned shooting sessions fell through, but her living expenses over the coming weeks also became a significant issue. In order to earn a living, Click applied to become a video producer for a pharmaceutical, thinking that she'd make some quick money, find the technician, fix her drone, then continue with her online career. 
The rest is history - she now stays at Rhodes Island. 
The reason is actually very simple. The people here not only helped repair her drone, but even made a few technical upgrades that she never would've thought about before. Now, the drone is more sensitive, sturdier, and even comes with a small amount of firepower for self-defense purposes. Thus, after renewing her employment contract and adding some filming permission, Click stayed on Rhodes Island and became an operator.

In Terra, producing outdoors videos alone is a daunting task. Outside the relative safety of the cities, even an infant can hear the howling of danger. Therefore, before every filming session, Click spares no expense in doing her homework, assessing the danger level of the area, the weather status, the topography, and other factors. For this reason, after each video is finished, Click will attach highlights of roughly identical length, and in many cases, these highlights are even more popular than the original video. Of course, even all the preparation in the world cannot ensure that the video shoot goes smoothly. In the event that all her preparation is not enough to save her life, she has to resort to the one thing that can - herself, the one brave enough to face the storm.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Hm… Hmm… Hmmm… Oh, Doctor, is your day going well?
This is a floral tea that I made myself, Doctor. Come try a cup, I promise you'll feel cozy all day.
The sunlight in the greenhouse is so comfy. Even if I'm in charge here, it sometimes makes me want to sit down and relax for a bit.
Use the fruits of your labor to make everyone forget their sorrows and worries. That's probably a gardener's primary objective, don't you think?
I much prefer gardening to fighting. But as long as I think about how I'm helping everyone, I can muster up the courage to go into combat.
These bottles? They're the pollen and seeds I've been collecting. I usually put on a gas mask and gloves before handling them, to protect me from poison.
Hm, everyone seems a bit weary these days. But, when they see the flowers I've planted, I'm sure they'll cheer right up.

Doctor, Doctor! Are you coming to the greenhouse today? Everyone's been awfully busy the last few days… If nobody comes by the greenhouse, they're going to miss the blooming season. And wouldn't that be a terrible shame?
Tending the greenhouse is really hard. But, as long as the flowers I grow can make people smile, all my hard work will be worth it!
Doctor? Oh, you're asleep… May the flowery fragrance waft over your dreams.
Doctor, it's Podenco, here to say hi! If you have time, I'd love for you to come by the greenhouse!
Oh… I was expecting a video about gardening.
Artist? N-N-No, I'm not that talented. I'm just a normal gardener.
Look, Doctor! These are the new varieties I've been tending for so long. They've finally started to bloom! Aren't they gorgeous?
Hm? Am I going too?
Um, I've only ever tended a greenhouse. Can I really help with this…?
I see the enemy! Let's go!
Everybody, look after yourselves!
Yes?
Where are we going?
Got it.
I'll do it.
Careful, this pollen is allergenic.
Okay, I'll handle this.
I've seen weeds like these before.
Let me protect everyone!
Phew, are we safe already? Good job, everyone!
Achieving a flawless victory is like cultivating a beautiful flower. Both require a lot of hard work.
Doctor, everyone is waiting for your next orders.
Ah… I never thought it would turn out like this…
Should we plant some flowers over here?
Oh, Doctor?
Doctor! Would you like to decorate your office with some flowers?
Arknights.

Back home, most flowers would already have withered by now. But just thinking about how spring will be here soon… fills my heart with hope. Doctor, let's find the first flower that blooms in the greenhouse together!
Hello, Doctor!

handbook.profile: Podenco is an operator who applied to join Rhodes Island through a normal process, and is responsible for taking care of the greenhouse and cultivating flowers in Perfumer's Convalescent Garden. Can also be deployed as a combat operator and is capable of utilizing her understanding of plants to heal teammates or disrupt enemies.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Podenco has no signs of Originium infections. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Podenco has very little contact with Originium. 

'That scent, it's so good... So refreshing... Ah, ah... Achoo!' —A medic operator with a pollen allergy
handbook.promotionRecord:
'Podenco's Greenhouse - Production Commission Details' 
We can make floral tea, which is best enjoyed in the greenhouse. 
With a flower purse, you can always carry a soothing fragrance with you. 
Experience better rest with a flower pillow (please allow extra time for production). 
Come enjoy my flower biscuits, but please supply all the ingredients other than the flowers. 
Please discuss with me if you would like to request any other items, and I will see if there is a possibility of making it. 
There are many combinations of the above items to choose from. Please contact me for further details.
archives: Podenco was born into a small settlement on the steppes near the border of Bolívar. While this remote settlement was able to escape the flames of war due to its distance from the center of Bolívar, this isolation also created its own problems. To ensure their survival, the people of this settlement delved into their natural talents at evading Catastrophes and cultivating crops. Podenco has been interested in a variety of plants since a young age, likes to make dried flowers, and also tended a small nursery back home. As she grew up, she became involved in the community's farming efforts, gaining rich experience in botanical cultivation for plants both edible and ornamental. When asked which type of plants she prefers, Podenco will quietly tell you that she likes flowers more, but when food and clothing become a scarcity, she will silently stash away her personal preferences deep into her heart.

Not everyone who lives in these remote regions aspires to lead a bustling life in a distant land, but Podenco was one such person who did. The people of her home had little contact with the outside world, but the interactions they did have gradually gave Podenco a rosy impression of the outside world, particularly towards flowers. She had seen all kinds of flora in the world depicted through books and photos, but someone who never left Bolívar would never be able to see these flowers in their entire life. Within her stirred a great anticipation to see the outside world.

After arriving at Rhodes Island, her becoming Perfumer's coworker and apprentice was actually by chance. The young Podenco, like a fledgling leaving the nest, was completely spellbound by the magnificence of the city after arriving at the closest nomadic city from her hometown. She couldn't wait to find some place filled with fragrance and beauty, and soon after, she bumped into Perfumer in the middle of the street. Perfumer immediately noticed Podenco's fondness for flowers, and her own Garden happened to be short of the personnel needed to make her aromatherapy raw materials. And just like that, Podenco ran into someone by mistake, and landed herself the first job of her life. 
Compared to Perfumer, Podenco still is lacking in many ways. Her sense of smell isn't as sensitive as Perfumer's, nor does she have any knowledge of auxiliary professions, but she is quickly approaching Perfumer's skill with the momentum she has. From a single flower, to a garden, and now to an entire greenhouse, Podenco has the skill to independently manage the Convalescent Garden. In addition, she also began to use the flowers she collected to create a wide variety of reagents, constantly adapting to meet the demands of the various medics in the medical facility. In time, she may well become the world's undisputed master of horticulture. 
And it all stems from her love for flowers. 
A lifelong love.

modules.moduleDescription:
To the operator temporarily standing in for me:
Hello.

My name is Podenco. My health hasn't been too good lately. The doctors say it's because of overwork and so on, so I have to recuperate, and I'm not allowed to go and look after the plants. That's why I need you to take over some of the Convalescent Garden's work. I'll write what you need to do underneath, and if you're not sure about anything, you can ask Miss Lena to teach you. I'll recover as soon as I can, so I won't keep you for too long.
Before I introduce the work to you, please take a look to the right of this letter. There's a pouch with floral teabags, and some tasty little snacks. They're all for you, to say thank you. Go on and have them while you read below.

Your daily work will involve the following:
1. Temperature logging and warning. Each greenhouse entrance has a terminal to control the thermoregulatory equipment. You just need to check each day if the figures are normal or not, that's all. If the equipment's giving a warning, then report it to Miss Lena as soon as possible, and she'll help you solve the problem.
2. Operating the lighting. The Garden's lighting systems are all unified under PRTS control, so you don't actually need to worry too much, but just in case it's not working properly, you'll need to operate them manually, and adjust them into the correct positions. I've drawn detailed directions on another sheet, so make sure you look over that carefully.
3. Plant irrigation. You can leave most of the plants alone, and the greenhouse will sprinkle them at the same times each day. The schedule should be stuck to the door, so don't go inside when that's happening. There's some other flowers too, the ones in my studio, and I'm really sorry, but all I can do is ask you to take care of them for the time being. I've labelled how much water and nutritional fluid every plant needs on their pots, so keep a close eye on the markings on the spray bottle, and don't give them too much.
......
That's all I wanted to tell you. Once again, thank you for finding the time in your busy schedule to help me. If you like the presents I left you, then I promise I'll make more for you once I'm back in shape.


—Podenco
