handbook.promotionRecord: Most of the scars on Courier's body came from the people of Kjerag rather than beasts. After all, as an important man, SilverAsh has many enemies that want him dead. Courier always confronts these people in the dark. As for the fights with these rebels, only Courier's scars tell the tale - Courier himself says nary a word.
archives: Courier's keen sense of the terrain and environment is entirely from years of experience. In fact, when he was a child, he was not only unfamiliar with the roads, but he would even get lost. The way he tells it, he once got snowbound when he went out to play and almost didn't make it home alive. Fortunately, SilverAsh was hunting nearby and found him, thus returning him to safety. Because of this, no matter who might try to convince or threaten him to turn his back on SilverAsh, Courier will forever be the man's most faithful supporter.

As a race living in the cold regions of the plateau, the Itra have extraordinary resilience and endurance. Courier is no exception. Still, he likes to keep a low profile. He does everything with skill and with ease, and never lets anyone sees the limits of his abilities. Even SilverAsh is unaware of just what this Itra is capable of.

People enjoy having their letters delivered by Courier. Not only thanks to his attractive face and sunny disposition, but also because the letters he delivers have a faint fragrance about them. When the topic comes up, Courier will immediately change the subject. If pressed on it, he will hem and haw and his face will blush, a side of Courier very rarely seen.

Courier rarely loses his signature faint smile, though it should be noted that he has another side - a calm, tranquil, and peaceful side characteristic of one from the snowlands. Only his enemies and his most trusted friends get the chance to see that side of him. If he loses his smile while talking to you, that can only mean one thing - he regards you as a dear friend.

modules.moduleDescription:
Weiss brushes the snow off his body, and enters.
If it weren't for the bandages and bruises, you would never suspect from his unrelenting faint smile that he'd just gone through bitter hell.
It was an attempt on Enciodes's life. Comms were cut off before Weiss could state the precise location, leaving Enciodes's guards no choice but to provisionally surround him. Shields and blades firm in hand, they noted, out of the corners of their eyes, the Caprinae woman standing by their master's side.
They were all sure that with this Caprinae bodyguard by his side, no attempt would ever succeed. They just needed to coordinate with each other and settle this chaos while keeping casualties to a minimum. Not to mention, Weiss managed to get the most critical part of the message out, so now all they had to do was wait patiently for the enemy to serve themselves up.
But they didn't get to await the enemy.
In fact, when they caught sight of the traps on the mountain that had taken down a dozen or so of said enemy, the guards, shields and blades and all, were momentarily shocked—just a few branches hidden in the snow, plus flint blades fashioned out of rocks struck together, formed traps no one would ever notice and yet which sunk circle after circle of blood into the white snow, a faintly sanguine pink even leeching into the tundra some meters out.
And strewn all along the tundra were the enemy's now frozen severed limbs, as well as blood and pulped flesh hacked free from Weiss himself, forming mound upon mound in the snowfall. Sunk into the dismembered parts were wounds fierce, firm, and even visibly wrathful, while the cuts on Weiss that bared bone made every guard wince.
Itra do not reign supreme in sturdiness, and though Weiss's abilities excel, he is only human. Only a single member of Enciodes's guards, one who spends a considerable amount of time merely couriering Kjerag's letters to boot. People are fond of the faint scent on the letters he handles, and of his cheery face, and they admire his loyalty to Enciodes.
But no one would've imagined he had this side to him too.
Why? Nobody had asked Weiss to go so far. Being all on his own, simply passing on the word would've sufficed. He could've found somewhere to hide, and mustered enough defense to cope with this spate of traitors.
Enciodes looks over Weiss, but makes no move to ask him anything. Weiss sorts out the letters and documents on the table and deferentially excuses himself. Before the door closes, Enciodes hears a cut-off remark vanish into the wind: '...live up to duty.'

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Shirayuki, at your service.
Princess Fumizuki is my master, and you're my employer.
My hobby? Standing on the coast, watching the snow fall.
My affiliation? Secret.
My birthplace? Higashi.
My weapon? A shuriken, the Silver Wind, made by Eastern Heavy Industries.
Favorite food? Sushi.
My age? Confidential.
My duty? Protecting you.
How tranquil...
I am Shirayuki. Princess Fumizuki told me to assist Miss Ch'en and follow all your orders.
You have my gratitude.
A promotion? I, Shirayuki, am honored.
I, Shirayuki, may devote greater strength to you.
Understood.
Orders received.
Commencing operation.
A snowstorm will bury this battlefield.
Very well.
Ready.
Roger.
Understood.
Exterminate.
Shatter.
All ends on the wind.
Sever.
The enemy dies, I advance. I advance, the enemy dies.
The enemy has fallen. Total victory.
Of their ranks, some flee. Wariness, a must.
Should we fight again, we will return the favor one hundredfold.
A very nice room.
Here.
Your consideration, I, Shirayuki, will engrave upon my heart.
Arknights.
Happy New Year. May all proceed as you will it.
Yes, employer?
Happy birthday. Please take this present. No, 'tis no bidding of the Princess.
I, ShiraYuki, here ever keep my watch. In duty, and our bonds.

handbook.profile: Formerly the personal bodyguard of Lady Fumizuki, wife of Lungmen's Chief Wei Yenwu, Shirayuki was sent to Rhodes Island to serve the Doctor in the same role, after the Lungmen Guard Department partnered with the company. She uses large shurikens as her weapons of choice, and is well-versed in covert ops and intelligence gathering. She protects the Doctor from behind the scenes.

handbook.promotionRecord: The princess said blind loyalty is nigh-impossible to find. But here you are, and I like it. —Shirayuki
archives:
A reserved ninja who is incredibly succinct with her words, never using two when just one would do. 
You never know where she might be until she is needed by the Doctor and she appears with unerring, possibly even eerie, dependability. 
Her hobby is apparently watching the snow from the coast, but it is not known if her preference is for the coast, the snow, or a necessary combination of the two.

Large shurikens are Shirayuki's weapon of choice. 
There are many shapes and sizes of shurikens, but no matter the type, throwing weapons are always difficult to wield effectively.
Undoubtedly, Shirayuki is an expert at using them, exhibiting accuracy and lethality that most normal people would find impossible given the unwieldiness of these weapons.

The ninja is commonly held as one of the national symbols of Higashi. 
These mysterious assassins can allegedly walk on walls, burrow underground, and kill from impossible angles. They are said to value loyalty above all else. 
A ninja, upon pledging fealty, will serve his lord unwaveringly. And that is exactly what Dr. Kal'tsit is having an issue with--Shirayuki's loyalty lies with Madam Fumizuki, not the good Doctor at Rhodes Island.

Of course, the true purpose of Shirayuki's presence at Rhodes Island is not to protect the Doctor, that much is certain. That was just a pretext for Rhodes Island to accept her. 
Still, that does raise some questions. 
Even though it's ostensibly a partnership, Lungmen and Rhodes Island hold different views and objectives. Still, the Governor sent off his wife's personal bodyguard to protect the Doctor. Whether for surveillance or a show of power, it was very blunt, even unnecessary. 
Supposedly, Madam Fumizuki doesn't involve herself in politics, but it's hard to imagine she has no ulterior motive with this move. 
So then, what are Shirayuki's orders after all?

modules.moduleDescription:
Heavy snow, a bamboo forest.
An emaciated figure dives in, staggering; this is where she's concealed herself the whole way. She thinks to dig out some winter bamboo shoots to stave off her hunger, to take a few mouthfuls of snow to allay her thirst.
The bamboo forest is a fine place to hide, but she's not the only one who knows that. A dozen or so shinobi are in cover here, tasked with ensuring that this girl, the last survivor to escape from the purge of her family, does not remain so.
The bamboo leaves rustle, and the branches up high drift up and down in the wind.
Their tips shudder, shaking free small clumps of snow, which scatter in a slicing gust before they ever touch the ground, becoming a fine wintry mist and disappearing into the air. A few fowlbeasts on another stalk retract their necks, stuck out moments prior, and fold their wings up again, relaxing and continuing to huddle close.
All is still.
The bony girl lifts her head.
Suddenly, a white glint.
A dart at odds with her build flies from her hand, snowflakes and wind whirling alongside. This weapon has seen plenty of use thus far; now, it makes a clean cut yet smashes to pieces a bamboo leaf big enough to conceal someone.
The struck shinobi lets out a short cry, and powdery snow explodes off the layers of leaves. A trap prepared long in advance cuts off the girl's retreat. She leaps atop a branch, before being forced back by the flash of a descending blade. Her weakness from days without food catching up to her, she loses her grip on the branch, and drops like a stone. But undeterred, she looses one final arrow from her sleeve in midair.
It finds itself with no target to hit, but both her and the shinobi crash to the ground at practically the same time, with a dull thud. She lifts her head, and before her is a Lung dressed in black, brandishing a naginata right behind the shinobi.
'So this is where you were, girl?'
The girl stares blankly, not knowing how to respond.
'I am Fumizuki,' she says, patting the girl's head. 'Can you use a blade?'
The girl comes to her senses, and nods. She grasps a handful of snow from the ground, stuffs it in her mouth and swallows, draws a spare tantou from Fumizuki's waist, and charges at her enemy within the forest. Fumizuki watches this frail girl leave, and quickly follows behind.
One, then two. From sun overhead to horizon-laid, the shadows amidst the bamboo fall without even a chance to signal their backup. When the final shinobi uses the last of their strength to charge the girl, aiming a hidden shot straight at her stomach, Fumizuki pushes her down to avoid this fatal blow.
Once it's all over, a tiny body collapses in the great bamboo thicket, holding her wounds and letting out a long, slow breath.
Sunshine's rays filter through the leaves and shine on her face, the sound of fowlbeasts flapping by in her ears.
Before exhaustion brings her to sleep, her parents' lifelong teachings come back to her. The girl must offer her loyalty to the princess before her.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: I sense something familiar in the wind. Where are we?
Do you feel the wind from Kazimierz?

Rhodes Island is very different from the places I used to live. There's nowhere to start a campfire here... too bad. Maybe on the deck? I'd like to create a space where everyone can talk and grow closer together.
Umm, how does this mission signup system actually work? I'm really bad at electronics…
There have been lots of new faces at Rhodes Island. I'll gladly help them adjust to the environment.
That Kazimierzian knight... Oh, it's her. I knew that girl years ago. She used to be a shy, bookish type. I wonder what made her change so much.
Shh... look what I found! A solitary Doctor... gotta catch this one! Oh, did I scare you? Haha…
I sometimes recall the time back home in the forest. We had lots of different competitions every year…ah, the good old days. I wonder what my hometown is like now.
I'll always have your back, Doctor.
So you can fall asleep without a care, just like that? Heheh...
Hello, I'm Meteor, the archer from the woods. Do you need an Operator who excels in long-distance support?
Archery requires constant practice. No one can afford to slack off for even one day.
I'm honored to receive this promotion.
Thank you, Doctor, for recognizing my skill. I'll continue to do my best to serve you.
Leave the long-distance support to me.
I'll keep everyone safe.
Everybody, let's go.
Time to show them what we can do.
Awaiting your orders.
I've been waiting for a while.
The wind is blowing in the right direction.
I'll stay vigilant.
Perfect chance!
Feel the wind.
This is the shot!
Critical hit.
No matter how difficult the battle, we can handle it, as long as we work together as one.
Perfect! You all did well.
All injured personnel, please stay put, don't move. I'll be right there.
I'm sorry... I didn't want it to end up like this...
It's hard to get used to such a small room.
Oh? Need anything?
Being by your side feels like basking in the spring sunshine. So warm, so comfy.
Arknights.

Another year gone by. I wonder if the forests are as I left them? I'm still not too used to modern life, and people still fear Oripathy as much as ever, but the arrival of a new year means the land is once again shining with new life. There's still hope, for everything.
Hello, Doctor.

I found this plant a few days ago on a field mission. It's quite a miraculous one. Even when it's wilted, all it needs is to soak in water for a few nights, and it'll regrow all its leaves and stems—a method that lets it live for a very long time. Happy birthday, and may our fellowship be just like this plant.

Oh dear, these electronic appliances never make it easy. But I've been making progress, don't you think? Some of the things you call 'old-fashioned' just suit me better, like this bow. After using it for so many years, it has my total trust.

handbook.profile:
Meteor is a former forest warden from Kazimierz, an amazing archer with extensive experience in tracking and wilderness survival. 
She serves as a frontline sniper for Rhodes Island concurrent with her medical treatment.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5% 
Currently no visible symptoms. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.24u/L 
Minor stage of infection, currently no discernible physical effects.
archives:
Meteor is an easy-going forest warden. 
Time was, she and her fellow wardens protected the endless forests of Kazimierz, until she contracted Oripathy and was forced into exile. She joined Rhodes Island after several stops in between. 
Kind and caring, Meteor loves big get-togethers and often takes the lead herself. Despite her age, she is very reliable.

Meteor doesn't care much for electronic devices. 
Trying to get some gizmo to work is worse than having Oripathy to her. Naturally, coming to Rhodes Island was quite a culture shock for her; more than most any other new operator. 
Even after all this time, she still avoids electronics.

As composite bows replace the traditional kind, Meteor bucks the trend by sticking to the old ways. 
It is to her a commemoration of her past, the other forest wardens who fought with her, and her life in the woods. 
Given her skill, she easily meets expected damage output metrics without the advantages provided by a composite bow.

After leaving the forest, Meteor wandered for a long time. She went endured the hardships of the modern world and saw how much the people feared Oripathy. 
None of that made her lose faith, though. She finally found Rhodes Island and requested to serve as an operator while undergoing treatment. Rhodes Island couldn't turn away a talent like her.

modules.moduleDescription:
Coming in at a clip through the dense forest hills, her heart pounds like it wants to leap from her chest. The prey at her knees thrashes relentlessly and still draws ragged gasps, kiln-hot breath met with the ice-cold forest air as it flares from its nostrils, giving rise to a fine white mist.
Stooping low, she leans to its ear, and speaks a few soft words of comfort.
'Shh, it'll be fine soon. Calm down, calm down.'
Heeding her warm caress, the prey's struggles slowly cease, and it stares at her with its deep black gaze. In the pool of its stagnant eye, its pupil still tremors and quakes, stirring a whirlpool in its sclera, tenaciously seeking to draw one last drop of mercy from the two eyes staring back.
Yet her voice is a ruthless gust that coils through dead leaves.
'It'll all be over soon.'
With a draw of a hunter's knife from her rear hip, slitting the prey's throat is both quick and clean. Fresh blood gushes from the incision and stains the earth, leaving behind a thick iron stench which mixes with the rotting autumn leaves and lingers for a good while in her nose.
This month shows signs of spring, winter having only just thawed, and the ice-littered creeks chill her fingers to a deep red swell while the blood hardened on the knife washes and melts away in the current. Like red threads needling through the water, flowing with the creek to the forest's edge.
Behind her, a full beastskin hangs on a branch, with a bonfire lit below to cook the moisture from it. The prey's carcass has been split, one half skewered above the fire, wafting an enticing aroma of grease as it roasts. The other half she's left by the creek, soon to be found by scavenging animals following the scent of blood, and dragged away in their mouths.
Daytime follows in the departing footsteps of night, early morn filtering through the forest in slanted beams from the east. Perfectly pale light glances again and again off the creek's shimmering waves, stabbing at her undefended eyes still adjusted to the earlier darkness. Her hand quickly shields them as she waits for them to adapt to the sun's sting. Warmth takes to the fine veins in her eyelids, inviting her to open her eyes again and see the beautiful sight. Letting out a deep sigh, she experimentally opens her tightly curled fingers. Her eyelashes tremble, she opens her eyes, and that which filters through the cracks between her fingers is the faint green of a rich forest. Deep in the trees, a kyebeast wanders through the cover, chewing leisurely at the grass, unaware that it's already been trapped in that frigid forest, and of the keen arrow nocked in a bow aimed at the hollow of its throat.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: I-Is there anything I can help with? Just say the word and I can do it.
Franka and Liskarm are so incredible! I really admire them. I want to become as great as they are someday. I can... I can do it! Will you help me, Doctor?
Um, I heard word that Vanilla's here too? She was in my squad when she first joined Blacksteel. We went on missions together! She's become such a reliable Operator now... but I'm still just me...
Dr. {@nickname}, do I come off as... spineless? I know I shouldn't let people walk all over me... I'm trying to change...

Sometimes I feel like I'm back in Blacksteel, even after going through so much with Rhodes Island. I'm not the old me anymore, either... it's weird. Is it because I miss how it was back then? No, no. I don't miss the person I used to be, I know that for sure...

Hard work doesn't mean anything without results. That's what I think at least! That's why I don't want anyone to see me training alone. Having you, though... it's really comforting when you're with me, for some reason.
I pulled a muscle training a couple days ago... but don't worry, I-I'm okay! Urk...! I won't let this get in the way of you or anyone at Rhodes Island, Doctor!
Freeze, hands in the air! Oh, did I scare you? I'm sorry, it's just Franka told me to be bold and assertive, and I only wanted to try it out... I'm really sorry...
Everyone at Blacksteel and Rhodes Island is so amazing and talented. I know I'm nothing compared to them... but, still, just every once in a while, I really like it when I get compliments...
Doctor... Doctor? Are you sleeping? I'll clean your desk up for you, then...
Um, are you Dr. {@nickname}? Nice to meet you. I'm Jessica from Blacksteel Worldwide. Sorry... I'm really bad at introducing myself...
This seems a lot more effective than training by myself.
Doctor... I'm... I'm so happy you're honoring me... Just... let me cry it out for a bit, I'll be fine...
Ah, Doctor, does this mean you think I'm a great Operator? Thank you so much for all your help. You were by my side all the way...!
Just give your orders and I'll carry them out!
I won't let you down!
Stay focused... look straight ahead.
I'll definitely prove myself this time!
Standing by...
Haah?
Ughh...
All right...
Y- you'll pay for that!
Freeze!
Not one step backward.
I'll show them what I can do!
I'm going to climb to the top of the mountain. I won't stop halfway!
I... I really did it? I managed to protect everyone by myself?
I could do better. I can't get complacent just because we won!
Requesting medevac! I dragged everyone down... it's all my fault! Sorry! I'm sorry!
I wonder if the people at Rhodes Island are nice...?
Where are we going...?
I can do a little cooking...
Arknights.
Uh... S-Sorry, Doctor. I think I pushed myself too hard. My hands won't stop shaking... But I can hang these balloons on my own, no problem! Alright... Happy New Year, Doctor.
Good morning, doctor...
Happy birthday, Doctor! Sorry… I can't make anything myself, so I had to buy you a gift… It's too expensive? It could pay for a whole month of training? B-But isn't that pretty normal for a gift?

Back at those Blacksteel ceremonies, when we all got to meet the really highly-decorated mercs, I would find myself wondering if I could ever match them… But since coming to Rhodes Island, I'm always thinking about how much I'd like to go on the really tough missions with the senior operators.

Dr. {@nickname}, do I come off as... spineless? I know I shouldn't let people walk all over me... I'm trying to change...

Hard work doesn't mean anything without results. That's what I think at least! That's why I don't want anyone to see me training alone. Having you, though... it's really comforting when you're with me, for some reason.

Freeze, hands in the air! Oh, did I scare you? I'm sorry, it's just Franka told me to be bold and assertive, and I only wanted to try it out... I'm really sorry...
Everyone at Blacksteel and Rhodes Island is so amazing and talented. I know I'm nothing compared to them... but, still, just every once in a while, I really like it when I get compliments...
Doctor... Doctor? Are you sleeping? I'll clean your desk up for you, then...

I won't let you down!

I'll definitely prove myself this time!

Haah?

I'm going to climb to the top of the mountain. I won't stop halfway!

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Jessica showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Jessica rarely comes into contact with Originium.
archives: A panicky Operator dispatched from Blacksteel, Jessica is a reliable, combat-effective asset and full-time Blacksteel mercenary. But she suffers from such crippling insecurity that Vanilla, a Blacksteel apprentice, seems more dependable in battle.

Perhaps thanks to her timidity, Blacksteel executives would often scoop Jessica up and subject her to tests of new equipment and devices. Even after arriving at Rhodes Island, Operators would ask Jessica to demonstrate their new equipment before they'd be willing to use it. 
In a way, it shows how naturally trustworthy Jessica is.

A part of Jessica's insecurity stems from selective perception. 
In actuality, Jessica has the skills to hold at least the middle rank in an organization of any scale. In her time with Blacksteel as well as Rhodes Island, there has never been a blemish on her record.

modules.moduleDescription:
Dear Sis,

I've been looking forward to the day you wear the equipment I designed into the battlefield, ever since you became a mercenary at BSW with that giant smile on your face. Now my wish has finally come true. Do you know how happy that makes me?
Here are some tactical gloves designed for Pioneer teams heading anywhere from Columbia to Sami, with insulating material, extra protection on the knuckles. They should do great for helping you resist the cold. I worried a lot about how they'd conduct Arts, but I don't really know much about controlling stuff as precisely as firing a gun, so maybe these gloves could interfere slightly? Whenever you reply, remember to fill me in on how they went in real combat. If you don't write me at least a full page, I'll tell Dad about how you've been ordering equipment from me on the down-low.
You mentioned how touching ice still makes you shake because of the brutally cold winter days you spent in Ursus, so none of the sugary stuff I'm buying you needs refrigerating. I hope this partner firm you're at now doesn't treat you too bad.
You always seem a little guilty about how you performed in your most recent op, like blaming yourself for not contributing enough. You might not be willing to tell me about what's happened in concrete, but I think if you're still standing on both feet at mission complete, nobody can ask you for anything more. You end up getting put through the wringer on campaigns as a merc, and even just listening to clients' stories tells me there's more than enough funny business out there. Even the most seasoned vets have some terrors carved into their memories forever, and some enemies they think they could never take down. I've even seen a guy start sobbing uncontrollably when something old came up at a meeting.
If you keep having all these nightmares, I just want you to know you're welcome back home anytime for some rest.
—Take a step back, though. You chose to purchase new gear, and more etched ammo. Doesn't that say how brave you are?

Also, I'm not gonna jab at you about taking a break, but if you get hurt while wearing gear I designed, I'm gonna feel real bad about it. So get yourself in a good headspace before you run your next op, okay?

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Alright, Doctor, your tarot card for today is...
Would you like to learn more about your future?
Bear it in mind that excessive reliance on unfathomed power will eventually backfire on us.
Tarot cards aren't divine, all-seeing tools. Instead, we use them for guidance when we feel lost.
Destiny is like the world we walk upon—no one can escape it.
Humans might never be able to escape this world... but we can change it. Our actions belie endless possibilities.
There are countless topics for which you can consult the tarot, the most common one being your luck in card games. To change it, however, you must be brave enough to change your fate first.
We have a ritual among diviners that's all the rage these days. We call it the 'Hand of Fate.' Would you like to try it?
It's a divination taboo to do readings concerning death. But I don't believe death is the end—it's the beginning of something new.
Dreams can often enlighten you in strange ways. If you have an enlightening dream like that, you'd best remember every detail, Doctor.
Following the guidance of the arcana, our paths have finally converged. Nice to meet you, Doctor.
I feel inspired now.
I'd already foreseen this promotion in my crystal ball. Heheh, just kidding.
You want to know your destiny, Doctor? Too bad, I can't help you. I'm not the one to share it with you, for the fate forbids me to do so.
Wait a minute, let me predict the results of this battle.
Well then, let me pray for everyone.
Fate is a fickle thing... only the victorious will be forever revered.
I can see the outcome. Victory belongs to Rhodes Island.
A very wise choice.
My turn.
Draw a card.
Do not resist your fate.
The tower of void.
The flying chariot.
The Emperor's scepter shall break.
All will fall before the Priestess's might.
Will fate have us in a chokehold… or will we turn the table?
I have moved all of them to the graveyard.
Time to reshuffle the deck.
Impossible... this isn't what I saw in the cards...
Bad omens seem to lurk inside this room. May I use my powers to help you manage them?
Hm? What can I do for you?
Want me to do a reading on your future? All right, please give me a minute.
Arknights.

Happy new year, Doctor. I bet you are eager to learn your fortune this year from me, aren't you? I have, truth be told, stolen a peek into it. My divination was reliable, as always. Still, only by unveiling the fate's mask with your own hands will you discover what lies beneath, don't you agree? No need to worry, I will be there to help you.
Doctor, you're blessed by the winds of luck.

Happy birthday, Doctor. As my birthday gift for you, I will answer any one question from you about the future. Yes, anything will be fine. I would like to remind you though, that I don't offer this kind of chance everyday, so think twice before you ask.

There's no preordained path where one shall walk, nor predestined fate which one shall suffer. And everyone on Rhodes Island has proved that many, many times. Here, Doctor, Peek into the crystal ball. As long as your heart is not shadowed by the clouds, you will see the light of hope at the end of the haze.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.3u/L 
Infection approaching mid-stage, Originium beginning to have physical effects that are not obvious.
archives: A fortune teller cannot tell her own future, but she can read the omens and guide her choices. She has the power to create devastating explosions with her Originium crystal ball, but she must also withstand the backlash.

Divination is a hobby to Gitano that she does almost for free, accepting fruits and cakes as tokens of payment. Her clients ask for readings on anything from the future to a misplaced key. Just like any soothsayer, Gitano gives ambiguous answers that require some careful thought to decipher.

Unlike her relaxed composure during a reading, Gitano gets anxious easily and becomes very competitive when playing cards. She is never allowed to shuffle the deck out of fear that she'll cheat. Even then, she knows countless other card tricks, and unless she's caught red-handed, she'll never admit to cheating. Still, some people play with her because they either want to catch her in the act, or see a nervous side of her she doesn't otherwise show.

modules.moduleDescription:
The moment she raises her crystal ball, Gitano foresees danger.
The squad is escorting a group of rescued Infected to Rhodes Island's transport. After the intense battle, everyone is visibly exhausted. She reminds her teammates to watch out for an ambush, but not a moment after she finishes—and before her teammates had time to react—the ambushers have already emerged from behind the boulders.
The very next moment, the fog that clouds the barrenland is immediately split asunder by the blinding flash of Originium Arts, forcing the ambushers to take a step back.
It seems casting the Arts was too much for Gitano to bear, giving her a spell of dizziness and a burning sensation at the source of her infection. 'You can't keep using your Originium Arts like that.' The advice she got from her tribespeople years ago echoes in her ear. 'Your body can't withstand it anymore. You'll fall ill if you keep casting them.'
Nonetheless, she has pushed herself to her limits in the tundra more times than she can count. With the responsibilities she shoulders, she's never been one to fear falling ill.
Some time later, she faintly overhears two men talking in hushed voices.
'Shh—It's okay. She fell asleep because she's tired. Her infection hasn't gotten worse. Don't worry.'
'We have her to thank for reacting so quickly, otherwise we wouldn't have made it back in one piece.'
'How did she foresee the ambush, though? If she's really able to peek into the future, wouldn't she also know that—'
'Don't be stupid. She herself often says that destiny is something that can be changed.'
'Will you really resist the guidance of fate itself?' All those years ago, her tribespeople implored her. 'We need to turn around. We don't want to leave our homeland, and we've already paid a dear price.'
But the young fortune teller kept leading them onward.

The Rhodes Island transport pulls out of the site with the team, after their successful rescue mission. The Elafia holds tightly onto her crystal ball as she sleeps on the stretcher. She dreams of the black forest back home and the bitter, salty snowdrops, as well as the silhouettes of the mountain chains peeking above the horizon. She's never turned around, nor can she ever go back.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Didn't notice me behind you, eh? It's only natural. I'm a cat. We're known for being silent prowlers!
Hey, don't touch my hat... it's crazy, you know! If it feeds you too many secrets, Doctor, you'll be in trouble.
So rare to see a pharma take in runaway kitties from a jail. Did you all want a peek at my maps? Or,  was it some advice on prison breaks?
We thieves have our own principles and standards too... perhaps. Who can say?
Meow, meow, meow... Meow? Never you mind, I'm just talking to myself.
Anytime you want. Don't you worry, I have friends everywhere. Eyes everywhere.
Curiosity can kill a cat, you know.
I'm in a good mood right now, so here's a riddle for you. 'Why is a raven like a writing desk?'
Thank you, for this 'Haze' I'm now. But... did you catch a peep of any of them, along the way? Any of, well... my secrets?
Asleep like a baby... Time to get 'meown to business,' then.
Hello, I'm Haze. I like relaxing work environments, and an employer who knows better than to bother me with too many questions.
Yummy.
Promotion? What's that? Does it taste good?
Finally out of those old shackles... and here I am, straight into new ones. The destiny of a thief's no wonder.
Give me a bit of freedom and I'll be happy.
What do we need a leader for? Can't everyone just fight on their own?
Meow... It's driving me wild... this sweet, sweet smell of freedom!
Everyone, no need to have cold feet here.
Meow?
Here we go.
Out and about.
Like a shadow.
How do nya like this?
Careful, kittens. Don't lose your mittens.
You think you've got all the trimmings, don't you?
Nah-ah-ah, Don't get carried away.
No one stands above a kitty in the end!
Perfect victory? Whatever. A victory's a victory afterall.
Do you know how many enemies you let go? That will be a spanner in the works.
I'm no stranger to running for it, but this is just too embarrassing...
Kotatsu. Where's the kotatsu?
Meow?
Meow? I'm not satisfied yet. You know my rule: if I can't have it, I want it.
Arknights.

New year? A year is such a long time for a kitty. And happiness won't come knocking if one worries about more than just today. Speaking of which, today is really nice for napping. Doctor, how about we just spend this day with some lazy, cozy naps.
Doctor, nice to meet nya.

Happy birthday, Doctor. Meow? My best wishes aren't enough? Don't tell me you want some presents, you greedy kitty. Well then, what do you want? Shall I give you a riddle, or allow you to rub my ears?

A kitty visits gardens that provide food. But if someone tries to lock the kitty up, it will surely run away. When the kitty's in a good mood, however, it can bring back some tasty stuff as thanks. Know what I mean, Doctor? Be sure to make Rhodes Island a garden that everyone likes.

handbook.profile: Haze is an operator from Victoria, where she did time in an Infected quarantine lockup. She finally escaped after multiple attempts, eventually joining Rhodes Island under an alias.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 16% 
No visible signs of crystal formation, but comparatively worse internal contamination. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.36u/L 
Infection entering mid-stage, crystals are starting to enhance the host's Originium abilities.
archives: Haze is able to cast Dark Fog Arts, a spell unique to her. The versatile mist can obscure vision, damage, kill, or enhance Haze's own abilities.

Haze has a habit of palming things from those around her. While she never steals money or keys, no trifling trinkets are safe with her around. Such trivial thievery wouldn't normally get anyone in serious trouble, but upon getting picked up for a minor infraction, her infection was discovered, so the authorities dumped her into a cell for the Infected.

Her prison was especially built to hold Infected criminals. To break out and breathe free once more, she had to climb the towering quarantine wall and evade all security measures in between. Haze is the only one to have managed such a feat, with the Victorian Police still hunting her to this day.

Haze makes no secret of her fondness for feline Beast Stewards. Even though these same cute animals led to her infection, she still feeds and cares for them. So it's no surprise Haze gets along with other Felines like Mousse.

modules.moduleDescription:
Through the 'Forest' she makes her way. Between the bars of naked steel she skips, from one end of the alleyway to the other, and on top of a faded billboard she climbs. Not far away, an empty tin can topples over. She takes a small step back, crouching for a while under the shadow. Only once she's sure her silhouette is alone again under the moonlight—does her step pick up once again, deft like a wisp of fog. She finds her way straight through a window empty of its glass.
A puddle of water rests on the ground, which she avoids with great intent. Probably the recent shower of rain, that tonight's so especially bright. Not a good omen, in any case. In times gone by, no one would dare trespass into the Forest thick of fog, for there was Witch's domain. The greedy merchant had want of the Witch's powers, but pitch-black smoke would bind the neck of such a soul. Only lost children would have good fortune in the night... Most of the coven had come to suffer a different kind of curse already, but in the hazy night those inauspicious stones would happily be hidden from view.
A great fire of yore took the original Witch Forest. Thereafter, one nomadic city to the next, these empty rooms have been little more than the cracks amidst neon and skyscraper's reflections... hardly fit for a safe domain.
She silently patrols her temporary lodgings, and finds the Hat out of a pile of miscellanies. A broad-brimmed one, cloth heavy-set in all its layers. Its inside is riddled with patchwork, every hand which sewed on those eclectic fabrics still there in her memories. Some were wizened, some young, all so soft without exception, so tender. She jumps into it, lets the sheets of fabric surround her body, as if she's returned to their embrace.
Another hand rests upon her head. She remembers this one, the youngest among them, and the last to still follow her. This girl's hand once carried the scent of clean grass and fresh paper, like the others, but in these times it was always sullied with rust, with blood.
'We've been found again.' The young Witch picks her up and cradles her, and puts on another hat entirely. 'Take a guess. How long can we still run, I wonder, before the next time we're caught?'
The creature brushes against the Witch's cheek, reflecting not an inch of light.
Together, she and the girl leap into the dark of night, straight through the Forest. Such is the freedom they were meant to share.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Work's kinda like a trap, and you just fling yourself into it.
I don't talk much 'cause I don't want to. Not 'cause I'm looking down on anyone.
What did Midnight do this time? Did he finally end up in Medical after hitting on one too many ladies in the hallway? No? Too bad.
Got something, Doctor? I could probably lend a hand. But I'd rather not eat up too much of my time. I got a lot of comics to read.
I know I speak a little too bluntly sometimes, but I always get my work done. It's not like I got professional pride or anything, I just can't respect somebody who doesn't finish his work.
Rhodes Island is a strange place. The people here just say whatever they're thinking, and somebody's always there to help when someone needs it.

Reserve Op Team A6 is a real diverse crowd. We have Lady Stinky-face, Miss Lacking-self-confrol, Narcissist Kun, and a little walking time bomb. But still, I do think I can trust them. They work hard, even if they don't show it.
I used to live free and easy like everyone else at Rhodes Island, but my family thought I was a freak. This place may be a freakshow, but at least everyone's happy, and that's pretty good.
Can I go back to my room now?
Hi, I'm Spot from Operation Reserve Team A6. My job is to protect the other troublemakers on my team, I guess.
I've seen this battle before. Bad guys got their asses kicked.
I'm gonna work twice as hard. I'll bump it up from a 0.1 to a 0.2, I think.
I won't ask about the meaning of this mission then.
I wanna get back to my dorm.
Got it.
Save us a lot of time if you just surrender.
Whatever you say.
Doesn't matter to me.
Alright then.
Yeah, yeah, fine.
Hey, catch.
Don't see any harm in this.
So many weaknesses.
Holding this shield is tiring, pal.
Been through an easy battle, you say? Then better do it all over again.
With hard work, even an idiot can get the job done.
Perfection is for suckers, you know.
Relax, you're doing fine.
Yeah sure.
Ah.
If you keep petting me like that, my hair's gonna get tangled.
Arknights.

handbook.profile:
Originally a Sargonsoldier, Spot took the initiative and came to Rhodes Island seeking employment himself. After passing the examination battery, he was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6.
He has a lot of experience as a guard; and serves as the defensive specialist on the team.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in his circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming him as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3% 
Crystallization visible on surface of body, with many symptoms of Oripathy difficult to spot due to skin and hair color. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.30u/L 
Infection is currently spreading at a constant rate. Regular observation and treatment required.
archives:
A member of Reserve Op Team A6 who used to be a Sargon soldier. 
He rarely speaks and has little reason to. On the rare occasion he does open his mouth, he tends to be brutally direct. Among the ostentatious members of Team A6, he is truly the odd man out.

A fan of superheroes and pulp action, Spot loves to read comics and has an impressive collection. 
He has filled a whole shelf with his comic books, and other Operators often borrow them from him.

Although Sargon is a developed country with no shortage of modern entertainment in its cities, the Sargonians always seem a bit withdrawn.
Spot himself seemingly has no interest in anything other than comics and fashion. Every once in a while, he will ask Orchid to give him a Sargonian hairstyle.

Spot's personality is largely the product of a stoic family. 
Sargonian military families have no patience for laziness. Unwilling to conform to his family's wishes, he became closed off, aggressive, and eventually ran away from home.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Ummm... Nice to see you again, Doctor. It makes me happy... hehe...
Doctor, do you need a break? I made you some tea, and Miss Orchid made cookies. Here, hope you like them… And, umm... Cheer up!
Why is everyone in Team A6 always fighting with each other...? If things keep going like this, we can't be a team anymore... Fighting is bad. I must make them understand!
The gear on my chainsaw is kinda loose, the one that makes the 'vrrrr' sound ... But I don't remember using it lately. Weird...
Doctor, is Team A6 getting along well...? That's really some good news. Peace is the best... As long as they don't fight, nothing will bother me while I stay with you…
I don't know why, but I sometimes get these gaps in my memory. Then when I ask my teammates in A6, they just smile and tell me nothing happened at all...
Um, Doc-Doctor, did I just pass out...? Um, why is everyone lying on the floor? Miss Catapult? Mr. Midnight? Mr. Spot? Why do you all have bruises on your face? And Miss Orchid too...

I'm actually super strong? You say I lost control over my power, when I wanted to stop my friends from fighting each other? That's why I don't remember anything...? Okay, I think I get it! Umm... right, I will put my power to good use!
Aaaah! The cup! I didn't control my grip... Errmm... I'm in trouble when the Doctor wakes up...
Popukar from Operation Reserve Team A6, reporting in. Um, my teammates in A6 are always arguing. I'm sure you worry about them, Doctor... But I know what to do...
Umm, Doctor, is the girl in the video... me?
I'm so happy I don't even know what to say...! Thank you, Doctor...! Thank you so much!
My name is Popukar... Nice to meet you...
B-But... I really don't know anything about tactics or strategies or anything…
Miss Catapult, um, it's time to deploy!
Miss Orchid, don't worry... I'll be fine.
Errrmm...
I'm right here.
I want to stop this fight.
Please stop arguiiing!
Be good and don't move.
Chainsaw got mad…
Mr. Midnight, come back here... Miss Orchid is staring at you…
Can everyone have a good peaceful talk, now...?
Doctor… Doctor…? Here, I made some tea. You must be tired.
**A painful groan** I'm… injured…? It hurts…
Please don't leave me here alone...
Aaaugh...
Doctor, headpats…
Arknights.
Happy New Year, Doctor. I made some soft and chewy New Year's cakes at the cafeteria... They say my cakes are great. I'm strong, so I always pound the dough well! Hehe...
Doctor, are you getting along with everyone today...?

Happy birthday, Doctor. I never really celebrated birthdays before, but now that I'm at Rhodes Island, Orchid always lets me have extra snacks on them... Do you want any? I'll sneak some out for you. Others won't notice!
Will we all stay together if I'm a good kid, if I'm a little smarter? I want A6 to stay together like a family... Will you help me, Doctor?

handbook.profile:
Initially a patient at Rhodes Island, Popukar requested and passed the trial to become an Operator for Rhodes Island. She was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6.
She possesses tremendous destructive power, becoming the team's heavy.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3% 
Crystallization visible on surface of body, with many symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.2u/L 
Subject is currently stabilized, but regular observation and treatment are required.
archives:
A member of Reserve Op Team A6. Although not capable of complex reasoning, her infection bestowed on her an ability that made her a suitable Operator. 
The source of a lot of problems for Team A6, most of these are unintentional. Because of her sincerity, she is also the easiest to forgive.

Unlike most other members, Popukar was taken in by Dr. Kal'tsit personally.
 Dr. Kal'tsit did not explain why she made this choice, only saying Popukar would stay on as a full-time member of Rhodes Island. 
However, Dr. Ansel said that was the first time she had ever seen Dr. Kal'tsit visibly upset.

Although Popukar failed her Operator exam, she was allowed to work in logistics, rather than being cast out. 
And as it is so rare for an infection to make a patient stronger, even rarer to the extent of Popukar's infection, she is a very valuable case study.

Popukar has gradually become one of the mascots of Rhodes Island. After all, no one could hate such an energetic little cutie -- even if she occasionally engages in 'minor' vandalism. 
Moreover, since joining A6, she has a much bigger family. Their shenanigans are just part of the Rhodes Island color nowadays.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Thank you for choosing me, Darling. Now, what kind of secret are you going to share with me under this velvet of the night?
Fiend of the Night? Ah, I can't hide anything from you. But past glory is nothing to me. After all, I have an even brighter future waiting.
I may work in a different place now, but my job is still the same—to put a smile on everyone's face.

I bet Ms. Orchid must have been born with a negative number on her happiness scale. Why else would she always look so stern whenever I'm there to light her up? If you know anything about her, please tell me.

People say my swordsmanship is top notch. All due credit, I have to say. Practicing swordsmanship helps me maintain my figure and cultivate my elegance. It'd be a crime for me to slack off on the pratice. After all, you either keep the momentum and hold the lead or end up getting overwhelmed. Please keep that in mind.

People used to say that I sold feelings as commodities, that I treated 'happiness' as a product. Fools, all of them. How can I expect my customers to open their hearts to me if I don't open mine to them first?

I believe happiness can be contagious. It's a tangible atmosphere that truly exists. I feel the joy when others treat me with sincerity, and I will make sure my happiness reaches right into their hearts.
My colleagues in team A6... they may be a bit weird, but they're truly kind souls. They're a gift from destiny, a gift that continues to remind me to cherish those important to me.
Now that I have some free time, I should read.
Show me your brightest smile, my esteemed customer! Happiness is at arm's reach when you're by my side. Midnight, at your service.
It's important to never stop learning!
Whoa, so my hard work really paid off! Let's set up a champagne tower to celebrate. My treat.
With me on your side, success is guaranteed!
Follow this handsome me!
Show me your spirit, everyone!
Behold, here comes my flamboyant moves!
Hmm?
What's up?
I've arrived.
OK.
O sword, pierce the moonlight that veils the night!
Bathe in fresh blood!
Impressive, Dr. {@nickname}, truly impressive. Your blazing brilliance almost stole my show today.
There's only one thing that's impossible for me: being imperfect.
Not too shabby. Such a heart-warming result calls for a little celebration.
No need to look back. We'll greet each other with a smile next time.
A wonderful place. Let's have a drinking party tonight.
There now, would you please leave my collar as it is?
Thanks for taking care of me.
Arknights.

Sometimes, it doesn't take flowery tricks to capture a customer's heart. See the fireworks here? The sight of them going off, even just for an instant, will be enough to focus all the customers' attention solely on me, their souls scorched by my gaze... Orchid? Why are you dragging me away?
Good evening, Dr. {@nickname}.

Happy birthday. You should set your work aside for today. We can chat until dawn, and I'll stick by your side if you want to watch the sun rise. But {@nickname}, I trust that you know what to say if Orchid asks why I didn't work overtime tonight.

What you see today is the fruit of all your hard work, {@nickname}. Nothing makes me happier than accompanying someone in admiring their own marvelous achievements. I do hope you'll still choose me to stay by your side this time next year.

handbook.profile: Initially a patient at Rhodes Island, volunteered to become an Operator. He was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6 after completing his examination battery.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in his circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming him as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 8% 
Medical readings indicate subject has many symptoms of Oripathy. Oddly, subject has no visible crystallization on body. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.30u/L
Infection is spreading at a constant rate. Regular observation and treatment mandatory.
archives:
A former host now assigned to Reserve Op Team A6. 
Midnight was the most popular producer at a prominent host club in the Far East. He broke earnings record several years in a row, and was known as the Devil of the Eastern Night. 
He tends to speak boldly, even claiming he's here as God's gift to women. 
While he has never caused any real problems, he is still often a headache.

Midnight doesn't know how he got infected. According to his own words, he was very quick to retire after his diagnosis. 
After retiring, he found Rhodes Island through prior connections and came for treatment.
Then, after being in the program for a while, he made a peculiar request: He wanted work at Rhodes Island.

Midnight finally became a member of A6. 
At first, even in eccentric A6, Midnight was widely considered the most difficult person to get along with. But after a while, everyone realized he was actually kind and hardworking. 
Even then, there are still many people, such as Orchid, who can't handle his wild boasts.

When Midnight cares about someone, he gives his whole heart, but that means only a few people can reciprocate on the same level. 
Since everyone is used to his hard work, they don't notice his exhaustion, which he wouldn't want them to notice, anyway. But it would be best for someone to check up on him once in a while.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: We got a lot to do today, Doctor. So how about we play some games first? Isn't getting nice and relaxed the best way to prepare for a hard day of work?

Aw, I feel so lazy today for some reason! Maybe because Midnight isn't around? I love watching him chat up girls with that flashy smile of his. It's especially fun when the girls turn him down! Totally makes my day.

Doctor, you know who's the most reliable in our group? Oh, you can't guess? It's Spot! He might be quiet, but he's very reliable. So why don't we get him here to offer a hand? After all there's so much work for only two of us, don't you think?

Aw... Ms. Orchid yelled at me again today. She's such a nag! Must be work getting into her head and stressing her out. She should learn from me—I have the perfect balance between working hard and playing hard!

Hey, where's Dobermann? She's out on business today? Yay, finally! I can slack off all day now, wonderful! I'm gonna go get some snacks first. Doctor, you want some chips or popcorn? I'll grab a bag for you!

Uh, Popukar, sweetie, please listen to me, I'll do anything you say, okay? J-just put down the chainsaw! Oh no, she's out of control! This is the worst! Doctor, run! Run! We gotta jump out the window! Yeah, the window! Follow me!

The town I came from... the mayor was a tyrant, a fat cat with no heart, no sympathy. Drove the townspeople nuts. I hated him too, so I blasted open his vault and handed out all the money I found to the townies. Now that was a good time!
I don't care what anybody thinks of me—it's more important that I just enjoy every day doing what I like. My life belongs to me, so I alone decide what I do. Isn't that right?
Doctor's asleep? Well, can't interrupt a beauty nap. Guess I'll go out and have some fun.
Reserve OP Team A6, Catapult, reporting in! Hey, I can tell you're hella different from that stuffy old bit—I mean, that esteemed, honorable instructor Ms. Dobermann. Right? Like it's obvious!
...Ahhh, that was a nice nap.
Hehe, I finally finished basic training. Wait, what? Dobermann will keep overseeing the newbies, even AFTER their promotions? You gotta be kidding me! No—
It's not time to head out yet, right? Let me hang out for a bit longer...
I'm the captain? Haha~I've been waiting forever to hear those words!
Aw man, where did I leave my ammunition belt?
Ugh, I hate fighting. But what else can I do?
What's up?
Whatever you say.
Safe landing!
Time for business.
Watch how I get them with one shot!
You're all gonna fly!
What an awesome formation! You got some great tactics, Doctor. And it all went down perfect!
I love commanders that lead us to victory! Just like you, Doctor!
Relax, I set a whole bunch of traps right where the enemy's gonna be running. What? They didn't step in any of them? No way!
Oh shoot! Hurry up, Doctor. We gotta move!
Psst, care to take a peek and tell me if Dobermann's in there?
You can't catch me! ...Oh, you can.
Doctor, you're an awesome leader!
Arknights.

Doctor! Quick! Stop what you're doing! We don't get to take time off for new year's everyday, and you're just commiting a crime letting your works trouble you. Get out of your room, and let's have some fun!
Doctor! I'm right here!

Happy birthday, Doctor! I guess getting old isn't something you should feel optimistic about, but it's still worth commemorating the day a new life was born. Gimme a minute, let's celebrate with something from my secret snack cache.

I don't like working, but Rhodes Island isn't so bad. Instead of evil landlords, you have comrades you can trust to have your back, and that's enough for me. Say, if today's special, does that mean I get the day off?

Safe landing!
Time for business.
Watch how I get them with one shot!
You're all gonna fly!
What an awesome formation! You got some great tactics, Doctor. And it all went down perfect!
I love commanders that lead us to victory! Just like you, Doctor!
Relax, I set a whole bunch of traps right where the enemy's gonna be running. What? They didn't step in any of them? No way!
Oh shoot! Hurry up, Doctor. We gotta move!
Psst, care to take a peek and tell me if Dobermann's in there?
You can't catch me! ...Oh, you can.
Doctor, you're an awesome leader!
Arknights.

Doctor! Quick! Stop what you're doing! We don't get to take time off for new year's everyday, and you're just commiting a crime letting your works trouble you. Get out of your room, and let's have some fun!
Doctor! I'm right here!

Happy birthday, Doctor! I guess getting old isn't something you should feel optimistic about, but it's still worth commemorating the day a new life was born. Gimme a minute, let's celebrate with something from my secret snack cache.

I don't like working, but Rhodes Island isn't so bad. Instead of evil landlords, you have comrades you can trust to have your back, and that's enough for me. Say, if today's special, does that mean I get the day off?

archives:
She is a soldier in Reserve Op Team A6.
The problem child of A6, she loves to stick her nose where it doesn't belong and stir the pot. 
Catapult is a repeat offender who always gets into trouble and irritates Orchid in particular..

She didn't make a big mess in the last city she served. 
The mayor didn't step down, no one suspended the construction of the dam, and the vaults she blew up only accounted for a fraction of the city's revenue. 
Just a matter of time before the consequences finally kick in.

Catapult actually enjoys hearing Orchid's critiques, and even deliberately makes her angry sometimes. 
Because she knows Orchid means well, she makes trouble for her.

Catapult often avoids responsibility and work. It is hard to say if this is because she is simply rebellious, or something left over from her time in the military, or both.
But she is a good girl, otherwise she wouldn't have blown up the vaults. Although she wasn't happy with it, she did the best she could. In addition, since her time at Rhodes Island, she has never neglected her duty. 
If one day Rhodes Island disappoints her, she just might blow something up and leave. Hopefully, that day never comes.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: I'll make the arrangements. Just leave it to me.
Doctor, I certainly hope my teammates won't cause any trouble while I'm here working for you... Aagh, the more I think of it the worse this headache gets...
An ordinary job, a peaceful life. That's all I ever wanted.
Yeah, it's not that I don't get along with the other A6 members... I just get a little headache whenever I see them...
My group members just bump into new troubles every day. There is the anti-social one, the never listening one, the awfully stubborn one… Just when will they ever settle down and work?...
I don't know how I ended up on this team either. All I wanted was an ordinary life. Why did I end up in charge of these... problem children?! Wait a minute, Midnight is a grown man!

Popukar... gotta pat her on the head. Catapult... gotta tie her up. Spot... never make him mad. As for Midnight, just knock him out. There, Doctor, now you know the proper protocol for dealing with Team A6.
I made a cake for my teammates. Wanna take a slice, Doctor? Everyone in A6 just love fruitcakes. They really are a bunch of kids, aren't they?
Not much time left. Done with your work for the day, Doctor?
Captain of Reserve Op Team A6, Orchid, reporting in. Are you the Dr. {@nickname}? I look forward to working with you.
I learned a lot from this video. I'll keep it in mind for sure.
Thank you so much. I'll work hard to improve my skills from now on and strive for better results for you!
I'll complete my mission to the best of my ability.
Please follow the tactical combat manual closely, everyone. Thank you for your cooperation.
The battle has begun! Be careful, everyone!
Please make sure you follow every detail on the plan. Alright, everyone, now spread out!
Go ahead.
Here.
Orchid, ready to move.
Just as planned.
Target locked!
Stop them now!
Out of my way!
Oh come on, I already have enough work to deal with!
Well done, Doctor! Impeccable leadership even against such a tough opponent.
A perfect job! Looks like we can have a good rest today.
We need to work harder next time.
Is everyone okay? Let's get out of here!
Oh, What a noisy place...
What do you want...?
Huh?! Overtime again?! Ugh, I knew it...
Arknights.

Popukar, listen, I want you to sit still on the couch... Catapult, what are you doing—they just hung the streamers from that window! Midnight, for heaven's sakes, get down from the fireworks pile! Ugh, all of you! Stop messing around, NOW! Or nobody's getting a New Year's present! NOBODY!
Greetings, Doctor. Let's start today's work just as planned.

Present time. I picked out a color-changing lipstick, one that goes from transparent to light pink. Even if you aren't in any makeup, it'll give you some complexion. I wasn't sure what kind you'd like, so I went the one I use, a fruit flavor. How about you give it a try...? No, no, Doctor, no licking once it's on.

I've been so busy with work, I wouldn't even have noticed another year vanish in a blink. Forget anything else, I have far more patience than I used to, honestly. Have they grown up? No, they're still the same loud brats as ever. But at least they're doing much better now. Look at this—they made me tea after hearing I had overtime.

handbook.profile: Former editor of a Columbian fashion magazine, Orchid began treatment at Rhodes Island following Oripathy. She expressed her desire to become an Operator, passed the examination battery and was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6 as the squad leader. She manages the team and provides support with her Arts in combat.

basicInfo.value: Originium crystals distributed across surface of body, confirmed Infected.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 6% 
Infection is expected to spread given the current course. Regular observation and management required. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.23u/L 
Operator Orchid displays conspicuous symptoms, but has cooperated with the treatment plan and has minimized the spread of the infection.
archives:
Captain of Reserve Op Team A6, yearning to return to a normal life. 
Having previously been an office worker, Orchid is one of the most 'ordinary' Rhodes Islanders, but finds herself constantly troubled by the more colorful characters on her team. Her title might be captain, but she's more like the squad nanny.

The former fashion magazine editor still has a nose for the trendy. She never bandwagons onto a fad, preferring to keep to her own vision. The way she dresses usually sets the style for the season at Rhodes Island. 
More importantly, she knows all the tricks to cover up all the superficial symptoms of Oripathy, keeping the Infected looking the same as they ever did, and even bringing out their individual charms--just as she did for herself. She has been a godsend to many Oripathy sufferers, especially the ladies. 
As such, Miss Orchid has become an icon to some of the girls on the island.

A modern city girl like Orchid would have never volunteered herself for a highly dangerous job like an that of an Operator. 
But treatment at Rhodes Island isn't free (though there are discounts and payment plans), and she did lose her job. Ultimately, after a battery of exams, she decided to accept the position. 
Of course, if she knew she was to lead the freaks on A6, she probably would have had second thoughts.

But when all is said and done, Orchid knows better than anyone that even though A6 is a freak show, they all have their hearts in the right place. 
her egotistical but sincere Midnight, her deadly but well-meaning Popukar, her icy but caring Spot, and... then there's Catapult... Right, let's not talk about her. In any case, Orchid treasures her squadmates.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Welcome back, Doctor. Steward at your service.
Steward is my surname, as well as my Operator codename. Doctor, I'm sure you can tell from it what my ancestors did for a living.
I didn't expect to see another from my clan here. Is she looking for someone? I know how that feels... Oh, never mind.
People often say our fur has the 'color of snow.' Doctor, have you ever seen snow?
Lava has a very distinct fighting style. I thought she was going to cast with her book, but her real Arts Unit is a dagger. Her style reminds me of the mystic who taught me Arts.
It is my honor to work for you, Doctor. But if possible, I do hope you pay some extra care to Melantha. She's always alone…
Adnachiel is a mysterious one... No one can tell what he is thinking.

Ansel... It's okay... I stopped caring about my identity as an Infected long ago. In fact, I received a lot of help because of it. Before the infection takes away what's dear to me, I will use it to create a place where everyone can live in peace.
Are you tired? Do take a good rest, Doctor. Rhodes Island will need your skills tomorrow.
Caster Steward reporting in. I'm glad to be working with you.
I have learned a lot. Thank you.
I'm glad that you are satisfied with my work. Instructor Dobermann will be happy too.
What can I do for you?
Cardigan, always read the situation before you act.
Well, I'll be sure to bring you some good news.
They probably won't make it to tomorrow.
Awarting orders.
Gladly!
Got it.
Understood.
Freeze!
Down you go.
With the right strategy, we'll make it through any tight spot.
A perfect victory. Good work, everyone!
Ansel, please check the casualties for me. We must prepare for the next battle.
Did we make a mistake somewhere...?
Is that you, Cardi— WAI-WAIT! WAIT! Don't touch the equipment!
Hmm?
Doctor, is there anything I can do for you?
Arknights.

Heavy snow always dominates Kjerag at this time of the year, burying everything from the last year beneath. With that, our calendar turns a new page. If possible, Doctor, I really wish to give you a tour of my hometown. But, the wilds there are dangerous on snowy days, and you'll need me as your guide.
Awaiting your instructions, Doctor.
Happy birthday, Doctor! And allow me to be your personal butler today! Steward, at your service.

Had I not come to Rhodes Island, I would't have had the opportunity to continue my study on Originium Arts, let alone making friends with my teammates in Reserve Op Team A4. I will cherish all I have at present, for chances like these don't grow on trees. So, Doctor, let us keep up the hard work.

Had I not come to Rhodes Island, I would't have had the opportunity to continue my study on Originium Arts, let alone making friends with my teammates in Reserve Op Team A4. I will cherish all I have at present, for chances like these don't grow on trees. So, Doctor, let us keep up the hard work.

EN.voiceText: Welcome back, Doctor. Steward at your service.
Steward is my surname, as well as my Operator codename. Doctor, I'm sure you can tell from it what my ancestors did for a living.
I didn't expect to see another from my clan here. Is she looking for someone? I know how that feels... Oh, never mind.
People often say our fur has the 'color of snow.' Doctor, have you ever seen snow?
Lava has a very distinct fighting style. I thought she was going to cast with her book, but her real Arts Unit is a dagger. Her style reminds me of the mystic who taught me Arts.
It is my honor to work for you, Doctor. But if possible, I do hope you pay some extra care to Melantha. She's always alone…
Adnachiel is a mysterious one... No one can tell what he is thinking.

Ansel... It's okay... I stopped caring about my identity as an Infected long ago. In fact, I received a lot of help because of it. Before the infection takes away what's dear to me, I will use it to create a place where everyone can live in peace.
Are you tired? Do take a good rest, Doctor. Rhodes Island will need your skills tomorrow.
Caster Steward reporting in. I'm glad to be working with you.
I have learned a lot. Thank you.
I'm glad that you are satisfied with my work. Instructor Dobermann will be happy too.
What can I do for you?
Cardigan, always read the situation before you act.
Well, I'll be sure to bring you some good news.
They probably won't make it to tomorrow.
Awarting orders.
Gladly!
Got it.
Understood.
Freeze!
Down you go.
With the right strategy, we'll make it through any tight spot.
A perfect victory. Good work, everyone!
Ansel, please check the casualties for me. We must prepare for the next battle.
Did we make a mistake somewhere...?
Is that you, Cardi— WAI-WAIT! WAIT! Don't touch the equipment!
Hmm?
Doctor, is there anything I can do for you?
Arknights.

Heavy snow always dominates Kjerag at this time of the year, burying everything from the last year beneath. With that, our calendar turns a new page. If possible, Doctor, I really wish to give you a tour of my hometown. But, the wilds there are dangerous on snowy days, and you'll need me as your guide.
Awaiting your instructions, Doctor.

Had I not come to Rhodes Island, I would't have had the opportunity to continue my study on Originium Arts, let alone making friends with my teammates in Reserve Op Team A4. I will cherish all I have at present, for chances like these don't grow on trees. So, Doctor, let us keep up the hard work.

handbook.profile:
Steward is a member of Reserve Op Team A4 and a citizen of Kjerag. Before he officially took the position, he worked as a freelancer. After an exceptional performance on his tests, he received permission to join Rhodes Island and now serves on the reserve team. 
He shows promise in the areas of Arts support, navigation, and combat support.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of his internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in his circulatory system, confirming him to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9%
He presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.3u/L
Infection has progressed to mid-stages. Currently there is no evidence of spreading.
archives: Steward was born in the southern territory of Kjerag and spent his childhood being educated at home. He has a calm temperament that stands out amongst his peers and has a certain talent for Originium Arts. However, given the snowy environment and the high cost of studying Arts, this talent went uncultivated and was left buried in the heavy snow drifts of Kjerag.

The southern territory of Kjerag has long acted as the exit point for all of Kjerag. When the Silverash family declared a new economic policy, merchants from Columbia, Leithanien, and Rim Billiton launched several investment plans. During this period, Steward took the initiative to become a guide and local servicer for the business activities of merchants from all over the world. He also worked part-time as a model to help market goods. The brand new goods coming out of Columbia left a deep impression on Steward, and Steward's excellent service has garnered the praise of many merchants.

Snow Blue Wand
Quality Guaranteed by: Director of the Leithanian Arts Society

Manufacturer: Rudolf Bros. Wand Workshop
Product Number: ADD-143.
The Snow Blue wand used by Steward.
Proof of a Caster's mastery of Arts. Its handle has been engraved with the words 'Mythic Future.'
When you use it, you can hear the whistling of snow.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, it's time for your injection. Oh, um, are you alright?! Are you scared of needles?
Like Dr. Kal'tsit is always telling you, Doctor, you really need some exercise. I'm new here, but you still need to listen to my advice.
Cardigan! We've told you, if you move like that when you strike, you'll wind up getting hurt.
Good grief... Doctor, you need to take care of yourself. You can't make us do it for you.

Are you worried about my health after so many night shifts? You shouldn't be. My race has a unique way of producing hormones, which allows us to handle night activities better. So I can hand my shift over to Hibiscus at just the right time.
You must stop with the midnight snacks. Don't go bringing up my eating habits. I eat at night because of my race! Yes, it's a racial trait!

I'm Ansel. It's a little embarrassing to admit, but I chose to become a Medic because I've been sickly since I was young. But now that I'm an Operator, I'll make sure not to burden you. So please treat me just the same way you treat the others.

I know everyone does what they can. But I heard from Dr. Kal'tsit that Steward and Melantha's conditions aren't looking too good... My job is to make their lives as easy as possible. Doctor, let's redouble our efforts, together.
Adnachiel, could you ask Cardigan to settle down for a moment? The Doctor is resting.
I am Ansel, a medical intern. I'll be assisting with surgery and internal medicine, among other things. I look forward to working with you.
I hope I didn't cause you any trouble.
I'm glad that you care so much for the wellbeing of us Medics.
Ready whenever.
Medical support should be the top priority for any tactical squad.
Alright, all medicine has been prepared.
Injections ready. Prepare for battle.
First aid box is ready.
Awaiting your orders.
Ready to heal!
Please hold on!
Clear!
Your medication is here. Take it!
Phew, thank goodness I brought enough medicine. Please don't worry.
I was very impressed by everyone's performance. It was fantastic.
Please hold on, I'll treat your injuries right away.
We've sustained injuries! I need to get the wounded to the rear. Cover me!
I'm checking on the medical supplies here.
Whoa, Doctor, please don't mess with me!
Doctor, I'm very glad that you like me.
Arknights.

The Medical Department actually gets busier around New Year's. People hurt themselves setting off fireworks or gorging on food... I get wanting to indulge in the holiday spirit, but you need to keep yourselves safe too. You know how to take care of yourself, Doctor, don't you? Very well. With that, I wish you happy new year. May you spend the year without that kind of visit to Medical.
Good day, Doctor.

Doctor, good evening. It's just past midnight, so I think it counts as your birthday. Happy birthday to you! I got you a cake, but my advice is to wait till tomorrow to eat it. Oh, come to think of it, does this make me the first to wish you a happy birthday?

I only came to Rhodes Island at first because no other place would accept my resume. It seems more like a kind of destiny now. All of A4 are maturing, and I can't fall behind, Doctor. The good news is, test results show my health condition has gotten a lot better over the last year.
