handbook.profile: Ansel is a member of Reserve Op Team A4 and a citizen of Rim Billiton. Before officially taking up his post, he was a member of the Rhodes Island pharmaceuticals intern staff. After excelling on multiple tests, he was permitted to join the Rhodes Island medic team.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Originium crystals have not been found on the surface of his body, confirming no infection.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator shows no signs of infection at this time.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.09u/L 
Physical data reveal this Operator to be in a basically healthy state.
archives: Ansel maintains a very calm demeanor. No matter how complicated the situation, he gives priority to providing timely medical support. This calm demeanor makes even the question whether or not he is taking part in the battle. Very few people can care for the wounded in a well-ordered manner while there are explosions and collapsing roofs all around them. Of course, this is also because Ansel is very strict with his own rules as a medical practitioner. He works hard to follow established medical regulations and doesn't hesitate to let others know if they are violating them.

Ansel was born in a city in Rim Billiton that is, like so many of them, famous for mining. He has three older brothers and one younger sister. After his mother passed away due to an illness, his exhausted father gave him to his sonless brother to adopt. Despite growing up in such an environment without a steady household to live in, he nevertheless grew into a gentle and responsible man. When Ansel realized that most of the workers around him were in poor health due to overwork, he decided to become a medic, hoping to one day alleviate some of the suffering in the world.

During his time at medical school, Ansel sent his resume to several large medical companies and research institutes in Rim Billiton, but he lacked the money required for further study. His sparse resume was rejected by almost all of the companies. Of the two companies that did not reject his resume, Ansel chose the newly established Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals for his internship. During the half-year internship period, Ansel proved himself to be diligent, patient, and attentive to medicine, which earned him recognition from one of the company's top doctors, Dr. Kal'tsit.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Did you call for me, Doctor? I feel so happy to be with you!
Doctor! Dr. Kal'tsit said that you need to look after your health more. In two words, E-A-T L-E-S-S! So there!
You know, Doctor, if my sister starts getting all bossy with you, you have to tell me! She needs my treatment or else!
Dr. Kal'tsit teaches me a ton of practical stuff, although it's tough to actually learn! At least I've always had a knack for nutrition, so I think I'm doing well with that!
I feel better about everyone here, compared to when I just joined Rhodes Island! And they all eat my healthy food on schedule! But... why does everyone pull these weird faces when they finish?
Tadaaaaaah! A special healthy meal just for you, Doctor! Decaf coffee and a hamburger without meat, cheese, pickles, or lettuce! Oh, and a mixed salad made of 12 different vegetables!

Hey, Doctor, where does your family live? Are they doing well? I know there's things you can't tell them about because they're your family... but, still, I think you've got to reach out. You have to try, at least.
Isn't it lonely cooking all by yourself? Let me help you out! Oh, right, and let's get Lava in here too!
Doctor, did you fall asleep? Have a good rest then. You need to sleep plenty to stay healthy.
This is intern Hibiscus. From now on, I'll be in charge of managing yours and every Operator's health at Rhodes Island. Thank you for your cooperation!
Oh, I see! So that's how you do it!
It's my honor to be promoted! I'm looking forward to working under you for the health management of us all, Doctor!
I won't fail you! I'll protect everyone!
Acknowledged! I'll take good care of everyone! First, I need to get my special sustained-release medicine ready...
Please take good care of yourself while I'm gone!
Ready to heal!
Don't be afraid!
Doctor?
There we go.
It's safe here!
Please come to your senses!
I can heal that wound in no time!
Even if everyone gets wounded, I can heal them all with my staff!
Looking after everyone's health is my greatest motivation.
Doctor! Everyone! Are you alright?
No... First aid needed!
Anything I can help with?
Oh, my~!
Doctor, do you want to have a taste of my new vitamin drink?
Arknights.

Here, Doctor, your new customized healthy daily schedule! Relax, given this full table of gourmet food we have here, I will make an exception today. I will allow you — one bite of fries! That'll be my most generous offer!
Doctor! Would you mind tasting this?

Stop hiding the cakes, Doctor. They aren't escaping my eyes!... Look at all these cakes you have here! It takes three full teaspoons of sugar to whip the cream for just one of them, let alone the milk and butter that went in there. I know, I understand they are just tokens of appreciation from your fellow operators. But you could have just looked at them — Hey, don't steal a bite when I'm talking!

They had a celebration today? I was so occupied that I hardly noticed… Doesn't matter, as long as there are wounded looking for treatment, my job's not finished. Not to mention the goal I set for myself to become a better medic. See you then, Doctor, for I still got works to tend to!

You know, Doctor, if my sister starts getting all bossy with you, you have to tell me! She needs my treatment or else!
Dr. Kal'tsit teaches me a ton of practical stuff, although it's tough to actually learn! At least I've always had a knack for nutrition, so I think I'm doing well with that!
I feel better about everyone here, compared to when I just joined Rhodes Island! And they all eat my healthy food on schedule! But... why does everyone pull these weird faces when they finish?
Tadaaaaaah! A special healthy meal just for you, Doctor! Decaf coffee and a hamburger without meat, cheese, pickles, or lettuce! Oh, and a mixed salad made of 12 different vegetables!

Hey, Doctor, where does your family live? Are they doing well? I know there's things you can't tell them about because they're your family... but, still, I think you've got to reach out. You have to try, at least.
Isn't it lonely cooking all by yourself? Let me help you out! Oh, right, and let's get Lava in here too!
Doctor, did you fall asleep? Have a good rest then. You need to sleep plenty to stay healthy.
This is intern Hibiscus. From now on, I'll be in charge of managing yours and every Operator's health at Rhodes Island. Thank you for your cooperation!
Oh, I see! So that's how you do it!
It's my honor to be promoted! I'm looking forward to working under you for the health management of us all, Doctor!
I won't fail you! I'll protect everyone!
Acknowledged! I'll take good care of everyone! First, I need to get my special sustained-release medicine ready...
Please take good care of yourself while I'm gone!
Ready to heal!
Don't be afraid!
Doctor?
There we go.
It's safe here!
Please come to your senses!
I can heal that wound in no time!
Even if everyone gets wounded, I can heal them all with my staff!
Looking after everyone's health is my greatest motivation.
Doctor! Everyone! Are you alright?
No... First aid needed!
Anything I can help with?
Oh, my~!
Doctor, do you want to have a taste of my new vitamin drink?
Arknights.

Here, Doctor, your new customized healthy daily schedule! Relax, given this full table of gourmet food we have here, I will make an exception today. I will allow you — one bite of fries! That'll be my most generous offer!
Doctor! Would you mind tasting this?

Stop hiding the cakes, Doctor. They aren't escaping my eyes!... Look at all these cakes you have here! It takes three full teaspoons of sugar to whip the cream for just one of them, let alone the milk and butter that went in there. I know, I understand they are just tokens of appreciation from your fellow operators. But you could have just looked at them — Hey, don't steal a bite when I'm talking!

They had a celebration today? I was so occupied that I hardly noticed… Doesn't matter, as long as there are wounded looking for treatment, my job's not finished. Not to mention the goal I set for myself to become a better medic. See you then, Doctor, for I still got works to tend to!

handbook.profile: Born in Londinium, Victoria, Hibiscus is the older twin sister of her fellow Operator, Lava. After contracting Oripathy, she came to Rhodes Island for treatment. While undergoing that treatment, she began to dream of helping others. Her passion for caring for others, as well as her hard work, have led Hibiscus to become a Rhodes Island Medic.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7.4%
She presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.2 u/L
Degree of infection is minor and physical symptoms are not yet present.
archives: Born in Londinium, Hibiscus was popular among her neighbors as a child, and for good reason - she is considerate, hardworking, courteous, modest, and is good at taking care of people. Though it appears to outsiders that Lava does not like to deal with Hibiscus and that the two sisters don't share a strong relationship, Hibiscus knows the truth - that Lava just isn't very good at expressing those kinds of feelings.

After the two sisters were infected with Oripathy, Hibiscus took Lava and left their parents to come to Rhodes Island. The determined Hibiscus decided to work hard for Rhodes Island, for her sister, herself, her parents back home, and all the other infected.

Because of Lava's obstinance, Hibiscus has cultivated a tough attitude from the time they were little. 'This food is good for you. You need to eat it every day!' 'I threw all your snacks away because they're bad for you!' 'It's 10:30. You need to go to bed!' From a bystanders' perspective, Lava seems to have a rough time dealing with her older sister.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Need something? If you don't ,how about some divination?

Just tell me when there's work to do. But don't ever put her and me on the same team. I hate her guts. And don't get me started on all the weird food she makes me eat... Just thinking about it makes me... euurghh...
No one told me Hibiscus was at Rhodes Island before I got here... It's too late for me to quit now.
If you grow up sheltered, you don't know how to taunt, how to destroy, and how to handle yourself in a real fight. Am I right, Doctor?
Have you ever heard the saying 'little sisters are justice'? If that's true, then my big sis is evil by default... at least as far as I'm concerned.
Instruments? I can play the piano a little. My teacher in Leithanien said learning an instrument can improve your Arts affinity. It also apparently eases the impact that Oripathy has on your mind...
I'm starving... Huh, what's this? You keep sweets in here? Nom... I'm in the middle of training. Should I really be eating this?

See, like, I don't have a big beef with Hibiscus... It's all water under the bridge. I'm fine with her as long as she doesn't force me to eat her medicine and food. After all, she was the one... who saved my life...
I almost envy your ability to sleep like a log...
I'm Lava, a Caster, here to join you simply because I'm bored and want something to do… But I heard my sworn nemesis is here too, though... Can I just quit now?
Thanks.
Did you forget? I don't need a cause to work for, and I don't need a team... but... thanks, I guess...
As far as teamwork's concerned... I don't mind, as long as nobody messes up.
I'm not good at this sort of stuff, but if you insist...
Let's go. Keep an eye on my back.
I can see their souls. They're mine to reap.
What are you waiting for?
Hurry up.
Come on.
That's it.
It's game over for you.
Even the dead can't save you.
The supreme form of Arts. I'm interested in seeing what it's like.
I foresaw this result earlier. A perfect victory.
Well… My fortune telling isn't always right. Sometimes there's a lot of external noise that affects the outcome.
Dammit... These evil spirits are too strong...
Oh, come on. I'd rather be alone.
Don't touch me! Uaghh!
Eh, you're not scoring any points with me like that!
Arknights.

I need your help, Doctor. Tell me, Just in what world do I fall under the category of 'Out of Shape?' I was feeding myself some fried-foulbeast, and that annoying Hibiscus took it away, before peeling the coat off and handing the rest back to me! The crispy, crunchy coat! She took it! Gone! There's *NO* way I can get my hands on what I want to eat with her around! There's gonna be a fight... Ugh! Never mind.
Oh, it's you, Doctor. Morning.

Happy birthday, Doctor. Here, I made you a pair of gloves. And take a look at these beautiful patterns on them! Cool, aren't they? I got them from my divination, which always comes true. You too will learn that in the future.

My infection made my sister's life hell as well. It may not look like it, but deep inside my heart resonates with hers, because what we all want is to help those in need with our hands. Speaking of which, isn't she still on shift today? Huh, how can someone have the right to call me the one that worries when she pushes herself this hard?

handbook.profile: Born in Londinium, Victoria, Lava is the younger twin sister of her fellow Operator, Hibiscus. After contracting Oripathy, she came to Rhodes Island for treatment. She found the idea of saving lives appealing, and so volunteered for training.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9.4%
She presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.25 u/L
Degree of infection is minor and has not had any physical impact.
archives: Unlike other stray children hiding in dark alleys, Lava was born into a relatively normal middle-class Victorian family. Lava believes that one must personally put in effort to help others, rather than stand at a distance. When she was young, she enjoyed working with the poor and the orphaned. She was very aware how much pain they suffered, which planted in her heart the seeds of compassion and justice.

Lava is tough and ignores the advice of others when she moves into action. In fact, she is gentle and childlike at heart but prefers not to admit it to herself. Whenever anyone brings this up, she immediately changes the subject and tries to play it cool.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: That device you're holding seems to be in poor shape. Would you mind if I take a look at it?
Hey, Ansel. Cardigan looks good today. Anything I can help you with?
We have a squad of very interesting people, especially Melantha. She always seems to be hiding from me, but I can sniff her out.
Cardigan, what are you doing? You look so happy.

Not every Laterano has the right to use guns, rare weapons that they are. In my hometown, we're pretty good at making knockoff gun parts. The crossbow crafting industry is also on the rise. The result is what I have here - a crossbow with a tactical rail attachment.
Would you like to try some of my handmade sweets? I'm kind of ashamed that I can only make 25 types of desserts. It feels like I've disgraced the Laterano people.
What's wrong with my halo? I don't know why, but it seems to have deviated slightly. According to Dr. Kal'tsit, it probably has something to do with my abnormal hippocampus.
Instead of watching you from afar, I feel much better standing by your side, Doctor.
Doctor, you strike an impressive figure, even when you rest like that.
My name is Adnachiel. I'm a Sniper from Laterano. Although I'm not yet certified to carry a gun, I can match the veterans with my crossbow!
Put me to good use and I'll be more than happy.
Thank you very much for the promotion.
We will be fine.
If anything breaks, bring it to me. I may be able to fix it for you.
It's time to go. Are you ready?
Let the hunt begin.
I will follow your orders.
Hmm?
You better run away soon.
Okay!
Gotcha!
Locked on!
Everything went just as you planned, Doctor.
We have the Doctor's orders to thank for this.
Our operation was a success, but something feels a bit off...
I'm so sorry...
This place has a great vibe.
What?
Doctor? I'm so happy to be with you!
Arknights.

Just like here, everyone would get together on this day to celebrate in Laterano. Some friends would even come visit just for the occasion, and see whether my halo was righted yet. Well, it's a shame I wasn't able to get my own gun before I left, but I guess I clicked with the crossbow anyhow. Slick of me, right?
May the Lord bless you, Doctor.

I've learned how to make fifteen more desserts this year, and though that's a long way off from how many desserts Laterano has, it should be enough for you to choose your birthday cake. I'd lean towards a fruitcake or a raspberry mochi—sweet and delicious in spades.

Doctor, nothing's made me happier than getting to work with you so long. I can't count how much you've cared for my squad members over the past year. Whichever way you guide me, Doctor, that's the future I'll sprint for.

handbook.profile:
Adnachiel is a citizen of Laterano and enjoys rights one through thirteen afforded to all citizens of Laterano. Before his arrival at Rhodes Island, he worked as a freelancer. He received excellent results on a battery of tests and was assigned to Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4.
He has demonstrated great potential in the areas of rapid response, marksmanship, and support operations.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of his internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in his circulatory system, confirming him to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9%
He presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.26u/L
Degree of infection is minor and has not displayed any significant physical symptoms.
archives:
Operators familiar with Adnachiel tend to use one word to describe the angel: bright. No matter how complicated the subject or advanced the technology involved, he seems to have no trouble mastering it in a short period of time. 
In a show of humility, Adnachiel stands helpless in the face of loftier, theoretical topics, though everyone assumes he's just being modest. After all, as soft spoken and kind as he is, Adnachiel gives off the impression of being a clever and considerate young man. After meeting him, most operators come to understand his observant and sensitive personality. He always speaks to the true nature of things, but the scope of his theories is limited to that over which he has immediate control. Through his analyses, he can even predict the short-term future of his targets. He consistently rejects the titles of both 'prophet' and 'genius pretty boy,' but rumors about him continue to proliferate.

When he has free time between missions, Adnachiel often goes to the Rhodes Island Maintenance and Repair Workshop. Working as an intern assistant, Adnachiel's wrists are flexible and his attention to detail is meticulous. He has demonstrated an insatiable curiosity about Rhodes Island's equipment.

Adnachiel has not yet completed the Laterano Firearms Usage Agreement. His most trusted piece of equipment is his personally modified crossbow (Laterano crossbows are very different from the metal crossbows mass produced by Raythean). As he is not sufficiently physically strong, Adnachiel's crossbow has a pedal on the front used to help pull back the string with his foot.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, it's such a nice day, so can't we take a little nap?
Hmm...? We're about to leave? But I just got up... Wait, is this the Doctor's office? How'd I get here?
Why am I always squinting? Because I don't want anyone to see my eyes. Nope, nobody~
I'm really careless and get hurt a lot... But Hibiscus heals me every time, so I'm not afraid of getting injured. Oh gosh, that 'Curing Cuisine' of hers though, I'm terrified of it...
Doctor! Someone left 10 alarm clocks by my bed! Who would do something so awful?!
Doctor, let's play a game~ Put an apple on your head and we'll start~
I'm always looking for fun things to do as a way to ease the pain of my Oripathy, I guess. Plus, I love seeing other people smile~
One day, our journey with Rhodes Island will come to an end, and hopefully we'll all get to have a warm, neverending dream, lying in the sunshine~ That's my number one dream~
Can't believe the Doctor's a heavier sleeper than me...
Hi-hiii~ I'm Kroos~ I might be inexperienced, but I'll do the best I can~
Thank you so much!
A promotion~ What a lovely dream~ Huh? I'm not dreaming?
Umm, where's the rally point?
Huhhh~? Fang would make a better captain than me!
Listen, everyone~! Stay calm~
Why can't everyone try to get along...?
Sure!
Let's take it slow~
Mmhmm, I'm listening~
I won't sleep on the job~
There you are!
Heeere I aaaaam!
Take aim!
Phew, that was tough...
I think we did alright!
Hmm, I guess this was a bit of a letdown...
S-sorry... I'll fight harder next time...!
Can I get my beauty sleep in here?
Ughh...
Hmm, have I matured?
Arknights.
Doctor Happy New Year! I'm really sleepy already, so I'm just wishing you a good year ahead of time. How was that can I gave you, tasty? If you liked it, I could give you a few more.
Doctor~ *Yawn*...

Fang! You're awful! Doctor, don't be scared, come with me. Hmm? What are you crouching for? There's no water bucket on the door. Pff, your chair's got all four legs too. No hot sauce in your cake either. Heheh, Doctor, Truth is, I haven't pulled a single prank at all! That's what I'm fooling them about!

It's so fun having everyone together like this. Not a care in the land except what's coming up next and what eats there are. How nice it'll be if every day was like this. Oh, the light show's starting? Let's get moving, Doctor.

handbook.profile: Originally from Rim Billiton. Kroos also received her training from the Columbian Garrison at Holmegard with Fang and Beagle. She is calm and constantly smiling as she maintains a gentle demeanor. However, she sometimes breaks her facade, revealing a sharp-tongued, ferocious side.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 8%
She presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.23u/L
Degree of infection is minor and physical symptoms are not yet present.
archives: Kroos prefers put in the absolute minimum effort in life and on the battlefield, which is reflective of her weapon of choice - a modern crossbow. Despite her lazy work ethic, Kroos has become a skilled marksman and assists her fellow Operators by flanking the enemy and shooting them in the rear with deadly precision.

Ever since she was a child, Kroos lacked initiative. But during training, she showed an exceptional talent for marksmanship. On the battlefield, she effortlessly locates ideal sniper nests and rains down a hail of precise and deadly fire while backed up by her teammates. Both Fang and Beagle trust Kroos with their lives and she is their support sniper of choice.

While a member of the garrison, Kroos faced everything with a smile. Upon being infected with Oripathy and suffering discrimination, she had a complete change in mood. After angrily cursing out the other members of the garrison, she along with Fang and Beagle left the garrison for good. In order to find a way for the three of them to survive, Kroos searched far and wide before finally discovering their new home at Rhodes Island.

The always smiling Kroos often leaves others with an affectionate impression but does so in order to avoid trouble. She enjoys finding quiet places to slack off and take naps. Although she is typically well-mannered and aloof, when something she cares about is on the line her persona shifts into a more ferocious persona. Even when she is talking, she occasionally displays hints of that ferocity. This facade works on Fang, but not Beagle as Kroos cannot withstand her piercing gaze.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, I'm your guard for the day! Don't worry, I won't let any sketchy people near you! Just relax!
My training score for today...? Um, I mean, we could talk about something else...
I can't shake the pre-battle jitters, and that makes Captain Fang really nervous too... What should I do? Doctor!
Hibiscus and Lava always complain to me about each other, but both of them are my good friends, and neither of them are wrong... Doctor, what should I do?
Instructor Dobermann always told us, 'Even when after you finish your training, your number one goal on the battlefield is to stay alive.' Urgh... How can I become as strong and awesome as she is?
I'm still a rookie Operator, but I'm working hard! Hehehe, I'd really love a compliment or two, if you agree.
My Oripathy? It doesn't bother me all that much, I'm used to it. I just want to be with the people I care about until my disease gets cured... Ughh...

I didn't have much confidence before I came here, but I'm so glad that I can protect you and everyone on Rhodes Island! It's my dream to protect everyone! I really wish days like these could last forever.
Aww... seeing the Doctor sleeping all vulnerable like that makes me want to doodle something on a certain someone's face...
My codename is Beagle! I know I didn't do very well on my assessment, but I'll still do my best at my internship!
I did it! I've become stronger!
Finally, FINALLY! Now nobody's going to call me 'the Rookiest Rookie in the Rookieverse' anymore!
I'll do all I can!
Huh? I am the leader? I don't feel right about Fang not being the leader...
Everyone, let's roll out!
Everyone, enemies incoming!
Grant me strength!
Is it my turn?
Target location reached!
This is the place!
Haah!
Watch this!
It's my duty to protect everyone! My resolve will never falter, no matter the odds!
All enemies have been defeated! We Rhodes Island Operators are the finest!
Hooray, we won! Although a few enemies managed to get away... *sigh*...
I'm sorry... so sorry...
What can I do for you?
Doctor! Th-That tickles!
Doctor, can I come to your place to study every day?
Arknights.

Doctor, Happy New Year! Today's a day off, right? So that should mean we don't have to go to training... But just a minute ago, I saw Instructor Dobermann and a bunch of other operators at the training grounds. Maybe that means I should go too...
Hi, Doctor!

D-Doctor, happy birthday! Huh? I—I'm not nervous, not at all. We got you a birthday present, so can you come visit the dorms real quick? But you'll want to be careful! And please don't tell Kroos I was the one who warned you!

I think—what scares me more than Oripathy is the idea of separating from my friends. I love being here at Rhodes Island with everyone, and making a bunch of new friends too! As long as I keep doing what I can to get stronger, I'll be able to protect them all!

handbook.profile: A frontline Operator on Reserve Op Team A1. She originally came to Rhodes Island with Fang and Kroos. Though immature in some respects, she has gradually displayed professionalism, resilience, and extreme talent. As a result, she has earned the recognition of others as a reliable Operator.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 8%
She presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
Degree of infection is not yet severe and has not yet brought about a significant physical impact.
archives: Though she lacks flashy skills or the capacity for Arts, Beagle uses her endurance to establish a strong forward defense for her teammates. Though a bit clumsy, she believes that everything will work out as long as she continues to press forward tenaciously. So far, she has only been proven right in this regard.

Her time in a Columbian outskirts garrison was one of the most difficult periods of her life, but also among the most precious. Beagle, along with her close companions Fang and Kroos, worked tirelessly to close the gap between them and the official team members. However, Beagle fell into a deep bout of self-loathing after being infected with Oripathy. She felt that she had become a burden on Fang and Kroos, and that it was her fault they lost everything.

At their lowest point, Fang, Kroos, and Beagle faced expulsion and banishment from the garrison. On Kroos's recommendation, the three of them came to Rhodes Island together. On that day, Beagle resolved to repay the kindness of Fang, Kroos, and everyone who stood beside her.

After witnessing everyone bicker, play, and express joy day after day, Beagle began to feel grateful and happy. Beagle works hard every day to solve disputes that arise between Hibiscus and Lava. She helps Fang find Kroos whenever she is slacking off. She even helps the senior members of Rhodes Island by doing chores in her free time. Time and time through and through, she enjoys every moment of her hard work.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Hello! It's my shift now, Doctor!
What does my 'Cardigan' codename mean? Ahh, It's actually the name of my clan. It's a family tradition to use it as a codename.
Wow, I found one of my people on another team! I've got to invite her to hang out with me sometime!
I was born in the north of Leithanien, a place full of snowy forests. Oh, that reminds me, I can teach you to ski, Doctor!

A lot of people say stuff like 'it's a Defender's job to hold her ground,' but that's such an outdated concept. Speed is what you need! This is the age of maneuver warfare! Mobility is the key to victory!
*Sniff sniff*... I recognize that perfume, it's gotta be Melantha! I hope we can become closer friends... 'Cause then we'll be able to work better as a team!
Hehe, I really enjoy playing with kids. Back in my hometown, I took my brothers and sisters sledding every year. I really miss it! Oh, speaking of sleds... I wonder if Adnachiel can make one for me.
I have plenty of things I don't like. Oripathy, for instance... But there's no point in worrying too much. I would rather live my days in happiness! Plus, I've got you with me, Doctor!
Woof!
Heeellooo! I've never been in such a big mobile facility before! I'm so excited! Merry of the Cardigan here. Are you the Doctor?
Ehehe, thanks!
Yay! I will keep fighting hard for my next promotion! I'm sure it will come in time!
Awesome! Finally, my time has come!
Ansel! Come on! I promise I won't lead everyone on a wild-goose chase!
Formation ready! Advance to the objective!
Let's go! ...Steward, what was I supposed to do next?
There's no hesitating in battle!
All right!
Understood!
I will protect us all!
Aha!
Your attacks have no effect!
I knew we could do it. Right, Adnachiel?
Yeeaaah! A flawless victory!
Thanks, Medics! You saved my life...
Ughh... Sorry, Ansel...
Steward, what should I do next?
Woah! Roller coaster—!
Melantha? Huh? Why are you here, Doctor?!
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor! I wonder why there's no snow outside. And after I spent all that time getting my sled ready… When will I ever get to rocket down the slopes straight into a snowdrift like I did when I was little?
I'm right here, Doctor!
Yay! Happy birthday, Doctor! Hm, something smells good. You got a gift from Melantha, didn't you? What a scent! Melantha taught me how to make perfume, actually, do you want to try with me?
I promise I'll be more careful, I won't break anything! Sorry… Honestly, my salary won't even be enough to cover the damages if I keep breaking things… heheh…

archives:
[Cardigan]
Cardigan is a proactive and confident Operator who carries out both daily tasks and combat missions with vigor. As a member of Reserve Op Team A4, Cardigan is very fond of all her teammates.

[Cardigan's History 1]
Cardigan was born the oldest of five children in the frigid northern region of Leithanien to a mother and father who worked in the forests. Growing up in a comfortable and relaxed household, she had harmonious and intimate relationships with all her family members. When she was a child, she dreamed of becoming a professional skier. With her family's support, she took a shot at her dream, but ultimately failed to succeed. She quit ski training and was recruited by a bobsled patrol team. It was during this time that Cardigan underwent defensive and tactical training.

[Cardigan's History 2]
Before she was recruited by Rhodes Island, she left her hometown, curious about city life. She made her way to the center of Leithanien to seek work, but due to its focus on Arts and her lack of talent for it, as well as her love of sport, she felt the city wasn't a good fit for her. During her stay in Leithanien, she met fellow travelers Steward and Adnachiel and formed a deep friendship with them. Even after the two of them became infected, Cardigan continued to put all her effort into helping her friends make it through, and contacted Rhodes Island to seek treatment for them.

[Cardigan's...]
A list of broken items.
Sofa back leather 14 square centimeters. Cause of damage: Weapon wasn't unequipped and its edge cut everything up.
Medic Operator Ansel's office chair legs. Cause of damage: Got over-excited and lost balance. Chair legs bent as a result.
A 90*120cm tactics book. Cause of damage: Over-excitement resulted in book getting broken with a hammer.
Signature of person responsible: Cardigan. Signature of team leader: Melantha.
Outcome: After finance personnel calculate damage, they inform the responsible party that payment will be deducted from their salary in 12 equal installments for compensation. Responsible party has been handed over to team leader for Reserve Op Team discipline and re-education.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: H-Hello, Doctor... It's nice meeting you...
Um... Sorry... I'm not a good talker...
Yes... My parents are Victorian merchants. But I haven't been able to contact them for a long time... I picked this code name because it reminds me of home.
Th-That masked Operator... makes me feel... nervous...
It's not that... I'm trying to avoid people, it's just, I'm not sure... what I should do...
Sorry to make you worry again, Ansel... But you don't have to give me special treatment. Many more people need your help.
Oripathy granted me powerful senses, but they're slipping away, little by little... Even so, I will not crumble... There's so much more I want to talk about with everyone...
Doctor, could you take this bottle of perfume, please? I brought it from home... This type of perfume lifts spirits. I often take a sniff when I feel down.
Merry? Keep it down... The Doctor is very tired.
I'm Melantha... From now on, my blade is yours.
Thank you... for your guidance.
Thank you very much... Um, were the others promoted as well? I think they all deserve it just the same.
Understood... I'll follow your orders.
The leader? But I'm not particularly good at giving orders...
Let's work to make the world a more peaceful place.
Ansel... I'm counting on you now.
Please give me instructions...
What are your orders?
Understood.
I'll do my best.
You will fall...!
Attack!
No matter what difficulties are in store for me, I will keep on advancing.
We won? Thank goodness for that...
I can still fight.
We failed... How did things end up this way?
Is there... anyone else here?
Wh-Who's there?! Oh, Doctor...
Doctor, thank you for always taking care of me... Um, actually... I'd like to keep taking on the fight.
Arknights.

Um… Happy New Year, Doctor. My parents sent me a letter and a present. I'm also doing a little better today, in terms of perceptiveness. It's a happy day for me. I hope… it puts you in a good mood too.
Doctor...

Doctor, thank you for all the care and encouragement you've given me. This is a present from me... some refreshing fragrances. I've already tried them, they don't clash when mixed together. So you can blend them however you like…
Doctor… How have we been doing? Um… yes… Thank you. I hope I can do better, bit by bit! My squadmates have been supporting me all the way. I hope to repay them… with my strength.

handbook.profile: Melantha is the captain of Reserve Op Team A4 and a citizen of Victoria. Before she took up her current post, she was a typical jobless Infected. After an exceptional performance on her tests, she received an offer to join Rhodes Island.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 2%
Subject is mildly infected. There is a lesion upon the subject's left shoulder, though the infection has largely been contained and is in stable condition.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.25u/L
Results of internal circulation tests have been positive. Strength training is recommended as part of the course of treatment.

'Melantha is still growing and needs to eat food high in nutrients.' - Medic Team Intern Hibiscus
archives:
Melantha was born in Londinium, the capital of the Kingdom of Victoria. Her father is a trader engaged in the bulk spice trade. He runs several spice mills of his own. Her mother is the head of the family's aromatherapy flagship store in the heart of Londinium.
Following in the footsteps of her parents, Melantha got involved in spices at a very young age, often assisting them in developing new aromatherapy products. Melantha's experiences have been heavily influenced by her parents.

Melantha was a student at the Wessex Private Middle School when she was young. She received exceptional marks in all her classes, but because she was soft spoken and lacked communication skills, she was never the center of attention or very popular. 
Her lack of friends remains due to her unwillingness to change her personality. With her parents' help, she immersed herself into upper-class academic activities, including art, literature, and poetry. In traditional Victorian society, the arts are an important part of a woman's formal education.
In addition, in order to strengthen her weak constitution, Melantha's parents arranged for her to study swordsmanship and other popular upper-class sports.
After the Infected crisis broke out, Melantha was herself Infected. Her parents arranged for her to receive treatment from Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals. And before long, she was on the way to the company for treatment.

Melantha has a close relationship with all the other members of Reserve Op Team A4. Introverted by nature, she initially worried about whether she would be able to serve well in her role as Reserve Op Team A4's captain, but with the help of her companions on the team, she broke through her inner obstacles. 
The lively and cheerful Cardigan is her inseparable friend. In both life and on the battlefield, they maintain a strong and complementary relationship. 
Melantha also has great respect for the mature and dependable Operator Steward. She feels both guilty and grateful to Ansel, who is in charge of maintaining her health records as well as providing her with daily treatment. Finally, Adnachiel is the Operator that Melantha understands the least. Since the beginning, she has struggled to figure out what this kid from Laterano might be thinking. Nevertheless, Adnachiel hasn't caused any problems in battle. 
During her tenure as captain, her subordinates have all spoken highly of her attentive and careful nature. Her serious and disciplined qualities have enabled her to complete all the missions Rhodes Island has entrusted to her.

So far, both existing archives and the observations of her fellow Operators have failed to grasp just what kind of swordsmanship Melantha employs. This is one of Melantha's few mysteries. 
Judging from test records and daily battle videos, her swordsmanship appears to have originated from the Victorian traditional duelist's style, but at some point during her training, she must have picked up some heavy influences from Eastern sword arts. 
Melantha's weapon can also be looked at as a kind of circumstantial evidence for this. She uses an exceptionally fine yet extremely sharp straight sword. Current data makes clear that this weapon is only used in Yan and some parts of Higashi. 
Melantha's swordsmanship is agile and her skills are outstanding. In terms of combat techniques, Melantha has is skilled in tactical assault. Even without support, she can rely upon her mobility to move about the battlefield and hide when necessary. 
On the other hand, Melantha lacks the ability for effective direct confrontation and she displays certain deficiencies in stability during high-intensity operations.
Up until now, Melantha has trained under the guidance of Franka.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Don't worry, Doctor. No matter what happens, I'll protect you.
Liberi have excellent eyesight. According to legend, some can even tell one droplet from another in a rainstorm. Sounds incredible, huh?
I take everyday life too seriously? My apologies. I think that comes from my time serving as a Laterano Guard. I'll work on that in the future.
To most Lateranos, heavy armor doesn't serve much of a purpose. Of course, when we perform the large-scale rituals of our homeland, we do dress up in ceremonial garb.
I appreciate your faith in my abilities, Doctor. I won't let you down.
Right... I submitted a request to the HR office... to become your personal bodyguard. I guess maybe I miss my old job too much.
I grew up in Laterano and didn't really have the chance to learn about other cultures. Here at Rhodes Island, I get to see such diversity, way beyond my imagination. Actually...it's not so bad.
I have no regrets. Yes, true, they did drag me out of Laterano against my will... but this has been a great adventure. I've enjoyed it.
It is my duty to protect you, Doctor. Rest assured.
My name is Plume, formerly of the Pontifica Cohors Lateran. I will be your sword, and your wings, as I defend your very life.
Ah, so tactics can help you overcome a more skilled opponent, huh?
Thank you, Doctor. As your bodyguard, your approval is the best reward I can ask for.
I'm ready.
As the leader, it's my responsibility to keep everyone safe.
Watch the friendlies!
Keep your guard up!
Hmm?
Got it.
Ready for overwatch.
Understood!
You think you're faster than me?
No move can escape my sight!
My resolve lies with my spear!
I fight for the glory of Laterano!
Nothing can hold me back.
Like a wave crashing against an immovable stone, isn't it?
Regroup! I'll look out for the remaining enemies!
I can't... fall... yet!
Should I patrol this area?
Anything over there?
Doctor... it feels like I'm abusing my position...
Arknights.
Lift the corners of my mouth, don't knit my eyebrows...good, hold steady, then ease my mind, relax... Okay, now get in and greet everyone… Ah! Doctor, you scared me. Um, Happy New Year!
Hello, Doctor.

So today is your birthday, Doctor? Alright, happy birthday! I promise I'll see my guard duty through more vigilantly. Uh, I mean, if you're going to hold a birthday get-together like the Laterans do, then I'll ensure your safety, and take responsibility for the aftermath.

Someone once told me that the honor of protecting Laterano was the sole reason I fought. But now, I have more things to protect. My beliefs, my companions, and you. It all weighs heavier on my spear, but I will never let it slow down.

handbook.profile: Plume is a Liberi from Laterano, and former member of the Laterano Guard who bumbled her way out of Laterano and into Rhodes Island. She performs security, inspection, and loss prevention duties.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
No Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.09u/L 
Subject is rarely exposed to Originium.
archives:
Any Liberi wanting to join the Laterano Guard needs to learn the art of the standard battle axe. 
Plume has speed but lacks strength, so swinging an axe was a challenge for her. 
When she joined the Defense Squad, she tried to build up her strength with regular training. Unfortunately, these exercises didn't make her strong enough for the hefty battle axe tactics demanded of her. Not only did she fail to earn good marks in her training, she made many high-profile mistakes in her practical lessons, such as mishandling her weapon and destroying public property. 
Plume did not let these setbacks get to her. She calmly analyzed her performance to find out where she went wrong. After seeking guidance from other members of the Guard, she took their advice and started doing exercises focused on battle axe technique and attack speed. 
After abandoning the brute force route and focusing on technique, Plume worked hard to create a simple but effective battle style. She darts swiftly around the battlefield, launching quick offensive strikes, downing her targets just as quickly. 
Although she is not strong enough for head-on assault missions, Plume can fulfill all the basic duties of an Operator. Whether on offense or defense, Plume can hold her own, all while keeping high spirits and a strong will.

Plume has no life outside of work. It may be that she is still adjusting to life at Rhodes Island. Either way, she is working hard to reconcile herself as both a Laterano guard and a Rhodes Islander.
In the former role, she is serious, determined, loyal, and proud. With no distinction between her work and private lives. She could even see her work as a form of entertainment. 
But after joining Rhodes Island, she began to see the appeal of having a life outside of work. 
According to Plume, Rhodes Island doesn't have some aloof aristocracy she needs to put her life on the line to protect (though she believes such people don't actually need protection), and life is not as regimented and ritualized as she is used to. Diverse individuals with all personality types can fill the halls, and there's no distinguishing rank among them. Everyone has their own lifestyle--this has had a tremendous impact on her.
Plume tried to maintain her Laterano Guard ways of thinking, but her sharp eye is dazzled by all of the colorful characters around her. She has been unable to ignore this diversity. 
In fact, Plume has said she is considering changing her image. We see this sort of thing whenever a new Operator is starting to integrate themselves into Rhodes Island life. 
Perhaps she could start by smiling more?

But why did Plume leave Laterano for Rhodes Island?
She has never explained why, saying only that she 'is not authorized to disclose that information for the time being.' 
Particularly right before and right after the incident, it seemed she was still involved with two senior Operators who had left Laterano. 
At present, only part of the eyewitness testimony has been provided by those who were working that day. It seems she was dragged along by the two Laterano staffers, and it was purely coincidental. 
She might not have known where she was. 
Plume may be acting out of caution or convenience, but no one knows the details of the situation. Her reason for leaving Laterano remains unclear, and no one knows where Laterano stands regarding her story, either.
Sometimes she will stand stiffly by the edge of the bridge of Rhodes Island and look out anxiously in Laterano's direction.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Awaiting your orders, Doctor.
The two seniors from the BPRS squad are here too? In that case... Could you assign me to their squards in future missions, Doctor?
Huff... huff... three more sets of physical training and I'll be half-done for today. Doctor... please... fetch my water bottle for me...
You want to know about my hometown? My hometown… it's a cruel wilderness. Even survival itself is a difficult feat there. Compared to that, Rhodes Island is like heaven.
I've become stronger than when I was an intern for Blacksteel.

The 22nd rule of Blacksteel: 'Anyone who loses her weapon no longer belongs here.' That's why I always bring my hellebarde with me wherever I go. The rule doesn't apply to everyday situations, you say? But... if I remember correctly... wait, let me check. 'This rule only applies to contracted Operators and new recruits under training.' What?... Ms. Franka didn't tell me about this part...
Instructor Dobermann's really got a heart of stone! Why choose me other than anyone elase to deal with all those live Originium slugs? I... I just can't!
I think I know now why Franka and Liskarm decided to stay at Rhodes Island. Compared to Blacksteel, this is a place we can call home. There's lots of fun things to do here besides the missions...
Shh, the Doctor's having a rest now. Keep your volume down, would you?
I'm Vanilla, trainee Operator from Blacksteel. Looking forward to learning from you, Doctor.
It's time to organize my notes. I need to digest what I've just learned.
A promotion medal? For me? My-my sincerest gratitude!
I'm here to help everyone!
Me, the leader? Are you sure about that?
I'll work even harder.
I will not bring shame to Blacksteel!
Hmm?
Your words are my command.
Okay!
Understood.
You shall not pass!
This hellebarde isn't just for show!
Battles aren't always won by the most experienced!
Take that!
Whew, perfect victory!
A very successful operation.
If we worked a bit harder, we could have done better.
I... I'm still not strong enough...
At your service.
Huh?
Doctor, would you like to dine with me tonight?
Arknights.

Vanilla is a Blacksteel trainee, currently training and studying as part of an exchange program with Rhodes Island. 
She has learned to use her race's combat abilities to her advantage, and performs well as a Vanguard.

basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Vanilla showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Vanilla rarely comes into contact with Originium.
archives:
Vanilla is a rather naive and inexperienced Operator sent to us from Blacksteel Worldwide. 
Even though she's only been with Blacksteel for a short time, her dedication impressed the executives enough for them to send her to Rhodes Island for additional training. 
She stands much taller than Liskarm or Franka, but the three are often seen together.

Vanilla is very protective of animals. A conversation about animals will always gets her out of her normally very thick shell. It may also be a reason she left home. 
But because the animals she strives to protect include icky things like the Originium snail, her affection can unnerve some people.

Because Vanilla was born in an isolated tribe, Blacksteel added a special common knowledge to her training regimen. 
According to Franka, Vanilla was at first startled by the automatic doors at the base. 
In fact, Vanilla is not yet used to most of the technological equipment at Rhodes Island.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Is there anything I can help you with, Doctor?
Thank you for believing in me! I'll keep up my work!
Hibiscus and Lava are fighting again... What a pain. Why are they like this? They're sisters.
Instructor Dobermann puts us through mock battles a lot, but I can never get a handle on her skill. Doctor, next time you and Amiya observe our training, would you please give us some notes?
Someone on my team is late again, huh? I'll make sure that gets fixed.
Lava and I are both Infected, but I didn't get a talent for Arts like she did...
Rhodes Island is our home and shelter, Doctor. I will protect everyone here with my life.

The ever-honest and reliable Beagle, the perceptive Kroos, the resourceful Lava and the energetic Hibiscus. I like everyone in this team... as long as Hibiscus doesn't force her health food innovations on me.
Shhh! The Doctor's resting. We can talk outside.
Lancer Fang, captain of Reserve Op Team A1. My team and I will do our best to serve Rhodes Island.
Thank you for your guidance.
Your approval means so much to me, Doctor. This promotion proves my hard work is paying off.
Leave it to me.
I know the captain's duty well. Rest easy.
Team, check your gear before departing.
Enemy spotted. Prepare to fight!
Ready for action.
On standby.
In position.
Leave it to us.
Thrust!
Everyone, follow me!
With the right plan, even rookies like us can win a tough fight!
We have accomplished our objective as planned.
We can't call a mission complete if we let even a single enemy get through. Beagle, let's do better on the next one.
I'm sorry I failed you, Instructor Dobermann...
Yes. I'm back. Is Kroos here too?
Ahh...!
Am I helping?
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor. Our team's going to eat dinner together, and we were just about to invite Instructor Dobermann. Would you like to come as well? I have some combat-related questions I'd like to ask, too... Oh, sorry, I know I shouldn't be mentioning work on a holiday.
I'm ready whenever you need me, Doctor.

Doctor, happy birthday! We got you a birthday present as a team. Have you seen Kroos? We agreed to do this together, and she still vanished. Anyway, whatever she told you, just don't believe a word of it, we did actually—awgh! Krooth! Whah ah yoo cavvarin m' mauph phor?!

Looking at our set goals, I've already finished all my training, the other members of my team have made huge progress under Dobermann's instruction too, and we're adapting better and better on the combat side of things. Doctor, I'll be a better captain than I'm now, I promise.

handbook.profile: Captain of Reserve Op Team A1. She has prior experience working with a Columbian garrison, and has proven herself to be outstanding in combat. After joining Rhodes Island, she had no problem adjusting to her current work. She joined the Operation Planning Group with its original members, Beagle and Kroos, and has worked hard to become its leading Operator.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests confirm she is infected.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7.4%
She presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.2 u/L
Degree of infection is minor and physical symptoms are not yet present.
archives: Fang shows off a Kuranta's natural dominance in battle by always holding the most advantageous position at critical moments. To strike a balance between power and control, Fang prefers to use a spear, which she applies with versatility in any situation. Fang acts impulsively and springs into action before others even finish talking.

Immigrants from many nations came to the outskirts of Columbia. Fang, Kroos, and Beagle all met there after moving from their respective homelands. After realizing their common goals, they joined the city guard and underwent basic training together. The humorless Fang, the gentle Beagle, and the laid-back Kroos possess wildly different personalities yet rely on one another for support.

Before an election day, a Catastrophe struck the outskirts of Columbia. In their efforts to aid others in escaping, all three Operators were infected with Oripathy. Fang suffered discrimination due to her condition and fell into deep despair. Kroos rallied the three of them and together they went to Rhodes Island.

After arriving at Rhodes Island, Fang and her two companions as well as Hibiscus and Lava were all trained by Dobermann. The training was extraordinarily intense, and Kroos and Hibiscus seized every opportunity they could to goof off. Even Fang as their captain couldn't do anything to control them. Currently, Fang is training herself to be as intense and strict as her teacher, Dobermann. However, if the giddy expression on her face as she eats fruit is any indication, she's got a long way to go.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Forgive me, Doctor... There are limits to what I can do, including in conversation... but I'm honored to be your assistant. I look forward to helping you with your work.
Doctor, time heals all wounds. Please have more confidence in yourself. Your Operators have chosen to follow you because we believe that you will bring positive change.

Many Infected have relocated to Rhodes Island... not because they have any particular goals to achieve, but simply because they want a place to call home. The world outside no longer accepts them, after all...
Owl may not seem very friendly, but she's got a good heart. Please excuse her and pay her no mind.
12F? That was the day I 'came to' this world. You could consider it my birthday.
I might not be able to spend my entire life serving one person... but at least I can start working on it now.
She has finally found you, Doctor. What a perilous journey it's been. You're very important to her, as well as to everyone else.
I'll be by your side watching over you, Doctor, even in your sleep. So rest easy, you have nothing to fear.

You have my thanks for allowing me to join you. From now on, I will do my best to serve you, Doctor, with my alchemical skills. I have never had a name... but if you must call me something, you can refer to me as 12F.
I see, I understand now. Thank you for your guidance.
I may not possess outstanding skills, but I will do my best.
Will it be alright for me to be the leader? Anyway, thank you for your trust, Doctor.
Relax, Doctor. We will complete this operation in no time.
Everyone, get ready for battle.
Your orders?
Ready for action.
Got it.
Copy.
Please show me the path.
Burn to ashes.
Clear away all obstacles.
Watch out, Owl!
I'm used to failure... but a victory after countless defeats is always the most precious one. Don't you agree, Doctor?
This victory is all yours, Doctor. And I am honored to be a pawn in your game of chess.
That was a hard-won victory, but we did it. Are you all right, Owl?
Failure is only normal. Don't be discouraged. I've been in many wars, and my experience tells me that your victory will come soon.
If you'd like, I can help. No trouble.
Aah! Be careful.
I am so thankful for all that you have done for me. I feel ashamed I have so little with which to repay your kindness. Forgive me, Doctor.
Arknights.
'I want to live through the coming year.' That's probably every mercenary's wish they only dare think deep down, and never risk saying out loud. Doctor, may all be peaceful in your New Year.
Good morning to you, Doctor.
Doctor, happy birthday. I'm very curious, actually. Is this your real birthday, or is it maybe a particularly significant day to you? Oh, perhaps I'm prying too much. Please, forgive me.
I was just a lucky survivor, and found a place to call home in Rhodes Island. I will devote all the power I have, and I look forward to the ending that you lead us towards, Doctor.

handbook.profile:
12F was the alias commonly used by this Operator in his mercenary work. By his own account, he vacillated between different factions and was involved in several famous battles over the past few years. 
The few verifiable documents we have confirmed that 12F was indeed present for these conflicts, either as a regular mercenary or security for a local facility. 
He joined Rhodes Island with Owl, having been admitted for his unique combat experience as well as his experience in general. Now a standard Arts Operator assigned to normal duty.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator 12F showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.09u/L 
Operator 12F rarely comes into contact with Originium.
archives:
Originium Arts Assessment: 
Despite his extensive combat experience, 12F's Originium Arts was not decisive in any of his battles, as his own accounts confirm. But his grasp of Originium Arts is slightly better than your typical caster, and maybe factor into his continued survival.

12F appears very stern and abrasive, but feedback from most Operators who have worked with this inconspicuous caster has been positive. The comments include 'Didn't hold up the squad,' 'helped smooth over internal conflicts,' 'provided timely assistance,' 'made unexpectedly good suggestions.'

12F gets along with many Operators. In contrast, his closest friend, Operator Owl, has few other friends at Rhodes Island. 12F often makes concerted efforts to speak to Owl at places she frequents. Because the medical department is too busy to keep up on Owl's state of mind, 12F has been providing regular reports.

12F has described many of his battles in detail, but reports that he's forgotten what his home and family looked like. '12F' was the designation he was given for his first mission. That was when he met Owl, who was on the opposing side. He was gravely wounded but lived long enough to become a prisoner of war.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Morning, Doctor... Mind if I lay out my sleeping bag here...? Thanks. The rest is up to you...
How do I fight? Using Arts, of course... Want me to show you the power of earth?
What time is it...? See, I don't work mornings, noons, afternoons, or nights...
You'll make an S-sized uniform for me...? No thanks. My oversized one works as a sheet when I take naps... plus, it's really warm.
Dooooctoooooor? I need a break! I'm competing in the Speedy Sleep Contest.
Doctor, check this out. This isn't my normal wand, it's a pendulum. You're feeling very sleepy and will nap in five minutes without giving me any work... Zzzz...
I was hoping I could tell you about my homeland, Doctor.
After you went to sleep, I somehow didn't feel sleepy at all anymore... Hmmmph...
Hello? Hellooooo? Can you hear me? Down here. Down heeeeere! Nice meeting you, big Doctor. I'm Durin the Caster.
Whoa... I've fiiiinally gotten s-tron-ger.
The secret to staying healthy is to sleep whenever you can.
Captain's orders: everyone, save your energy and take a nap!
I wanna dig a hole in the ground and make a shelter to sleep in, if you don't mind.
Take over for me. Thaaanks.
Wooo.
Hmm?
What a pain.
Okaaaay, I'll do it.
You're going down!
Gooooooo!
Why do we have annoying missions like this? Can't we do something easier...? Still, it's nice that we won.
Of course we won. I worked real hard supporting you with my Arts.
Doctor, are you still worried about those ones that got through?
Ugghh... Sorry... I'll try harder next time...
The Land of Giants... Here I aaaaaaaaaaaaaaam!
Hmmm?
I'm in a good mood, so how about a magic trick?
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Big Doctor. There's lots of tasty foods at the cafeteria. Have you been eating well? Oh, right, I saw Myrtle carrying a huge sack with her to the cafeteria just now. Too late, though. I already ate all the cheese fried fowlbeast.
*Yawn*... Good morning...

Big Doctor, Big Doctor, Happy birthday! If you're another year older, does that mean you're getting taller, too? I bought you a sleeping bag. If you're getting taller, I don't know how long it'll fit...?

Because of how short I am, nobody ever notices whether I'm working or playing hooky... Rhodes Island gave me a really comfortable environment to sleep in, though, so I still gotta do some things every now and then to repay the favor. Doctor, I'm looking forward to a good year.

handbook.profile:
Durin serves on Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4. 
She has a tremendous aptitude for Arts but is unable to fully realize her potential due to her physiology. 
Extremely narcoleptic, she is able to fall asleep at just about any place or time despite averaging more hours of sleep than most operators. Despite this, she makes very few mistakes in her work.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Durin showed no signs of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.18u/L
Operator Durin has come into frequent contact with processed Originium, but so far no abnormalities have been detected.
archives:
Modus Operandi: She takes advantage of her small stature to launch surprise attacks. 
SOP: She finds somewhere more comfortable to sleep.

Thanks to her peculiar origins, Durin eats a slightly different diet than most operators, though this does not mean she eats any less. Despite her small stature, she is known to wolf down an entire meal before her fellow operators have taken more than a few bites. She then promptly seeks out a place to sleep.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Doctor, I greatly admire your genius. It's my honor to be your guard.
A man of my experience can tell you'll be a great leader one day, Doctor.
I have an unusual skin tone, you say? Hah. Just a souvenir from back when I snuck into a biolab, and... Please, I'm joking around.
I need to wear this scarf, even when I sleep, or else my neck will get cold.
This face of mine might be a little too exotic for your typical townsfolk. Heh, I tend to draw a curious crowd when I wander.
I'm surprised how polite you are to this old man! Not many besides Durin ask after my health.
When I go barefoot, I can sense enemies through their vibrations on the ground.
Hmm... Snoring is a bad habit. The other rangers will hear you.
I'm Rangers, the Sniper. Call whenever you need me.
Not bad.
My turn, is it?
Good. Let me show you what an old man can do.
Let's get going.
Prey spotted. Commence operation.
I'm waiting for orders.
What are your orders?
Alright.
Got it.
Found you!
Taste my arrow!
Challenge after challenge. Exactly what we wanted. Right, Noir Corne?
What a satisfying battle!
A few of them got through. I'd call that decent.
Oh no, I'm out of breath...
If you need anything, just say the word.
Urgh! Please, leave my tail be...
You like me that much, huh? Weird taste, I gotta say.
Arknights.

Doctor, it's been three hours, and the kiddos still clamoring for more of my stories. Talk to them, will ya...? The New Year always makes the young'uns so astonishingly lively. I can't compete with that…
Doctor, how can I help you?

I'm kinda too old to follow what you young'uns may want. But here's a little something I like. This scarf's made out of my favorite material, lightweight but warm. It will keep you cozy when it's cold, Doctor. Happy birthday.
Retirement? Too soon for that. Not while I still eat five buns for breakfast. Once my appetite declines, then—and only then, will I find some place to bask in the sun. But for now, don't you worry.

Retirement? Too soon for that. Not while I still eat five buns for breakfast. Once my appetite declines, then—and only then, will I find some place to bask in the sun. But for now, don't you worry.

handbook.profile: Rangers serves on Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4. A longtime veteran, he has traveled to many different places prior to serving in Rhodes Island's reserves. An expert archer, he still retains the characteristic agility and vigor of the Savras despite his advanced age.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Rangers shows no signs of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Rangers seldom visits regions affected by Oripathy.
archives: A master of camouflage and utilizing the environment to his advantage, Rangers favors pre-emptive strikes using the element of surprise over waiting for his prey.

Rangers is, without doubt, an excellent storyteller whose head is filled with fantastic tales and a desire to share them with others. After each morning class, many younger Operators offer 'Grandpa Rangers' a glass of water and beg him to regale them.

Unlike that of most Savras, Rangers's skin provides no natural camouflage at all. But he is also more confident and more open to communication than most of his kin. Whether that is a blessing or a curse is strictly up to him to decide.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: What's up, Doctor? Me, I'm just on standby.
My shield? Fun fact: I personally provide a portion of the energy it needs.
What I look like beneath the mask? Well, I... Actually, let's keep it secret for a bit longer.
Man, nothing better than a break after you finish a mission.
Doctor, if I get to know you better, I figure my shield's gonna get even sturdier.
Course I know where my limit's at. But I don't want Yato to worry about me, which is what matters. We'll worry about the rest some other time!

There's always the need for guys like me, you know? Nah, I'm not trying to act high and mighty. What I'm saying is: when you have a VIP plus a lot of danger, you need a guy to stand between them, that's all.
Sometimes you've just gotta take off the mask and catch a breather.
Defender Noir Corne, reporting for duty. You need VIP protection, I'm your guy.
Cool... So this stuff is what Grandpa Rangers was talking about earlier.
We bringing friends?
I'm gonna get even stronger!
Holding the line is a Defender's most important job!
We're doing it!
C'mon, say something.
What's up?
I've got this!
Here I come!
Watch it, buddy!
Reinforce defenses!
Even guys like me are happy to get through tough battles like these.
That was all right.
Well, we managed.
This wouldn't have happened if I'd worn my good mask! God dammit!
Alright, let's take a breather.
Yeah?
You wanna get some drinks after work?
Arknights.

It's these kinds of days I love the most. Everyone has a blast getting together, and we're off work. C'mon, Doctor, you gotta try this burdenbeast offal flambé while it's still fresh from the pan! Whoa, whoa, I don't think Dr. Kal'tsit's gonna like you drinking that much, y'know?
Nothing outta the ordinary, Doctor.

Yo, Doctor! Here's a mask from my stash, straight to you! You've rocked the hood for long enough, right? You could try masking up, just for today. Think about it! And hey, if no one else is gonna say it, I will—I think you'll look cool as hell with it on.

With all the years I've spent at Rhodes Island, I know exactly what's left on the agenda today. The Doctor's still got mad business, alright? Can't keep 'em any longer. Everyone, a toast to the Doctor, who's spent another year working hard for us! To you!

handbook.profile: One of Rhodes Island's core Operators. On the battlefield, he rushes to the vanguard to protect his teammates, but back at the Ark, he quietly dedicates himself to logistical duties.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 11%
No major infection symptoms have yet appeared. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.22u/L
Severity of infection remains low, with no major hindrance on motor functions.
archives: A veteran Operator of Rhodes Island in both age and experience, Noir Corne's habit of wearing a mask often makes him seem unapproachable. However, those who converse with him quickly find that he is an easygoing, brotherly figure who gets along well with his juniors and never touts his seniority.

Noir Corne keeps a huge collection of masks in his room. He'll wear the most suitable mask for each occasion. 
The mask he is seen with most frequently also seems to be his favorite. In his own words, 'This one best suits Rhodes Island's ambience.' 
By the way, his mask does not hide any terrible secrets.

The most peculiar thing about Noir Corne's personality is his caution around Yato - not fear, but a conspicuous, careful deference so as to avoid angering her - which has spawned plenty of gossip among the operators. 
However, neither their backgrounds nor their interactions seem to clarify why.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Hey, Doctor. Do me a favor and just tell me what you need done.
I'll be watching you even when I'm off duty.
Hm? Do you need something?
My skin is sensitive to sunlight. So please assign me to nighttime missions, whenever you can.
There's limits to what I'm capable of, but even so, I want to help ease the burden you carry, Doctor.
I can't help but feel just a little envious when I see how the other Operators fight...
I need no particular reason to fight for you, Doctor. I hope to see an exciting frontline battle someday...
Doctor, let me be your guardian, now and forever...
Vanguard Yato here. Are you the one I'm protecting?
Thank you.
Yato has joined the team.
We're ready to execute your plans, Doctor.
All Operators, be on alert.
Targets spotted. Get ready for battle.
Here.
Go ahead.
Got it.
Understood!
In a blink of eye!
Prepare yourself!
Haaaaghhh!
Slash you down!
As long as we follow the Doctor's orders, we won't have any problems.
The Doctor's brilliant command was the key to victory.
Victory is the most welcome news.
I apologize... We failed to execute your plan, Doctor...
Please send me somewhere that sunlight can never touch.
*Gasp*!
Doctor, thank you for always taking care of us.
Arknights.
Happy holidays, Doctor. Thank you for your work over the past year, and may you continue to guide us this year.
Doctor, I will be your shield.
Happy birthday, Doctor. Please, accept this humble gift. Yes, of course I remember your birthday.
A blade needs a sheath. It is a shelter, and a place to return. For me, Rhodes Island is that sheath.

handbook.profile: Yato is the team leader of the core operators. She is a loyal and dependable warrior.
handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 8%
No major visible symptoms of infection. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.22u/L
Severity of infection remains low, with no major hindrance to motor functions.
archives:
A quiet warrior with no particularly memorable traits except for the mask she wears. 
As a result, people tend to overlook the fact that she's there. She doesn't seem to mind though, instead focusing on diligently carrying out every task given to her. 
 Dr. Kal'tsit has praised her as 'the cornerstone of Rhodes Island.'

No one knows when Yato joined Rhodes Island, and no one has ever tried to find out. 
Her presence as a Rhodes Island Operator is taken for granted, but if she were to suddenly disappear one day, it's unclear how many people would actually notice.

Some curious Operators once asked Yato about whether she had a history with Noir Corne, but she didn't provide a straightforward answer.
Like Noir Corne, she is rarely seen without her mask.

LINKAGE.voiceText: 汪汪，嗷！（虎狼丸看起来很有精神，似乎可以放心把工作交给他。）
汪嗷！（虎狼丸叼来了一个弹力球，但上面有医务室的徽记。是他捡到的吗……）
汪汪！（虎狼丸叼来了蜜饼，似乎是想分享这份食物。）
汪呜……汪，汪呜……！（虽然天气不太好，但虎狼丸在望着窗外吠叫。看来就算是这种天气，他也想去散步啊……）
汪……？汪汪，汪，汪？（虎狼丸似乎对置物架上的棋盘很感兴趣。下一次下棋时，要不要请虎狼丸来观战呢……）
汪嗷……汪！呼呼。（按照指示，虎狼丸叼来了一盒泡面，看来阿米娅没有发现。刚好热水也烧好了。摸摸虎狼丸的头，表扬他吧。）
汪！汪……？汪汪。（虎狼丸守在办公室门口。出门时，他似乎想要一起走，示意他回到门口，虎狼丸就乖乖地坐下了。）
呜……（虎狼丸用头顶了顶你，然后在你身边安静地卧了下来。）
汪！（虎狼丸伸出了前爪，似乎想要握手。）
汪……？汪嗷，汪！（虎狼丸很高兴，看来他很想一起看电视……？）
汪，汪，汪汪！（虎狼丸对同伴们轻轻叫着，像是在打招呼一样。）
汪汪！（虎狼丸非常兴奋，请队员们留意跟上虎狼丸的速度。）
汪！（虎狼丸似乎想要确认目的地。）
汪呜……汪汪汪！（虎狼丸冲了出去！）
汪呜？（虎狼丸似乎在思考……）
呼呼……（虎狼丸似乎在等待指令。）
汪汪！（虎狼丸迅速到达了指定位置。）
汪……嗷！（虎狼丸的速度很快，不过及时停下来了。）
咕噜噜噜……汪！！（虎狼丸召唤了人格面具！）
嗷呜——！（虎狼丸取得了先机！）
汪呜……汪！（虎狼丸攻向了敌人！）
汪——嗷！！（虎狼丸的气势震慑了敌人！）
汪呜……（虎狼丸敬佩地摇着尾巴。）
汪汪，汪！（虎狼丸很开心，但请小心不要被他扑倒。）
汪……汪汪！（虎狼丸对着逃走的敌人吠叫不止，似乎想去追赶。）
汪……嗷呜……汪汪！（虎狼丸挡住了敌人，不停大吠，听起来十分焦急。）
呼……（虎狼丸在地毯上打了个滚。）
汪……！（虎狼丸开心地摇着尾巴，似乎很想一起玩耍。）
哼……（虎狼丸看起来非常惬意，请继续摸摸他的下巴。）
明日方舟。
汪汪汪，汪汪！（虎狼丸叼来了一个纸袋，他看起来很有精神。纸袋里有在圣髑安所许愿用的喷漆，还有一枚硬币。是同伴们拜托他送来了纸袋吗？）
汪，汪嗷……？（虎狼丸绕着你转了两圈，难道他是想要出门去散步？）
汪……呼！汪，汪汪！（虎狼丸叫醒了你，亲热地舔了舔你的脸。不知从哪儿传来了隐约的音乐声和学生们的声音，还闻到了蛋糕的甜香……虎狼丸是想带你一起过去吗？）
汪，汪汪！……汪？汪！（虎狼丸似乎对校庆很激动，于是带他一起来参加了。可能是感受到了庆典的氛围，他看起来很开心。帮虎狼丸拿了一块他也能吃的蛋糕，他高兴地摇起了尾巴。）

archives:
在虎狼丸在校时间的争夺中，本班取得了无可置疑的胜利，这是班级年历中值得书写的一笔。
本班的竞争对手是圣马尔索综合学校小学部的某班级，也就是天田乾同学所就读的班级。对方班级的代表主张，小学部是天田同学和虎狼丸最初入学的校部，虽然虎狼丸没有进行正式的入学登记，但原则上他应当是小学部的成员。所以，在虎狼丸一周五天的上课日中，小学部应当拥有三天。本班代表则指出，中学部的户外课程占比更高，自由活动场地的面积也显著大于小学部，为虎狼丸的身心健康考虑，中学部才更适合虎狼丸活动。
双方僵持不下，争论也逐渐滑向了小学部和中学部之间的名誉战争，直到虎狼丸自身出面终结了这一乱局。在埃癸斯同学的帮助下，虎狼丸表示希望周一、周三、周五待在中学部，周二和周四待在小学部。小学部的班级代表激动之下放声大哭，好在虎狼丸及时上前，依偎在该代表身旁，安抚了他的情绪，避免了“本班学生欺负小学生”的流言诞生。让我们感谢虎狼丸。

*贴在本页的便签之一：可是老师，周五一整天虎狼丸明明都待在你的办公室呀，这一点不用提吗？
*贴在本页的便签之二：这是虎狼丸和我的约定。没关系，不妨碍我们班的胜利。
