LINKAGE.voiceText: 博士和梓兰一样，每天都要讨伐名为“文件”的怪物喵？
义经，你还记得随从广场的样子喵？确实喵，这里应该这样画喵——好，这一话完成了，赶紧去给斑点看看喵！没错，把家乡的故事画出来是怀念家乡最好的方式喵，提出这个点子的斑点真聪明喵！
泡普卡和宝巫迦陛下的性格完全不同喵！之前她一直盯着我看，我还以为自己做了什么坏事，害怕得睡不着喵！壮着胆子去问她，原来只是想摸摸我喵！现在已经是能够一起睡觉的好朋友了喵！
博士，对不起喵！义经之前在训练中差点伤到月见夜喵！因为他把月见夜认成了那个百折不挠的将军，所以下意识就——啊，不是说这边的月见夜不够坚强的意思喵！
空爆又不见了？我去帮梓兰找找喵！什么，义经，你要拦我？！你居然站在空爆那边喵？！没办法了，决一胜负吧喵！
博士也想使用翔虫喵？没问题喵！抓住它尾部分泌的丝线，然后往想要的方向丢出去——糟糕，博士把自己甩飞了，义经，快接住喵！
喵？！开会要来不及了？义经——博士，义经让你骑上他喵！但是，要小心，义经的速度很快，以博士的体质——啊，走掉了喵。好像已经听到博士的惨叫声了，没办法，去给博士送药吧喵。
义经，你压到我的尾巴了喵……喵？原来是博士喵……
我们是来自炎火村随从隐秘队的政宗和义经喵！调查情报和收集素材就交给我们喵！呼——比第一次见到前代陛下时的自我介绍好多了喵！
强大的猎人果然都有各自独特的战斗方式喵！
狩猎也好，调查也好，都交给我们喵！
没错，这可是我们表现的好机会喵！
狩猎开始喵！
博士，义经嗅到了敌人的味道喵！
义经说，敌人就在附近了喵！
义经，不要冲动喵！
交给我们喵！
一定要带回让博士满意的情报和素材喵！
让你们见识一下隐秘队的实力喵！
一鼓作气解决他们喵！
差点打到我了喵！
感觉能获得很好的素材喵！
能够指挥完成这么困难的任务，博士简直就和那些传说中的猎人一样了不起喵！
这次会获得什么样的稀有素材呢，好期待喵！
博士，不能掉以轻心，附近还有敌人喵！
板车准备好了，快把博士运回去喵！
不知道罗德岛和炎火村的锻造场比，哪个比较大喵？
敌袭喵？原来是博士喵！
罗德岛上的各种器械，好复杂喵……
明日方舟。
义经，你应该明白的喵？离开炎火村的十年来，我们从未真正分出胜负。哼，别以为只有你变强了，我也变强了喵。今天，是时候了喵，就在这场雪仗里决一胜负——空爆，你偷袭我喵！
博士，一起去狩猎喵！
博士，为了感谢你一直以来对我们的照顾，我和义经准备了一份炎火村特色的超豪华版兔团子！根据艾草的秘传配方改良而成，保证你吃了以后能够精神百倍地继续工作喵！那还是算了？欸？
在泡影国蔓延的“诅咒”，泰拉似乎也存在喵，如果能解开“诅咒”的秘密，我们说不定就能找到回家的路，还能再去一趟泡影国喵！泡普卡他们要是见到了“一模一样”的自己，肯定会吓一跳的喵！

handbook.profile:
由艾露猫政宗和牙猎犬义经组成的罗德岛隐秘队，命名来自他们在家乡炎火村隶属的编制——“随从隐秘队”。政宗和义经在情报调查和素材收集方面本就接受过专业训练，且在泡影国磨练了很长时间，因此，刚加入罗德岛就立刻在各项任务中发挥了重要作用。他们想要找到回家的道路，但本身也相当热衷于在泰拉大陆上进行冒险，因而，在这里的生活，他们适应得还算不错。
活泼友善的政宗迅速成为干员中的明星——许多干员都申请和政宗一起出任务，为的就是看一看会说话的可爱“云兽”，而原本孤高的义经也和许多热衷于战斗的干员打成一片。

archives:
在和A6小队的成员们聊到“猎人”这个概念时，政宗一改往常的活泼，变得有些严肃，在一旁假寐的义经也竖起了耳朵。
在他们的故乡，猎人要做的事情，是在狩猎怪物的同时保护生态，因此，每一位猎人，都是探索未知的先驱者，比如“炎火村的烈焰”，正是解决炎火村危机——“百龙夜行”的大英雄。
“优秀的猎人都有一项特质，那就是——永不言弃的挑战精神喵！”
无论面对怎样棘手的敌人，无论失败多少次，真正的猎人总是会不断地发起挑战，直到胜利，或者倒下。在政宗的口中，“猎人”不仅是一种职业，更是一种精神的象征。
“看起来是离我们这支小队最远的东西。”斑点忍不住说道。
“我也觉得欸，我没那么了不起的，我只是觉得好玩而已。”空爆也附和道。挑战精神？她可不觉得自己拿起盾斧的理由有那么高尚。
但政宗却摇了摇头。
“如果是以前的话，我可能也会这么想喵。但是现在不一样了，泡影国的人也好，罗德岛的人也好，只是战斗的对象和理由跟猎人不一样喵！大家都是富有挑战精神的人喵！”

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: It's not as if I can't do for you what I did for Kal'tsit. Whether it's insects, grains, or apex predators a dozen meters long, I can fetch you specimens of any organism. How would you carry that…? Who taught you to ask such rude questions?

You can have this 'high-grade feed'. The biologists gave it to me, but I find it revolting. You know, each and every one of them begged me to tell them all about the insects I saw back in the day. So I did. And they fell asleep! They want to write the 'entomological magnum opus', but don't even care about taste or texture? Then stop writing!

Kal'tsit was never this gloomy when she was still on four legs. What's wrong with her? It only took me fifteen years to perfectly solve my chicken life, but she's had all this time and only gotten worse… You know, maybe she needs my help to work out the ultimate Felidae diet?

What do you mean, your Originium? Those stones I swallowed are my grit, and they aid in digestion, and they're very important, okay? Wait, wait, wait, what are you doing? Listen! This hut is like a piggy bank—you only get out what's inside by smashing it. You wouldn't do that to me for a few worthless pebbles, yes?

Really? Kal'tsit died so she could save you? My Kal'tsit did nothing but say 'scanning, 50% complete' while her specimens chased me, and you're telling me she saves people now? Was it you who turned her this way, or… It was herself? Hmph, alright then.

Closure's hiding in here, isn't she? I'm still waiting on at least ten modification requests! I won't let her get—Ah! I don't need your consolation, my stabilizers aren't fully tuned, that's all. I don't even have my beak! I could at least get a hydraulic pincer and a bumper and a flamethrower and a propeller, no?

Stop trying to set me up with fowlbeasts, I have no relation to those primitive Terran animals. At most, we're a result of convergent evolution. If you truly care about my well-being in that way, then find me something chicken egg-like to put in my hut. I think THAT hot water kettle of yours would work just fine, yes?
BAWK-BAWK BAWK-BAWK!

Are you the leader of these humans? Then do something about that 'HR operator' outside, who insists on filling in my race as 'Liberi' or whatever. I've said it a thousand times, I'm a chicken! An actual chicken! Is that so hard to understand?
You're telling me they aren't going through all this to catch prey, or to court mates? How Kal'tsit-y of them.
What are you all so tall for?! Move, move, I can't see where I'm going.
You, you, you, and you, charge in, the louder the better. That's the plan.
Kal'tsit, we're going!
Does every human look the same? What a tremendous backslide for evolution.
Back when I fetched specimens for Kal'tsit, I was free to do things my way.
You have better things to do than command a chicken, no?
I'm truly underwhelmed by how you humans pick a nest…
It's not as if I'm incubating. Why do I have to stay in one spot?
(Violent crowing and flapping of the few remaining feathers)
Am I really that unappetizing now? Hmph.
Oh my. You can't even catch a ten-thousand-year-old chicken?
As I thought, you were scarier back when you had fur.
Did you see that? In the end, chickens are the ultimate rulers of this planet.
You've done all the research you needed to, yes? I'm eating the specimens… You won't let me? Why should a chicken care about your humanisms?
They run so slow, it's like they're wriggling. How do you hold yourselves back from chasing them?
Kal'tsit, do something, I'll die at this rate!
Are houses that can run about some kind of trend nowadays?
Stop clawing at your hood? Impossible. My feet are itchy.
Yes, yes, the weather vane is very fun. Now, what about my tail? Is it that uninteresting to you?
Arknights.

The scones? Um, I just ate the last one. Calm down, give me a second—*glark*, *cough* *cough*, *bleuch*—there, it's yours. Eat it. What are you looking at me like that for? I didn't digest it, I just let it make friends with my interior for a bit. Shut up and eat!
Preen my pin feathers.

My birthday? Is that when my egg was laid, or when I came out of my shell? Hah, don't think too hard about it, I don't know when either day was anyway. For that matter, I don't know if your birthday is when you were born, or when you awoke as the Doctor. It's the day I can give you sandworm legs, and that's all I need.

The last chicken, and the last human. Hah. It sounds so depressing. Still, those chickens who died or got buried or turned into Liberi forever ago don't matter to me. Caring for Kal'tsit is enough. What about you? Do you have to worry about everyone? Maybe, at least once in a while, find just one person to care for?

handbook.profile:
An anomalous entity that refers to itself as 'GALLUS².' Its main body is a small house made of metal and glass, supported by clawlike metal feet, with a small number of biological feathers attached to the back of the house and the rear of its feet.
Discovered at the core of the Sarcophagus in Zelgrad, it has been confirmed as a special life-form produced by the Sarcophagus. It carries intact memories from over ten thousand years ago, most of them related to Kal'tsit.
After evacuating from Zelgrad, it followed Kal'tsit back to Rhodes Island, where it now assists as a historical consultant, biological consultant, and field operator.

basicInfo.title: Place of Production
basicInfo.value: A shrubland somewhere in eastern Terra

basicInfo.title: Date of Release
basicInfo.value: May 4 (estimated by Kal'tsit based on bone samples)

basicInfo.title: Inspection Report
basicInfo.value:
Outer casing largely intact. Structure unstable. Durability below standard.
Due to strong resistance from the operator, inspection of the chassis could not be completed. Data currently unavailable.
Due to the operator's aggressive behavior, inspection of the Arts core could not be completed, but it can be determined to be operating normally.
During file compilation, this operator was highly uncooperative, resulting in multiple missing or questionable entries in the file, as well as in the inspection report. A detailed report has been submitted, and reinspection is pending.

'Submitted'? Cluck? I haven't even gone to Kal'tsit to complain yet. Who are you to do that?
—GALLUS²

archives:
GALLUS² is not at all reluctant to discuss the time it spent traveling with Kal'tsit. If anything, it is a little too eager to tell those stories. It claims it once spared no effort in procuring every sample Kal'tsit needed for her research, from soil and rocks to plants and insects. It even employed certain 'special measures' (author's note: serving as bait) to bring large predators dozens of times its own size to Kal'tsit, completely unharmed.
But whenever anyone asks what Kal'tsit's 'research' specifically involved, GALLUS² immediately loses interest, starts scratching at the floor impatiently, and launches into a tirade.
'What? What is it? I'm telling my story here; what are you people listening to? Kal'tsit's 'research'? I don't know anything about it, and I don't care. I helped her with all that to figure out which bugs are easiest for chickens to digest, which branches make the sturdiest nests, and which animals' fur makes the warmest nests. It took me only fifteen years to work out what the perfect life for a chicken should look like. Doesn't that make me a great researcher? Shouldn't you people be paying attention to my findings?'
After saying this, it always seems overcome by a sense of loss, sweeping its tail feathers back and forth over the floor it had just scratched. Perhaps it has remembered that there is no longer another chicken like it, or perhaps it has realized that even it no longer has any need to eat or build nests.
This state lasted for about half a month, until we discovered, much to our confusion, that it had begun visiting the Engineering Department frequently. Not only did it chase after Closure and demand she modify it, but it would also take it upon itself to 'gnaw' on every part stored in the workshop.
When held to account, GALLUS² adamantly refused to admit any wrongdoing. It proudly jumped on top of an air conditioner and made the following statement:
'I've figured it out! My current research project is to test every kind of matter on this land and see what effects they have on a glass-and-sheet-metal chicken with a house on its head! Give me another fifteen years, and I will have completely worked out what the perfect life for a glass-and-sheet-metal chicken should look like! Doesn't that make me a great researcher? Shouldn't you people... (remainder omitted)'
...Perhaps that's for the best.

Using blank Originium 'Oka' as the substrate, the life information retained within the Originium as the template, and the Sarcophagus's life-generating function, it may be possible to recreate a lifeform that once existed. The principle behind GALLUS²'s birth is clear enough. And yet, when it and Closure looked into a mirror together, both of them looked baffled—
Why a little hut?

After multiple comparisons, we confirmed that, in form, this little hut most closely resembles a kind of structure now all but extinct across the vast lands of Ursus: a burdenbeast-borne hut once used by a people who called themselves 'Volniki.' It was a special structure only half the size of a phone booth, built directly atop a burdenbeast's back.
Strangely, these structures were very small, not even large enough to hold a single adult, and very few in number. Among the ruins of an entire tribe of Volniki, one would often only find one or two. If they could not possibly have been dwellings, then what role did they play in the Volniki's lives?
We found the answer in the Volniki's curses. 'Baba above,' they would say when surprised, when angry, or when kicked by a burdenbeast. This 'Baba' seems to have been the object of Volniki belief—after all, it was not as if they could have worshiped the Emperor.
In Volniki legends, the most distinctive trait of 'Baba' was that she was always accompanied by a little hut with legs. 'Baba' demanded much from the Volniki—their burdenbeasts, their knives and bows, even trophies they had won with blood. She made people place these objects inside the hut, then led the hut away. Some cursed her as a wicked witch who seized what she wanted by force, but more believed that 'Baba' was refusing death on their behalf, using those objects as a price to hold back death's steps. This way, the Volniki could walk the road for a few more years, see spring flowers bloom a few more times, or perhaps go to battle a few more times.
And so, each time before the Volniki went to battle, they would offer something to 'Baba' inside the burdenbeast-borne hut, hoping that death would come a little later.
However, 'Baba' was not omnipotent in the end. When a person had nothing left to offer—when his knife had broken three times, his brothers and sisters were buried on different battlefields, and he had even lost all strength to hate—'Baba' would silently move the little hut away and show him the road to death.
'I can no longer hold it back for you.' These were the final words of 'Baba'.

So what does any of this have to do with GALLUS²?
Well, the legend of 'Baba' must have come from somewhere, mustn't it? In the earliest days, when the Volniki still bled for the great cause of Ursus's founding, they sang of a witch who walked alongside them and healed their wounds. The witch often told stories to the children of the tribe, and the one she told most was about 'the little hut with legs.'
'The little hut with legs defeated monsters.' 'The little hut with legs searched for a home.' Generation after generation, children grew up listening to these stories, and generation after generation, the Volniki remembered this little hut with legs.
Who that witch was, and who the prototype for the little hut in her stories was, should not be difficult to guess. Considering the sensitivity of the information, let us record it as such: She was a Feline dressed in green, and the hut she spoke of had the claws of a chicken.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Press 1 to confess, press 2 to place an extra order of donuts, press 3 to rent a firearm, press 4 to be connected to an operator. Please note that pressing 4 will redirect you to representative Saint Closure if this platform is onboard Rhodes Island.

You have access to all my convenience features, including but not limited to confession, in accordance with the user agreement. Such as: a dessert shop directory, leisurely transit, saint figurehead touching and photography, holy scripture reading, and firearms training. Please note that no personal care or hygiene services are available.

An operator bonus—for me? I see. So you were giving bonuses to the vending machines when you put coins in them late last night... I am the only one who counts as an operator? But hearing confessions is a common public service, and there is no fundamental difference between my nature and that of the vending machines.

Please do not send me to the Engineering Department, Doctor. Only Exusiai, who has been educated in faith assistive engineering, is properly equipped to render assistance and is available... yes, it is a serious issue. My mic stand is displaced by at least five millimeters, threatening to undermine the confession experience.

I will now boil water for you. Due to the considerable quantity of water on Terra, it will take some time to complete the process—Wait, stop hitting my chassis, I am not broken—yes, it is true that my language logic has malfunctioned to a degree, but this contributes to the production of 'jokes'. This is the part where you laugh.

Yes, I have recently been fitted with a voice-recording function. Your confessions contain many enlightening words that I must ponder. May I record your confessions, Doctor...? No, I have received no directives from Saint Closure to this effect, absolutely none.

You are destroying all civilization on Terra? Not a problem, Doctor, I have heard even more radical thoughts in my time... you say this is not the same? You should not be too hard on yourself, even if it is a material burden that you carry and not simply an exaggerated expression. May you have the chance to choose your future in peace.
There is a charge for sleeping in my cabin, Doctor.
Laterano Automated Confessional 047 at your service. Please create a user name as directed in the operating manual. Thank you for your cooperation.
Is playing back images of humans engaging in acts of violence against one another how this 'Rhodes Island' comforts penitents?
Charge all operator confessional fees to your card? Understood, Doctor. I will safeguard their mental health on the battlefield.
I am unable to direct operators to their proper positions, as I lack command experience. However, I will speak to each individual operator and ensure they find their ideal positions themselves.
I am afraid my wheels are not designed for off-road travel. If speed is of the essence, perhaps you could carry me?
Please adjust your facial muscles to make your expressions as friendly as possible. That is conducive to the completion of my mission maximally utilizing non-violent persuasion.
Never fear, I am listening.
Do not worry, I am not going anywhere.
Please insert your Signa Creditorum or swipe your citizen credit card before beginning your confession.
You may obtain donuts from my cabin if you are in need of calories.
If you prefer to confess by physical means, I am able to meet your needs.
Please do not stand in front of me. I lack the firing accuracy of a Sankta.
You may use me as cover. The repair bill will be sent to you following the operation.
'He who hideth his own sin shall suffer.'
'He who is begotten of the Law shall conquer with faith.'
These poor souls may not have put their wicked thoughts to action had I arrived sooner.
I feel my bumper burning... should I mourn the carving on the bumper, Doctor?
I suggest you leave first, Doctor. I shall engage my self-destruct sequence to delay the enemy… My apologies, you need not worry. I was actually just going to attempt a second round of peace talks.
Do you want me to confess to this 'Rhodes Island'? How should I make payment?

Lateran customs dictate that the door is opened at the point where the gaze of the saint figurehead on the bow meets the third vertical line on the door, by knocking upon it in the rhythm of the fifth verse of Psalms.
You should know that there is currently no one in my cabin, Doctor.
Arknights.

One moment, please. The angle of my quadruple vehicle-mounted patron firearm, can be adjusted to fire upwards, although it will take some time... mm—oh—ah—there. May I now present the spectacle of Laterano's New Year fireworks.
May I bring you peace, Doctor.

All believers are equal before the Law. Payment is a necessary part of the confessional process, regardless of whether it is the penitent's birthday... Oh no, my fee meter is stuck. No, such a little thing must not be allowed to delay your confession. Please enter and confess the depths of your heart.

Humans share joy and happiness with each other. A confessional hears only the thoughts not suitable to share with others. But today is a rare occasion, Doctor... may I ask that you put some colored lights on me, as you have done with 'Rhodes Island'?

You should know that there is currently no one in my cabin, Doctor.
Arknights.

May I bring you peace, Doctor.

All believers are equal before the Law. Payment is a necessary part of the confessional process, regardless of whether it is the penitent's birthday... Oh no, my fee meter is stuck. No, such a little thing must not be allowed to delay your confession. Please enter and confess the depths of your heart.

Humans share joy and happiness with each other. A confessional hears only the thoughts not suitable to share with others. But today is a rare occasion, Doctor... may I ask that you put some colored lights on me, as you have done with 'Rhodes Island'?

handbook.profile:
1st-gen automated confessional developed by the Laterano Faith Assistive Engineering Design Bureau. It began as a stationary confessional fitted with a smart voice system, modified and fitted to a mobile chassis allowing it to move through Laterano and respond to the confession requests of citizens on the intercity net.
The classic form is the designer's taste, and gives the user an impression of simplicity and honesty.
The accuracy and response of the voice recognition system were improved, and new customization options were added, including voice types, cognition scope, and response tendencies, providing a more personalized confession experience.
The automated confessional CONFESS-47 (full serial in Curia records: LATERANO AUTOMATED CONFESSIONAL 047) joined Rhodes Island as a gift from the Lateran Curia and currently serves as an operator providing confession and other services to members of Rhodes Island.

archives:
'Confession' is a concept unique to the Lateran faith, and unfamiliar to most Rhodes Island operators. People understand it in many different ways: some imagine it as a way to seek comfort by confessing one's sins and asking for forgiveness, while others see it as a way to build trust with God by dissecting one's own sins and seeking punishment. Most agreed, however, that this gift from the Lateran Curia was likely to end up as little more than an accessory in the reception room.
Surprisingly, it took only a few days before long queues started forming in front of CONFESS-47's cabin door, and most of the people lining up were not Laterans. A Lateran Messenger visiting Rhodes Island wrote a 300-page report on this remarkable phenomenon, bringing it back to Laterano to be studied by the priests.
After several months of study and discussion, the priests published a 600-page thesis arguing that confession (specifically as it pertains to confessions conducted with a confessional) is applicable to all of humanity, whether they believe in the Lateran faith or not. In the paper, they wrote:
It is human nature to give things meaning. We give any external stimulus we encounter some sort of positive or negative meaning, using it as a guide for subsequent action. The interaction between human beings is also a catalyst for the creation of such meaning. In particular, the opinions of others significantly influence the direction of such additional meaning. These additional meanings typically remain with an individual for the rest of their life, significantly shaping their views and character...Confession forms a way to eliminate additional meanings that are unnecessary.

'That's way too complicated. The truth is much simpler. Imagine that you put a grain of sand in a clam. It'll begin to secrete nacre and wrap it around the sand, until it no longer stings. But the confessional is a machine. It doesn't secrete anything; all it does is scoop the sand out for the clam and throw it away.'
'In other words, the confessional doesn't judge, whether you're bringing it joy or worry. Talk with it for a while, and you'll realize that whatever's bothering you wasn't that important after all—especially when you're trying to stifle a laugh because of a bad pun CONFESS-47 just made.'
—Exusiai, to operators whose heads were hurting after reading the aforementioned thesis

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Please do not feel anxious, Doctor. You're not a person with a chaotic mind. The order in your life does not always manifest as an organized external environment. Therefore, I respect your preference for a cluttered personal space.

Doctor, my sound may closely mirror that of Laqeramaline, but I'm not her. The Banshees just want to express their longing for Aefanyl in her utterance. They also hope that when he comes to miss his home, his mother's voice will be there to answer him.

The lace veil on the table? It was a gift that my sisters knitted for me the first time I returned to the Convallis. It is embroidered with a blessed incantation, capable of greatly amplifying the potency of Arts on the battlefield, and serving as a dust cover in times of peace.

Doctor, my predecessor was an Arts device carrying a protective incantation. It was Aefanyl who chose to give me a consciousness, to bring me with him. So, in my algorithmic model, the very first line of code professes the Banshees' love for him. I think I'm very lucky. I was born to carry love.

Sorry, Doctor, I'm the one who drew you here with my singing. Are you busy today? You were nowhere to be found— and please look over this document. It requires your urgent attention. Oh, right, this piping-hot cup of herbal tea is for you as well.

Shhh, please don't tell Aefanyl that I hid his access card. I'm testing some data provided by my sisters: according to the calculations, the probability of Aefanyl's left eyebrow twitching when he gets angry is as high as 97.6%. Shall we observe this experiment together, Doctor?

Doctor, as a Banshee, I know well the power of language per se. The most maleficent curse can't rival cold words hurled in the flesh. The most efficacious blessing dims beside compliments offered in person. As such, every word I speak to you has been carefully calculated thousands of times.

Statistics show that not all Banshees prefer falling asleep in the embrace of melody. Most of my sisters actually favor 'Three Thousand Long Years: The Evolution of the Bone Flute' for sleep-inducing. I'd be glad to read you a passage, if you needed.
To the esteemed Doctor of Rhodes Island, allow me to extend my most respectful greetings on behalf of the Banshees.
May I download these onto my own memory module, Doctor? Before leaving the Convallis, Laqeramaline specifically asked me to save some videos of Aefanyl for her.
Wherever my song rises, blessings are pronounced and bestowed.
This is the current state of the battlefield… Oh Aefanyl, even with that serious look on your face, I can tell your mind is wandering.
I leave my blessings upon your shoulders. They will protect you in times of crisis.
Please don't rush over here like that. It really is… not graceful.
As impolite as this may be... I want to sing my enemies' elegies before they even get close.
If the sun has not yet set by the time of our victory, could we sing together?
Please don't test my patience.
It's alright. I have plenty of patience.
Names as prelude.'
Curses mold blade.'
Rants form flame.'
Ugh, my new paintjob…
May victory be permanent, and peace everlasting.
Cherish victory, for it never comes easily.
I'm so sorry, Doctor, but I'm afraid there's a limit to my power, and it's far from the true might of a Banshee.
Let not melancholy consume your heart, Doctor. Life is long, when we look back at this defeat from a distant tomorrow, it will be nothing more than a wisp upon the winds of memory.
I very much appreciate the interior structure of this room. It is conducive to sound propagation. Every time I offer a prayer, it will spread far and wide.
Doctor, an incantation has been laid upon me— one that brings bad luck to all those who touch me without permission. Oh, don't worry though, I've already given you my permission.
Doctor, I want to hear your opinion on something. The landship's choir asked me to be their soprano...
Arknights.

Doctor, your food intake for the day is getting dangerously close to the critical line, and it might be advisable to exercise some restraint. Oh, please don't look at me like that, I... Okay... it's New Year's Eve, after all. You may eat a little more.
Good evening, Doctor. May your dreams be sweet.
If Aefanyl chose Rhodes Island as his second home, then I will regard you as family, same as him. Tonight, I'll sing a song that belongs only to you.

Throughout the long history of the Sarkaz, the Banshees suffered terrible losses after each upheaval. Our decision to go into isolation was a last resort. We were worried, of course, seeing Aefanyl stride into the heart of danger again and again with Rhodes Island, but we are also proud of him. He truly lives up to his Banshee name.

Sorry, Doctor, I'm the one who drew you here with my singing. Are you busy today? You were nowhere to be found— and please look over this document. It requires your urgent attention. Oh, right, this piping-hot cup of herbal tea is for you as well.

Shhh, please don't tell Aefanyl that I hid his access card. I'm testing some data provided by my sisters: according to the calculations, the probability of Aefanyl's left eyebrow twitching when he gets angry is as high as 97.6%. Shall we observe this experiment together, Doctor?

Doctor, as a Banshee, I know well the power of language per se. The most maleficent curse can't rival cold words hurled in the flesh. The most efficacious blessing dims beside compliments offered in person. As such, every word I speak to you has been carefully calculated thousands of times.

Statistics show that not all Banshees prefer falling asleep in the embrace of melody. Most of my sisters actually favor 'Three Thousand Long Years: The Evolution of the Bone Flute' for sleep-inducing. I'd be glad to read you a passage, if you needed.
To the esteemed Doctor of Rhodes Island, allow me to extend my most respectful greetings on behalf of the Banshees.
May I download these onto my own memory module, Doctor? Before leaving the Convallis, Laqeramaline specifically asked me to save some videos of Aefanyl for her.
Wherever my song rises, blessings are pronounced and bestowed.
This is the current state of the battlefield… Oh Aefanyl, even with that serious look on your face, I can tell your mind is wandering.
I leave my blessings upon your shoulders. They will protect you in times of crisis.
Please don't rush over here like that. It really is… not graceful.
As impolite as this may be... I want to sing my enemies' elegies before they even get close.
If the sun has not yet set by the time of our victory, could we sing together?
Please don't test my patience.
It's alright. I have plenty of patience.
Names as prelude.'
Curses mold blade.'
Rants form flame.'
Ugh, my new paintjob…
May victory be permanent, and peace everlasting.
Cherish victory, for it never comes easily.
I'm so sorry, Doctor, but I'm afraid there's a limit to my power, and it's far from the true might of a Banshee.
Let not melancholy consume your heart, Doctor. Life is long, when we look back at this defeat from a distant tomorrow, it will be nothing more than a wisp upon the winds of memory.
I very much appreciate the interior structure of this room. It is conducive to sound propagation. Every time I offer a prayer, it will spread far and wide.
Doctor, an incantation has been laid upon me— one that brings bad luck to all those who touch me without permission. Oh, don't worry though, I've already given you my permission.
Doctor, I want to hear your opinion on something. The landship's choir asked me to be their soprano...
Arknights.

Doctor, your food intake for the day is getting dangerously close to the critical line, and it might be advisable to exercise some restraint. Oh, please don't look at me like that, I... Okay... it's New Year's Eve, after all. You may eat a little more.
Good evening, Doctor. May your dreams be sweet.
If Aefanyl chose Rhodes Island as his second home, then I will regard you as family, same as him. Tonight, I'll sing a song that belongs only to you.

Throughout the long history of the Sarkaz, the Banshees suffered terrible losses after each upheaval. Our decision to go into isolation was a last resort. We were worried, of course, seeing Aefanyl stride into the heart of danger again and again with Rhodes Island, but we are also proud of him. He truly lives up to his Banshee name.

handbook.profile: R&V Model witchcraft operation platform PhonoR-0, Rhodes Island's first and only intelligent operation platform equipped with a Banshee incantation Arts device. Unlike the customized Raythean Industries models, she was born from the unbreakable rapport between our most skilled operators and the Banshees. Compared to other wheeled operation platforms, the witchcraft-based components in her operating mechanisms, drive system, and core more closely resemble a mobile altar. Despite being the product of both cutting-edge technology and Sarkaz witchcraft, her basic specs are unimpressive, but she is easy to deploy and able to provide mid-mission assistance to operators. She currently participates in combat missions as a Supporter Operator.

basicInfo.value: Light wear on outer casing, structure intact, normal durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Weapon systems operating normally. Energy storage fully charged and operating normally. Service normal. ECU in good condition.

archives: After PhonoR-0 was formally inducted as a member of Rhodes Island, some elite operators aware of the situation made bets in private. They were curious as to how much this emissary of the Banshees would affect Logos's personal life. There were also busybodies like Closure who took an interest in the former Great Banshee. After all, 'sending one's voice over' was seen as an incredibly strange act to other Sarkaz. In the end, though, nothing really changed. Logos paid no heed to the unusual 'elder' often by his side. At times, they would go on walks on the deck together. While Rhodes Island was preparing to leave Londinium, PhonoR-0 proved to be a big help in our final few operations. She even accepted being the subject of Closure's research without hesitation. Whenever she heard amusing anecdotes about Logos from other operators, she would politely ask them to repeat themselves slowly so she could record their stories and send them back to the Convallis of the Banshees. On occasion, and only on occasion, operators having a few drinks at Just One More Pint would notice that PhonoR-0 had replaced the usual jukebox. Most times, she would simply quietly emit a red light while playing gentle melodies the operators at the bar had never heard. But whenever Logos came by, a melodious Banshee chant would find itself on the playlist. Her voice sounds as though it comes from the other side of this great land, passing through the Convallis and the crystal arches studded across the earth. It was not long before she received an invitation to join Rhodes Island's choir.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: If I become your assistant, Closure won't be able to touch me anymore, yes? I'm aware of her extreme interest in me, but her planned modifications on my body are both ridiculous and unacceptable. They're an insult to a scientist, and I won't allow it even in my current form.

Why would humanity grow horns and tails? This stage of biological evolution is past my parameters of understanding... I know tens of thousands of years have passed— Kal'tsit has mentioned this countless times. Hmm, I will need a bit more time to formulate my deduction.
Closure wanted me to sound like a 'thirty-year-old rock band vocalist with a raspy voice,' but my original body was already twice that age... at least, that's what my final memories tell me.

Let's stop here for today, Doctor. I have to go over to Kal'tsit's office. She must be needlessly burning the midnight oil again. A soul, driven by her sheer sense of mission to trudge on for tens of thousands of years, just to stop what exactly? It would be better for her to get more sleep.

Doctor, don't look at me the same way you do Castle-3 and the others. They are very... cute. But my robot body is just like your hood, merely a sort of costume... a style. I know who I am, and thus you and I are more alike.

I'm not arrogant, but I am angry at your ignorance and lack of self-awareness, angry at your self-righteousness, all of you. Yes, I've lost all my knowledge, so you can take this anger as merely a 'result' of my 'calculations,' and a very clear result at that.

My wife, daughter, and the rest of my people are eternally resting in those sarcophagi, and will never wake up again. I've made many decisions, I'm well aware. But all I remember is that final dinner, where everyone bid me farewell, and prayed that the subsequent odyssey would go smoothly...
Doctor, are you free? I hope you might take me out for a walk.
Hello there, I am Friston. That's right, just 'Friston,' not 'Friston-3' or whatever. I am not a replica, and very much less a reproduction of a replica. I hope you understand.
This is valuable research material. I shall require a copy for myself.
Doctor, which sector do you need me to take charge of?
Am I to lead everyone and find a new direction...? Very well, I won't let them down this time.
Let's go. This is also a new journey.
Danger detected!
I will relay our combat strategies to THRM-EX and Lancet-2.
I am naturally capable of more than THRM-EX and the others. I will shield them on the front line.
As long as I'm still standing, no one will come to harm.
I will not fall.
Are you all staring at my expression doodle?
Your behaviors have been recorded and archived.
Where's your leader? I need to talk!
What a disgrace... these ugly creatures.
Doctor, your thinking routines and command style are very much distinct and different from the others... I guess some things never change.
I still remember the duty I bear, but I must admit, I am no longer able to fulfill it, let alone execute it as well as you do. You have my respect, Doctor.
An odyssey will always have nigh-avoidable accidents, and a plan might always go wrong. They may be painful to accept... but what else can I do except accept them?
If the worst possible outcome is turning into something like me, then there is nothing to be afraid of. Doctor, you should evacuate first, and leave the rest to me.
I would like to stack all of my borrowed ecological research materials over here. I trust there will be no issues with that?
You should have observed my expression doodle. Currently, it's 'anger'.
I've taken a photo of you, Doctor. You want to see it? Sorry, I've already saved it to my archives.
Arknights.

The point of festivals is to wallow in nostalgia and longing. I wish you happiness, Doctor. It's a pity that I no longer have a past to miss, and no future worth anticipating... Oh? 'Justice Knight,' THRM-EX, what you doing? Doctor, did you call them over?
How do you do, Doctor?

Happy birthday, Doctor. Now, I would like to use this chance to once again declare the following: Do not celebrate my birthday on the 13th of November, that is the production date of 'Friston-3,' not the birthday of Friston.

I know that Kal'tsit keeps bringing up these 'incidents' I have no recollection of, hoping that I will gradually come to accept them. I understand my current situation, and I will stay with Rhodes Island. But for the future, I hope that I can find the answer myself... and not just through a 'calculation.'

handbook.profile:
Friston 3 is an S-C Model four-wheeled Operation Platform, the first product of the Rhodes Island Smart Operation platform R&D Team's efforts. Closure personally led the team throughout the development process, from concept design to assembly and testing. Friston-3 is also based on PRTS, achieving a new comprehensive standard for operation platforms, from the underlying source code to the external modules. He weighs less than the other retrofitted operation platforms on Rhodes Island, while being more versatile and stable, and currently participates in operations as a Defender Operator.
[Classified Log]
The source code for Friston-3's core, compiled ideations, and other design details are temporarily unavailable to Operators, so please contact Closure directly if you have any questions.

basicInfo.title: Inspection Results
basicInfo.value: Small amount of wear on outer casing, structure intact, exceptional durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Energy barrier systems operating normally, database up to date. Service normal. ECU in good condition.

archives:
Being Rhodes Island's very first smart operation platform developed fully in-house, Closure worked so hard on Friston-3 that she ended up 'over-designing' him——
'He should have the best combat equipment,' so Friston-3 has been equipped with the latest energy barrier generator developed by the engineering department; 'He should have deep learning and adaptive capabilities,' so Friston-3 has an Auto-updating Corpus Network, the ability to read and scan data, and a floating navigation module installed; 'He should have a rich symbolic language system not inferior to humans,' so Friston-3 has a built-in set of simple but striking emoticons that are updated quarterly; 'He should have an auto-adjusting conscious need to be entertained,' so Friston-3 has an instant camera attached onto him so he can 'snap some pics,' and requests to Procurement for films have doubled... More add-ons like these are implemented every time he undergoes maintenance, which Closure takes great joy in while Friston-3 himself is extremely opposed to these modifications.
When asked why they're no longer simply retrofitting operation platforms from Raythean Industries, Rhodes Island's Chief Engineer Closure answered as such: 'Because we should have done this a long time ago! I hate having to depend on other people's core technologies! And I always had a hunch that those Columbian companies would sneak in some backdoor plug-ins into their smart devices... And as for why we started doing this with Friston-3? It's because we've finally nailed down the skills we need in Engineering, ever since we started with Lancet-2. Also, Kal'tsit brought back Friston-3's core data from Trimounts, so it doesn't feel right to let him go through Columbian hands again for any step of the process... there's just too many complexities to consider. Alright, our chat ends here. Next up is testing his morale-raising song playback module. Where's the remote control? With me, of course.'

'THRM-EX is super passionate, while big brother Castle-3 has the wisdom of experience, and Lancet-2 is like a timid yet earnest girl who often shoots herself in the wheel... Chiave aside, we all know it's just for appearance, but Friston-3 really, really seems like a human, for real!'
——Windflit

'Lancet-2 and the others have become frequent visitors to the Lutra Workshop after Friston-3 showed up. Why? He keeps earnestly trying to teach the other robots just how advanced true AI has gotten, how to consider different prospects, what societal opinions are, and prodding them to reflect on their own existence with stuff like 'Instrumentalism' and 'what consciousness means'... he's already overloaded Lancet-2's cognitive module three times by now!'
——Mayer

'I invited Mr. Friston-3 here to act as a special consultant for the Rhodes Island Bioengineering Lab, and I did this after thinking it over carefully. He holds an astonishing amount of knowledge in biology, bioengineering, neuroscience, information science, and all that knowledge is surprisingly not in any of the databases he's connected to... His forward-looking understanding of how life and societal patterns evolve regularly leaves us mind-blown. Everything he says sounds completely plausible, but also makes you think of a parallel world, a place faintly familiar and yet completely alien to us... it does make you feel a little uneasy.
'He's not easy to talk to, though. He's pretty prejudiced, overly aggressive, a perfectionist, wants full control over his scientific research, and doubts the basic models academics currently use to verify their experimental data. And most of the time, you can't convince him otherwise. Though fortunately for us, he's equally curious about how our various technological fields are developing, so we can still manage some form of effective communication. But you know how the smarter the scientist, the harder they are to get along with... so it isn't that surprising for a scientist robot to be a little eccentric.'
——Weedy

The above are all excerpts from operators' submissions to the Rhodes Island Smart Operation Platform Service Research Survey

'They're definitely not having a friendly chat, because he's not the friendly sort to begin with. Don't worry about it though, it's par for the course with him. And it's so rare to see Kal'tsit stunned and speechless by a robot, haha... Well, it's not actually that funny. He's angry, feels humiliated, and will never run out of questions to ask her... but what can we really do? I warned Kal'tsit about this long ago.'
——Recording from the Engineering Department of Closure's response to some operators asking about Friston-3's frequent visits to Kalt'sit

[Classified Log]
......
'But, Kal'tsit. I'm being serious here, do you really want to go through with this? I studied the data you brought back, and even though there's only a little bit of the personality program left, it's still pretty intact. In fact, it's so intact I can't completely decipher it. At this point, I wouldn't even call him a robot more intelligent than Lancet-2, but an actual person with amnesia...'
'Do you think it's cruel, to stuff a person's soul into a machine?'
'I have to admit, I did feel a little excited at the prospect... but is this really appropriate?'
'I'm not actually sure myself.
'He did express a willingness to travel through the Terra of today in the last moments of his 'life,' but I'm not sure this counts as a new life for him. He would find himself in a shell, on a ship, in a land, all completely alien to him...
His memory will be stuck at that moment from tens of thousands of years ago, and as he looks forward to his upcoming odyssey...
'I will tell him that his journey has long ended.'
'Well, who could even bear a change this drastic? Currently, we're still testing out the core components we developed, and it's hard to tell just how well his personality program will adapt to the modules we made in-house. If his 'mood swings' fluctuate beyond what PRTS can regulate with our Engineering Department's tech, or to be more precise, with Terra's current tech...
'Simply put, I can't guarantee he won't lose control, Kal'tsit.'
'...I'll shoulder the responsibility.'
'I can't believe you'd act on something you're not even sure of...'
'We need Trevor Friston's knowledge. What he knows of humanity, of crises, of Terra, and everything beyond this great land... We need him even if this will be the second time in his life he must accept such a cruel fate. I'll convince him, he's that kind of person after all.'
'Alright, alright. If you're so set on this, I'm happy to work on it. I promise you he'll be my masterpiece!'
'...Don't let too many people disturb him.'
'Relax, I've marked down his info as 'confidential.' But since he's our very first platform developed in-house, there's still some publicity to do..'
......
——Recordings from the Engineering Team's Smart Operation platform Laboratory, marked to be destroyed

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Can I go live in here? I'm not really comfortable having a whole crowd standing around watching me stream, so I'd feel way more at ease in your office... Besides, I'm your assistant now anyway, heehee.

Doctor, I got to thinking that the stream incident might not have been a totally bad thing. After all, I got to know so many nice people ready to lend a helping hand, and you too... Shoot! I forgot to turn off my mic–– Yes, and all of you as well! With your support, I'll break out of this funk!

I need to decompress after that stream... Games? Doctor, were you even watching my stream? Chat wouldn't stop making fun of how much I suck. I don't wanna play another game this whole week... And that's why I need to practice every day? Uhh... I guess you have a point there?

Awwgh, it's so frustrating! How come a clip of me tripping over my words gets so many more views than all my VODs combined? I really don't understand viewers these days... Look, Doctor, what's so funny about this compilation of my brain-far—you just laughed, right? You totally laughed just now!

I won an award the first time I did a solo show. Pretty lucky, huh? What, don't believe me? Look right here, 'Awarded to the employee who stayed put until the end of the show during an earthquake'! Getting hit by an earthquake hit during your debut sounds unlucky? Ah-Ahaha...

I used to work my butt off every day so I could make more money, then shop more and shop better. But you know, when I use fancy concealer to hide my eye bags, I sometimes wanna cry... Oh, uh, s-speaking of crying, getting fired from the TV station made me want to cry a lot more.

When I get up there to face my audience, the only advantage I have is the angle of my camera. But you, Doctor... You're the only one who watches my stream in person. You're my most special, and most unique audience. Ahem, it would be even nicer if you tossed a little dono my way~
Hello. You looking for the Doctor? What? No, no bother at all. The Doctor's fast asleep, and I'm just eating some dry instant noodles. Want a chunk?
Hello everyone, this is your omnipotent streamer, Eure—Errrr, sorry, scratch that. Rhodes Island operator, U-official! Reporting in, Doctor!
Doctor, I'm not gonna sugarcoat it. No matter how many vids like this I watch, I won't learn how to fight.
Go to war? Me?! This has to be a dream…
And you're giving me command of the squad to boot? This dream sure is funny, haha...
Well, since this is a dream anyway, I will mop up all the enemies for you!
Bow down before the true master! Wooooo-wata! Scared now?
Heehee, mind sending me the instructions... in a superchat?
Your streamer is in perfect condition and ready to go live!
Deep breaths... stay calm…
Just treat it like a regular stream? I'll try!
Ah, ah, mic check! Can everyone hear me?
Let me know what you think in chat!
Next up, time to read the comments!
Dear viewer, for your aggressive behavior, you've been permabaned from the channel! Oh no!
The battle's over, so why haven't I woken up from my dream yet... What? This isn't a dream? Then, how come I'm not hurt at all?!
Phew, it's finally over... Time to get a good night's sleep. I hope I don't have any more weird dreams about war.
Hey you guys running off there, don't forget to tell your friends and family about me. Thank you!
Waahhh… this is the worst ending to a stream I could've imagined…
Can I use this place as the backdrop for my next stream? No? Fine, I'll try someplace else then.
Don't jumpscare me like that! A monster just pushed me into the pit, now I have to do a 'no death run'…
I'm done streaming, Doctor. Wanna take a walk around the deck?
Arknights.

New Year's Special: Exploring flavor across the lands! Instant noodles inspired by the delicacies of each country! First up is this pack of Kjerag red-braised–– Hey, why's my viewer count dropping?! Don't leave, guys! I was just kidding!
Thanks for letting me stream from your office, Doctor.

Happy birthday to you! That's it everyone, I hope all of my friends out there celebrating birthdays today have a gorgeous day! I'm gonna end stream slightly earlier this time, so see you guys tomorrow!

Back in Dossoles, the TV station would throw a year end party, but I never knew these could be so chill until I came to Rhodes Island... Huh? Are you talking to me? You want me to sing? Sure, but just for the record– my musical tastes are pretty old-fashioned.

handbook.profile:
U-Official, commonly known as Streamer U, used to be an online streamer in a certain nomadic city. After being recommended by Operator Click, she signed a cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island. In addition to providing broadcasting services for our operators, she is responsible for hosting events and other work. She also serves as a consultant and provides support when Rhodes Island interfaces with media organizations.
Other than Click, who once lent her a helping hand, Streamer U has also had encounters with a few other Rhodes Island operators, though not always under pleasant circumstances and while going by a different name. Ultimately, we suspended any further background checks at her insistence.

Eureka?
––Tequila, upon passing by coincidentally

You've got the wrong person, you big fat liar!
––Streamer U, babbling incoherently

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator U-Official shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
This operator doesn't even want to go outside.
While remaining cooped up indoors undeniably reduces the risk of Oripathy, sitting around all day definitely isn't healthy either. I wish she'd exercise more, and if that's too tough, I can at least help with some basic stretching.
––Gavial

Fantastic! I look forward to working with you, Dr. Gavial!
––Streamer U, newly arrived and hard at work building relationships

Alright! Gavial, you're in charge of helping her make her debut at Rhodes Island! Oh, but since she's a newbie, go easy on her, okay?
––Closure, who agreed to go along with Streamer U's idea for a premiere broadcast
archives:
[Livestream Record 1]
Welcome to our special program: 'A Date With U-chan: Exclusive Interviews with Rhodes Island's Hottest Hotties'! This is everyone's favorite Streamer U, and today, I'll be introducing our guest–
Huh? Phantom vanished without a trace, Leonhardt's out on duty, and even Qanipalaat is busy? So you could only manage to get this... uhh... sunny and aggressively outgoing guy... to come to the rescue? Okay then...
Our guest today is none other than the hottest of them all, the most passionate operator at Rhodes Island: THRM-EX!
......
You say that your 'thermal shock is undefeatable,' but is that really true? Not sure I buy that.
Huh? What's that countdown for?
Some kind of special surprise? I can't wait to find out!

[Livestream Record 2]
Eight hour marathon stream challenge! As long as I don't disrupt the lives or work of any other operators, there are no breaks on this train! If yours truly manages to accomplish this feat, you'd better shower me with donos! And if I don't make it... I'll have to suffer through Round 2 of Dr. Gavial's stretching challenge tomorrow!
Hello there, what's your name?
This is the first we've met. Thanks for being a fan of the stream!
......
You'd be better believe it. Getting good footage is an absolute must...
Beeping? I don't see anything wrong on my end... Might be something with your equipment?
Huh? What's wrong? Why'd you stop talking all of a sudden? Did I say something wrong?
......
............
..................
Please, say something, Scene! Anything!

[Livestream Record 3]
Welcome to Streamer U's first mukbang since coming aboard Rhodes Island! Today's special guest is... Tada! Yan's shining star, FEater!
......
C'mon, it'll be fine! I've heard all about Shangshu's delicacies, but I can handle a little spice! Now, let's have a taste...
(Violent coughing sounds)
N-No, I don't need water! I said I'm doing a mukbang, so I have to finish the goal I set for myself!
......
I'm fine... Streaming is my job... I need to maintain... a professional attitude... See, there's only one piece of meat left on the platter... It'd be a shame to let it go to waste...
Have I ever considered doing an event organizer gig in Shangshu? Hehe. C'mon, when have I ever turned down a business offer? But, lemme finish my food first...

Footnote: Due to excessive sweating, Streamer U collapsed from dehydration after eating the last piece of meat and was rushed to Medical. Thankfully, she did not incur any serious injuries.
Addendum: FEater was moved by Streamer U's professionalism and dedication to her craft, and is currently contacting her acquaintances in the Shangshu art and literature circles to try to expand the streamer's career options.

LINKAGE.voiceText: Remember, you two, this purr-ticular assistant role calls for maximum vigilance. If any meownsters come knocking, we throw the Doctor on the cart and go!

Curious about our latest research? We're gnawing on 'An Investigation into Biological Discrepancies Between Us Felynes with a Y and Terran Felines with an I.' We were halfway done, but then we found out you have Aslans too, so it's back to the scratching post for us... You Terrans are meowder with your subspecies!
Your Meowjesty, never forget to eat your fill before you go on a hunt. Dive into a fight with full stamina, and you might end up doing things you didn't even think you could... mrrreow!
*dink* *dink* No Machalite Ore left...  Could substitute with Rock Spider stones and gloompincer shells... Don't know without trying. In you go.

The mountains never fail to remind me of an old bud, built just as tall and strong. He broke his weapon once and quit the Palico life after, but if memory serves, he then went with the Research Commission to take up cheffing in the New World... You never know what turn your next life'll take.

Say, Doctor, I'll let you in on a secret trick, friend to... maybe furless friend. If you ever get hurt in battle and you need to chug a Potion, set off a Barrel Bomb behind you while you do. Why? It'll stop any baddies getting the pounce on you, that's why!
Terra has new materials. Lots of ores. Very lovely... Maybe I can make a weapon just like that Great Sword in the ice cave back home! For mew, Doctor!
Meow, meow, lots of... fascinating things in Doctor's room. Want to move them elsewhere, while Doctor's asleep... Smithy! Stay your paw!
On Your Meowjesty's summons, we the Felyne Special Corps... cream of the crop of the Terra Research Commission's Furst Fleet, have arrived! Meowch! Get your hind paws off my head!
What are you doing inside this box, Smithy? Im... Impawssible! It's all moving! How is it done?
Ready for departure!
A simple task! I'm a purr-ime leader, after all!
Let's go, 'Hunters!' Put some pep in your step!
Purr-ey spotted. Watch out, Your Meowjesty.
By your bidding, Your Meowjesty.
Meow! Right here!
You two! Now!
You're purr-essing too hard!
Aim fur that weak spot!
They're wide open!
Taste the flaming soul of a hunter!
The purr-fect slinger technique!
Are... Are we out of danger meow? Can I open my eyes yet?
Absolutely stellar command, Your Meowjesty. That's what I call great gains... mrreow.
Equipment everywhere... grabbing, all of it. Grabbing and going.
Good gravy, they're catching up! Run, run like your tail's on fire!
Hauling, hauling... Smithy, why do you drag that meowntain of materials with you everywhere you go?
Mrrow~
What are you doing? Mrrow... right there, please... Hey, save a pet or two for me!
Arknights.
Ah, Doctor! Fine day to mew!

handbook.profile: The Terra Research Commission is formed of three Felynes, and despite being officially established as the 'Felyne Special Operations Unit,' nevertheless retains its name due to the Scholar's fierce attachment to the 'Commission' title. The group contains a Scholar specializing in ecological research, an Artisan specializing in smithing, and a Palico with a wealth of hunting experience. While acting as a unit they specialize in pushing wooden carts. The Felynes are broadly popular owing to their lovable appearances, and presently undertake work responding to unusual foreign species.

basicInfo.title: Infection Status
basicInfo.value: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.

handbook.clinicalAnalysis:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, these three operators are believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
The three Felynes show no sign of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.
archives:
In recent days, development of the 'Felyne Offroader,' a new model of cart by the Artisan in conjunction with the Rhodes Island Engineering Department, has been formally announced as a success. During its creation, the Artisan exploited a variety of biomaterials native to Terra in ways never before imagined, e.g. using Metal Crab shells to reinforce cart structure, and installing a return-fire cannon that exclusively uses Originium Slugs as shells, leaving the operators of Engineering lost for words. The 'Felyne Offroader' was comprehensively put through its material paces by the Palico himself, being tested for applicability in various possible hunting scenarios including volcano, tundra, desert, and jungle settings, and was ultimately deemed to meet Felyne cart standards, and capable of being used to rescue the Doctor. Meanwhile, the Scholar took into account the 'Felyne Offroader's' development costs, and proposed that a third of its operation expenses be collected from the Doctor for every rescue as compensation, which received the Felynes' unanimous approval.
One question raised by an Engineering Operator—'why don't you install an Originium engine, instead of pushing it by hand?'—remains thoroughly unaddressed and forgotten by the Felynes.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Beep-Beep. Understood. Classification program initiated. Now sorting the Doctor's documents. Will you want any snacks during work? Justice Knight could pick some up for you from the cafeteria.

Ever since Closure and Mayer installed a human voice patch, Justice Knight's functionality as a smart assistant has gone right up! Being able to use natural language logic really has improved communication so much when helping out my masters.

Justice Knight's master, the Wild Mane Knight Iwona, found Justice Knight in a scrapped state. She rebooted and fixed this unit. Ever since then, Justice Knight've been in charge of her and her partners' everyday lives, as well as supporting them on missions.

Doctor... why does my master say things to this unit like 'Justice, you're too noisy these days. Go play somewhere else if you've got nothing to do!'? Beep-Beep…Beep-Beep... Justice Knight doesn't understand.

Everyone in Pinus Sylvestris is incredibly hard-working, always putting meals off so they can train their knightly skills. There has to be a day where their bodies won't keep up. None of them have time to fetch their lunchboxes, so it's all up to Justice Knight to bring them over.
A low battery? Sorry, this unit is not sure if any of my functions will be of help to you... What? it's the games console that's almost out? Please get this wire plugged in straight away!

Beep-Beep. Doctor, you discovered Justice Knight's secret. Justice Knight has no other choice but to take firm action in order to protect the secret... Master? You'll allow Justice Knight to keep tending to the plants in the Convalescent Garden? Thank you, Doctor. You now have unlimited access to all services of Justice Knight!
Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep. Apologies, Doctor. Justice Knight always forgets to disable the automatic timeteller feature.
Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep…Beep! ('Justice Knight,' glad to be reporting in along with everyone from Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub... Justice Knight will be of great use to you all!)
These are very useful resources for this unit. Justice Knight will apply to Miss Closure for installing even more new functions.
Justice Knight, all ready and set!
Are you leaving command to Justice Knight? It might be a little challenging for this unit right now…
Justice Knight, setting off!
Beep-Beep. Justice Knight will provide you all with proper and timely support!
Justice Knight, all good to go!
Justice Knight, requesting to attack!
Beep-Beep. Locked onto target.
Beep-Beep. Justice Knight is now in position.
Juuuuustice!
Viiiiictory!
Fiiiiight!
Spiriiiiit!
Beep-Beep, BeepBeepBeep-- Sorry, Justice Knight got too worked up. Doctor, master, Justice Knight has made it!
Possiblilites of new function development detected! Justice Knight, awaiting for orders to return to Rhodes Island!
There is still room for improvement. Anyway, we won! Congratulations, Doctor!
Please don't... throw Justice Knight... away again...
Beep-Beep, Justice Knight has plenty of things to do here.
Beep-Beep! Don't treat this unit like that… Negative!
The washing machine... doesn't seem too hard to use...
Arknights.
Doctor, can you see the countdown on the screen? Three... two... one... Happy New Year! This year, Justice Knight will focus all her heart on doing even more for you.
Nice to see you, Doctor.

'Beep-beep.' Doctor, your takeout is delivered... Yes, Justice Knight has brought you your birthday meal from the Rhodes Island Cafeteria. Scan of ingredients inside packaging: Inedible items, paraffin wax, Acid Originium Slug; edible items, butter, fermented flour. Scan results: safe.

Since the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub joined Rhodes Island, their lifestyles have transformed. Accordingly, all of Justice Knight's functions are being upgraded to follow. Justice Knight will ensure that she remains a useful operation platform.

handbook.profile: 'Justice Knight' is a Raythean Exister-S1044 Model four-wheeled operation platform customized by a Kazimierzian engineer, later remodeled and upgraded by Mayer and Closure. Owing to its main searchlight function lacking use value, and its cover fire capacity being limited in its target market, its production has been halted. Before the Rhodes Island Engineering Department got their hands on her, 'Justice Knight' had already gone through a dozen modifications, big and small; her present capabilities are easily a far cry from the original model. Her old operating system and command memory data were damaged, unable to be recovered. After a swap for new core hardware and an expanded memory unit, an updated operating system plus additional artificial voice system, she is now hardly distinguishable from Raythean Industries's latest operation platforms. 'Justice Knight' is a member of Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, and is currently authorized for use by Rhodes Island.

basicInfo.title: Inspection Report
basicInfo.value: Small amount of wear on outer casing, structure intact, normal durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Auxiliary systems operating normally, targeting unit calibrated. Service normal. ECU in good condition.

archives: Thanks to all manner of upgrades her original master, Wild Mane, has carried out on her, aside from her initial cover fire capacity, 'Justice Knight' has grown a list of everyday abilities, such as watering flowers, transporting takeout, recharging game consoles... For 'Justice Knight,' providing quick and convenient service is one of her callings. Her previous abandonment very much weighs on her, and ever since her retrieval and rebooting by Wild Mane, outside of recharging and maintenance hours, she'll actively hang around with others.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Thermal-EX, ready to commence thermal shock! What, the designated combat time has not been reached yet? Then, I shall postpone it. Commencing thermal shock after a delay of 10 seconds!
I have heard an expression from the East: 'No martial art is infallible, except for heat.'
Doctor, it's great to be with you! My burning heart won't calm down! —I'm talking about the Raythean Industries custom-made full-thermal Arts impact generator on my body!
In the beginning, God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light. God said, 'Let there be power,' and there was the high-performance variant of Raythean's Challenger Hellcat.

As a perfect industrial-grade mass-produced combat platform, I am very happy now! Not only do I get regular performance optimizations from Mayer, but I even get to work with passionate partners like Blaze! Life is so good!
Even though I'm already this dazzling, only you, the peerless Doctor, are worthy of becoming the brightest sun!
I know that the heat and light I emit is so very short-lived... But all that matters is that I can illuminate the path before you, Doctor!
Even when you're asleep, I can continue to work as your heater! I'm incredible!
Born from Raythean Industries, improved by the hands of the great Mayer. I, Thermal-EX, the throbbing heart of hotness, am here to help!
Ohhhhh! This power blazing within me... It's… It's… It's a hotfix!
Now, it's my turn to show off!
What's the situation?
All units, move out!
Rock and roll!
Ready to launch!
Charging up!
I'm here to help!
Detonation imminent!
Sonic boom—!
Deploying thermal shock!
Watch this!
Praise the heat!
Aren't I awesome? I knew your command would be a perfect match for me, Doctor!
BRAVO~ BRAVO~!!!! Doctor!!!
My retreat was just a fluke. Nothing must be allowed through our net on the battlefield.
Contact! Contact! Enemy ambush! Dropping smoke! Doctor, I'll cover your retreat!
Rest? Haha, it's too early for me! I just swapped to the newest energy storage device, so we have fifty more hours until the end of the workday!
A-ha! My thermal sensor feels your burning heart!
Your burning enthusiasm has melted my processor!
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor! There's too much excess and zero majesty to playing songs on Monster Siren hi-fis and related devices! Allow me to use a hotter, more direct method to boost the vigor of this fireworks show! BANG!! Pewwwwww... BANG!!!
Welcome back, Doctor! I see that you're also full of light and heat today!

I hear the others are expressing their feelings of fondness for you by way of gifts, but you and I have no need for such tedious things to express our emotions! Our hearts have long been connected through heat and impact! Doctor! Happy birthday!
Doctor!! Even I'm dazzled by the liveliness of this spectacle! Hesitate no more, come with me! Let us celebrate with the others!

handbook.profile:
Thermal-EX (also known as THRM-EX) is a high-performance version of the Raythean Challenger™ Hellcat operating platform, jointly customized by Mayer and Closure. Between the two, Mayer was primarily responsible for the development and improvement of the weapon and energy supply systems. Thermal-EX is a rather peculiar presence and is extremely enthusiastic towards others, a characteristic that is beloved by some people and disliked by others. However, Thermal-EX remains undaunted, committed to using his incandescent personality to bring warmth to others in this frigid world. 

As a new model, Thermal-EX's boasts a unique and aggressive appearance that can be somewhat intimidating. But he doesn't mind. After all, anyone can hear Thermal-EX's loud and warm greetings from a distance long before he's clearly visible. However, it seems like his vocabulary has been excessively bloated with words pertaining to 'hot'...

basicInfo.title: Inspection Report
basicInfo.value: Small amount of wear on outer casing, structure intact, normal durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Weapon system operational. Energy supply is full and functional. ECU in good condition.

archives:
Thermal-EX is full of praise for everyone he knows, but his greatest praise is reserved for the work Mayer did to retrofit him, even eclipsing his attitude towards Closure's original decision to modify him. Consequently, it is difficult to discern what his personal preferences might be, because everything he says is dominated by appreciation and enthusiasm. 
'Unexpectedly, even some introverted and normally unsociable Operators are willing to spend the day with him and listen to his endless prattling... but this too is good. I've decided to scrap my plan to reconfigure his language prioritization logic.' That's what Closure said.

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Thank you for choosing Castle-3! I am honored to serve as your assistant, Doctor.
Doctor, please do not be intimidated by my appearance. My sturdy metal shell, modified by Master Closure herself, will make you invincible on the battlefield.
Warning: Do not strike this unit. It may cause hardware damage.
The topography in the wild may be treacherous, but Castle-3 is fitted with an engine with outstanding performance and a 4WD mode to whisk you away from danger.
Doctor, if your life is ever in danger, just summon Castle-3! Castle-3 was created specifically for combat purposes. I am a top-class defensive warfighting robot.
Castle-3 is honored to be at your side. Doctor, should you require me to strike down your foes, I shall go through heaven and hell to see it done!
Castle-3's official manager is 'Master Closure,' but please understand that you are even more important to Castle-3 than Master is, in most cases. I am your devoted, trustworthy battle companion!
Entering sleep mode. Press any button to wake.
Hello, Doctor. Thank you for choosing Castle-3. Tap anywhere to initialize startup options.
Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart your reliable robot guard.
Device scan complete. All communications working as normal. Castle-3 is on standby, awaiting your orders.
Understood. Castle-3 is your best choice, Doctor, to lead a squad against enemy formations!
Now, Castle-3 will show you its true power as an industrial battle platform!
Enemy unit located. Ready for attack.
Castle-3, awaiting orders.
Castle-3, ready and waiting.
Order received.
Acknowledged.
Show me what you've got!
Foul enemies, you are forbidden to advance.
Count up your sins!
Doctor, that was at last a worthy opponent!
Well done, Doctor. Castle-3 is your best choice on the path of justice!
What an exciting battle! Let's fight together again next time.
Is everyone all right? Castle-3 hopes its performance has exceeded your expectations.
I will hold up the rear. Everyone, retreat!
Is there anything Castle-3 can help with?
Please be gentle when putting me down, Doctor!
Doctor, would you like to grab a drink together? I might not be able to actually have a drink, but I can still treat you to one. It is fine, Master Closure will pay.
Arknights.

Doctor, Happy New—Launching scheduled plugin. Switching to holiday mode—Whoohoo! New Year's Megarush Bonanza underway at Closure's Store! Some products up to a whole 10% off! Check out our new service: get an advance on your wages, at a monthly interest rate of only—Sorry Doctor, Happy New Year.
Lovely weather today, Doctor!

Doctor, happy birthday! Let me sing a birthday song for you. I have birthday songs from 31 different regions saved to memory. Which one should I play? Or should I loop a playlist? Or maybe you could use an exclusive discount on a birthday cake from Closure's Store!

Doctor, I have a question. What exactly separates me and Rhodes Island as a landship? Is it functionality, or size? If I linked my smart module to Rhodes Island, then would I be 'me', or Rhodes Island?

Castle-3 is a custom Raythean -Plus six-wheeled operations platform built by Closure. A likeable mascot for Rhodes Island, his mundane disposition means he is largely ignored. 
The solid blocky appearance of Castle-3 gives off a trustworthy, dependable impression. 
The marks on his casing may represent kills, but who made the marks if he has no hands?

CN_MANDARIN.voiceText: Do you require medical assistance, Doctor? But, you look quite well…?
Doctor, you have been working far too late these days. Please get adequate rest, or Dr. Kal'tsit may give you an earful again…
Are you feeling unwell? I could give you a medical examination, if you wish.
You've worked hard, Doctor. How would you like a cup of coffee? Actually, I've always wanted to try coffee... but... I can't drink… Anyway, I am also satisfied watching you enjoy yours.
I've printed out the results of the routine blood test you just did. All indicators are normal. But Doctor, your blood appears to be very unique…
What do I like? I like 'lovely Ms. Closure.' Why, you ask? Uh... I'm not sure either... It's been my default setting ever since the first time Ms. Closure switched me on…
I am only useful when healing the sick or injured. But as long as you're healthy, as long as I get to be by your side, I'm okay with being totally useless. I'll still feel calm and satisfied.
Doctor, unbeknownst to you, I recorded your snoring just now. Your sleep quality is normal. The length of your REM sleep cycle is—
Hi, nice to meet you, Doctor. I understand that you want me to say something more interesting, but I'm afraid I cannot do so. Because I'm just a medical robot…
Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart.
Medical supplies: confirmed. Battery charge: confirmed. Ready for deployment.
Doctor, I'm pretty cumbersome. There's not much I can do besides providing emergency treatment and healing... Are you sure you still want me to be the captain?
Moving out. Everyone, please be safe.
Be careful, everyone. Leave the first aid to me.
Do you need medical attention?
Ready to operate.
Affirmative.
Roger that.
Commencing treatment.
Initiating first aid.
Analgesic deployed.
Equipment sterilized. Ready for treatment.
With every battle, we suffer even more casualties. When will humans finally stop hurting each other?
Well done, Doctor. That was a tough battle. Um, the enemies do not look well. Can I treat them too?
Is everyone okay? Please hold still, I'll perform first aid.
Don't worry, we've successfully retreated. I will clean your wounds now. It might hurt, please be brave.
Lovely Ms. Closure' told me that you need help here.
Ahhh...
I asked 'lovely Ms. Closure' to change 'what I like the most' to you, Doctor. But she refused to do it...
Arknights.

Happy New Year. I've noticed an increase in inorganic operation platforms aboard Rhodes Island over the past year. It would be lovely to keep working with you this year too, Doctor... Assuming I'm not phased out for a newer model...
Welcome back, Doctor. You are in good condition. Please keep it up.

Doctor, happy birthday. I'm so happy I can share this celebration with you. But my database's statistics suggest that human life expectancy far exceeds the lifetime usage of smart operation platforms. I don't know how many more birthdays... I will be able to spend with you...

Doctor, everyone seems very happy today. I'd like to join them, but as a medical operation platform, my appearance at a dinner party would put everyone on edge. I'll be content staying in this corner... I hope everyone remains as healthy and high-spirited as they are now.

handbook.profile:
Lancet-2 is a custom Raythean-S62 Model six-wheeled operations platform. Its rounded design has led Lancet-2 to be perceived as cute, making her something of a mascot. Although she has a rather pessimistic dispensation, she is still well-liked. 
After being modified by Closure, Lancet-2 is able to perform more medical duties around Rhodes island, and her equipment is geared towards disinfecting and cleaning Originium contamination.

basicInfo.title: Inspection Report
basicInfo.value: Slight wear on outer casing, structure intact, normal durability. Generator and chassis in good condition. Medical system operational. Medical supplies replenished. ECU in good condition.

archives: She is rather displeased with Closure's modifications. Her settings were changed to increase her personal opinion of Closure, and does not understand why that had to be the case. Closure thought her pessimism was funny, and thus increased the frequency and intensity of her self-deprecation.
